review_body: This is not lined with flannel, it is some shiny material. Will try it and not send back, but not really happy with the quality.

product_title: Therm-a-Rest RidgeRest SOLite Mattress
review_body:
Pros: lightweight, wide, slip-resistant
Cons: bulky, fragile

I bought several of these for my [young] kids. Works well for them on a 30-40degree night, with the same rated bag. I took one with me to put under my therma-rest self-inflating mat... it was very comfortable and warm, with little added weight. It was bulky and a bit out of place on my pack.

product_title: Kryptonite Kryptoflex 815 Combo Cable Bicycle Lock,FLEX 815 COMBO CABLE
review_body: Cheap cable to deter theft. Don't expect this to protect your bike - it won't. This cable can be cut in less than a few seconds, however, when you use both a cable and u-lock, in the proper place, it can make bike theft occur less often. Make your bike harder to steal!

product_title: Dakine Snowboarding Spike Stomp
review_body: bought this stomp pad for my snowboard, what else do you want? it works great, my boot never slips, and I cut it into 3 rows and 2 rows like everyone else was saying and it worked great.

product_title: Energizer Night Strike LED Light with Swivel Head
review_body:
I have semi-heavily used this light over the past ~2 years. Its dented and all dinged up from the use. Its a great camp-site tool, and night trail lighter. I got a great deal on it from Craig, the owner of Illuminationsupply. The only thing I really don't like about it is the visible PWM flickering in the lower modes. Love the form and ergonomics overall. It clips securely to my pack shoulder strap and I never once worry about it falling off. I wrapped some 550 around it just to make sure it stays planted. Mine recently developed a flicker condition when the head is rotated to the \\"straight\\" position... so I have to keep it turned to 90 degrees, which is my preferred configuration anyways.

it is a bit big and bulky compared to my much smaller 1AA Zebralight and Fenix MC10. Both of which emit about the same Lumens (~100L) OTF. I think size overall is another one of its drawbacks.

I love the RED led light for preserving my night vision, Awesome and its easy to activate the different modes/colors. I also like the big orange \\"kill switch\\", that effectively serves as a lockout switch to prevent accidental turn-ons when stowed at the bottom of a BOB or pack.

4 stars overall. I'd give it 5 if it did not flicker when turned straight.

product_title: Packtowl Original Superabsorbent Towel
review_headline: Works very well, 2 is a nice luxury for a full size man
review_body: The towel works, but I plan on bringing two during my next trip. They are so light and compact it is worth the luxury of having a second one. Particularly if it rains all day and you can't dry the first one out. The little mesh bag it comes in is very handy.

product_title: Suunto Observer Replacement Strap Kit
review_body: I've had 2 of these bands break within 6 months of wear. Pathetic. I love the watch but these bands are brutal. Definitely making me think about a different brand so I don't have to keep buying expensive bands that don't last.

review_body: Haven't had to use these yet, and actually, I hope I never do.  Bought these for emergencies only, and it's great knowing that they're in my truck if I ever do need them.  Fast shipping and great price too.

review_body: I purchased this item not too long ago. This ghillie suit is very light-weight and comfortable. I use it hunting and its great! The quality is very nice, easy to throw onto the ground and pick up foliage for the terrain you are in.

review_body:

product_title: Bike Peddler Take A Look Cycling Eyeglass Mirror
review_body:
The mirror does everything it is supposed to: very light yet durable, great visibility of behind me, it doesn't block my forward vision, it's highly adjustable, and it goes on/stays on the edge of my helmet visor. There is no excessive vibration and no need to re-adjust it unless you bump it. It's small enough to fit easily in my sunglasses case when I'm not using it. The prongs that hold the mirror in place are strong yet flexible to allow it to be attached to different shapes (visor vs. eyeglasses).

I have a lot more confidence to ride on roads with traffic using the mirror.

review_body: I purchased for connection cable for my portable Coleman BBQ stove for this season. So far there is no issue with it, working very well. I suggest this product.

review_body:

The head band is a little stretched out but not too big of a deal since it's adjustable.

If you're looking for something that will hold up under heavy use, I find this headlamp will get the job done.

review_headline: It did what I wanted it to.
review_body: Seemed to expedite the healing process and took some of the sting away from my abrasion. I would recommend this to my mountain biking friends.

product_title: Razor Sole Skate
review_headline: very useful, not the best ride quality.
review_body:
whats great about it

what really makes this board great is how small and practical it is. I use it everyday to go about five blocks to the tram stop to get to school, then i can just put it in my backpack so Im not carrying around a board all day. If you live in a city where you end up walking a lot for just a few blocks to get various places this thing can really make your life easier.

Problems
the small wheels can catch very easily on even the smallest bumps, stopping the board suddenly and sending you sprawling. Once you get used to it you know how big of a bump it can take but you have to be careful.
the board won't ride well on rough pavement
I youre not a skateboarder it may take some time to get used to, if youre used to skateboards (like me) you will get it pretty fast.
It won't take very high speeds. its fine for flats, just no downhill.
I had an issue with the bearings on the back wheel on one of my sole skates. The good thing is these are super cheap (i didn't even bother fixing it just ordered a new one)

Basically, if your looking for a fun ride or you have longer commutes get a longboard or something but for a lot of practical purposes this thing is unbeatable. It has actually made my life so much easier thats why i give it a four star despite a few things that could be better. It would be nice if they could come out with something as small as this but with a better ride quality

product_title: TerraTrike Rover 8 Speed Recumbent Trike (Internal Hub)
review_body: I have not yet purchased this bike, but have it on my wish list for the future because I have rented it locally several times.  I can tell you this is one great machine.  I love to bike, but my derriere hurts on conventional seats even the larger ones on the Townies.  I cannot say enough about this bike.  The gears are enclosed in a hub, but it has ample gearing with the 8 gears for comfortable riding in moderate terrain.  I rode 33 miles the other day on the one I rented and would have ridden another 8 miles but my batteries ran out on my cell phone and I had no more radio to entertain me while I pedaled.

product_title: Big Skinny Men's World Leather Bi-Fold Slim Wallet, Holds Up to 35 Cards
review_headline: Replacing an all-nylon Big Skinny World wallet
review_body:
I replaced an all-nylon Big Skinny World wallet with this one. After a year and a half, the billfold lining in the all-nylon World was getting a little torn.

The black leather looks a bit classier. it's a little thicker than the all-nylon version, but that's expected, and it's still a lot thinner than any other (non-Big Skinny) wallet I've ever owned.

It's a bit harder to get cards in and out than my previous all-nylon World. The leather isn't as flexible as the all-nylon World I had before, but some of this is likely due to it needing to break in a bit.

product_title: NALGENE Tritan OTG BPA-Free Water Bottle 24 Oz

review_body: This is a one awesome looking Zippo lighter. When I received it iw was like WOW it even looks better than it does in the picture. The eyes are green which make it even more awesome. I love it.

review_body:

It comes with a shoulder strap that clips onto plastic d-rings, which can be stored in a small, velcro, side pocket (big enough for 2 CO2 cartridges or a small flashlight).

review_body: This one arrived a month later than the first... The batteries worked in it and the button worked too. Basically, out of two lights... one worked flawlessly and one was unusable. For the price... the risk may be worth it to you. Very bright!

product_title: Therm-A-Rest Women's Prolite Plus
review_body: It says" women's" but the outdoors doesnt care if your sleeping pad is purple on one side. I got this for a deployment and used this thing A LOT. This one is a little smaller, but I'm 5'9" and the reason i wanted a smaller pad is: they fit better INSIDE the sleeping bag. Do this and you will be warmer, and you will not roll off your pad onto the cold ground. it packs down small, and if we were on multiday ops, I always had this.

review_body:

However, I have found the helmet portion to be very small, while the \\"100%\\" adjustable strap is way too big for the size head that would fit in the helmet. In other words, the largest head that will fit in the helmet will be still on the low end of the adjustment strap. Seems strange to me. Anyway, it has worked well for us for these few months.

product_title: RainStoppers   Umbrella
review_body: My 6 year old really liked the design and found it easy to operate.  My first thought was the plastic handle looked a little cheap, but I think it'll hold up well enough.  Overall, a good deal for the price.

THe measurement on it have also helped out in a pinch!

review_body: Good replacement pedal for the price, my kid seized the original pedal up on his NEXT 20" bike and this works great. Easy to install and no hassle with shipping.

product_title: SKY LANTERNS 10 Pack - Assorted Colors
review_body: although they are much bigger than i expected, they are very hard to light & easily burns holes in them if you ever get them to go, causing them to fall quickly and in the case of the last one, didn't quit burning on impact; i.e. almost started a fire.

product_title: NiteRider Lumina 350 Light
review_headline: Good battery life, very visible, right price.
review_body:
I've seen mixed reviews on this and decided to take the gamble. I'm pleasantly surprised! I've done a few dozen rides with it and am yet to completely drain the battery. I've had it fully on/low beam for two hours in the woods, and done a ~3 hour road ride with it in strobe mode and it lasted the entire time. The bar mount is well made and easy to use and the chassis is rugged.

I'm only knocking off a star for it because it did not come with a proper wall plug, just a USB cable. I had a standard USB/110 adapter kicking around from other devices, but for the price of these I would expect them to come with a means to plug in the USB charging cable. While it makes sense for more "tech" devices (like a GPS) to plug into a computer to be charged, this is a headlamp, and there is zero benefit (obviously) from plugging it into a computer. It should have come with a wall plug, and a much longer charging cable.

Other than that, it does the job and is a decent somewhat inexpensive light that lasts a good while.

review_body: Very easy and quick to set it up all by myself, but is best set up with another person.  Plenty of room inside for several people. product_title: TRP CX9 Linear Pull Bicycle Brake Set
review_body:
Easy install, great stopping power, easy to modulate, (almost) no squeal. These took care of the terrible fork chatter/shudder that I had with the previously installed cantis - what else would one want. These are close to perfect. Highly recommended.

Update after one full race season and plenty of gravel riding: These are still on my bike, and will stay. I have changed to Koolstop salmon pads for aluminum rims, which has further improved brake feel and durability (one particularly muddy race and the original TRP brake pads were done, which made for some interesting situations towards the end of the race). Pad change is easy, no fumbling with tiny micro-allen keys and even smaller screws (as on Avid Ultimates). Instead, nicely sized lock screws in the brake pad holder, plus good access to the lock screw.

review_body: I bought these because I have reynalds, poor circulation in my hands and feet, it feels like they are either to hot or not hot enough, I want a pair that doesn't feel hot but keeps my feet at 75-85 degrees. product_title: Black Diamond Equipment Storm Headlamp
review_body:
While this product is waterproof, moisture can get inside depending on the conditions of when you use this product. If you don't clean it out, it will mold. This may or may not affect the circuits required for it to power on.

I used it for the Half Dome hike, and went through the Mist trail. While it worked great at the time, I found out that it molded on the inside a month later. As a result, the light no longer functions unless I get inside and clean up everything. I only found out too late during my Zion trip.

Aside from this, it works as described.

review_body:

I've put about 100 miles on these so far, no flats. Grip and handling were an improvement as well coming from Conti Ultrasports (admittedly a slightly lower-end tire). The real test for these will come as the mileage rises even more, but so far so good.

review_body:

I've taken this thing out to the park to do work on my laptop when I wanted to get out of the office. It was great.

product_title: Tribe Provisions Durable Diamond Lock Rip-Stop Nylon Adventure Portable Hammock
review_body: As soon as this hammock arrived, my boys set it up in the garage they were so excited. It sets up so quick and easy that I don't think my boys will ever camp on the ground again. Very comfortable and so compact. We loved it.

product_title: Mora of Sweden Clipper 840 Carbon Steel Knife
review_body: I am returning this for a refund. I ordered a Mora Knife. Not a Morakniv knife. This is what is pictured, and described.

product_title: AXA Left Side Mounted Hr Power Dynamo
review_body:
I have this unit but I did not get it here the cost is way to high you can get it at cantitoe Road for only 39.95
I order a lot of parts from Amazon but this part just cost to much here they need to look in to there pricing and try to match other places that has the same part for less my 2 cents. This Power Dynamo is the best side mount on the market I think.Amazon did match the head light to Cantitoe Road has but I order the complete light set and power control from Cantitoe Raod and save a few bucks.

product_title: Jagwire shift-/ brake cable set Racer L3
review_headline: Produced work very well, was easy to use for a new user.
review_body: First time replacing cables on my bike, and decided to use these due to the color choices (I went with yellow, and Jagwire was the only brand that had yellow). I have yet to ride the bike with them yet, but these cable went on very easy, without issues.

product_title: Eco Vessel Scout Kids Stainless Steel Water Bottle with Flip Straw (13-Ounce)
review_body: I hand wash this water bottle every day and the gray screw top piece has come apart from the metal container.  Paid a good deal of money for something to come apart too easily without any way of fixing it!

product_title: Vizeri LED Tactical Flashlight with Focusing Lens, Cree XML T6 or XRE Q5, Military Quality
review_body: The Vizeri flashlight is the brightest and most versatile I've found.  Great for midnight walks to the bath house when camping.

product_title: Blank Vinyl Plastic Cruiser Skateboard Complete Penny Size 22" Stereo-Sonic Tail Black/Blue
review_body: Sucks!! Waste of money. Don't buy it!!!!!  It's nothing like a real penny board, they're ripping u off. Trust me

product_title: Atom Pin-Tail Longboard (39-Inch)
review_body:
Pros: Nice design. Good grip tape. Trucks respond well.

Cons: No extra board past trucks to pop up with foot. Original wheels are too hard. Feels a little flimsy and prone to cracking if over 160lbs.

Bought this for my Girlfriend and was stoked when received. There was a flaw in the paint which I was sad about but Amazon helped me out. Wheels are much too hard, they don't absorb the road much so makes for a harsher ride. You can ride with them no problem but if you want a more comfortable ride, I'd switch them out.
Girlfriend weighs about 120lbs so the board is great for her, nice flex. I weigh over 160lbs and get nervous when I step on it as the board really bends under my weight making me think I could snap it at some point if I rode it.
Trucks feel good and are responsive. All around it's a good board and would recommend to others.

product_title: Zoic Men's Ether Mountain Bike Shorts with RPL Essential Liner
review_body: I'm new to mountain biking and haven't tried too many brands. Size fits according. I did try it on at a local shop before buying the item. Overall, its great. I'm happy with this purchase.

product_title: Nalgene LDPE 22oz ATB BPA-Free Water Bottle
review_headline: Nice bottle, cheap plastic dome on top breaks easily
review_body: I like the bottle fine, and the lid and nose part is easy to open while riding, but the plastic dome, which is the whole reason I bought it, broke off rather easily. I wasn't rough on it; the part holding it on was kind of cheap and brittle, so now it's just a normal water bottle, which I already have plenty of. :(  One nice thing is it doesn't stink or make your water taste gross. So that's a plus. You would think something marketed for mountain biking would be more durable though.

product_title: Coleman 5319-700 MicroPacker LED Mini Lantern, Yellow
review_headline: Good stationary light source, but it's no headlamp.
review_body: This is bright enough to light up a 2 person tent , but I haven't used it much because I find my head lamp is much more useful, so now I don't take this camping . It doesn't weight much, feels kinda cheep, but it hasn't stopped working, takes standard batteries, and was inexpensive. I could see this being good for emergencies or as a stationary lightsource.

product_title: Coleman Thermoelectric Cooler 120-Volt Adapter
review_body: ,Works perfect , small which it's good for me work great I recomen it , I received at time no problems

product_title: Intex Pull-out Sofa Inflatable Bed, 76 inch X 87 inch X 26 inch
review_body: This product is useless.  It will not stay inflated when you sit on it!  You get what you pay for.

product_title: Adidas Ladies ClimaCool Mesh Polo
review_body: The tshirt arrived on record time and it was exactly what I had ordered. Excellent service, the tshirt fits nicely , the guide to sizes was very clear so no problems there. Glad I ordered it. I would definitely buy a product again frm this retailer

product_title: Wellgo Super Strong Double Pedal Straps
review_headline: Great pedal straps to keep your feet locked in
review_body: Easy to put on my cheapo plastic pedals and they fit snugly. So far with 2-3 months of daily riding, they are still holding up nicely, but the edges will scuff easily if you tend to drag them against the ground. I do not skid stop, so no comment on how durable they will be for more enthusiastic fixie riders.

product_title: O'Neill Wetsuits Men's UV Sun Protection Basic Skins Short Sleeve Rash Guard Crew Shirt
review_headline: Good stuff but watch the sizing
review_body: As most have already said, the size is the issue and thankfully, I read the reviews and chose to upsize to a large though I am of medium built. Thanks to all who previously contributed on the sizing. Material is good, fit is nice.

product_title: Ritchey Pro Carbon Cyclocross Fork
review_body: Someone needs to refigure the weight estimate my scale says 477 grams. So there claim is off by 25% almost felt like sending them back. But there still lite so I'll keep them.

product_title: Blue Double Lock On Locking Handle Cycle Bicycle MTB Mountain Bike BMX Grips
review_body: Their cheap and look good on my single speed MTB. Grips feel good anodizing looks good. They look on firmly. Good stuff.

product_title: Morakniv Companion Fixed Blade Outdoor Knife with Carbon Steel Blade, 4.1-Inch, Military Green
review_body: this knife is a must for anyones BOB.  it is lightweight, compact, ultra-sharp comfortable to use and a fantastic price.

product_title: Fyxation Mesa Platform Pedal
review_body: Don't plan to bike sandstone or anything more technical with these. The pegs were either scrapped or knocked off and cannot be replaced.

product_title: Energizer Weatheready 3-LED Carabineer Rechargeable Crank Light, Red
review_body: Extremely useful for emergencies.  I have only had it for a few days, but it has withstood my three year old and my autistic 12 year old playing with it.  We no longer have to hunt for batteries and my kids can provide their own power for the lights during a power outage.  I will be getting more to have one in every room of the house.

product_title: Lezyne Pressure Drive Hand Pump
review_body: My pump came faster than expected and does exactly what it says. Youll have to pump pretty hard for higher pressure but it'll get you there. Nice pump overall.

product_title: BV Bicycle Light Set Super Bright 5 LED Headlight, 3 LED Taillight, Quick-Release
review_body:
Absolute necessity for the daily commuter. I do feel much safer having frong and back light especially if you're commuting in the early hours when it's dark and people haven't had their morning coffee. I feel like having the lights has kept people from making turns in front of me and the flashing headlight attracts enough attention that I think it makes people check their side mirrors before opening doors on cars parked along the street. A nice feature of the headlight is that it has a lucent ring around the side which makes the flashing light visible from the side.

The detaching latches are a little bit cheap in that that don't lock all the time but I haven't had a problem with them coming off while I've been riding.

product_title: Coleman Deluxe PerfectFlow Lantern
review_body: I really didn't want to switch to propane but once i got the refilling device for propane cans, I made the leap and it was awesome.  Great lighting, lasts a long time all without the Coleman fuel hassles.  Definitely recommend to those that will refill their cans!  If you're not gonna do that, stick with the Coleman fuel, please.

product_title: Titan Girl's Flower Princess BMX Bike, Pink, 16-Inch
review_headline: Great little bike, but wrong assembly instructions.
review_body: This is a great little bike!  My daughter loves the "accessories" (basket & baby carrier), however I'm not sure how long they will survive since she's quite the little dare-devil.  No need for the training wheels, so I can't comment on them.  My only complaint is that the assembly instructions in the package were not for this bike, but were rather for a 10-speed adult bike.  Not very helpful.  Fortunately, I found some basic assembly instructions on youtube for a similar child's bike, and was able to put this one together relatively easily.  No thanks to the seller, though.  Other than that, I'm very satisfied with the purchase.

product_title: KAVU Kicker Bag
review_body: This is a good all around bag.  My only issue with it was that the velcro on the front enclosure came un-sewed almost immediately and I had a difficult time reattaching it because of where it fits.

product_title: Avid Juicy/BB7 Disc Brake Pads
review_body: these pads are just some stock replacements for what i had on my bike, they perform just as expected and went in without a problem

product_title: Kelty Cosmic 0 Degree Down Sleeping Bag
review_body: Being a mummy bag, this thing is a bit tight to sleep in but its extremely comfortable. I took it backpacking and it was pretty light and I slept without waking up all night. Woke up next morning to a few inches of snow that had fallen the previous night. I think the temperature was around the low 20s that night. Definitely very warm. Be sure to use a sleeping pad as compressed down on the bottom of the sleeping bag won't be a very effective insulator against frozen ground.

product_title: Razor Jr. Lil' Kick Scooter
review_headline: Your child will hurt his/her ankles for sure.
review_body: The scooter works fine… but having two wheels in the back with nuts sticking out is a killer on the ankles.  The design is a real ankle-bitter!  If you buy a "toddler scooter" you are much better off buying one with two wheels in the front.

product_title: ExOfficio Men's Give-N-Go Boxer
review_body: By far the best underwear I have ever worn. They do everything. They fit perfect, they don't creep up or get out of place, they don't get worn or lose their shape, they keep you dry and dry you out very quickly after a workout or hot day, they are easy to wash, dry almost instantly (or so it seems), and they help prevent bacteria and odor. They are very comfortable and durable as well. Great quality, performance, function, and durability. They are a little on the expensive side, but you get a whole lot for your money with these.

product_title: Kelty Lakota 85-Liter Backpack
review_headline: This thing is a gear hauller
review_body: This bag is very versatile. It is huge, but can be loaded for an overnight and compressed down and not feel clunky.  The only negative that i can think of is that the suspension is NOT adjustable, so make sure you get the size right for your torso.

product_title: Super Bright Bicycle Safety Light Set, LED Bike Bicycle Head Light and Rear Light for Night Riding. Quick Release, Weather and Water Resistant, Doubles as a Bright LED Flashlight By Turf Torch (TM)
review_headline: lights up the darkest roads for biking in the evening
review_body: Right price, decent lights, the construction is a little shotty (the flash light button pops off when clicked "on" or "off").

product_title: Topeak MTX Trunk Bag EXP Bicycle Trunk Bag with Rigid Molded Panels
review_body: i use it to commute to work and it hold emergency tools, lunch a shirt change and it could hold a lot more. it slides on and off plus locks in place in a snap.

product_title: Energizer 3 LED Headlamp
review_body: I ended up getting a different color choice than what I had ordered. The company apologized for the error, but since I needed the product for a trip, I kept it. It's comfortable and works great. But I am disappointed to not get the exact one I ordered.

product_title: Columbia Men's Silver Ridge Convertible Pant
review_body: Light weight, basically wrinkle free. East to wash and dry out without any hassles. recommend if you are travelling abroad.

product_title: Exofficio Men's Give-N-Go Boxer Brief
review_body: I really like the fell of these. They fit great and the freshness is great. You should try them, they are the best

product_title: Hydro Flask Vacuum Insulated Stainless Steel Water Bottle, Standard Mouth w/Loop Cap
review_body: I like that the flask design is unassuming, since I don't wish to attract more attention than the sound made, while you're trying to screw the lid back into the flask, already does. Purchased for school, the build is sturdy, although you might want to be careful with dropping it. Doing so when the bottle is loaded will dent or scratch the bottle, and of course, your ears will take a beating (clang!). I would advise people buying this to also purchase a neoprene bottle pouch or silicon cover to protect your product, and save your neighbours the din this bottle would cause. I also appreciate that there is minimal plastic used in constructing the cap. For younger children, this bottle, when loaded, can get quite heavy (understandably a trait of insulating flasks).

product_title: NiteRider TriNewt Wireless LED Li-Ion Bicycle Head Light - 6519
review_body: I have owned mine over four years, its been a great light! I mountain bike and road bike,  6000+ miles a year , many miles in the dark and it has held up to the abuse.  At 500 lumens on high, aimed correctly, it lights up the night with a bright white light.  The battery holds a charge as new (3.5 + hours on high)  after four years and charges fast. light travels at 186,000 m\s , I don't think I will run out of light.

product_title: Coleman 9940-A55 Roadtrip Party Grill
review_body: Super cool product. Good to have for camping, beach bound, or just incase the electric goes out. Portable easy to store.

product_title: Zippo Matte Lighters
review_body: Awesome Lighter, I don't smoke it's just to light fires, and for use with heat tubes for wiring, Works just awesome for that! A+++ remember to buy fuel

product_title: Blackburn Air Tower 1 Floor Bicycle Pump
review_body: No problems yet. Pumped up bike tires...it even has a movable pressure indicator mark to guide you when to stop; however it is bigger than the needle mark so you have to guess-timate. the locking head is easy to use - i used it on presta valves with no problem. It has some weight but not so heavy you don't want to lug it around.

product_title: Valet My Stick Skateboard Snowboard Razor RipStik scooter combination cable lock
review_body: My 9 year old uses this to lock up her razor at school.  Works great and she hasn't had any major problems using the combination lock.

product_title: New 26" Folding Mountain Bike Foldable Bicycle 6 SP Speed Shimano, Black Color
review_headline: A real good 26 inch bike - that folds!
review_body:
Great if you prefer carrying your bike in a big trunk or the back of the van instead of on the outside...

Mud guards a little flimsy, but the company replaced the ones that fell off quickly.

6 gears,,shift easily. Shocks adjust well, work well.

product_title: Exofficio Women's Bugs Away Baja Long Sleeve Shirt
review_body: Hiking in the Utah mountains...and not one bug lite on me!!! This thing works! Worth the price for sure! Great fit too.

product_title: Zenmil® New Adjustable Focus CREE LED Flashlight 2200 Lumens Zoomable CREE XM-L L2 LED Flashlight Torch 3 Modes Light Lamp for Riding, Camping, Hiking, Hunting and Indoor Activities
review_body: This is a good product. Plenty of good, inexpensive LED flashlights are available and this allows you to put one on your handlebars. My handle bar is getting crowded, so this stays in my tool bag unless needed. Easy on and off and flexible silacon and velcro straps fits a variety of handlebar and flashlight sizes.

product_title: Coleman Back Home Instant Screenhouse
review_body: This is an awesome tent. It's very easy to put up. With two people it goes up in a matter of minutes. I love the option of having the screen on or off.

product_title: Coleman Patio Sling Chair
review_body: I use "camp chairs" almost every weekend on ball fields and/or camping and this one is a winner.  It is light weight but feels sturdy and the mesh backing helps beat the heat.  I really like the high back of the chair.  Unlike similar chairs the back is tilted back for a comfortable "lounge," however it may be uncomfortable for those with back issues.  The cup holder is a little unstable and I suspect it was made small to compensate for that - but, regardless, it is too small for some 16-20 oz bottles.

product_title: Outdoor Research Men's Swift Cap
review_body: Another very well thought out and constructed product from OR.....mesh lines the whole dome with some wicking material at the forehead that is very comfortable and extremely breathable and some very high quality supple nylon for the separately sewn (ingenious!) dome and brim.  Good design and stitching....the only small gripe is that there is quite a lot of extra webbing beyond the adjustment buckle and I have a 7 1/2 fitted cap size.  Still the best domed hat I have ever owned for mountain running and backpacking.  Lots of room in chilly weather for a earwarmer or beanie which will add to its usefulness for shoulder season outings.

product_title: Plan B Danny Way Franchise 8.0 Skateboard Deck
review_body: This is the best deck I have ever stepped foot on great pop like never before! I was hesitant at first but I went for it the best definitely deserves my rating! NICE JOB PLAN B!!!

product_title: Columbia Men's Plus Tamiami Ii Long Sleeve Shirt
review_body: excellent! come to my country without any problem. I recommend it 100%

product_title: Coleman 15 x 13 Instant Screenhouse
review_body: This truly IS instant. My husband and I had it up in a jiffy. Even a newbie can put this up in a couple of minutes. The durable screen withstands gusty wind and keeps those inside insect free. It saved us this summer while at a seasonal campground.

product_title: Horny Toad Women's Spicey Dress
review_body: Wonderful day dress.  The fit is true, the color is great, and it traveled like a dream.  Very Happy! did I say it also was slimming (bonus!)

product_title: RockBros Tour de France Cycling Bag Outdoor Backpack Portable Folding Waterproof Yellow
review_body: I love this backpack because I can carry it folded up and have it handy if I decide to stop and buy something while riding my bike or want a place to stow a jacket when the weather changes.  It is not for everyday heavy use.  It's made of a very light material which is how it can fold up so small and light. Super convenient for biking.

product_title: Mini Backpack - Disney - Monsters University 11"
review_body: This is just what I was looking for. It's actually for me-an adult that won't grow up!  Perfect size for a few water bottles and snacks without being to big! Luv it!

product_title: Equinox Nylon Mesh Stuff Sack
review_headline: Great bag, but pay attention to the size and measures
review_body: This is a well-made, sturdy mesh bag that can serve many purposes. Just make sure you read the measurements displayed here on Amazon for size choices, so you can get the right size for your needs. I got a Medium, and I use it to hold my swim gear after I come out of the pool to shower (it allows me to rinse and drip-dry my stuff without having to put anything on germy floors or shelves). I am able to fit a pull buoy, my swimsuit, goggles and cap. I might even have room for hand paddles, though I haven't tried it yet. However, the buoy is a tight fit, and the Large size would probably have been better (I didn't follow my own advice and didn't pay attention to the measurements before ordering, but this bag is so versatile that I might order a bigger one and find another use for the Medium).

product_title: MasterGlow Mini Camp Lantern
review_body: The lantern was barely brighter than a candle and quit working entirely before I even burned through 1 can of butane.  The concept of a butane lantern is great, but this product was a complete failure.

product_title: Coleman 6-Person Instant Tent Rainfly Accessory
review_headline: coleman 9' x 10' instant tent rain fly
review_body: The rain fly is great because it exactly fits the tent framework.  It attaches easily and is very easy to set up or take down.  Have not used it in the rain, but it covers sufficiently that no rain would get in the tent.

product_title: Exofficio Women's Kamili 3/4 Sleeve Shirt
review_body: This is alright, but it is absolutely SHEER.  It's clearly for the sort of travel that involves beaches, skin, bathing suits, resorts, etc.  It's pretty and seems well made, but I'll be returning mine since it's not appropriate for what I have in mind which is more along the lines of hiking and such. I would also say the sizes run snug.

product_title: Croakies ARC Endless Adjustable Eyewear Retainer, 16 inches, Regular/XL Terra Ends, Black
review_body: I cut off the thick rubber ends and then super glue the ends to the tips of the frame.  They are virtually invisible.

product_title: Nalgene Tritan 16oz Wide Mouth BPA-Free Water Bottle
review_body: Other than looking like people played soccer with it on the warehouse floor, it works great. I purchased the purple 32oz. Perhaps other colors won't be as scratched up. I've been looking for a solid sturdy water bottle that doesn't get smelly or foggy, I've been using mine for Approx. two months and it's still looks exactly how I received it; scratchy but it does the trick!

product_title: O'Neill Wetsuits Women's Basic Skins Short-Sleeve Rashguard
review_body:
I read the reviews before I bought this shirt.

I am 5'6\\", 120lbs and 32D chest.

I ordered size S (after initially ordering an M then changing my mind).
It fits like a normal fitted t-shirt, but for a swim top I would expect it to be tight, especially as swim gear tends to go baggy eventually.
I should have ordered an XS.

Apart from that, the quality and look of the top is good and for the price it's great.

For the price, I will keep this one and probably order another, but in XS.

product_title: Sonic the Hedgedog Super Speed Blue 16" Large School Backpack
review_body: I bought this for my 8 year old grandson for school. He absolutely loves it. If you looking at it I highly recommend it.

product_title: Intex Classic Downy Airbed, Full
review_headline: SAME item but with pump for lesser price at walmart does not get firm
review_body: You can get a better price for the same item at walmart, MISLEADING you think you are getting a pump with the item.  The item does not get firm enough. I had to order a pump to inflate the matress which cost me an additional $9. Suggest you go to walmart to get everything you need for a lesser price.

product_title: Sundome 4 Person Tent (Green and Navy color options)
review_body: It's roomy enough for 3 people, I don't think you'll feel comfortable for 4 people. It's tall enough that you can move in the tent easily, put up your pants easily, but you do have to bend a little. The set up is easy. In our camping trips (two) in the last few weeks, it was windy as hell in both cases, it took us some extra time to lay it down. It holds up against the wind well. However, the shoe mat was blown over 200 feet away when we got up one morning, there should be something to attach it to the tent.

product_title: Columbia Women's Ultimate Catch Short
review_body: I bought these to take on a trip to Disney knowing it rains in the afternoon and the wet rides I wanted something that would dry fast and this fit the bill perfectly.  There is a bit more spandex than I would like on a daily basis but they were comfy.  Fit the bill perfectly.

product_title: Samsung GT-E1205L Keystone 2 Dual Band GSM Phone with FM Rad (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
review_body: Want a cheap burner replacement?  But it.  Want something that offers more than one ringtone and doesn't feel like it's going to fall apart in your hand?  Don't buy it.  You get what you pay for.

product_title: Grabber Outdoors Original Space Brand All Weather Blanket: Olive, 5 Feet X 7 Feet,  Box
review_body: I use this as a ground cloth under my backpacking tent.  With the silver side up, it's definitely warmer in my tent at 3am, and it's sturdy enough to put up with abuse that a mylar blanket can't handle.

product_title: Coleman Evanston Screened Tent
review_body:
I always go with Coleman and this tent did not disappoint. I'm a 35-year-old female and I can easily set up this tent on my own. First night I set up the tent in my yard I decided to camp and it rained all night long...no leaks! Although, I will add that the rainfly does not completely protect the screen porch area, so items can get wet there. The porch is a perfect area to take off shoes so the tent does not get dirty. Although this says it is a 6-person tent, I always think that number ideally fits half of the amount of people as advertised. This tent fits a queen air mattress with plenty of room to spare so you could do 4 people. I have nothing bad to say about this tent and would recommend to any of my friends or family.

Update: I'm on my 3rd summer of using this tent and it still works just as great as the day it was purchased. Love this tent.

Update: Tent is going on 5th year of use and is still in great condition. I plan to buy this tent again because it's so reliable!

product_title: Surftech Takayama Sup Orange Deck Peach Bottom Surfboards (Orange, 11- Feet 6-Inch)
review_body: This is a great SUP. excellent for surf. rides just like a long board. Could have a little more float to it but, that is probably what makes it so good for surfing. I would recommend this to anyone who is looking for a small wave paddleboard. Not the best for backwater paddling but still does the job.

product_title: Axiom Modular Grand Tour 45 Pannier Set: Red/Black
review_headline: Top of the line luggage for a bike
review_body:
I'm not a serious tourer, but I wanted to only have to buy bike luggage once and never again. From all the research I did these were the best bags to buy. They look great, have reflectors, and snap on and off the bike very easily (but have a restraint to prevent accidental release)

Only remove one star because they do not have internal frames and do not hold their shape. If they are empty they look like photo. If they are totally full, likewise. If however you put a few items in each (wrenches, spare flashlight, etc) then they droop and sag.

product_title: Serta Raised Air Mattress with Never Flat Pump
review_body: Perfect size for one person who moves during the night, great aspect is the setting nob, I have it to plush. It does make noise when you get off it. It suctions to the ground if it is tile or concrete, which is nice so it doesn't move when you are on it. Can't hear the pump or feel it at all unless you are blowing it up or deflating it, the pump does all the work. Feels very durable, and will have it for years to come. (Poor College student who has an unfurnished efficiency)

product_title: Lezyne Alloy Floor Drive Pump
review_body:
Three points about this "grown-up" pump:
1. It's not cheap, because instead of having a rubber friction fitting that works poorly and occasionally breaks your valve, it has a screw on metal fitting. It works all the time while protecting the valve. Genius.
2. It's beautifully machined. If you like to own things because they are well made, you'll like this.
3. It's pretty. So if its sitting in plain view in your Victorian home, your spouse won't complain.
Pricier than cheap pumps (but slower because you have to take time to turn the fitting to the valve), but an excellent value.

product_title: Kryptonite KryptoLok Series 2 Standard Heavy Duty Bicycle U Lock with 4ft Flex Bike Cable
review_body: i HATE the key/lock for this product. i use my bike all the time to take the bus, and when I see full bus racks I often need to lock my bike in a hurry. my old lock was great in a pinch but my bike was still stolen, so this one really works. however it was so annoying and cumbersome to lock that i have been leaving my bike unlocked in my yard. it takes about 2 minutes of fumbling which doesnt sound long but in the moment it really is. i also wish the cable was  a few inches longer.

product_title: Topeak Aero Wedge QuickClick Pack
review_body: Lots and lots of storage room - probably more than expert cyclists need.  But I'm a novice and wanted some extra space for snacks, tools, tubes, rain jackets or the unforeseen.  I have NOT (as some have claimed) noticed any rubbing/chafing on my legs.  Very good quality construction. Easy to mount and zip/unzip.  No issues after 6 months of 3x weekly use.  Clip-on light with no issues.  Sturdy, reliable - highly recommend.

product_title: Light My Fire TinderSticks Natural Fire Building Material with 80% Resin (Quantity Varies; Approximately 7.5 Ounces)
review_body: I guess you pay for the name! I was thinking about it after i received these in the mail and realized I could have gone to Wal-Mart and bought a firestarting log for 2-3x the price and turned out about 30X more tinder sticks. All in all this product is good and worth having especially if you dont want to split the firestarter logs up into smaller sticks

product_title: Maxam Digital Camo 2 Person Tent
review_body: My son received this from a friend who bought it on amazon.Love the digital camo. He also recieved the matching sleeping bag.  He just went on a camping trip set it up went to zipper it up and the zipper broke it's useless now. Luckily my husband brought an extra tent so he wasn't stuck using  a tent the zipper was broken on.

product_title: Bear Grylls Men's Trek Long Sleeve Shirt by Craghoppers
review_body: this shirt is perfect for around town in the Phx desert as well as traveling to the high country to enjoy the cooler temps on the Mogollon Rim

product_title: Columbia Softshell jacket Triteca black black
review_body: Fits to size and gives you a body shape instead of a square box shape like most coats. I can't wait for winter...What the heck did I just say?????????

product_title: Canari Cyclewear Men's P2 Short Sleeve Cycling Jersey

product_title: Seattle Sports ATC Cart
review_body:
This is working even better than I expected for my 17' 70 lb. canoe. I can move the canoe effortlessly from front to back yard or from the vehicle to the water (and at a comfortable height). Everything seems to be top quality with one exception. When it arrived I needed to inflate the tires and assemble the wheels on the cart. All of this is straight forward but, when the tires were inflated and I was about to mount the wheels, I noticed that when I held the axels and spun the wheel there was a slight metallic clicking noise in one wheel. I continued the assembly and then again spun the wheels. The one wheel still had the noise. With the cart upside down I spun both wheels by hand at the same time. After the noisy wheel stopped the "good" one continued to spin for approx. 25 seconds. Clearly, in my mind, there was a potential problem with the noisy wheel. When I called the company's 800 number, I was told that because of differing cart designs, I must email them with photos of the cart, wheels, and, if possible, the bearings. I didn't have the guts to disassemble the axel/bearing but, took and sent the other pics. Two days later I received confirmation that they had received my email and it had been forwarded to the boss. Three day later I received the following email:
"Hello _____
sorry for the delay. Thanks for your patience.
Your email was forwarded to my boss. She took a look at the photos and couldn't determine anything wrong with the bearings.
Before we can actually issue replacements parts, we would have to see photograph proof of any damages.
We recommend holding on to your receipt in case anything does happen in the future.
Thank you,
Customer Service
Seattle Sports Company"
I didn't expect them to have x-ray vision to view the enclosed bearing but, I did expect them to trust that I wasn't lying about the problem. Being a retired auto mechanic with over 40 years experience, I know that mosttimes there is no visual evidence of a bad bearing until after you have broken the bearing apart and destroyed it. I will now wait to see if a larger problem develops over time and if so, I will update this review to inform you of the warranty results. Maybe I'm right. Maybe they are right. You decide.

A lot of air was lost trying to manually close it.  A neighbor had a billows-style foot pump which had more positive pressure - it worked MUCH better.  The adjustable seat was comfortable.  My feet did not reach the foot rest.  I really am enjoying this kayak and look forward to many more trips in it!

review_body: I have built several bikes up from the raw frame. I have built my own wheels.  I have been cycling on high quality bikes since the early 1970's.  Yeah I am a geezer.  But I also have experience building and repairing bikes.  I read the negative reviews and thought; \\"just how bad can they be?  I am sure that I can adjust them.\\"  They are as bad as everyone reported.  Maybe even worse.  I also thought that by now maybe the factory would have cleaned up their act and implemented some quality control.  Nope.  They are pretty shoddy pedals.  Poor assembly plus my pair was actually missing the rubber caps to protect the bearings from water, grit etc.  I decided that they were absolutely not worth the effort to disassemble, repack the bearings, rebuild and adjust.  I returned them for a refund.  I should have paid attention to all of the bad reviews .... they were correct.  Now, put your credit card away, stop reading about these horrible pedals and shop for a pair with a bit more quality and substance.

product_title: Effetto Mariposa Shelter Frame Protection - 2 54x500mm
review_headline: Thicker than I expected, but not long enough for my frame
review_body:
I knew going in from measureing that a single strip of this was not going to cover the downtube on my xxl 23\\" trek rumblefish elite frame, however I would still like to point that out :)

Installation took a few minutes as I had to go very slowly and cut out squares for the downtube front derailleur cable clamp ties on my downtube in 3 places, and poke/trim out holes for the frame pump/water bottle cage holder on the downtube as well. Trimming this was pretty easy with normal scissors and a pocket knife. The instructions say to NOT touch anywhere on the film and they are right, I was hoping to re-use these trimmings on my fork and headtube where the cable housing may rub the frame and they don't stick very well at all - no big deal this kit came with 2 strips so I will just trim some of the other strip off to do this before applying a long strip to my upper chainstay and the rear of my seat tube.

The material is about 2mm thick and very spongy/gel like. It's a little expensive but my other mountain bike (2004 xl 21\\" santa cruz bullit) didn't have any frame protection every done to it and there is not a lot of paint left on the downtube or chainstays and seat tube, the chainstays were beat up by the chain and the downtube + seat tube have tons of small rock chips from rocks being kicked up by the tires at speed. I am pretty confident this frame tape will save my new frame from the same fate!

Reason for 4 stars is I wish this kit was 1 long piece of frame tape rather than 2 medium length strips, it's very easy to trim with scissors and also sold in huge rolls for bike shops so I don't understand the reason to cut these kits in half when larger bikes need longer strips to cover from the headtube to the bottom bracket, I don't plan to fully cover my downtube now because I don't want an ugly seam right in the middle which will collect dust/dirt.

review_body:

PRO's
1. Lots of space: with 6 compartments, two straps, and three external pouches you wont run out of space (you might lose things but not because they are not in your bag)
2. Quality Materials: rugged heavy duty nylon and excellent stitch work this back pack is sure to go the distance, it also has so added reflective materials which is nice on a college campus where you might be crossing streets or if your hiking and a search party is looking for you. The zippers and pull tabs are all large and easy to use.
3. Comfort: both the carry handle and the straps are perfect for heavy or light loads and padded well to ensure comfort not just extra material.
4. the "tech spot" area for your tablet and laptop has an extra zipper that allows you access with out having to open the main compartment of the bag. This single feature made the difference in my choosing this bag over the other comparable backpacks in the market.

CON
1. the two beverage pouches are a bit small, they will hold a nice 24oz travel coffee mug, or a narrow water bottle, however they will not fit a 32 oz nalgene bottle. I use the compression strap and loop it thru the lid retention device on my bottle and it works great.

Overall this bag is making going back to school as an adult student well worth the journey.

product_title: SCHWALBE Big Apple Active trekking bike tyre Active, 26 x 2.15, Wire grey
review_body: These tires will spoil a person.  Very high quality and last a long time and seem totally trouble free.  I am using Slime puncture proof tubes with these in my gated, Geezer subdivision,  where there are rolling hills and good pavement.  They seem easy rolling, much more than expected at full inflation of 55 pounds and even at max inflation they ride well. I have tried them at minimum inflation and amazingly, they are not that much slower, but for longer rides, I keep  mine towards the higer end of the 1-2 bar inflation range recommended (about 30-55 pounds)  One thing they do have it amazing traction, both straight ahead, but especially in turns. I often forget this and scrape my pedals in turns when I forget to raise the inside pedal and at age 78, people gasp and gape as I speed into cul de sacs and exit as fast as I came in, without slowing.  I leaned my bike at home to see what the lean angle is when this happens, and it is alarming, so I can see why there is this reaction.  I can ride over curbs without jarring the fillings out of my teeth, too.  I can't recommend these highly enough.  I use these on a Townie with the forward pedals and one sits lower, allowing such turns and this rig seems the safest and most secure of anything I have ever ridden.

product_title: Big Agnes Slater UL 2 Plus Tent: 2-Person 3-Season
review_body: This tent is one of the roomiest, and more sturdy ultra light tents I have used.  I have used this on a 15 day bike tour, and several multi-night hikes.  It is free standing - but not very sturdy unless staked out.  I originally was leaning toward the Fly Creek, but after trying it out it was too short for me (6'4\\"). I had the tent fully set up - all stakes and guy lines, and it performed flawlessly and I stayed dry all night.  If you are looking for a high quality ultra light tent - I would check this out - especially if you are much taller than 6'.  If you are concerned with a true free standing and still stable tent - you may want to look elsewhere - but you will not find anything near this weight and size.  Another positive aspect is the company \\"Big Agnes.\\"  you can call the company directly in colorado, and speak with an employee that has extensive knowledge of the product. product_title: Coleman 25-Quart Party Stacker Cooler
review_headline: Ice for 27 hrs in August, LOW PROFILE CORVETTE COOLER
review_body:
The reason to get this cooler: to fit in the trunk of a 2005 Corvette or similar car where low profile is your demand. For that purpose you absolutely need a cooler that is no taller than 10.5\\". Here are my notes from just having tried this cooler:

- Fits in trunk perfectly, the 10.5\\" height is accurate
- 18 beers fit easily with 16 pounds of ice
- 24 beers would have fit easily, with slightly less ice
- 85F, in trunk of car X 27 hours until all ice melted
- does NOT have a water drain - this can be good (will therefore not eventually leak and make your trunk moldy as others will). Since it is small, it can easily be lifted by one person, out of the trunk and tilted on its side with lid cracked open to drain water. Even with 18 beers and filled with ice/water, it is not very heavy.

By comparison, I have a standard Coleman cooler with wheels that will keep ice in > 90F summer heat for more than 3 days. This cooler cannot do that. But if you just need a case of beer cold for a ONE day event, and you have a boat or Corvette with LOW PROFILE needs, then this is the only product I know that can suit your needs. I'd give 5 stars if it could keep cooler longer - but what it does, it does well.

product_title: German 4 Piece Stainless Steel Eating Utensil
review_headline: Perfect nesting utensil set for any activity.! I love it!
review_body:
Over the past few months I have purchased all types of nesting and non-nesting utensil sets. I started with a folding utensil set I bought at Wal-Mart about a year ago. One day as I was using the folding set when the non-locking fork accidentally closed down on my fingers and hurt me pretty bad and so that was the end of using that type.

Next I tried MSR's heavy duty polycarbonate utensils which didn't nest together whatsoever and were only held together with a light duty carabiner clip. Well, I became quite frustrated since the MSR utensils weren't very strong whatsoever. They seemed like flimsy plastic and for the price they charged I thought this would be the set to end all my searching, not at all, the fork would bend easily and the spoon was way to large and dribbled, they were totally useless.

Soon afterwards I then tried the Sea to Summit aluminum aircraft grade utensil set. The Sea to Summit set was a great set of utensils but once again they didn't nest and were only held together using a carabiner clip, they made all kinds of noise in the bush and were easy to loose.

I can go on and on about all the different models I tried and at one point I didn't think anyone made a good set of pack-able utensils until I came across this German Military Utensil set. I have got to say, \\"this German nesting set is the best I have found in over two years of searching.\\" They nest tightly together, are extremely strong and are as good if not better than regular table grade utensils you may use at home. I was able to see the moment I opened the package this was no light weight set. The spoon is large with no dribbles, The fork has very long and sharp tines, The knife is equally strong with grooved serrations. There is no way your going to even accidentally bend these. They are truly stainless steel which was apparent right of way. Like I said, these nest together very tightly and feel really solid. I wrap my set up in a microfiber towel and stow them in my MSR nesting pots and pans. I also like to carry them in an old folding pocket knife sheath that I bought in a discount thrift shop. Sometimes I just toss them in my back pocket, especially if I know I'm going out for dinner. I don't like using restaurant utensils for various reasons. I am going to purchase another pair of these German utensils just to stow in the glove box of my JEEP so I can keep the first pair stowed away in my bug-out kit.

Anyway, I know this is the best utensil set any outdoors-man will ever own. I am 54 years old, ex military and have been an avid outdoors-man for well over 30 years so, I think I am pretty qualified to know what's better. Lots of guys who buy gear are just out for the flash and bling but that never works and it's always to costly to think you own the best when in fact, you really don't. Some people really crack me up thinking they have the best gear, the funny ones are the ones who complain they're gear is dented, smudged or scratched.. LOL, I guess they buy gear so they can look at it and shine it up everyday. If your truly and Outdoors-man, like myself then you'll know right of way that this is the best utensil set you'll ever own. You'll never need to replace these, they'll last forever. My search for a great pair of utensils has ended with these. I am very happy with this German utensils set and highly recommend these to anyone serious about good gear.

I hope my review has helped. If I can answer any of your questions please feel free to ask.

Thank you for reading and 'Push Onward\\"

product_title: Gregory Mountain Products Palisade 80 Backpack
review_body:
First of all, I bought this pack at REI Seattle because I needed some serious advice from a specialist or at least, someone who knew what they were talking about. My last 2 packs were so terrible and hurt so bad not due to my own packing/adjustments. I had already known this pack was 100 dollars more at REI but because of the hour or two advice and support of the employee working in the packs department I decided to just buy it there.

That being said, this pack is probably one of the top 5 you can buy for this size and capacity/load size. Let me explain why..

Pros:
- Most comfortable pack I have ever put on. Even when you have 80 lbs of crap inside of it, this pack shines as being comfortable. When I put this pack on with 70 lbs of gear, it feels like around 35 on my back

- Straps, buckles, materials - As many of you know with experience in lesser quality backpacks, this pack does not suffer from inferior quality materials or design to save a few bucks. The buckles could be a bit better, but they are sound. The stitches will not rip, the buckles will not break, and most importantly the zippers will not come apart, even when you are zipping up a compartment that is stuffed to the brim. A+ design and construction.

- Weight distribution: Even if you load more weight into the left side than the right or vice versa, once you strap in this pack correctly you will be amazed that you cannot tell the difference. With the pack undone resting on your shoulders, you can feel the 10 lbs difference on one side or the other, but once you buckle in and strap up you seriously cannot tell that one side is off at all. I was impressed. It is like magic almost. Not even kidding.

- Detachable \\"fanny pack\\": Okay now we all know how stupid fanny packs are, but the fact you can detach the top compartment for a day pack is actually a good thing. At least for me, during several work party trips in the backcountry you must split up from camp and clear an area a few miles away. While the fanny pack isn't the ideal fashion setting, this pack makes for an ample and comfortable day pack when necessary.

- Hip belt: The hip belt and adjustments are very comfortable and exact, allowing for great customization for each person. There are a couple small compartments on the hip belt for items such as matches, a compass, etc.

Cons:

- Lack of compartments: Okay, now this is a pro AND a con.. But you know, some people like lots of pockets for lots of different reasons, which this pack just does not offer. There is a main compartment, accessible from the top AND front, a front pocket which is pretty big, a top compartment, and a sleeping bag section which is very ample. Now, most people will realize that this is actually a good thing, because the perfect pack will have fewer compartments compared with many. If you can't fit something into one of them, you are doing it wrong. Usually. But sometimes, a particular item or a an item with a strange shape or weight would most benefit from a separate pocket that would fit it just perfectly. However, this is not going to happen with this pack. Like I said, it will be a great thing for most, but sometimes you will be frustrated you can't just put that sack with your soap and knife into a side pocket. Not a big deal, and I actually prefer it this way.

- The only other con is the price, which actually is decent on amazon (300 USD) than what I paid for it. Do yourself a favor, get yourself a gift, BUY THIS PACK. Your next backcountry trip will be completely satisfying.

PS: Not for 2 days or less or day hiking at all, this is recommended for deep incursions into the backcountry. Will hold about 10 days of supplies I'd say. Happy camping :)

I cannot recommend these shorts more.  They are simply the best.  In fact, I recommend all Desoto products.  I have worn their Carrera tri shorts and full tri top for 7 years, and I bought the cool wings for my Ironman, which saved my bike ride in the Texas heat. product_title: Aztec Brake Cable And Housing Set
review_body:
I bought these along with [[ASIN:B0055BF8I8 Shimano Acera Mountain Bicycle V-Brake - BR-M422]] , [[ASIN:B0055BF8I8 Shimano Acera Mountain Bicycle V-Brake - BR-M422]] (back) , and [[ASIN:B0064QG9YK Avid Speed Dial 7levers]] onto a cheap \\"Next\\" brand boys bike which was downright dangerous due to the crappy plastic brakes that were cracked, flimsy, and failing my son who was born on the low end of the coordination scale to start.

I went out on a limb with these cables because of the price point and some of the reviews of the other Aztec inner cables. The gamble paid off.

Let me say that my mountain bike has hydraulic disk brakes, and these cables in combination with the above components felt so good to me that I wouldn't miss my current brakes. The final setup was that good.

Now, let me say that the housing was THICK!! This isn't a problem for the front brakes because the cables just makes a loose loop. But for the back brakes, the housing would not bend to the stock housing guides without putting tremendous pressure on the one side of the brake with the 90 degree aluminum tube (for v-brake style). I was able to come up with a solution by routing the cable laterally on the frame instead of following the underside of the frame and coming up the seat post. Now, with that said, I don't care one bit. It was totally worth it. The response through the housing is better than any cable brake that I've ever felt. There might be better, but I doubt for this price.

One last thing to note is that the first time I cut the housing with a dremel tool, I melted the innermost part of the housing together. I came up with a better technique which was to carefully cut through the outside of the housing and through the steel braiding. Then I used an exacto knife to cut through the final inner layer to keep it from melting together.

I also didn't have a real cable cutter, but some rather new tin snips which worked just fine.

And the final result: My son is now brave like William Wallace on his bike, and I'm a very happy Dad.

review_body: i bought two of these for my husband and myself for a 8 hour flight. we loved Memory Foam Neck Pillow and Travel Pillow with Portable Bag - Cabeau Blue. much better than the cheapo ones

product_title: Bell XLV Bike Helmet
review_body: It was not as big as I had hoped for, but still works, and I have a 7 1/4" head.  Now what that translates into mm's, I don't know.

review_body: I love to snorkel, but not with this mask.. When we go to Mexico or the Caribbean we always go snorkeling. I didn't want to rent like we always do, so I bought this mask at a dive shop.  Tried it on at the store and thought it was a good fit. When snorkeling in Mexico, the \\"comfort strap\\" stretches in the water.  I couldn't get a good seal even at the tightest adjustment.  The lens of the mask is very close to your eyes.(which I didn't realize when I bought it)  The bridge of the nose part pressed against the bottom of my forehead and bruised it after one use. Maybe it's just the neoprene strap that keeps it from getting a good seal.  I don't know, but I will not use it again.

product_title: Wenzel Kodiak Tent - 9 Person
review_body:
I really liked the style. However, it does have it's drawbacks. The biggest one I ran into was the short rain fly. It looks cool with the tent style but it does nothing to hold the heat inside. The ceiling in the tent itself is four large panels of screening, so the rain fly is the only thing that would hold in any heat. We ran the heater for 2 hours and it just went out the top. Whenever the wind would blow, the fly would lift and the breeze would blow right into the tent, creating drafts that kept it cold all night. We've decided that we're going to purchase some tent material and tack panels over the top tent screening, in the hopes of making it better. The other drawback, but not really a big deal if you have the time, is that there are TONS of tie downs. Walking around this tent is like walking around in a Chinese jump rope factory. And not something you want to do in the dark. Unfortunately all the ties did not pull it as tight as the picture suggests and some sections did sag some.

On the good side, it has good cubby holes to put gear and clothes. The two rooms are huge and roomy. We used one as an entertainment area and the other for sleeping. The material quality was good, and about average for this type of tent.

I did a lot of searching for a tent before purchasing this, so I fell in love with the style and still believe that with some alterations, it will be a really good tent. If I had a choice, however, I probably wouldn't choose it again.

product_title: Black Magic Single Sheet Griptape
review_body: Black Magic grip tape is what it is. Grip tape is by choice of what the individual prefers. Don't go cheap on the most important part. You can't go wrong with Black Magic.

product_title: Pelican Assembled Canoe, Green
review_headline: Large enough for Family of Four
review_body:
I chose the Pelican canoe because the middle seat was flatter across. This would allow my two seven year old daughters to easily sit side-by-side. Other models have a molded single-seat shape and coolers (and whatnot) on the sides, taking up room. We've taken the boat out eight or nine times over the summer (2013). Each trip has been a pleasure. My husband and I are seated at the stern and bow, and my girls do fit nicely at the middle seat, side-by-side. They also fit comfortably sitting on the hull of the boat, one in front and one in back of the middle seat. So there's plenty of room.

I've taken the boat out several time my myself and it paddles smoothly. When a wind kicks up it can be a struggle, but I always win. The more people in the boat, the harder this becomes, especially with children that can't paddle with the same force as an adult.

At first I knew everyone would want their own paddle so I bought four (also figuring we my lose one or two, eventually). Aside from her maiden voyage, we only take out two paddles at a time, and paddlers must be at either the bow or stern, else wise our paddles get in the way of each other (so no middle seat paddling).

The canoe is stable, paddles well, and with a little group coordination, won't tip, even with swimmers climbing in and out. Our method is we lean the side in to the swimmer climbing in (or out), then lean back to center once they are in the boat (or in the water). We keep to small lakes so we're always a short swim from shore with the little ones. And we ALWAYS wear our PFDs.

It is heavy, so while I can get it down from our car by myself, I can't get it back up onto the car by myself. We're happy to have short portages from car to lake (even my girls and I have managed by ourselves, though with several instances of, "put it down" along the way) but for longer portages in the future, I'll want a roller for one end.

We have packed it with four people, large soft-sided cooler, and a large dry bag. Plenty of room.

Only two cons:
First, the seats are seated high. This can lend a sense of instability when there are active bodies moving in the boat. Confidence, coordination, and experience soon compensate. Plus, paddling while on the knees or even cross-legged while seated in the hull are two other changes of position. The higher seats do lend a nice viewing perch.

Second, the keel (bar from bow to stern) is seated so that it is partially raised into the hull. While it is smooth, sitting in the hull centered above it can be uncomfortable on the tail bone. I have four seat cushions (or even a flip-flop will do in a pinch) that we can place under our bottoms on the hull to smooth the keel (or even on the seats themselves, if one wishes). I use foam gardening kneeling pads (the rectangular ones, not the kind strapped onto the knees) for this, for they already have a handle which allows for easy packing simply by tying them together.

Shipping wasn't too problematic. I was contacted by ABF via Amazon by email, phone and text. The first message said that ABF had tried to contact me but was unable (I had no record of attempted contact). But I was given the ABF phone number. I called, we scheduled a day for delivery later that week. This was a choice of two three-hour time windows, 9-12 or 1-4. I chose morning. After 12 I called and was told they only have four stops so should be here in an hour or so. They came about 3. This was stressful as we had planned to get the canoe strapped onto the car and get out to get our girls by 4 from their summer camp and go directly out onto the lake after that. None the less, we made it. The AVG guy was sharp and friendly. The canoe was covered in cardboard sheets, then all of this was fully sealed in plastic sheets. We cut through all the materials to find our canoe in perfect condition and ready to go.

I'm very happy with our Pelican canoe. I don't mind the minor (superficial) scrapes and scratches we've earned after a few 'voyages' I know some reviewers have remarked upon. It means she's broken in. She takes a gentle glide all the way onto rough rocks and gravel from the water. She takes the family stepping out of her from the hull onto the wet shore. I notice the hull will bend with the pressure of feet on her hull directly on the rocks, and she smooths back out perfectly. Perfect for a family with kids. She's holding up well. Looks lovely in the water, and again, is truly a pleasure to paddle and glide. Both relaxing and exciting.m very happy with our Pelican canoe. review_headline: Decent bit of kit / heats  2 cups of water
review_body: I saw one of these in Belgium where the French  girls were backpacking and they didn't understand how it worked so I showed them . They were miffed it didn't even come with the required  fuel tabs .They had no idea it got so dirty and sooty with use , so be warned - it gets very sooty on the bottom of the pot and also the windscreen /pot holder . I used a dremel and cut off the rivet and removed the fuel tab holder  and always use a piece of foil to hopld the fuel . Much cleaner . Less soot  to clean up. I wrapped their fuel tab holder with foil to help keep it cleaner  Fortunately , I always carry my homemade  free fuel tabs when traveling and got their water heating . Notice I said heating and not boiling since it's designed to only  heat water . If you're expecting it to boil water you may be disappointed.It will get you hot tea/ coffee but it will take multiple fuel tabs to actually BOIL the 2 cups of water needed for cooking /reconstituting dehydrated food. To BOIL water in a pinch , I still use my soup tin stove (free) and GSI  18 ounce cup ($4.99) to actually boil the water for Mountain House food pouches .  It's a good idea for a BugoutBag where it will take up very little space in WROL  . Comes with a 2 cup pot and lid. We all wish they had made a lid/ 8 ounce cup combination ( like the Coleman and ALOCS sets do  so you would have a drinking cup too .It would have taken 4 cents of extra aluminum .  Decent bit of kit for heating 2 cups of water for your tea /coffee in the great out of doors or in a SHTF situation. I also carry a 2" twig stove with it made from the bottom of a small soup tin for use in a SHTF  and no fuel tabs .
