product_title: Hibiscus Stomp Pad
review_body: I bought this as a gift for my sister when she moved to Denver and started learning to snowboard.  She's used it on her board since Christmas and has no complaints.  She loved the fun colors and it seemed otherwise to be just as advertised!

product_title: Cuscus Single Strap Sling Backpack 20 Inch for School
review_headline: Good bag if you're not carrying around a ton of things
review_body:
This bag is compact and not made to replace a \\"book bag\\". The large pockets are triangular shaped so it will be obvious right away if something doesn't fit. A netbook or iPad, no problem. A large laptop, good luck.

I used this for a 3 week trip where I was hiking quite a bit and wanted to carry water, a jacket, my iPod, sunscreen, wallet, sunglasses, two pocket cameras, and some other odds and ends. I used up maybe half of the space available. This bag worked perfectly, not too big, not too small.

The zip up pocket that has the headphones hole, is almost impossible to be opened once the extra \\"cargo\\" strap is fastened over it - a good feature if you're worried about pick pockets. I used it to store my cash, wallet and passport while I was overseas in a \\"questionable\\" city.

I would recommend this bag if you want something that isn't too bulky. The extra straps on the outside are a good idea if you have something that doesn't quite fit.

product_title: Timber Rattler Golden Sunset Knife Combo
review_body: When this knife arrived I was skeptical due to the price. I had purchased a Timber Rattler Outlaw Bowie in the past and I was pleased with it. When I first picked it up it felt like the handle was hollow and when gripping the hilt the large middle section of the handle twisted and cut my palm. This knife is dangerous to use, but only to the one wielding it. The blade is made of quality metal and arrived sharp, however the hilt is cheap, poorly manufactured, and dangerous for the owner. DO NOT BUY THIS KNIFE.

product_title: Atom Kicktail Longboard
review_body: This is my first longboard and i use it all the time! The wheels are good, but one of them makes a weird sound. I think it is perfect for beginners and I love this board. This is a good item for your money.

product_title: Avenir Regular Schrader valve 700c Tube (700x35-45)
review_body: They do what tubes do, hold air and fill the tire.  Not gimmicky and well built especially for the price, I had to use valve extenders for my Schwinn aero rims but still beats paying 10 Bucks for Schwinn branded Kendas. Just remember to use Velox tape for inside your rims, Schwinn put essentially a large rubber band causing a blowout in a corner for me and ruined a good ride, these plus good tape and proper inflation beats the gimmicky nonsense any day.

product_title: CamelBak 0.5-Liter Insulated Stainless Steel Better Bottle
review_body: In a nutshell: it looks great and funtions better.  The straw system is easy to use - and if you notice that the precut slit on the top of the straw doesn't open completely, just poke it gently with the tip of a knife, and the slit opens up fully.  Not an issue.  The insulation works perfectly and kept my drink cold for over 8 hours.  The bottle neither leaks nor sweats (which is terrific if you are carrying it in a bag with a book as I do).  And the \\"handle\\" is perfect for finger, belt, etc.  CamelBak makes great products; this is yet another one.   Is it a little heavier than polluting plastic?  Yes - empty, it weighs about 13.8 oz.  Not worth bothering about.  Recommend highly.

product_title: Avid FR-5 Bicycle Brake Lever Set
review_headline: Bought these to replace Plastic Levers of Death.
review_body:
If you have PLOD (Plastic Levers of Death) found on many X-mart bikes, do yourself a favor and replace them with these ASAP!

It is a cheap, but very necessary upgrade to your bike if any part of your brake levers are made of plastic. The plastic levers will easily give out when put under pressure in emergency braking situations, especially if the main housing of your levers are plastic and you are using the tension adjuster on the brake lever to provide adequate braking power. The adjuster on cheap plastic levers are threaded into the weak plastic and will easily strip out when applying heavier braking force, which will mean loss of braking ability, possibly ending up in a crash. Luckily I found this out while not in an emergency braking situation, but in the process of testing the braking ability of some excellent new Kool Stop brake pads. BTW: If you still have your original manufacturer brake pads on, you should also replace those with the awesome Kool Stop ones, while you are changing your levers, you will then be a bike braking beast.

product_title: OnGuard Bulldog Combo DT 5012C Bike U-Lock w/ Cable & Bracket
review_body: This lock and cable has been perfect for urban commuting.  My only qualm is that the U-lock is not as thick as some.  That aside, it has excelled in it's design.  The combo lock makes it easy to use without having to fumble for keys.  The cable is long enough to tie in the front wheel, but usually not long enough to tie in both wheels.  Overall, I'm very happy with this lock, and I highly recommend it.

product_title: SRAM X.4 8-Speed Trigger Set
review_body: So easy to install and adjust, took less than 20 minutes.  Took bike riding experience from painful (gears not shifting properly) to SWEET!  Now I can focus on my course and exercise parameters and have no concerns for whether the bike will fail me.

product_title: The Stick Muscle Massage Tool
review_body: This thing works quite well.  It does have a bit of a bend to it as many others have indicated but I don't find that to be a problem.  I think the flexibility prevents me from overdoing it too much.  I was worried the flexibility would create a permanent bend in the bar but it is designed to bend and it snaps right back.  It does seem a bit high to pay $20+ for this but I'm pleased with it.

product_title: Pyramid Mountain Bike Riser Handlebar, 5" Rise, Alloy, Silver
review_body: My mountain/street hybrid bike had only 1\\" rise in the handlebars. I was tired of bending over when I ride...very uncormforable for my neck.  These handlebars were the perfect solution. A bit too wide for me, so I hacksawed about 1\\" off each end. My rides are great now.

product_title: Kenda K838 Slick Wire Bead Bicycle Tire, Blackwall, 26-Inch x 1.95-Inch
review_body: Only a few days ago, i ordered one of these tires to use with my Bell bicycle trainer. Having a knobby tire on there was way too loud, after buying this tire i can finally use my trainer without getting irritated by the noise. While i have never been much of a brand loyalist, i can say that Kenda tires have always been great. They size them up right, and they last a long time too.  Ive never had a bad tire from Kenda.  And did i mention how quiet the bike trainer is? Some say that Bell makes a loud trainer, but i will never complain, not after having a knobby on it.

product_title: Polaris Dragon 10 Tricycle
review_headline: pretty trike but hard to ride
review_body: this trike looks good but is mechanically impractical-the strongest of kids wont be able to peddle this on their own. My son is a strong 3 yr old and has to be pushed to move on this.

product_title: SUP Wheels Classic Standup Paddleboard Trailer and SUP / Kayak Carrier
review_body: SUP Wheels brand wheels is the best SUP transportation product on the market! I am a 105lb female and I have no problems taking my SUP board out alone. This SUP carrier won't go flat on me! GREAT PRODUCT!

product_title: Undercover Canopy Flex Instant Shelter Pop Up (10 x 10-Feet, White)
review_body: I bought this canopy for my mobile auto detailing business and it is extremely easy to set up and take down...all by myself.  You need a little bit of patience, but I was able to set up the canopy for the first time (including attaching the actual canopy for the first time) in under ten minutes.  Now it takes me, by myself, under five minutes to set it up and even less to take down.  Great canopy, especially for the price.

product_title: GoLite TraveLite Wheeled Carry-on
review_body: It's a perfect piece of luggage that hopefully will meet international restrictions.  I will test it soon in Europe.  The only thing i wish is to have a regular square handle so it would balance better.  The fabric is very nice.  It is a bit expensive because i bought it at full price.

product_title: Roller Derby Boy's Tracer Adjustable Inline Skate
review_body: I purchased these in-line skates for my son to learn how to skate with. These skates are very nice , and I like the fact that they are adjustable and can grow with him.  These skates arrived in great condition and are very reasonable priced.  I am very satisfied with my purchase.

product_title: Bravo Sports Pulse Skull Wing Drift Scooter
review_body: I ordered this last week for my grandson's 7th birthday.  Wow!!  He was so suprised.  Very easy to put together and ready to ride!  With the helmut and pads to match in blue, he is one sharp skater!!  Thank you!

product_title: Cocoon CoolMax Blanket
review_body: I bought this blanket for a trip overseas.  I'm never sure what the temp. will be on the plane, and sometimes air conditioning is too high, and I need a light blanket at night.  This was just the ticket!  Compact, lightweight, warm.  I recommend it highly.

review_body: I just received this chair and it is exactly what I was looking for.  I do many outdoor craft/art shows and it is the perfect height for being able to sit and take a break, without losing contact with my customers.  It is very sturdy, solid, and comfortable!

product_title: Street Surfing Wave DLX Grey Shield Board
review_body:

Luke says this board is way faster then the RipStick and priced less the half.

Luke's Dad

product_title: GobSpark FireSteel Ranger with Super Scraper and Lanyard
review_headline: Easy to use and works great
review_body: Works really well and is extremely easy to use.  Far superior to other products I have used in the past.  Throws a nice consistent shower of sparks.

product_title: Dri Ducks Hooded Rainsuit, GREEN, 2XL
review_body: For a full suit, this packs easy & is light-weight. I ordered 2X so it'll fit over clothes & have room to paddle on canoe trips. The material is light-weight, yet durable. I do like the inclusion of a hood, but would've preferred more pockets, too.  We were lucky & in the 6 days in the Boundary Waters, we didn't have to use our rain gear. I will update my review if I do get to utilize my Dry Duck, but hope to never have to!  Have used these & now upgrading rating to 4 stars. Not a very breathable material & still wish there were pockets, but performed quite well in full rain for paddling & setting up/taking down camp. Still advise to buy big, as it would be uncomfortable if you buy fitted with a layer of clothes under, and you may get cold without a layer.

product_title: Topeak MTX Trunk Bag DXP Bicycle Trunk Bag with Rigid Molded Panels
review_body: The Product is just what I wanted and I am very happy with the item. In fact I went to REI and bought the same items for my wife's bike. The issue I had is not with the product. It was with the timely (or lack thereof) order fulfillment and delivery of the items that I ordered. This is the first time that I have had such a disappointing experience with Amazon and truly hope that it is the exception and not the harbinger of things to come.  I would highly recommend the trunk bag. I hope those who order it in the future have better luck getting it on time than I did...

product_title: Moose Blank Skateboard Deck
review_body: This blank deck has been an awesome addition to my collection.  I use mine for recreational use, but slapped on professional hardware and a coat of primer before use.  I intended to apply my own design before use, but cracked my last deck before the paint scheme was completed. I may go back to it later, but I'll probably just buy another blank to work with.

product_title: KMC Z510 1-Speed 1/8 112L Bike Chain
review_body: My 2011 Cannondale Hooligan 3 already came with a KMC Chain but was solid black. This is a great looking replacement with a removable link which my original chain did not have. This has made my bike much more portable and a logical addition to the i-motion's quick disconnect.

product_title: CatEye Rapid 3 Tail Light
review_body: This cateye has a center strobe and is very visible  . It works well during the day and is amazing in dim light. I hang this light on my seat bag and it is compact and fits well. No problems so far! Great light.

product_title: ExOfficio Savvy Pant
review_body: I own three pair of these pants.  I have a pair of capris, that come very near my ankle, and two full length pairs, which I hemmed.  These Savvy pants are my favorite summer pants of all time.    The pant length runs long, and the size runs large.  I am about 5\\"6\\" tall, about 150 pounds, and the size small fits me much better than the size medium.  The leg width is quite generous.    The pants have a small zippered pocket hidden inside the right side pocket.  This zippered pocket fits a passport or anything else you want to avoid losing to pickpockets.    The pants are light weight, and you can roll them up tightly in your suitcase without spoiling the look.  They do not wrinkle.  You can wash them in cold water in a machine or a sink, and then hang to air dry.    The pants have a drawstring waist, which leave you with a little bit of a bow around your waist.  I tuck the bow into the pants because I do not like the lumpy look under my blouse.    These pants are so comfortable that I will collect more to be sure I have enough pairs to last me into and through old age.

product_title: Timbuk2 Wingman Suitcase 2013
review_headline: Nice attempt at a Tom Binh bag
review_body: Not a bad looking bag, but a bit flimsy; not sure how much punishment it can take.  If you're serious about traveling light though (and travel more than once every 2 years), you're better off saving for the real thing this is modeled after: the Tom Binh Aeronaut.  It's more expensive, but will last forever and is better organized.

product_title: Coleman RoadTrip Wheeled Carry Case
review_body: I purchased this for our blue road trip grill.  It took a while but I finally got it to fit in the case.  The first time I fastened the straps one pulled out of the seam.  The grill was such a tight fit that I didn't think it would matter if it was not fastened.  The first time we took our grill in the case tailgating the zipper started pulling out of the seam.  I emailed Coleman but got no response. It's a great idea---too bad it is so poorly made.  I feel like I wasted $46.00.

product_title: Sierra Designs Wu Hu Annex 6+2 Six-Person Basecamp Tent
review_body: This tent is a bit more expensive then other car camping tents, but it is worth every penny.  It is easy to put up and take down for such a large tent, it takes about 20-25 minutes by myself.  It is huge inside with a flap to separate the tent for privacy (not mesh on the newer version).  It has a lot of ventilation so it does not get to hot even in central florida, where we took it last week.  It is factory sealed, so it does not get wet inside.  It rained both days we were camping and there was not a drop inside the tent.  I have been camping for 20 years and feel comfortable saying this is the best tent I have owned for the money.

product_title: Suunto Core
review_body: Buttons controlling watch functions stopped working within 1 week of delivery. Watch was returned for supposedly new item. That time, the buttons stopped working within 3 days. I did not pay attention to other reviews that highlighted this same problem. I'll just take the loss. Buyer beware!

product_title: Bell Sports 7070537 Gel-Base Bicycle Seat Cover
review_body:
I'm very new to bicycling and recently bought a new bike and rode it 20 miles the first day. It took my butt about a week to recover! I bought the Bell seat cover and it really helps. Some people warned me that seat covers slip but I decided to give it a try since it was much less expensive than a new seat.

A new seat would probably be more comfortable, but the seat pad is very inexpensive and I didn't have any issues with it slipping.

product_title: Nalgene Get-A-Grip CXC Bladder
review_body: Upon inspection the bladder looked great.  However on my second run with the bladder the hose broke away from the male piece and now wont stay attached.  This would have been bad enough but it happened in my car and 3 liters of water went everywhere.  I would just get a big freezer bag and a straw over this piece of garbage.  I guess if its not Lexane Nalgene isnt worth a darn.

product_title: SeaSense Wood Paddle
review_body: I was looking for a paddle to use as decoration in the front of our house.  Most of them had prices through the roof.  This was very nice...(and in a pinch, I can use it with the canoe)

product_title: ExOfficio Men's Boxer Brief
review_body: man these are amazing i work at a camp so it is long hot days in the sun. I bought these a week ago and i was so excited for them i actually told everyone around me camp makes you an open person quickly. when they arrived they were better than i thought they would be these are the best underwear i have owned. i just ordered another pair and plan to keep going i just have to wait a little bit as camp does not pay that well.

product_title: Coleman Bunkhouse Deluxe II Folding Cot
review_body: We bought this because we camp a lot and this summer I was in my final trimester of our second child and was not feeling sleeping on a air mattress - also my husband has a bad back so we knew it would get good use over the next couple years.   Not only did it sleep me well over the summer but came in handy when my mom came to stay for a week when we had our baby.   Its still a cot but of all the cots and air mattresses I have slept on in the last 15 years it does a great job. Its long enough for someone over 6' 3\\" and wide enough for a bigger girl (me).   It was defiantly worth the price and we will be getting another.

product_title: Camelbak Stealth 70 oz/2.1L Hydration Pack Black 76000
review_body: This camelbak is tough. I used this for a Tough Mudder. I found it to be very helpful and not only for the obvious reason of always having water. I tripped during this event while going down hill in a rocky area. Landed directly on my back, thought that I was going to pop it. And I am a 215 lbs. guy so most things that I land on of this size usually break. And it didn't! It even acted like a cushion of sorts against the rocks(though I still ate it pretty hard), so don't go falling on rocks with it(it will still hurt!). Now I cant really see how you would pop it, short of actually stabbing it. It never got any mud or dirt in it during the entire event as well. So this camelbak is AWESOME!

product_title: 2 Skydive Skydiving Goggles Reduced Glare Blue With Great peripheral vision design Lenses are shatterproof polycarbonate, 100% UV protection, and are ANTI-FOG coated
review_body: I bought these to go skydiving.  Once.  They worked just fine.  They fogged up a bit on the plane on the way up to 14K but cleared up quickly.  Once I was out the door I did not even notice I was wearing them until I was back on the ground. Vis was great, comfortable fit, and I was not squinting from any sun / glare.  The only thing is that the photo guy said \\"These are mirrored on the outside.  Your friends wont be able to see the look of fear in your eyes if you wear these.\\"  I said that it was just fine that way.  :)  The video turned out great, and I liked the look of the blue mirrored goggles.  I have no intention of jumping again, and these held up just fine for the one time I used them.  (The second pair was for a friend that I went with.)

product_title: NeoSport Wetsuits Men's Premium Neoprene 5mm Full Suit
review_body: This wet suit has a great fit for me, thick material makes it durable. I will buy this product again.

product_title: Filzer Mini-Zee Pump with Gauge
review_body: Got this pump because of it's function. It is compact and portable like a hand pump, but gives the pumping power of a foot pump. the foot stand really makes pumping at home or on the go a breeze. the included frame mount doesn't hurt either. Great pump, works wonders.

product_title: Diamondback Overdrive Comp 29'er Mountain Bike (29-Inch Wheels)
review_body: So I was leary of buying a Dimondback, I felt the quality had slipped in the last decade. I was impressed with the component group however. You actually can't buy the components for what this entire bike costs. And after some research I discovered its a Raleigh frame, which is respectable. Assembling the bike was no problem, but tuning it was challenging. Adjusting the disc brakes I think is more than the average person will manage. I also had to take links from the chain, and I shortened the cables as they were all over. I don't think most people would be satisified with this product out of the box... But a trip to your local bike shop still brings this bike in at a comfortable price, and its a very nice ride. I'm glad I did this, a comparable ride from a more respected brand would cost another $500. If you are buying this to ride with kids, commute to work, and non-technical riding this is a no brainer.

product_title: Deluxe Silver color 18oz Stainless Steel Water Bottles - BPA Free
review_body: Great bottle for the price--lightweight, fairly durable, good design--but smaller than I was expecting.  It's listed as 18 oz/500 mL, but 500 mL is actually about 16.9 oz.  Based on its size, it definitely seems to be in the 16.9 oz range.  Not a huge deal, but I wouldn't mind that extra 1.1 ounce.

product_title: Allen Sports Deluxe 2-Bike Trunk Mount Rack
review_body: I liked the idea and the price for this bike carrier, and it appears to have a simple design, but one thing that was lacking was clear assembly instructions. The instructions seem to be for another model, similar in looks. More than likely, the assembly instructions are very poor because they were translated from an asian language, but I do not know that for a fact. This carrier does not \\"install in seconds\\" as it is advertised on the box. It took me half an hour to decipher the instructions. I just installed it today, but have not used the carrier yet on a trip, and I am a little nervous, since I ride an expensive Trek bike. I will first go easy with the driving, and make sure the ties to the trunk are secure. I will write an update after I drive the car with a bike attached.

product_title: TrailHeads Women's Ponytail Hat/Beanie - 11 Colors
review_body: I got this products based off the other reviews. It definitely lives up to the other reviews. It is so comfortable and easy to put on and take off. Its not that cold yet where I live so I've just worn it around the house to try it out and it is so comfortable! Best part is I can still wear a ponytail or bun to work out in and not have to cram all my long hair up in a beanie and its cute!

product_title: Dahon Jack D7 Folding Bike (Shadow)
review_body: I've had my Jack for quite a while now, and it's hard not to gush about it.  It's a fun, practical bike for commuting and recreation, with many nice appointments which set it apart from other bikes.  It was a piece of cake to assemble, and it's held up great under pretty intensive use despite its light weight.  I've owned many mid-range bikes, and this is by far my favorite.

product_title: CamelBak WaterMaster 70oz Blue
review_headline: Great Product for the Right Price!
review_body: The Camelbak Watermaster 70oz Hydration Pack is a great purchase. I have had mine for about a month now and use it about 3 times a week. It fits me perfectly and has adjustment straps to set different lengths or sizes for all body types. The PROS of this product is it is lightweight, stylish, easy to use, holds a good amount of water, and fits well. The CONS are it would be nice if it had a small pouch or pocket to hold personal items such as keys or a phone and even with the shut-off valve completely closed on the suction piece it slightly leaks every now and then but it is not a major problem. product_title: Panaracer RiBMo PT Tire with Folding Bead, 26 x 1.25-Inch
review_headline: Great commuter and urban MTB tire
review_body: Reviewed riding a RETRO MTB (tricked out '89 GT Karakorum K2).   I replaced a pair of steel bead 26 x 1.25 Fat Boy's with these 26 x 1.25 Panaracer RiBMo kevlar bead tires because I had a few too many incidents with thorns riding the Fat Boy's. The RiBMo is a definite improvement in flat reduction due to thorns.   There are noticeable differences between the Fat Boy and RiBMo. The first is the 'feel' of the tire. I would give the edge to the Fat Boy there. The Fat Boy has a smooth, consistent, effortless  transition throughout the carving of rapid 'S' turns on pavement (a common tire handling check for me). Not surprising since the Fat Boy is a baldy, an excellent tire rubber and a traditional round profile. It is and should be a smooth performer in that situation.  The RiBMo has a somewhat raised center area - more like a pointy oblong than a circle. There is also a hint of a tread but nothing too drastic. Carving 'S' turns is a bit different on the RiBMo. Not in a bad way exactly, but it is clear that you are transitioning from left turn to upright to right turn. It's just not as fluid and smooth as a typical round profile tire like the Fat Boy.   When you are leaning into the actual turn I believe the RiBMo may have a wider contact area than a typical round profile tire. There is no lack of confidence speeding thru a turn on the RiBMo. They are fairly fast. Tough as nails so far and great performers on city streets and paved trails. They do seem a little sketchy on the dirt trails at times. Definitely not their intended usage but I always enjoyed taking my Fat Boy's out on the dirt once in a while. The RiBMo is not as comfortable making the switch to dirt.   It is a great tire for it's intended purposes and I can recommend it for commuters or urban MTB riders who struggle with flats or otherwise abuse their tires. You are giving up a little something in all-around performance and feel for that boost of flat protection but the RiBMo is still an excellent tire.

product_title: Mountain House Scrambled Eggs with Ham & Peppers
review_body: Let's face it, freeze-dried eggs are never at the top of anyone's must-eat list, but when you're camping (or, heaven forbid, relying on them for an emergency), you won't do much better than this for the price. I'm not exactly a fan of FDEs, thanks to a number of substandard school cafeterias, but the inclusion of ham and peppers actually transformed a usually bland staple into a very nutritious and satisfying meal. Preparation is easy -- just add boiling water, reseal, and wait a couple of minutes -- and the high nutritive value is right there on the package. (Flavor hint: add some dry parmesan cheese and red pepper flakes to the mix before eating.)    Hey, I'd love to bring fresh eggs with me on the trail, but this way I don't have to carry them (AND a pan). I just heat 'em up and eat 'em from the bag. No hassle, no cleanup. I'd give it five stars, but hey, they're still freeze-dried eggs.

product_title: Planet Bike Button Bicycle Waterbottle Cage
review_body: I purchased two of these cages for my father's bike. He used them and loved them since he got them, but during a ride (we were together) just 7 months later, one of his cages came apart at the mounting bracket welds. He was left with a bottle and half of the cage in his hand. The mounting bracket was still mounted to the bike. We pitched the cage and he put the bottle in his back jersey pocket for the rest of the 50 miles, but what a bummer this was. This cage saw light use, too, as he rides a couple of times a week. These cages didn't even get as much use as some on my bike would. Moral of the story, for $7 bucks a piece, buy something that is going to last instead of this. You can find full carbon bottle cages on ebay for 20-25 shipped for the pair and they will last a lot longer than these will.

product_title: Sierra Designs Utopia 15-Degree Synthetic Fill Sleeping Bag
review_headline: Perfect sleeping bag for crisp night, all-round
review_body: Nice sleeping bag, as advertised ... well-proportioned baffling/fill, zipper.  I got the 6' 6\\" longer model for my 6' 1\\" frame, and it is very  comfortable.  Looking forward to trekking across Africa with my new bag, from desert to high plain (not mountain tops ...).

product_title: Delta Cycle El Greco Bike Hoist for Garage Lift Space Storage Kayak
review_body: Let me start by saying that I think someone who is going to retrieve their bike, ride it, and re-hang their bike every day may find this system slightly inconvenient.  This is because it takes 30 seconds or so to access one's bike, and another 30 seconds to put it away.  This is less convenient than leaning one's bike against the garage wall or lifting it onto a hook.  That said, this system smartly makes use of high, otherwise inaccessable space, and frees up precious floor space in a garage.  The locking device which prevents the bike/hooks from coming down unless the rope is fed at a particular angle is both necessary and seems to work well, enabling older children and grandmas to hoist a bike up safely.  I have read previous comments indicating the hardware is inadequate, and I disagree.  Maybe the manufacturer has upgraded the hardware since those reviews, but what came with the units I received was satisfactory (Phillips screws, approx 2 inches long, maybe 3/16\\" in diameter, 8 screws for the ceiling and 2 for the cleat on the wall).  To be successful with these screws, one needs to 1) pre-drill, 2) use the correct size Phillips driver (#3, a large size that may not be in everyone's tool drawer) and 3) lube the threads with bar soap (optional).

product_title: Snorkel Fin Bag
review_body: The bag is 29 inches tall, made of nylon with a padded bottom and a padded carrying strap.  It is perfect for two people to carry snorkel equipment: large inside area holds two sets of fins; middle size outside area holds two sets of masks and snorkels: smaller outside pocket can hold suntan lotion or mask defogger or whatever.  The bag packs everything down for easy carrying: I put mine through with the checked luggage and had no problem.  The mesh netting lets the equipment dry out and keeps air circulated when you have it stored at home.

product_title: Leki Sierra SAS Trekking Pole (Discontinued)
review_body:
I'm an old lady who likes to walk, mostly in urban environments. I have tripped and fallen plenty,but recently I hurt myself a couple of times pretty badly when I discovered the broken sidewalk in front of a theatre in Chicago and a pothole at an Air Force base in SoCal.

I used to carry a hiking stick to ward off stray dogs, coyotes and the occasional killer rabbit, but they were the two for $20 cheapo things from the local sporting goods store. They broke. I stopped buying them.

The last time I fell I jammed my elbow and the doctors thought I might have an elbow fracture and/or an occult fracture. Thankfully nothing is broken but the arm still hurts a lot. I was using a cane for a short while to assist me in keeping my balance. But pushing off on the cane hurt the arm. A walking stick doesn't do that. By utilizing the strap and having the stick at the right height, you won't jam those bones into an elbow or shoulder socket.

So, I decided to spend a little more money and get a nice walking stick. I also purchased a rubber, boot-shaped, tip for the stick which I like very much. The only thing I don't like about the stick is the noise it makes when you put the tip into the ground. I think it's the anti-shock mechanism rattling around inside. I can live with it. So I am out and about again, giving the killer rabbits and their cronies the squirrel assasins what for with my new stick.

review_body: I had 2 pairs of castelli free bibs that I had worn out completely. I thought I would give a more affordable bib a try. These are a very comfortable, lightweight, buttery bibshort. The legs don't pinch. I felt they were true to size ( I am 5'10\\" 145 and the L is perfect) Great on long rides. I will definitely get another pair.

review_body: I only received one not a box of 24 as the ad stated.  However, I was refunded the purchase price in full.  But the horn is awesome.  I love the look, which is like a toy, but the sound is not.  It is louder than a bell, but not as loud as a air-horn, and not as big and bulky.  The perfect medium.

product_title: Serfas Speed Bag
review_body: The Serfas seat post bag is exactly what I needed for my Fugi commuter bike.  I wanted something big enough for an inner tube, a multi-tool, a patch kit, plus occasionally an iPhone and a wallet, without being unwieldy or ugly. This fits the bill admirably.  The inside has a stiffener along the top which stabilizes the bag nicely against the rails of your saddle.  There is a small pocket on the zip down back that holds a credit card and your I.d. or insurance card;  also attached is a small key clip, perfect for bike lock keys, etc.  Inside, there is an elastic strap on one side that works great for holding a tube, multi tool  or an air chuck.  Visibility is great plus!  3M reflective striping goes around the entire thing.  Best yet, it has a well designed tab for attaching blinkie lights-- and it works great with all sorts of different brands, including the Planet Bike Superflash (shown in the picture).  Another nice feature is the bag expands enough to accommodate a lightweight windbreaker or your wallet when needed. It's also easy to remove and replace to a different bike.

product_title: Energizer Weatheready LED Lights
review_body: I leave this flashlight plugged in in \\"ON\\" mode and it turns on automatically when I unplug it, or when the power goes out. In \\"OFF\\" mode it stays off when you unplug it. In \\"Nightlight\\" mode it stays on at low power all the time. I got this flashlight for convenience during power outages, not for brightness, but it's been handy enough for me to use at other times too.  I used the [[ASIN:B00009MDBU Kill-A-Watt]] to measure the power consumption. It measures 0W / 3VA when charged, and 0W / 3VA in nightlight mode, so I'm guessing the power consumption is too small for Kill-A-Watt to measure. (Note: VA is power supplied by the power company, and Watts is what you pay for, so it's using a trickle of power even when fully charged.)  What would make it better:    1. A light sensor that turned the \\"nightlight off\\" during the day. I want it to turn on only at night.    2. The folding plug could be stiffer, or \\"click\\" into place, so that it doesn't fold while I'm trying to plug it in.

review_body: I've been mountain biking for 12 years and have owned numerous helmets, so I'm not new to biking helmets. I bought a Giro Phase online but was very displeased with the comfort. The worst problem was that the dial adjustment on the back seemed to press into the back of my head like a knot. Even at that, the band didn't tighten enough to keep the helmet from shifting when I shook my head. Also, the band that the dial uses to tighten the fit ran very low on the side of the helmet, coming down against the top of my ears. If I didn't wear glasses, that might be okay, but it pressed on the ends of the earpieces of the glasses, pressing them into my head. In addition, the chin straps didn't lie flat and were a little uncomfortable, though they may well relax with time. The main problem was the uncomfortable adjustment mechanism. I think Giro makes some of the best looking helmets, but I ride often, long, and hard, and I can't have a helmet that is uncomfortable and takes my attention off the trail. I sent it back and bought another brand, which fit like it was made for me the instant I put it on.

product_title: SKS Commuter Bicycle Fender Set
review_body: I just installed these a couple weeks ago.  So far, they're pretty good.  My bike is a 1997-vintage Schwinn hybrid type bike.  I have 700C-38 tires, pretty wide, and I installed the 45 mm wide fenders.    Observations, which I hope will help others:    - One thing that really sold me on SKS is that they have a \\"secu-clip\\" that attaches to the hole in the fork blades.  (Go on the SKS-Germany website, look under mudguards, and you'll see this clip.)  The secu-clip will break away if something (a branch, etc.) gets lodged between the fender and tire and will prevent you from flipping over your handlebars in such a crisis.    - Quality seems really good; metal hardware is stainless steel.  Plastic fenders with an aluminum \\"core.\\"  I think they look pretty nice.    - Fenders, any fenders, are a PITA to install.  They just are.  Even if you have every necessary spot for mounting like I do.  The copy-writer who wrote \\"mounts in seconds\\" on the packaging was smoking something.  Once they're on, you'll still be tweaking, adjusting, etc. trying to keep 'em from rubbing.  You get a single hex wrench, and I found myself needing pliers and other tools to tighten the nuts that hold the hex screws from the back.  I'd allow a healthy hour or two.  I removed a kickstand to get at one of the mounting spots.  I decided to remove my wheels during installation, you might not have to.    - I have a carrier over my rear tire, it doesn't conflict with the rear fender (fender goes under), at least for me.  If you have a carrier, depending on how many mounting holes you have near the rear drop-outs, you may need to figure out a way to mount both the fender and the carrier in the same hole - might need a longer screw.  I fortunately have two holes so they mount separately.  If you have NO holes, well, you'll need some zip-ties or other creative solutions.  (That applies elsewhere as well).    - There is a poorly-documented \\"mystery tongue\\" of metal, used for alternative mounting.  What they don't tell you in the instructions  is that this screws under the front edge of the front fender for reinforcement, even if you're not using the associated piece for clamping on.  Like one other commenter, I also found two undocumented \\"ridged\\" washers that presumably hold tension for tightening some of the screws/nuts, but I still needed the pliers as noted above.    - I found my front fender rubbing very slightly after a ride (they seem to be OK when the bike has been sitting awhile).  Could be that my wheels need to be trued, not sure the fender is to blame. Multiple adjustments only helped so much.    - This is a great price.  My local bike shop would have cost me 60 percent more, plus installation (though THEY would have dealt with the PITA installation).  If you can afford it or aren't particularly handy, the LBS is the way to go.    - The fenders seems to work reasonably well at their job, though they BARELY cover the width of my 38mm tires and the hardware under the fender does come REALLY close, particularly in back. The width they give you is NOT the width of the tire you can use, it's the width of the fender.    - I was somewhat disappointed the front fender didn't extend further to the front of the bike.  My fork also has fairly poor clearance below the fender, so it barely fits.     - I concur with the other reviewer who suggests gluing on the four black caps that go over the ends of the metal struts.  I did so.  I do believe I would lose them otherwise.    - If you're not used to fenders - your toes could occasionally graze the mudflap in front if the wheel is turned slightly (say at a stop).  You'll hear pebbles banging around and rolling down, kind of a weird noise and disconcerting till you realize what it is.    Overall, the pluses outweigh the minuses, but be prepared to deal with a few hassles.

product_title: Buzzys Buzzy's Pollinator Shock Pump, 300psi (Aluminum Pump with Schrader Anti-Leak Chuck, Pressure Relief Valve, Includes Inflation Needle, SID Adaptor)
review_body: Excellent product.  This little pump is a demon, effortlessly lets you adjust your bicycle shock pressure. The finish is excellent and it does exactly what it's description says. Completely satisfied, would recommend to anyone who is a cyclist.  Roger

product_title: Park Tool FR-5G Cassette Lockring Tool with Guide Pin
review_body: Because there are no moving parts, there is little to say about this tool except that it does the job.  I would recommend getting the FR-5G over the FR-5 because then it has the guide pin built in.  (The FR-5 does not have this).  Good anodized corrosion inhibitor on the surface.  Makes getting the deep dirt our of your sprocket a breeze!

product_title: Klean Kanteen Stainless Steel Water Bottle
review_headline: Not as great as it's hyped up to be
review_body: While I do appreciate the fact that it's stainless steel and BPA free, there are issues that make the Klean Kanteen bottle a rather disappointing product.     1). It leaks. If you use this bottle while commuting, you'll find that it doesn't fit the standard cup holder. This leaves me to try to balance the bottle on my passanger seat, only to have it inevitably topple over. To be fair, the Klean Kanteen website does state that the sport cap is not leak-proof, but that doesn't make leaks any less annoying.    2). It sweats. Badly. Little puddles of water are left in its wake and my messenger bag is regularly dampened.     3). It doesn't keep drinks cold. I fill my bottle up with ice in the morning, only to find it melted before the two hour mark. Nothing like drinking warm water.    4). The sport cap whistles. I find this the most damning aspect, as I don't appreciate heads turning each time I take a sip. I've taken to unscrewing the sport cap and drinking directly from the wide mouth opening. This makes use cumbersome and I've eschewed the Klean Kanteen in favor of the plastic bottle on more than one occasion because of it.     In sum, improvements are definitely needed.

product_title: CatEye Single Shot USB Rechargeable Bicycle Headlight HL-EL600RC
review_body: Works great one it's charged, however the charger sucks and takes FOREVER!  The little red light on the charger keeps coming on and then it stops charging so you have to keep resetting it.

product_title: Military Inspired Canvas Messenger Shoulder Bag Laptop Case Bookbag Olive Drab
review_body: I received this bag....and it is what I expected. It is nice and a lot of room on the  inside but like everyone else that has commented ...the inside does make a lot of noise.  A crinkle noise. I am leary of washing it to see if it would soften up.  It is a loud of enough noise that anyone sitting or standing around would hear it clearly.  It would be a good bag to take if camping or going to the beach.

product_title: Finger Sleeves Assorted Sizes --- 12
review_body: These work very well for trigger finger. My mom loves them. They are easy to use and easy for her to get on. She is able to keep her finger open so she has less pain.

product_title: Motorcycle Full Rear Side View Mirror Universal Fit Harley Suzuki Kawasaki Honda Yamaha Triumph BMW
review_body: The mirrors came at a great price and arrived on time. They are light weight and look good on the bike. 1 mirror is fine but the other 1 will not stay where i put it and there is no way to adjust the tension on the part that is loose fitting. i guess you get what you pay for, should have bought OEM.

product_title: Overboard Gear Prosport Backpack 30 l (Black)
review_body: This pack is well constructed and has many carry options.  I needed something to piggyback along with my inflatable backpack kayak... this attaches fantastic thanks to the velcro strap on top. Small enough to carry in the kayak cargo area, large enough to carry all my cloths & shoes. Highly recommended.

product_title: Topeak Turbo Morph Bike Pump with Gauge
review_body: Great pump. I've had it for about a year now, works great, gives accurate pressure gauge reading, easy to pump (even at higher pressures) and easy to put on the bike.

product_title: Planet Bike 6.2 mm Welded Aluminum Bicycle Water Bottle Cage
review_body: The construction of this item is exceptionally well done and will endure for a very long time to come.  Great job on such an accessory.

product_title: Razor MX650 Rocket Electric Motocross Bike
review_body: My 8y/o son got this for his birthday and loves it.  He was riding an electric scooter and was going to hurt himself.  I showed him a video of kids riding this razor and he loved it and his friend has a 500.   I assembled it and had it charged for his party and he took off and his Nana nearly had to change her pants.   It's great if moms don't want kids to have a gas powered motorcycle.    Now for the review.   Assembly was pretty easy for a mechanic.  Shouldn't be too hard for anyone.  I did change the shock mounting hole, it has two,  to raise the rear end up some and tightened the shock up a bit.  Be careful installing the front wheel or you could bend the disk brake rotor.  Brakes work well just a little flimsy on the rotors part.    Decals are cheap and placement needs improvement but kids won't notice that.  The cap over the charging port is a nice touch.  Charging a 36 volt system takes a good while but if it is charged overnite it should last all day if not ridden too hard.    Speed is good 12 - 15 mph depending on terrain and going by my Honda 100 speedometer.    Fit and finish on metal parts is good and it cleans up easy.  Don't hose it off too hard because it is electric.    If anyone needs to replace batteries, which should be a few years, be careful because the wires are soldered to the terminals.  You will need a good soldering iron  to break them loose before you melt the battery.    I think Razor has a good product line and I am very satisfied with the MX 650!

product_title: OnGuard Bulldog MINI TC 5013TC Bicycle U-Lock
review_headline: Does its job, but has some flaws
review_body: This lock is a very convenient size, comes at a great price, and did in fact come as the newer version (distinguished by two yellow caps at the end). I feel safe with it on my bike anywhere public, but there are downsides: the yellow ends move around and block the hole, one of the ends started tearing after 2 days and had to be removed leaving a very solid edge there, and it is sometimes quite difficult to get the thing to lock into place when reapplying the end bar. I'd still recommend it for the price, as you'll start to get a feel for easing it in there once you've used it a while.

product_title: Coleman Coleman 62 qt. Xtreme Cooler
review_body: We just got the cooler and it worked well for  bringing frozen venison home, still frozen after  2 days of travel.  Interested to see how the   hinges hold up.  That seems to be the weekness  with most coolers these days.

product_title: Kinetic by Kurt 2013 Road Machine Indoor Bicycle Trainer
review_body: [[VIDEOID:mo3300AWW44341M]]This trainer was super easy to set up. It literally took about 5 minutes to go from opening the box to mounting my bike. I have only put a few miles on it so far, but I can tell that I'm going to have a great time working out this winter when it is too cold to ride outside (I'm a huge wimp when it comes to cold weather). It is also really quite when in operation. I was riding it at 20mph and the noise wasn't too bad at all, most of the noise came from my bike's drive train and not the trainer. This applies to any trainer, but I recommend that you buy a high velocity fan to go with this because without any wind (even though we cyclists normally HATE the wind) it is really easy to work up a sweat in stagnate air.

product_title: Underwater Kinetics 3AAA Vizion eLED Headlamp
review_headline: Not bad, but I believe there are better.
review_body: Pros:  1. Large, easy to find power button.  2. Two brightness levels.  3. Comfortable, with easy to adjust strap and no headlamp pad like some. It just uses the strap as a cushion underneath the unit.  4. Angle adjustment is not preset like some. It will rotate, within a certain range, to the desired spot which allows for fine-tuning of position. Also, it is not possible to knock the position out of alignment like on most headlamps. Once it is set, it is set.    Cons:  1. This con just depends on your memory. If you forget which side the angle adjustment is you might end up flipping through the filters instead, and vice versa.  2. Not the brightest LED, even with fresh batteries.  3. Red filter is not as red as you might expect. Especially not as red as true red LED's like on other units.  4. Sometimes it takes two hands to rotate the angle, and it definitely takes two hands to rotate the filter sleeve. Either that or you push it hard on your forehead while you use one hand.  5. Diffusion filter has little effect.  6. The filter sleeve (lens) rotates around the light. The problem with this is the lens gets small scratches every time you rotate it. I've only rotated the lens less than 10 times and already there are several noticeable abrasions. Over time this will create a haziness that will lower light output.  7. The focus of this LED is not great for up-close work. Even when using the different filter options.  8. This isn't a con of this particular light, but lights like this that only have one LED. When working on projects up close, the LED hampers 3D vision/depth perception. I recommend a unit with stereo LED's. I had an old, less durable, Energizer like this that was perfect for up-close work and had a single LED for long-range (walking, etc.). Also with a two LED unit, when working on things like cars where one LED and eye might get blocked by something, you still have your other LED and eye to see with. I did not realize this would be a problem until buyingthis unit.    Not a pro or con, but the color of this light is lower on the kelvin scale than many other units. Not quite yellow, but definitely lower.   Also, some might want to know that there is no flashing feature on this headlamp.    Overall a good waterproof light. Good for average use such as hiking/walking in very dark environments. (LED is not bright enough for brighter situations.) I wouldn't recommend this light for any precision work, especially at close range.

product_title: InStep Sierra Double Bicycle Trailer
review_body: I've looked at multiple trailers in stores such as REI, which retailed for over double what this product sells for on Amazon.  Are they better quality?  I'm sure they are.  The paint chips easily on this trailer, and I can tell the fabric isn't as high grade as some of the others out there.  However I have no doubt this trailer will outlive its useful life with my 3 year old son and our future planned child.  I'm just a weekend warrior with an occasional mid-week jaunt around the neighborhood and I love the fact I can take my son with me without breaking our bank account.  If you fit my profile I'm sure you'll be as happy as I am now.    One note.  I choose this trailer over cheaper InStep trailers because it has a reenforced seat pad.It's a \\"high density\\" pad that helps keep two kids from sliding together.  The cheaper models don't have the pad and they are basically sitting on just the fabric material.  I've taken our neighbor's child who weigh's about 40 lbs on a ride with my son who's about 30 lbs himself and they both stayed on their own side.  Well worth the extra money if you ask me to keep the peace.  :-)

product_title: Auto car glasses(red)
review_body: I love this little device. Many sunglasses are too bulky to fit into the storage compartment provided in the care. This allows you to clip them on the visor where they are handy and won't get scratched or broken.

product_title: Intex Raised Downy Airbed with Built-in Electric Pump, Queen, Bed Height 22"
review_body: Thanks for quick delivery. No complaints on that.   Recently inflated to test. Fast and easy since built in.  Will put to the test when my guests arrive for a vacay with me.   Bought 2 but I only need 1. For back up, I guess.

product_title: HIAEFIRE Q5 CREE 240 Lumen LED Bike Bicycle flashlight Torch +1 x Bicycle Holder +3 AAA batteries + dual charger
review_body: Awesome bike headlight. Also you can use it as flashlight. 3 LEDs make a powerful beam and nice white ray color. Easy install in 5 minutes. Two modes: blink and steady light. Powered from two AA batteries. I am fully satisfied.

product_title: Bolle King Sunglasses
review_body: They fit well (I tried them on in a store before I bought them), but they are a million times better than my $5 sunglasses when I'm running. These don't pinch my head behind my ears until they hurt. And they don't slide down either. Not work $80, but I'm glad I bought them anyway. Polarized lens is nice when driving. There's less glare from other cars and buildings.

product_title: LunchSkins Reusable Sandwich and Snack Bag Set-(SB Berry Flower + SB Green Bud + SnB Berry Dot)
review_body: I chose this particular product after reading other reviews and deciding it fit the need.  Now that we're using them, I gotta say, they WAY exceed my expectations!  I have other cloth-velcro bags but these seem like they're sturdier.  They're very well-made and I really love that there's the place to write my daughter's name on her lunch sacks!  I will be suggesting these to other moms for sure and buying them as gifts in the future!

product_title: Cygolite Expilion 350-Lumen USB Rechargeable Headlight
review_body: I do most of my bicycle riding before dawn and I've always had a blinking light for the rear of my bike, but recently considered a light for the front.  Was concerned about size and weight and decided to give the Cygolite ExpiliOn 350 a try.  The light has a very nice mounting system and I chose to mount the light under the handlebar. It's size does not reflect the amount of light this little light can produce.  After an initial alignment, I only used the light on the lowest of the intensities and have a very good field of vision provided. Not sure if I like the blinking selection, but again, the 350 lumens provides more than enough to be able to see where you're going.  I haven't had to recharge the unit yet, but it does come with a USB connection for charging.  Approximately 90 minutes of use on the charge from the factory, and we're still going strong.  Great value and superb performance from a small and compact light!!

product_title: Sun Dolphin Sun Slider 5 Seat Pedal Boat with Canopy
review_body: We received this item on Friday and took it out on Saturday, it was a hit! The canopy is a must have for hot summer days, and there is plenty of room for the whole family. Just make sure there is even weight distribution or you will be riding sideways. The package came as described and before estimated delivery date. The price was also more then fair. The next item we plan on buying is a small trolling motor, although the exercise is fun, going across an entire lake did get a little tired some. Hope you enjoy as much as we do.

product_title: TETC Motorcycle Racing 7/8" Handlebar Rubber Gel Hand Grips + Bar End Cap Plug Black
review_body: The quality of these foam grips are durable and the quantity is a real value at this price. I use them on the handle on my walking cane for a real comfortable no-slip grip!

product_title: Serfas Seca Wire Bead Tire with FPS
review_body: these are very good looking and long lasting tires. the rubber is extemely hard and the red side walls look wonderful on my red trek elance. it took about 5 hours of riding for the mould lines to wear off. eventually i began ripping through the corners faster and faster as i gained confidence in the tires. im not a pro. i just like to ride. but these really are a good training tire that will deliver a long life and they do look wonderful. i will buy these tires again and i have bought other serfas tires and products. i ride a lot. i have five bikes. two street,two mountian, and a cruiser i loan out to kids and to run to the store for groceries. im a siezure patient and put about 3-5k miles a year on my bikes. i pull a trailer behind my trek 930 and can pull 300lbs anywhere. anywhere. i also pull a kayak to go fishing. love my bikes. serfas makes good products. these are good tires.

product_title: ELEMENT Skateboards DISPERSION Complete SKATEBOARD 7.63
review_body: The design looks great on this board as well as the quality.  For the price this is a really good skateboard.

product_title: RAD Cycle Products Bike Lift Hoist Garage Mountain Bicycle Hoist 100LB Capacity (2-Pack)
review_body: The two pack was exactly what I needed.  These were very easy to install and simple to operate.  I freed up a ton of garage space and can run my bikes up to my 12\\" garage ceiling and easily pass under the bikes.

product_title: prAna Women's Headband
review_body: I have short hair and can never find headbands that will both keep the strands away from my face and the shorter hairs off the back of my neck.  This is perfect!  I have used it while running and it has definitely stayed in place. I can't wait to get more.

product_title: Pacific Cycle Men's Chromium Bicycle
review_headline: If on a very tight budget, it's ok. Note, it seems like a very heavy bike.
review_body: I got this bike at a local K-Mart for $86 yesterday, plus $13 for two years of no-cost repairs and replacement (if it totally breaks) warranty. The bike was already assembled by them, so all I had to do was take it home. The brake feel is fine, but it is a little squeaky sounding. What I did notice is this bike is heavy as hell. When lifting the woman's Pacific Stratus, which I also purchased ($59, assembled), it felt like it was almost a 1/3 lighter than the Chromium.    The bike has no manuals that came with it, so I guess I am on my own with figuring out how to work the gears on it. This is the first bike with gears I ever had, well the first bike I have had since I was in my early teens back in the early to mid 90s.    I found it hard to move up hills (a lot of work), but I noticed adjusting the gears it was a bit easier. Maybe it's a combo of not being familiar with how the gears work, and also that I am out of shape.    I do like the look and feel of the bike. So tentatively I am giving it 4 stars, as I can not ding it for being a novice newbie. I took it out on a small trail yesterday very briefly, and it felt just OK.    I will update this review in the near future, as I get back in shape with it, and I learn how to properly use it. If anything seems amiss with it, I will drop it off at K-mart to be sent out for new parts and adjustments for free.    So 4 stars because I was on a hyper shoestring budget, the bike looks nice, got 2 years of repairs and/or replacement warranty, and it seems like a decent fit for me. I will include some pics of this bikes in my review.          Update -> August 3, 2011:      Added more pictures of the bike for close ups of the bike.  Since the last review, I took it out a few times on some simple trails, rides fine.  I adjusted the brakes, and they don't squeak as much (they still squeak).      Things I do not like:  The seat is extremely uncomfortable and will soon be picking up a gel seat cushion.  After an hour ride, my rearwill hurt for a day or so from the seat.  The pedals don't freely spin, which sucks when your foot slips off the pedal.  The bike weighs a ton, and that added weight makes hills even harder.  I had less trouble up hilly terrain on the Pacific Stratus, than on this Chromium.  On the upside, it is giving my legs a killer workout.

product_title: Texsport MAC Sports Canopy Chair - (Colors may vary)
review_body: Searched the web for several weeks looking for a reasonably nice yet inexpensive canopy chair.  Found this one on Amazon.  This chair does everything I had hoped it would.  It blocks the sun from my head and face while being very roomy and comfortable.  I especially love the color.  It's a very nice looking chair.  I'm happy.

product_title: Huffy 26-Inch Ladies Cruiser Newport Bike (Blue)
review_headline: Well made but poor assembly of wheels
review_body: Manufacture of the bike is very good (machining, welds, paint). Assembly of the wheels was poorly done. Wheels run out (wobble and eccentric) by as much as 1/8\\" which required spoke adjustment to correct. Suggest that tires be removed so the rim strip and tube can be checked prior to applying air. After fixing these problems, it seems to be a good vehicle.

product_title: HIAEFIRE Q5 CREE 240 Lumen LED Bike Bicycle flashlight Torch +1 x Bicycle Holder +3 AAA batteries + dual charger
review_body: I bought two of these for our marina bikes on our sailboat. The light is pretty bright and the beam is more tightly focused than I expected.  It does a surprisingly nice job of illuminating the path in front of you, but \\"Blaze\\" is a case of marketing puffery.  All I can say is on a moonless night on a country road the Blaze was bright enough for me in either the 1W or 2W mode.  The strobe mode is downright annoying.  The only way someone hits you with the strobe on is if you caused the driver an epileptic seizure. The mounting system is pretty good, although the bike's brake cables always seem to be right in front of the light. Overall, it's well made product that so far is holding up in a marine environment.

product_title: CUSCUS 6200ci Internal Frame Backpack Hiking Camp Travel Bag Navy
review_body: I purchased two of these for a trip to Fiji. I cannot attest to the long-duration durability but they worked great as luggage for the long trip because it was easy to transport with all our other luggage. The internal frame is quite nice for support and everything is pretty well padded. I felt like even if they only made it one trip it was worth the money because they were so cheap compared to other brands

product_title: DAKINE Girl's Nina Bag
review_body: I bought this bag in black for $14 dollars! It's a nice size, me being a smaller women, it's not TOO big but it's also enough to hold a ton of stuff, inside it has four nicely sized pockets as well, fantastic for storage.

product_title: RAD Cycle Products Bike Lift Hoist Garage Mountain Bicycle Hoist 100LB Capacity (2-Pack)
review_headline: Great product for saving space in your garage
review_body: This is a great product, really opens up garage floor space.  Not hard to install.  As for some reviewers complaining about the hooks not having more of a bend....well, I just have to shake my head, it's like the human race is losing its intelligence and intuition... BEND IT!

product_title: Goson Classic 57mm Mirror Lens Aviator Sunglasses
review_body: These are great.  They are exceptional quality, considering the price I paid, and they are metal.  The mirrors are hgihly reflective.  These are extremely dark,there is no way the sun could bother you while you wear them.  No one needs a poker face when you have these glasses to block your emotions.  Then again... they shade so much that you won't be able to play poker with them on unless you have a lamp right over the cards.

product_title: Survival Fishing Kit - Compact Kit For Campers/Hikers (10 Pieces)
review_headline: Nice compact Fishing Kit for emergency use
review_body: Don't expect this to be a complete fishing kit that you can run out and catch big fish the first time out.  This is geared toward emergency use, and as such it is minimal.  It fits nicely in a bug-out bag, and, with the exception of the included large sinkers (which are a bit too heavy for what is needed), has the basics to catch fish.  I am tradding out the sinkers and adding a few pan fish lures, but other than that it is fine the way it is.  It does have instructions to help beginners use the kit.

product_title: Three-Person Camping Dome Tent 7 Feet X 7 Feet One Touch Set Up
review_body: I was looking for something simple and quick and that is exactly what this is!  Our Boy Scout troop arrived in the camping area and in 5 minutes BAM! I was done with the entire assembly (the rain fly took the longest...tent itself was up in 2 minutes!)...meanwhile everyone else was still putting poles together.... I did do a seam sealer on it and it did rain one of the nights we camped and the tent was as dry as you can get.   The only \\"con\\" in the length of the packed tent... too long for backpacking it but it is a good...\\"Scout mom\\" tent hands down!

product_title: Razor RipStik Caster Board Replacement Wheel Set
review_body: I just put these new wheels on to my Ripstik and it rides like new again!  I am an adult so I wore down the wheels pretty quickly.  I couldn't find replacement wheels at any stores, so i just ordered them from Amazon.  I took free shipping and they came really quickly.  I ordered 3 packs so I am going to be good for quite a while.  Rip it up.

product_title: Pearl Izumi Infinity Intercool Cap
review_body: A great hat to me is one that fits well, looks good and is durable. This hat seems durable but the fit and feel are not great. The sweat band is a bit bulky and has a tendency not to stay up. This is not a hat that I expect to re-order.

product_title: Coleman 2000018295 8-Person Instant Tent, Black (14x10 Feet)
review_body: This truly is an instant tent, had no problems putting up or taking down. Held up well in a big wind storm & kept us dry in a 15 minute down pour of rain. Definately purchase or make stronger stakes as the ones supplied are a joke. Apart from the stakes, my only gripe is that the main entrance zipper requires both hands to open it, one to hold down the material & the other to zip it open. ( kind of interesting trying to open the tent holding a baby :-)   This is a large tent, the bag it's packed in is 4ft long x 1ft wide x 1ft high.   Definately an awesome tent & worth the money.

product_title: Kool Stop Brass Card/12 PV Valve Adaptor (Pack of 12)
review_body: This is a great deal. There are 12 adaptors and they are built well enough that you will probably only use them up if you lose them.  They fit well and are easy to use.

product_title: Intex Quick-Fill AC Electric Air Pump, 110-120 Volt, Max. Air Flow 21.2CFM
review_body: This is the most useless item ever. There is not enough power to blow up a stayball, and it screams the whole time it is on. Now it's just taking up space in my locker.

product_title: Chinese Sky Lanterns UFO Balloon
review_body: This product really did what it promised. We used them as a way to celebrate our family vacation every night. There is limited instructions how to get them to float but if you would allow them to heat up and to inflate, it truly is a great memory maker.

product_title: Hobson Easyseat Ergonomical Dual Pad Bicycle Saddle
review_headline: Seat broke after 3 rides on flat surface
review_body: After installing a Hobson Seat on my LandRider bicycle, and taking it out for 3 rides on flat, easy surfaces, the seat broke.  There was no warning, as the left pad fell into the muddy ditch.  Bluntly, I was all but buggered by my own seat post.  Of course, I was past the 30-day warranty.  I am an experienced, recreational rider, 69 years old, 6' 6\\" tall and 250 lbs. weight.  This saddle may be just the thing for a small person of average weight, dressed in skin-tight racing duds, riding hunched down over a set of dropped handlebars.  For the average street and trail-riding cyclist, I DO NOT RECOMMEND THIS PRODUCT - save your money and buy something else.

product_title: RipStik "G" Caster Board
review_body: I dont know how to skateboard but this made it so easy. Would recommend it even to those young at heart like me :)

product_title: Sawyer Products Premium Insect Repellent with 20% Picaridin
review_body: The Summer of 2010 was a really bad one for biting flies on the Chicago Lake Michigan beaches a block and a half from our home.        Fortunately we had just returned from a vacation in Florida for which we bought 3 different types of insect repellent; a 20% DEET product, a popular Lemon Eucalyptus based product and Sawyer's 20% Picardin spray.       We proceeded to use all three at various times and of them the Sawyer was the only one truly effective against the flies.  (The Lemon Eucalyptus product just seemed to amuse them and,  while the DEET containing spray was mildly effective against the casual pacifist fly with no real ambition, it withered before the truly determined pest and most of all when they swarmed ... as I said, a bad summer for flies.)       With the added benefit of not being DEET (with all of its problems and concerns) there was no question of which product we were going to re-order for this Summer.       In fact I just did.

product_title: Hydro Flask Stainless Steel Insulated Drinking Bottle, Narrow Mouth
review_body: I love this bottle! It arrived super quick, too. Washed it out and put it in the freezer (cap off) with 1/2 cup of water overnight. Filled it and it stayed cold for over 15 hours. I actually refilled it once @ the office and the tiny bit of ice remaining in the bottle kept the water cold. It's lighter and sleeker than my thermos 24oz hydration bottle I also purchased on amazon. The only complaint I have is that I wish hydro flask sold a sport top for this bottle on amazon. between this and the Zojirushi SM-JA48BA 0.48-Liter Stainless Steel Vacuum Insulated Mug I also bought on amazon for hot drinks, I am set! All other travel bottles and mugs are going out to recycle.

product_title: Avenir Coil Combo Cable Locks
review_body: These cables are sturdy and the design is excellent.  They can easily be mounted on about any bike, and you can customize your passcode, which is a nice feature.  Another good product from Avenir.

product_title: Cateye CC-TR300TW Triple Wireless Cadence and Heart Rate Bicycle Computer
review_body: This is a great little device.  It does take some time to configure and program...not intuitive but doable if you're patient.  Don't think you're going to pull it out of the box and start riding 2 minutes later.  Once set up, it does just what it's supposed to do.  Only thing keeping it from getting 5 stars is the ability to download the trip data.  Seems like they could put a USB port with a watertight seal on the bottom and let you download the data to Excel or something.  Right now, I just copy the lap data by hand to my training logs.

product_title: Vintage Black Wayfarer Style Sunglasses
review_headline: cheapest pair of wayfarers... do not buy.
review_body: I decided not to listen to some of the other reviews thinking they wouldnt be that bad... they are literally the cheapest pair of sunglasses. They are worse than dollar store glasses. I recommend buying from 80s vintage. I ordered one pair from each company, different colors, and these black ones were the worst out of all of them. DO NOT BUY or you will be writing a review just like this one.

product_title: Nashbar LDT Rack
review_body: Comes with all the stuff you need to mount it, very versatile.  Could be a little stronger, but I am not carrying building materials on it, so it works fine.  The Nashbar rack bags work extremely well with this rack with minimal mounting and dismounting time.

product_title: Kool Kovers Bicycle Shoe Cleat Cover Set
review_body: Some other reviews say they fall off the cleat.  This has never been a problem.  I've used them around 10 times on my commute which includes a 75 yard walk on pavement, a climb up 3 flights of stairs and the same or more walking in the building.  A simple product that works very well.

product_title: ALPS Mountaineering Clearwater Ultra Lightweight Mummy Sleeping Bag (20 Degree)
review_body: This is a great sleeping bag, especially for the price.  I can get it stored down to the size of about a coffee can, and it is very light.  I have had no issues staying warm in temperatures above 20 degrees, and all of the zippers are of high quality and don't jam easily.  No complaints here.

product_title: Greenfield Rubber Foot
review_body: Bought these for a [[ASIN:B000FR33ZM Pletscher Two-leg Kickstand 320mm Silver]] (I bought the black one), and they look/feel/work super. No glue used, very tight fit, but the way the end is cut, makes it easy to put on. They seem very well made. Would buy these again if ever needed.

product_title: JanSport T501 Superbreak Backpack
review_body: My 7 year old LOVES this back pack, It is very sturdy and holds all her stuff and is not too big. Love the zebra print too!

product_title: Slime Bicycle Tube Protector
review_headline: I would stay away from Slime products.
review_body: The Slime Liner had sharp ridges on one side and smooth on the other side. The Slime instruction did not mention the Liner needs to be installed side specific. A brand new tube was destroyed  After 90 miles I got another flat, small steel wire went through the Slime Tube Protector.  I posted pictures.    Slime customer service did not respond to my email complainant.

product_title: New Wave 2.2 Liter BPA Free Plastic w/Sturdy stainless steel cap (Blue)
review_body: I was hopeful that I had found a large water bottle to take to work with me. However, the lid does not screw all the way and it constantly leaked water.  The top appeared to be sideways as if the plastic did not mold properly.  It upsets me that someone would ship something when it was defective by appearance.  I promptly had to throw it away, and am still searching for a large water bottle =(.

product_title: Oxy-Sorb Oxygen Absorber, 2000cc
review_body: A general internet search will reveal that this is a good purchase.  I used these to seal some buckets I had packaged for rice.  They worked perfect.  One thing to remember is once you open the package, you have to use them all, since they are not individually wrapped.

product_title: Pearl iZUMi Transfer Hat
review_headline: Great hat, hardly know you are wearing it
review_body: I have a fairly large head and often hats can give me a headache. Not this one. It is soft, flexible and you hardly know you have it on. It keeps you warm and was a great purchase overall.

product_title: LEDwholesalers 51-LED 395nm Ultra Violet Blacklight UV Flashlight 3xAA, 7202UV395
review_body: Great for detecting scorpions and anything else. Not extremely bright, but not too dim either. Just the right size, durable, and made out of metal.

product_title: SpongeBob Child Pacific Nickelodeon Hardshell Helmet and Pads
review_body: I bought this as a suggestion from amazon as a bundle with the spongbob bike.  the helmet is very well constructed and fits a 6 year old girls head well.  the knee pads not so much.  my grand daughter is an average kid but the knee pads are kind of small.  i was also upset with the color.  it didn't match the bike.  but that was my problem.  no one else seemed to care.  i just assumed if they bundled something its because it went together.

product_title: Brunton Raptor Foldable Canister Stove with Piezo Ignition
review_body: Ideal burner if you are looking to go light. After a couple times out I noticed the ignition wasn't working properly. I just turned up the fuel and it was fine. I have one, my brother has one and I would recommend this burner to anyone.

product_title: NeoSport Full Body Sports Skins - Diving, Snorkeling & Swimming
review_body: I wanted something to cover me up while swimming in our pool and this served the purpose perfectly. I took the advice of other reviewers and ordered one size larger. I'm 5'6'' and 137lbs and usually wear a size 2-4/XS-S. The medium size is almost perfect except it could have been a bit longer in the legs. I did not \\"struggle\\" to put it on as other reviewers have mentioned; however, I did have to get help to take it off after the swim! I felt very comfortable while swimming and did not feel any drag. Overall, good buy!

product_title: Coleman Liquid Fuel Lantern Hard-Shell Carry Case
review_headline: Ive been putting off this case for too long, Its perfect.
review_body: I have been using the original box my lantern came in since 1993. It had stains on it and our last camp outing it got wet. I really like this case its a tight fit and hold latern firm. It has extra room on the base to hold xtra mantles and matches.  If I have one complaint is that it doest have any room for my funnel/filter so Im rigging something else up for that.

product_title: Columbia Men's High Line Ridge Pant
review_body: Length is great. Travels well and cleans off easily. Pockets are spacious and useful--since most have velcro or zipper--without being like some cargo pants: big and bulky looking. The size chart says 32-35. That's too big of a range to really be meaningful. I'm a 32 waist. It fits like a 34\\" to 35\\". So if you're more of  34\\" waist, go for it, if smaller... what a waste.    I got them last minute before a 10 day trip to London, only brought one other pair of pants and these did well.

product_title: Intex Pillow Rest Raised Airbed with Built-in Pillow and Electric Pump
review_body: Purchased this bed for the Hershey car show to have a comfortable extra bed in the hotel room and this product did not disappoint.  Quality product - easy to inflate and deflate and worth every cent I paid for it !!!!!

product_title: Outdoor Products Power Pack Daypack
review_headline: greatest computer bag for a traveling consultant
review_body: Having taken a consulting job with frequent travel - this bag is a wonderous, portable office - cubbies for all your cable (chargers, usb, headphones), places for drinks, security badges...  I have two laptops and an ipad, a filing section for paper, place for my sunglasses...  I have some cubbies I haven't even used yet.    As other reviewers have mentioned, with all the gear, the only downside is the straps.  Not the most padded or comfortable, but tolerable.

product_title: Kijaro Dual Lock Folding Chair (XX-Large)
review_body:
Nice chair, pretty heavy and durable, however mine arrived with part of the rubber/plastic foot of the chair broken off and dangling from the end of it.

Update: After owning it for a year and a half, I sat in it today, and one of the rivets holding a cross support to the leg snapped off completely, rendering the chair useless. FYI I'm 230lbs, the chair says it supports up to 400lbs, so I'm well within that range.

Update 2: After contacting Kijaro they requested I take photos of the damage, then sent out a replacement immediately. Gotta love a company that stands behind their product.

product_title: Eurosocks Patented Recovery Graduated Compression OTC Socks
review_body:
I use compression socks for medical purpose. They are difficult to find and don't look very good. When I saw these, they were the same price as \\"medical\\" compression socks, but they looked better. I didn't think anything that looked good would be effective. I had a double lung transplant and I didn't want to take chances.

I purchased the running socks for my wife and she loves them. Since she is on her feet all day, she will often complain of tired feet. I decided to get one pair for her to try. She loved them and her feet stopped aching. Then I tried them and I got the same result, comfortable to wear, not as ugly as medical socks, and twice as effective. We immediately bought 3 more pairs and will be buying more.

product_title: Nalgene HDPE 48oz Silo Wide Mouth BPA-Free Water Bottle
