review_body: I use this with the MSR miniworks.  It holds water. The cap seems to be well made and i have used this about 10 times and no problems.

product_title: Axiom Power Top Tube Bag
review_body: I really like the bag. It puts items in reach easily. The problem I have noticed was that after a 1 hour ride it is already scuffing up the paint on my top tube. I read about this problem on the double bag so I wanted to check this one for scuffing also. I'm glad I did. I am thinking it is actually the straps that are doing the damage, they are very rough on the bike side.    I am going to have to put some kind of barrier between the two.

product_title: SIGG 8195.40 REDUCE REUSE RECYCLE 1.0L WATER BOTTLE
review_headline: Great bottle if it had an improved lining
review_body: I use this bottle all the time ~ it is the perfect size for someone on the go and I only have to drink two of these (66 ounces more or less) to meet my water requirements ~ and I like the color and the \\"Reduce Reuse Recycle\\" is a good motto to promote to others as you carry it around.  However, after only a few months, the lining of the bottle is starting to peel around the opening.  I know this is supposed to be the \\"new and improved\\" lining without BPA, but the designers at SIGG need to go back to the drawing board.

product_title: Tire Bicycle, 700 X 25 Inch Puncture Resistant, Puncture Guard, thorn resistant, Comfortable ride by Biria
review_body: this is the worst tires i've ever had. the puncture guard doesn't seem to work well. i had flats in just  weeks ruining my trips. not only that, it's very sluggish tire coz u can only inflate it up to 65 psi plus the treads wear too fast. i wouldn't buy this tire again. stay away form it.

product_title: O'Neill Women's Skins Short Sleeve Crew (Royal/White)
review_body: Arrive home last night to find a package waiting for me.  I was so excited that I ripped opened the box, nice packaging by the way.  it was the Rashguard I ordered a few days ago, it's the right size. i was alittle worried about buying clothes on-line, since you can't try it on first and I didn't have time to send it back before my trip.  I love the color and design, even my son was impressed (he wants one now) I can't wait to use it on my trip. Snorkling, here I come!!!!

product_title: Brunton New Profile Two Burner Stove
review_body: Bought this stove after reviewing many different brands. Took alittle getting used  to adjusting the burners and lighting them but with alittle time I had it down.  I recommend this stove to anyone.

product_title: Kryptonite New York Fahgettaboudit Mini Bicycle U-Lock
review_headline: Beware! Other kryptonite lock owners can probably open your lock !
review_body:
This lock is a heavy duty lock and is said to have the highest security level!
My friend has this same lock and tried his key in my lock And his key opened my lock?
How is that high security ?
Also One day I locked my bike outside and it rained briefly the lock got wet and a few days later The inside chamber Became rusty !
Kryptonite I love the lock but seriously needs to correct these 2 major problems!

product_title: Ocean Kayak Comfort Tech Seat Back
review_headline: Decent features except poor padding for tush, which is a deal breaker
review_body: This seat came with our S.O.T Ocean Kayaks. Tried it out today.     Cons - I am 130 lbs & after 45 mins in my Venus 11, my tush was getting sore. My husband who weighs 160 lbs in a Mysto kayak had no problem. The odd thing about this seat is they cushioned the back well yet barely the seat. My back doesn't need cushion (especially since the life jacket does that)just support. It is the seat on a plastic SOT kayak that needs cushioning. I will modify to add cushion or get a better seat & use this as a backup.     Pros - All brass buckles secure it in place well. Nice height, support & mesh on the backrest.

product_title: Polar Bottle Insulated Water Bottle - 24oz (discontinued colors)
review_body: Finally, a water bottle that has clean plastic and keeps your drinks cold too!  Just might want to pick up a water bottle brush to clean the inside real good if your using a lot of powdered drinks in it.  Yes you can safely throw it in the dishwasher too!

product_title: Sterno Emergency Candles and Clear Mist
review_body: Prompt shipping, I'm trying to use for Emergency only for vehicles in winter only. For survival in extreme cold. They appear to be very convenient for that purpose, easy to store. I just thought of something, what if the liquid parafin freezes? I'd better do more research.

product_title: Velo Transit Metro 20 Waterproof Rear Modular Pannier
review_body: There's a \\"newer\\" version Velotransit has which includes an inner zip pocket and shoulder carrying straps. When ordered through amazon (at this point anyway) you get the original which does not include these. I simply called Velotransit and they are sending the pocket and carrying straps to me!! Wonderful customer service, you can't beat good customer service. Love the product as well, perfect. 5 stars

product_title: Nutcase Little Nutty Chartreuse Metallic (Matte) Kids Bike Helmet, X-Small
review_body: Perfect helmet for our active 3 year old. Would purchase again in a heartbeat. Great for biking and other sports.

product_title: Aluma Wallet - the Indestructible Aluminum RFID Blocking Wallet
review_headline: Brand NEW Was broken straight from the package
review_body:
I bought this for my husband. We saw it on TV and my husband, who is hard on wallets wanted one. So I picked one up at the store. I gave it to him. He opened the packaging went to open the Aluma wallet and the \\"indestructable wallet\\" broke. The pretty blue aluminum pieces on it came off. WHY because they are held on by STICKY TAPE. And when you went to hit the clasp on the wallet they would pop right back off. Then we looked at the inside. Its cheap flimsy plastic. BIGGEST waste of time and money.

I do not recommend DO NOT WASTE YOUR MONEY ON THIS CHEAP RIDICULOUS PRODUCT.

product_title: OD Trifold Medical Bag - (without contents)
review_body: This is one cool bag and not just for a first aid kit. You can do anything with it. Instead of having multiple nylon bags floating around your backpack you can have one or to of these. They pack real nice and you can stow related supplies together. Neat bag!

product_title: Zippo Jack Daniel's Lighters
review_body: 2 replacements.... Finally a refund. It goes bad after 3-4 days of use! I suggest you get a another zippo....

product_title: Mora Bushcraft Triflex Carbon Steel Knife
review_body: This is a great knife for the money but the carbon steele blade will rust and stain real quick, like in minutes in salt water. If you want a field knife it gets sharp quick and is good steel. The handle has a foam type grip but firm. I swam with it on the saltwater flats and it stained and rusted in minutes. I don't blame this on poor quality or anything because I knew this before I bought it I wanted a general all around field knife. If you want a saltwater knife get a stainless blade. A great knife especially for the price and I will buy another one but will try the military version on the next one.

product_title: #2680C Pelican HeadsUp Recoil LED Flashlight
review_body: My boss had bought me and my crew 4 of these lights for work. We've been through all the other garbage out there. The other rinky-dinky headlights can't hold a candle to these lights! I am a Local 78 Hazardous Materials Laborer in NYC and used these lights deep underground in a sewage treatment plant with waste literally 8 feet high! Not only were they the brightest lights we ever encountered, but the most durable AND waterproof. These were our best friend and deconing the lights everyday was extremely important when clealiness was at stake. We submerged them repeatedly in water and still keep going! The cloth strap was great for non-hardhat use and the rubber strap was perfect for hardhats! A little clumbsy but you get used to it. Well worth the money!

product_title: Schwinn Kids Child Boy Value Pack
review_headline: Great price and will fit for years to come!!
review_body: We bought this helmet for our 2 1/2 year old son and he absolutely loves it!! In fact, he insisted on wearing it around the house even though we were not going on a bike ride for a couple of hours. There is plenty of room for him to grow more into it and the fit is great! The package said for ages 5+ but once I made the necessary adjustments, it fit our son great!

product_title: Coleman Queen Quickbed with Wrap 'N' Roll Storage
review_headline: WARNING -- No pump, no customer service, and no returns
review_body: I have no way of knowing if this product has leaks or works, because I did not realize it comes without a pump or any other way to inflate it. It does come with a big piece of paper saying \\"DO NOT RETURN THIS PRODUCT TO THE PLACE OF PURCHASE\\" and a consumer service phone number. Calling the number is a waste of time; I was put on hold indefinitely. Coleman's on-line FAQs casually reveal that they are sorry returns cannot be accepted unless the product is defective. It doesn't say that anywhere on the Amazon site. I have never run into anything like this before. Ever. I would not recommend dealing with this company.  Update: I accept the comments pointing out that I could have returned this enormous piece of plastic to Amazon, if I could manage to roll it up (I don't often shop online so I didn't know), and that it's my own fault for not reading carefully. Also, Coleman did provide a pump eventually, though I have had no chance to use it.

product_title: Portland Design Works Radbot 1000 Tail Light
review_body: Got this light in May 2011.  Worked great for 5 months, then when my first set of Duracells died, and I put a fresh set in, the light turned right on, and now won't turn off or change setting.  When I was changing the batteries I noticed some corrosion/battery acid around two of the terminals.  I'm guessing this was the cause of the failure.  I couldn't perceive any moisture inside, but since it doesn't have an O-ring, I suppose water could have caused the problem.   In Summary: After 5 months of regular use in Buffalo, NY, the button stopped working.  CORRECTION:  after about 10 minutes of being constantly on, the light flashed once and turned off.  After that, the button started working perfectly fine again.  Not sure wha the problem was, but it's fine now.

product_title: Planet Bike 5022 Men's ARS Competition Anatomic Relief Saddle with Gel
review_body: I do not wear padded shorts, and a $30 Avenir seat from Dick's is more comfortable.  I ride a hybrid bike and seat more upright, which could be the reason.

product_title: Coleman WeatherMaster 6-Person Screened Tent
review_body: I boucht this tent for a week long stay in the Shenandoah National Park.  I had some other tents of the dome variety but they were aging and did not provide me with enough room to stand.  Also the trip was my wife's first camping trip and I wanted it to be a good experience for her so I had to upgrade.  I seriously considered the elite version of this tent but believe the only real difference between the two (besides the huge price difference) was the LED lighting system and the windows that have the automatic rolling feature both with the elite version.  As I already have a coleman tent light the LED lighting system of the elite did not motivate me to shell out the extra cash.  Roll up windows are cool but again seem more like a novelty for the large price difference between this version and the elite.  During my stay, I had no problems at all.  We slept through two rainstorms without any leaks.  Also we were camping during the hottest days of the year but this tent provided enough ventilation so that we were able to sleep comfortably.  My tent light I purchased years earlier provided ample light and reinforced my decision to go with this less expensive but high quality tent.  The only criticism I have for this tent is that the inside only has one small hanging pocket for small items like keys and a wallet.  I wish there were more but there is so much room in this tent that it only bothered me slightly.  It would be very hard to be disapointed with this purchase!

product_title: Dakine Scooler Pack
review_body: I spend quite some time checking quality, price, reviews etc. before buying any thing online and always quite happy with what is delivered at the end. This indeed is a perfect backpack. I bought it for my daughter who is 7 - second grader who stays in latch key after school. so she has quite a lot of stuff to carry with her. This bag holds everything well. Its hrady, handy and looks smart on a girl too. Lunch bag can carry a bottle, an apple, lunch box and a snack pack. Perfect buy for the price. If you prefer a child with no princess and cartoons, but plain - smart school stuff and have a lot to carry - this is perfect.

product_title: Christmas Sale 100% BRAND NEW Military Folding Shovel Survival Spade Emergency Garden Camping Outdoor Tool NEW
review_body: ha sido muy util en mis experiencias de montañismo en especial cuando acampas en tierra dura y hacer una canal es un poco mas dificil. lo recomiendo

product_title: Coleman Sundome 6 Tent
review_headline: Good quality for a reasonable price
review_body: This is a lot of tent for not much more than $100. It holds four people and their gear comfortably. It is very well ventilated -- no condensation forms on the interior walls or ceiling overnight even with the rainfly on and doors closed. Having two doors is very convenient, allowing everyone to enter and exit without stepping over other people.    It's fairly easy to set up with two people. I've successfully set it up alone, but it is  difficult because of the length of the poles and height of the tent. It can be easily taken down and packed into its case by one person.    The roof and upper walls are screens. This makes the tent very comfortable in hot weather with no rain when the rainfly isn't needed. And both doors have screened windows which can be covered from the inside. All door and window zippers work well.

product_title: Columbia Women's Cozie Cutie Shirt Jacket
review_body: I love this jacket!  It's cute, form-fitting, and perfect as a fall jacket.  I found it in the store, and I think trying it on first is key.  I'm definitely small and small-chested, but my arms are usually too long for petite sizes...so this is the perfect jacket for me (in a size small).  FYI, I'm about 5'-3\\" and 118 pounds or so.  This jacket might not work for larger people or those with petite-sized arms.  But if you're like me, you will love it!

product_title: Camelbak Rim Runner 100 oz Hydration Pack
review_body: Loved this backpack.  It compresses down when you are only taking a couple of items but has the capacity to enlarge if you stuff it full of junk.  There were plenty of pockets and the top one is lined so it keeps things dry even if it's misty out.  The camelbak system as you probably already know is awesome.  It is easy to fill and clean.  I liked the addition of being able to disconnect the tube at the base which then seals itself off.  The strap along your waist is also detachable which you don't need if you're not carrying much.  The chest adjustment slides up and down for a better fit too. I really have no complaints about it if you are doing a day hike.  It might be too small if you're thinking of hiking on some 3 day trek but Camelbak has plenty of others to suit those needs. Pockets on both sides for drinks also which is helpful if your friend didn't bring anything or you can stuff things in it like rain gear. Enjoy. Would totally get it again.

product_title: ACS Crossfire 6-Notch Removal Tool
review_body: After pointing out to Amazon that not only the image, but the product features and description for this ACS Crossfire 6-Notch Removal Tool are wrong and actually for an ACS Claws (4-notch) Freewheel, Amazon replies:    \\"We have determined that no change needs to be made to the product image you have specified\\"  I guess as long as the products are made by the same company it doesn't really matter to Amazon if image or product description are even remotely correct. I understand that Amazon website folks may not know much about bike components, but common sense should tell them a freewheel and a freewheel removal tool are going to look and function differently, and if it doesn't perhaps they should listen to their customers who actually know something about these products.    I have purchased a lot of merchandise from Amazon over the years and the grossly inaccurate product information and images has always been their Achille's heel, particularly when it comes to less common components that require accurate product description nomenclature and specifications. Amazon bike parts are a good example, yes they are cheaper then the local bike shop, but you never really know what you are going to get... a freewheel removal tool or a freewheel. Bikers beware!

product_title: World Jerseys Men's Spam Cycling Jersey
review_body:
What I'm looking for in a riding jersey is a snug fit that makes body contact without puckering or wrinkling. But not boa constrictor tight. In other makes and models I wear XL for that snugness. In this product XL is too large.

Fairly pricey product. A full length zipper makes a big difference getting out of a jersey at the end of a ride. This jersey needs one.

I suspect either a variability in sizing or an incommensurability in how we reviewers are estimating size and fit. - What the hail, it's colorful and gets attention. Something I want as a rider is to be seen early and seen often. I'll try the L and continue this report later.

If my S.O. won't let me wear the XL to social occasions I suspect that someone is going to get a heck of a deal at Goodwill.

product_title: Coleman Montana 4 Person Tent
review_body:
By far the best tent I've had the pleasure to reside in for multiple weekends.
Spacious enough for a full airbed and room for luggage, mud mat, and water supply. I am short, but the height of the tent was satisfying for me, not quite tall enough to stand without your head touching the ceiling. Ideal for two people, very comfortable.
A few features really sold this tent for me:
1. the small porthole opening at the bottom back of the tent. This is the most innovative addition to recreational/affordable tents I've seen in a while. It allows for fan venting, increased airflow, easy access to items outside of tent (say a cooler), and many more uses your imagination can conjure up.
2. The rainfly design. It's very easy to put up and has the added overhang at the front door to keep you and the interior of your living space dry while you're entering. The first time I used this tent, I was caught in a terrible rain. The rainfly kept the whole tent dry, however I urge you to keep it taught or drooping sections can cause leaks from pooling water.
3. Overall design. This is the easiest tent I have ever put up! The poles are color coded to their sleeves and there are large air vents at the top of the tent. It was great watching fireworks through the screened ceiling with a nice breeze coming in at the same time.
Lastly, Amazon has the best price for this tent, where I've seen it at Dick's Sporting Goods for well over $150!
Hope this was helpful :)

product_title: PEARL iZUMi Elite Softshell Glove white
review_body: I'm from a warm climate so I'm not used to dealing with the cold. I did quite a bit of research, and bought these gloves as well as some Pearl Izumi liners for a trip to Chicago in January of 2011. They didn't work as well as I would have liked. The tips of my fingers got cold after walking outside in the city all day.    But for where I live, they're just fine.

product_title: Coleman SunDome 7-Foot by 7-Foot 3-Person Dome Tent (Orange/Gray)
review_body: I'm giving this tent 5 stars because I've had no issues and the price is great. The tent sets up in less than five minutes, super easy even for just one person. Along the same lines, the tent also comes down quickly and is easy to repack in the bag. The bag has the instructions sewn on, which is great. The tent is spacious. While it's recommended as a three person, four average size adults could fit if needed. But for two, very roomy as well as for three. I've used this twice when it's rained and I've had no problems with leakage. Really, for the price, this is a great tent.

product_title: BRACELET EFX SILICONE SPORT BLACK YELLOW
review_body: I have mild arthritis in my lower back and deal will a consistent ache, after hearing about the EFX product from some friends I decided to give it a try seeing no downside. I have been pleased with results. After wearing the bracelet for about a week there was noticeable improvement, even the absence of the ache everyday. After playing my first round of golf since wearing the bracelet I had significantly less discomfort during and after the round. Not sure how it works but it sure seems to be effective.

product_title: California Innovations High Performance Thermal Tote 56 Can Cooler Bag for Hot or Cold - Multi Color
review_body: This is one of the best thermal bags I have ever used!  It keeps the food or beverages cold for hours and doesn't sweat.......Love it!

product_title: AIRHEAD AHAO-1 Aqua Oasis Insulated Nylon Cooler with Removable Floating Base
review_body: The Kwik Tek Airhead Aqua Oasis was a birthday present hit!  It is so convenient to store cold drinks in this inflatable cooler while having fun in our swimming pool.

product_title: WeeRide Pro-Pilot Bicycle Trailer
review_body: I've had this only a few days and we've already put at 20+ miles on it, my 6yr old loves it, no more whining when he is tired. You'll be so glad you bought it!

product_title: DT Swiss Competition spoke, sil DB14g-box100 260mm
review_body: What else is there to say - perfectly good spokes at a great price. As good & easy as it gets.

product_title: HL CORP City Chromed Steel Touring Comfort City Bicycle Bike Handlebar Bar 25.4mm
review_body: I just received this handlebar, and I am impressed with it's quality. Smooth as silk finish; nice chamfered ends; nothing on it says 'cheap'.   For the curious: the ends appear to be bent somewhat over a 45 degree angle from a straight line.

product_title: Energizer 4 LED Headlight
review_body: I use this item at night in Afghanistan and have had no problems with it. It is bright in both modes, red and white, and has helped me a lot. Great product for the price, couldn't ask for more.

product_title: Intex Inflatable Fabric Camping Mattress with Built-In Pillow
review_body: Took to Bonnaroo. 3 days sleeping on floor.  W/O this I wouldnt have been able to lay down. Period.  A little more rugged that pool lounger but would nvr leave to sleep on floor for 7 days with out item.  Def recomm.  Buyer cool too.

product_title: Pedro's Tire Levers
review_body: This is a great tire lever and seems very strong and does not give when working. I like that they snap together and you can clip it on to a spoke when working to free up a hand.

product_title: ExOfficio Men's BugsAway Ziwa Pant
review_headline: ADVISORY, You may be able to save some MONEY!!
review_body:
First, I don't own but these seem EXPENSIVE!!
Second, you can get SAME results it would seem by buying Permethrin Spray Sawyer SP657 Permethrin Premium Insect Clothing Repellent, 24-Ounce Spray and spraying your OWN existing clothing. Just think about it before you buy.

If you go to Insect Shield(tm) web site ([website addy deleted by Amazon -- Google it]) they give you link to CDC / EPA-OSHA about insect protective clothing ([...]) which cites ONLY Permethrin as an effective garment treatment for protection against ticks, as it deals solely with Lyme Disease (tick borne), and I quote:

Use insecticides such as Permethrin for greater protection.
Permethrin kills ticks on contact.
Permethrin can be used on clothing but should not be used on skin.
One application of permethrin to pants, socks, and shoes typically stays effective through several washings.
Ref: [website addy deleted by Amazon -- follow InsectShield(tm) link to it at bottom of their product promotion.]

Just so you know what you are getting ...

product_title: Yakima FlipSide 4-Bike Hitch Mount Rack (1.25 and 2-Inch Receiver)
review_body: Do not use this bike rack until you have received the replacement retention pin or you're bikes will end up with roadrash!!!  The overall build quality seems good.  Made of heavy duty aluminum.  Just some oversight and lack of testing.

product_title: Seirus Innovation 8040 Ultra Clava for Complete Head Face Mask and Neck Protection 4-Way Stretch TOP SELLER
review_body: when I first purchased this product I was very excited, but when it came in the mail, I was very upset. The actual product was nothing like the picture it shows you when your browsing the product. It doesnt have the nose and mouth cover like the picture shows. It is only for your head and even if you wanted to use it to cover your mouth and nose it doesnt quite fit right and it bunches on the side and sticks out. Make sure of what your'e buying before you buy it.

product_title: CatEye - Strada Cadence Cycle Computer
review_body: I previously used schwin and Bell computers.  Yes, cheap and simple like me!  I decided after my Bell jammed and kept cycling past the desired numbers to check out something a little better.  The design seemed simple and, as stated, a larger display.  Mounting was comparable to my previous computers but a second sensor On the peddle is used for cadence.  This one was an issue because I ride a recumbent.  The distance between the crank arm and frame was too great.  After crafting a PVC pipe fitting I had it done.  My biggest surprise (and joy) was finding out I did not have to re-enter my wheel circumference every time I reset the computer.  Thank you Cateye for a great product that is easy on this old guys eyes!

product_title: Clean Bottle 24-Ounce Water Bottle
review_body: Man, this to me is the epitome of a great marketing campaign. I've been riding and racing bikes for over 35 years, and I do have to say that up until about 10 years ago, bike-bottles were horrible. The smell and opening-size were bad. Now, most all bottles have large openings, and screw-on lids - like this one. Some even impart absolutely no smell on any liquids you're carrying, and have clever one-way valves (so you don't get any sugary sports-drink sprayed all over your lovely bike - or worse yet, all over your front derailleur). There's one called a \\"Podium\\" that is fantastic (won't give the manufacturer, because this is supposed to be a review of the clean bottle).    What do I do to keep my bottles clean? Rinse them with hot soapy water after each use, and use a miracle product that everyone should know about: a bottle brush!!! Works wonders, and makes the need for a bottom that screws off completely unnecessary. I have absolutely no gunk (or worse) built up in any of my bottles. \\"Problem\\" solved. Oh yeah, dishwashers do a great job too.    This really seems like a solution for a problem that doesn't/shouldn't exist. But again, good marketing can create an interest and \\"need\\" for unnecessary products.    Now, this \\"Clean Bottle\\" has me thinking... if it does catch on, I think the public will be ready for another \\"brilliant\\" idea: drinking glasses that have bottoms that screw off. Just need a fancy marketing campaign, and a guy dressed up an outfit to run along side riders at the Tour de France... Hmm, guess it wouldn't make sense for a guy dressed up like a drinking glass with a screw-off bottom to run along side bike riders. Scratch that idea.

product_title: eZip by Currie Technologies 24-Volt Bicycle Battery Pack
review_body: The battery pack is a bit heavy but it is a lead acid battery. Plug and play right out if the box.

product_title: Smith Optics Unisex Adult Hustle Snow Sports Helmet
review_body: It's a little bulky on my head (I'm a larger medium), but not ridiculous looking. And it's comfortable. It stays put and isn't too heavy, and once I properly adjusted the chin strap it doesn't try to choke me either. It is warm too, especially with the vents closed. In fact, I can't wear this even with them open on a spring day with the sun shining. That's the only con, maybe it needs more openable vents. That and goggles don't really sit above the brim, they just slide back when you aren't wearing them. Can't wait to gut some headphones and put them in the ear pads. They open up all the way around so you can run the wire from left to right inside the pad. Not really a fan of skullcandy, who makes the simple swap in audio pads.

product_title: Coleman Oil of Lemon Eucalyptus, Deet Free Insect Repellent Bug Sprays
review_body: Can not use DEET and this product, while not as good as DEET products, Oil of Lemon Eucalyptus does seem to work pretty good.  All of the Oil of Lemon Eucalyptus products I have tried seem to have the same concentration, 30 percent.  What makes this one stand out a little from the other brands is the bottle.  I like to carry the bottle with me when I go walking or hiking.  The other brands I tried just have a cap on the top of the sprayer which come off easily and the sprayer can leak or get pushed easily to dispense the product in my pocket.  This does not have a cap but the sprayer twists to lock it and clicks into the locking position.  No leaks, no mess.

product_title: PISTIL Women's Carmen Brim Hat
review_body: This is a cute little hat at a good price. It is adjustable in the back which is helpful as I sometimes find hats too tight. When worn loose it doesn't mess my hair up so I'm not stuck either wearing the hat all day or no hat at all. It is perfect for one of those crazy hair days or as an accessory to an outfit. I'd definitely recommend this one!

product_title: Wald 535 Rear Twin Bicycle Carrier Basket (18 x 7.5 x 12)
review_body: The functionality of this basket exceeded my expectations. Does everything I need it to do. It is sturdy and very easy to install. I have recommend it to all my friends that join me at the Wednesday night Denver cruiser functions.

product_title: Sunlite HD Touring Spring Rack, Black
review_headline: cheap cheap cheap. Keep shopping for something better
review_body: First the good. The rack is very light weight and the spring clip is fairly strong. I also like that it is adjustable for different sized bikes. Now the bad. The mounting brackets that hold the rack to the top of the frame broke my first day out. I only had about 10 lbs strapped to it. So now I have to figure out another way to mount it. The adjusters on the bottom are also poorly made. They look like they did a rush job at the factory when they made them. There are almost no attachment points for attaching bungee straps so that makes it a little difficult to secure your items. And as others have said, there is virtually no instructions but if you have a little experience working on bikes, installing shouldn't be a problem. It took me about 10 minutes. I would only recommend this rack if you are on a budget or if you just need something for VERY light loads. The description says 50lbs but my little 10 pound bag broke both of the brackets so there is no way I would trust it with 50. One last thing, the screws that come with this rack are very cheap and if you're not careful, you'll strip out the heads.

product_title: Coleman Tent Kit
review_body: I bought this for my little brother for his birthday and it was everything he needed to maintain his tent.  He was very pleased, and so was I!

product_title: Princeton Tec EOS LED Headlamp
review_body: I took this headlamp on an overnight hiking camp out.  We had to hike in the dark for two hours and find a campsite in the dark.  Worked great in the cold. (I did have lithium batteries in it).  This light performed very well. I like the simplicity, light weight, and good light performance.  Great for backpacking, and great all around head lamp for the price.

product_title: Shimano PD-M324 SPD Dual Platform Pedal
review_body: Purchased these pedals as a transition from regular pedals. The thought was that if I get in a tight spot could just ride on out... Works great so far.. Going clipless was much eaiser than I expected. Great pedals. Box description indicates multi release cleats so you don't need to purchase those separately...

product_title: Topeak Sport II Floor Pump
review_body: This bike pump works well with no difficulty Ive noticed so far.  Also easily fits attachments in order to pump up basket balls and what not.  Only complaint is that the slot for holding the ball pump addapter is to snug, I need to use plyers to pull it out if I insert itall the way... On the flip side, it wont get lost.

product_title: Park Tool Derailleur Hanger Alignment Gauge
review_body: I couldn't get my Shimano Deore rear derailleur to shift properly using the adjustment screws or the barrel adjuster.  I read in my maintenance book that when this happens it is probably a bent derailleur bracket.  I bought this tool to see if that was the case.  It took me five minutes to fix my rear derailleur with it!  And I've never used one before.  I don't object to having the bike shop fix my bike, but it takes a week to get my bike fixed.  Now I can do it in minutes!

product_title: Gore Bike Wear Women's Alp-X Gore-Tex Lady Jacket
review_body: Bought this jacket for my lovely wife, she is extremely pleased with it.  Great features, including the hood and extra drop tail, has two zips at the front one that unzips for ventilation and the other to open the jacket. Waterproof and windproof, warm for 0-10C.  Breathes reasonably well, great with a thin baselayer but can get a little sweaty if you don't have long sleeves.  I bought a large and my wife is around size 10, fits her well, it is a reasonably slim jacket with good length in the arms and body.

product_title: Pearl Izumi Men's Select Glove,Black,Large
review_body: Great padding and fit, they also seem to be very well made overall and I expect them to last a long time.  Nifty tab on ring finger to pull them off is handy too.

product_title: InStep Sync Single Bicycle Trailer
review_body:
Sturdy, dependable, and convenient. There is the capability to tighten a lot of areas so that baby/toddler is comfortable and above the floor enough. The space behind the toddler seating area is wonderful to store cell phones, a purse, small diaper bag, etc. Our daughter absolutely loves it and falls asleep almost every time I take her out!

I bought this one after much research. We could not afford to spend over $150 for a bike trailer but we didn't want to skimp out on quality. After all, it is carrying precious cargo.

Some complain that they cannot go faster than 10MPH with this trailer. I have not found any trailers that allow the biker to go above 10 MPH. That is probably because it would just be plain unsafe. If you're biking as a means of exercise - please find a babysitter or wait for your spouse to watch your child(ren)! This is not meant for those purposes.

We appreciated the plastic covering for times when it begins to rain, or is too windy or any other such situations. Stashing a blanket to keep little one comfortable isn't a must, but I do just because none of these trailers - $80 or $900 - do not look entirely comfortable.

I have not had any problems with the trailer detaching. It attaches to my bike just fine. My only complaint is that it is a kind of pain in the butt to detach from the bike (requires a LOT of hand strength) so, instead of really utilizing it's fold-n-go abilities, I just store it attached to my bike instead. I would not want it to be easier to detach though because then the quality of the attachment would have to be degraded - and that defeats the purpose of safety!

By far the best value. Our daughter giggles half the time if she is not sleeping ;-)

(She is 20 lbs and about 28\\" and fits just fine in there with much room to grow).

product_title: Vittoria Road Bike Latex Inner Tube 700c 51mm RVC
review_body: Whether a quick hour ride or 3 - 4 hours in the saddle, in my opinion the value of latex vs. evo tubes is not worth the cost. I do not notice anything different with the ride.

product_title: Razor MX500 Dirt Rocket Electric Motocross Bike
review_body: Hi...maybe we were UNLUCKY!!  But the first Razor Motorcycle we got from Amazon had broken gears.  We would give it some 'gas' and the rear sprocket would just spin, as if the gears were not engaging with the sprocket/chain. So we returned that first bike, and Amazon sent us a new one at no charge (which was great).  Unfotunately the SECOND bike wasn't much better.  The battery on the second bike didn't hold a charge. We followed the directions for how to charge it initially, which we did, but now the yellow like on the throttle always shows \\"lit\\" meaning that it needs a charge, eventhough we had it on the chareger for several hours.  DON'T WASTE YOUR MONEY...IT'S NOT WORTH IT.

product_title: M-Wave Bicycle Pannier Bags
review_body: This bag is really great.  It's a little bigger than I was expecting.  It seems pretty light and it can carry just about anything you might need -- and then some.  You have to watch the connecting straps to make sure they don't catch in the spokes, but it's easy to tie them back.  I plan on using it for groceries and the occasional 12 miles commute to work.  This is a great bag for a great value.

product_title: Mongoose Gel Bicycle Seat Cover
review_body: This may be a good product, BUT it is designed for the long skinny seats, I needed them for what I would describe as a more \\"comfort fit\\" or traditional old bike seat.  No way to streach them over and they need to be returned

product_title: Advanced Elements Double Action Hand Pump with Pressure Gauge
review_body: This is the best pump for your inflatable kayak.  It has numerous attachments to fit all different kinds of valves.  But the attached pressure gauge makes this pump unique and a \\"must have for safety\\" since most other pumps do not include this feature.  Most inflatable kayaks have a \\"not to exceed\\" maximum pressure that you cannot estimate by feel. If you underestimate the inflation, you can taco your kayak; if you overestimate inflation, you can burst the inflation tubes.  Either option can be dangerous, especially in the middle of a lake.  Plus, this hand pump can be used anywhere and is easy to use and pumps up the kayaks very quickly.

product_title: Royal Robbins Men's Backcountry Shorts
review_body: These are my favorite shorts. They are comfortable, durable, wrinkle resistant, and light. I would recommend them to everyone. The combination of the built-in belt and elastic waistbands makes them truly comfortable.

product_title: Sunlite Classic Flower Basket, White
review_body: My wife wanted a basket for her bike so she could store her cell phone, keys and a bottle of water. Basket is a great size. Not to big and not to small. Attaches with ease and looks great.

product_title: Topeak JoeBlow Max II Floor Bike Pump
review_headline: pump does not live up to brand name
review_body: This pump was fine until wear and tear took its toll.  Then the hose came off.  When putting it back together it was never the same.  It did not hold pressure after that.  The guage was never accurate.  5lbs off from day one.  Then a plastic piece that connects to the barrel broke and the whole thing ended up in the trash after 6 months of use.  You get what you pay for $28.

product_title: Diamondback Wildwood Citi Men's Comfort Bike (2011 Model, 26-Inch Wheels)
review_body: I spent a few weeks researching and shopping for a new bike. I wanted a bike where I could sit in a more upright position and wasn't straining to hunch over and grip the handlebars. Initially, I thought I would end up buying a cruiser, but most of them are poorly made and don't have handle-bar breaks (unless you're adept enough to install them yourself). I fell in love with the Electra Townie, which was exactly what I was looking for but for $200 more than I was willing to pay. That's what eventually led me to this bike. After reading reviews on here, and elsewhere I concluded that this is good bike so long as it is purchased in an actual store instead of online. You will probably save $20-$30 by buying it on Amazon, but the problems everyone seems to have is with having it shipped to them. I tested this bike two or three times before purchasing and it has a good, sturdy feel to it. It's sturdy enough to take on a variety of terrains. Ultimately, I ended up purchasing it at a big box store and hedging my bet by purchasing a three year bike warranty in case I experience any problems like the other reviewers. I don't intend to take business away from Amazon by recommending brick-and-mortar stores, but I figure you might do like I did and end up purchasing the accessories like bike locks, etc. through Amazon. Hope this may help in your decision making.

product_title: Voit UDT Duck Feet Swim Fins
review_body: I bought these fins because they were the only large size I could find for my size 14 feet. I am totally satisfied with my purchase and especially with Amazon. I give it a 4 star rating only because I have not surf-tested the fins as of yet and I am sure I will need ankle leashes. Fair price/fair product.

product_title: Pearl Izumi Women's Superstar Skirt
review_body: Ordered a Large and wear size 12 in most bottoms and it fits well. The skirt comes with detachable biker shorts. The shorts are breathable and comfortable, definitely recommend.

product_title: Emotion Glide Kayak
review_body: [[ASIN:B002ZQM0TG Emotion Glide Kayak]]I purchased an Emotion Glide ( lime green) , after  many hours of research. I did read and use the reviews available.  It is exactly what I had hoped and expected. The quality is apparent. We have rented kayaks all season long so I have  developed what I liked and did not like in a Kayak. Unlike some it is not too bulky while not too narrow and tippy. The foot brackets are well placed and easily adjusted . I lOVE the color. The seat is as comfortable as it can be realizing that spending hours in a seat can become uncomfortable at times. I intend to purchase another Emotion kayak down the road and will go to Amazon for  that purchase. All in all a great purchase and very worth the investment .

product_title: Park Tool MLP-1 Master Link Pliers
review_body: As with most of the Park Tools I buy, after using this tool for the first time I was mostly irate with myself for not buying the tool sooner.  This tool is for use with bicycle chains that have a \\"missing link\\", like KMC chains.  If you have an old bike with an old chain that requires a link pin removal tool, then this tool is not for you.  Makes parting chains so much easier - the chain simply pops apart when you squeeze the grips.  Because it is so simple, you'll find yourself removing and cleaning your chain much more often, which can prolong it's life significantly if properly done.  Bravo Park Tool!

product_title: Diamondback Drifter Men's Beach Cruiser Bike (26-Inch Wheels)
review_body: Living in Miami beach, beach cruisers are a way of life.   I have the 2010 Diamondback Della Cruz which I absolutely love,  so when my husbands birthday came up this year, I thought he would enjoy having the masculine version called the Drifter.    There are pictures of the Drifter with fenders and without, and I was told that only the Drifter 2 comes with them by a local bike shop. However, it was our pleasant surprise that even the one speed model does come with the fenders included and they have matching pinstriping to the deck. Clean, understated colors and just the right amount of chrome.  This bike is really great especially for the price. It is stylish - looking cool with its flat black paint, white walled balloon tires, and red/white/silver pinstriping. These bikes ride like a dream, and are smooth and durable.   This version is the single speed, but it is available with 3 speeds.   Assembly was about a half hour but the instructions were poor - the fenders were a little tricky in particular without any real manual.   No kickstand comes with the bike, so I suggest ordering Greenfield KS2SB Kickstand With Retro Kit Black which looks and fits like it is an original kickstand for the Drifter.   I doubt that the beach cruisers that are double ( or more ) the price of the Diamondbacks can offer anything more.   Niagara Cycle shipped fast and I would order from them again.  PROS: price, style, smooth ride, cushy seat  CONS: weak assembly manual

product_title: Cateye Uno HL-EL010 Headlight
review_headline: Excellent light for its compact size
review_body: This is the second Uno I've bought - first went missing.  For a single AA battery, the Uno delivers alot of light. Battery life is good (I use mine mostly in flash mode) and the construction is of excellent quality. The mount is super easy to set up and the Uni slides on and off easily.  This is a great light to keep with you for the times when you are caught out and need to have a small light for the ride after dark.

product_title: Nemo Equipment 2011 Astro Air Short Sleeping Pad (Gray)
review_body: This sleeping pad is more than i could have asked for and you can't beat the price.  I bought this for about 60 bucks which is about half the price of the neo air and in my opinion it is more durable.  I bought the 3/4 length pad which goes slightly below my knees and I am 6'02\\" and if i sleep in the fetal position i can fit my whole body on the pad.  It packs down to about the size of an Aquafina bottle and weighs almost nothing and takes up no space in your pack.  The built in pillow is perfect and I really don't need to use anything else under my head.  It takes some work to inflate it but the trade off for the small weight and volume is well worth it.  Very comfortable pad and inflates to about 3 inches.  Bought this from Tahoe Mountain Sports and is the only place I have been able to find this pad.  Great product.

product_title: NEW YORK YANKEES MLB Baseball BACKPACK BACK PACK
review_body: My 6 yr old little guy is a ball player and a Yankees fan.  Me, not so much.  When I told his mom I was going to get him a backpack her first reaction was \\"Not another superhero one....?\\"  So I looked around on Amazon and found this cool backpack.  Tough part about shopping on Amazon is you can't get a feel for size. Too small and he's going to say it's for \\"little kids\\".  Too big and he's going to look like pigmy at skydiving class.  When the box got to my house I thought \\"Uh Oh.\\"  Looked a little small.  Luckily it was folded in half.  Perfect size for a lunch box and school books and a fresh change of clothes.  Also not a cheap looking pack.  This was the talk of daycare for days - all the kids loved it, it looks very offical and \\"grown-up\\" and the big Yankees symbol and the little patch, plus the Yankees pinstripes, make this a great looking backpack.  My boy loves it, and for the price, can't beat that.

product_title: d.light S10 Solar LED Lantern
review_body: This is a great company.  Awesome light.  Good construction, sturdy and the light quality is good. I'd say it's brighter than a kerosene lamp, which is the whole point as the d.light's mission statement is to replace Kero lamps in third world countries.  It's not the solution for all your lighting needs but comes close in many ways; solar power being one. I have all three styles that they produce and would love to get some more.  Maybe for Xmas?  Would love to see it made anywhere else but China.  Since it is helping get India off Kero lamps I am willing to overlook the made in China aspect.  The quality is far beyond the usual China fare.

product_title: Landwave Skateboard Starter Kit with 2 Ramps and 1 Deck
review_body: Got this for my son's 10th birthday.  Ordered with free shipping option and it arrived 5 days earlier than estimated!  The product is very sturdy and handles both skateboards and bikes well.  I'll admit, it is a bit high (off the ground) for a starter ramp but my son enjoyed the challenge.  He has to get his speed up in order to have enough momentum to get over the ramps when on his skateboard.  He is even going over it with his ripstick now.  I love how easy it is to assemble/disassemble these 3 items.  They then stack well in our garage when not in use.  Definitely a great deal for 2 ramps and a deck!!!

product_title: Sawyer Products Premium Permethrin Clothing Insect Repellent
review_body: I used this on all my clothes for a trip to Africa, and as far as I know it did the trick. I saw mosquitoes, but never had one on me...so I guess it did the trick.

product_title: Mongoose Status 3.0 Dual-Suspension Mountain Bike (26-Inch Wheels)
review_body: I bought this bike two months ago online here through Amazon. Shipping was quick and there were no problems with broken parts or disks bent. You will have to assembly several parts though. I am not an expert on bikes and if you are not one either, you will have to take your bike to the shop. I highly recommend you take it to a professional for a basic tune up (specially for all the gears). Normal tune ups are around $90 but since the bike does not need everything included on a regular tune up, I paid only $50. So most likely you will add this expense to the total price of your bike.  It is a very heavy bike. Gears work ok (not perfectly) even after the professional tune up. It is a great looking bike. It is a sweet ride too and worth the money. I am not an every day bike rider, I ride my bike 1 to 2 days a week in average. Again, I'm not an expert in mountain biking, but I would think that for someone that really is in to it, this bike will do a good work (not excellent work). I think lighter bikes will work better for going up hills (for instance), but if the idea is to do some exercise, then this bike will make you sweat! :D  I like it, I love it. Satisfied with the purchase, although I would think in to save some money and go for the big bucks bikes. Hope you get my point.

product_title: DMR STS Chain Tensioner, Stainless Steel
review_body: There is no assembling instructions.     The first time, I mounted in the wrong way and eventually noticed (wile riding of course) that something was wrong because of the constant chain loosening, but i can´t figure out what was. So, I had to do a  quick-internet-research to resolve it.    All ready properly installed, I had to ad an aluminum lever, in angle from MDR to bike frame, to strengthen the mechanism and avoid the loosen issues that  happened  some times even with the mechanism properly installed.  That's because of my riding style (hard cross country here in the high hills of Los Andes de Venezuela) and the drive relation used (22 to 14 to be able to ride up hill in very rough terrain). May be there is no need to do that but  I went with the lever solution to avoid tighten to much the system iron bolts to the aluminum hangers.     Any how, you have to be willing to do some mechanics corrections time to time (when chain get wear out), tight the crank arms and bottom braked more frequently  and sacrifice  the \\"flat tires quick repairs\\".     I think the system will work flawlessly with a 32 to 17-21 drive relation.    Nice and reliable solution anyway to get in the singlespeed experience.    Sorry for my English.

product_title: Kelty Cosmic 0 Degree Synthetic Sleeping Bag
review_body: I take this bag with me on minimalist camping trips where I sleep under the stars next to a body of water.  On one particular night, I tucked myself in for the evening and fell asleep to wake up 45 min later sweating.  The temp that night was 38F.  Definetly rated down to 0F.  And for the price, a must by for colder weather camping.

product_title: Burley Design Bicycle Trailer Hitch (Standard, Forged)
review_headline: Get one for all your bikes!
review_body: I got one of these for each of my bikes, so that I can move the Burley from bike to bike.  Now I don't have to remount the rear tire just to change bikes.

product_title: Polar Bottle Insulated Water Bottle - 24oz
review_body: I am not too sure how good it insulates as cold liquids get warm fast.  I usually fill it with ice up to the top and then poor liquids in.  By the time I need a drink, there is mostly liquid with some ice left.  Fit well in my bike holder and in my car so can't complain.  I do find it nearly impossible to drink from the spout...usually unscrew the top.

product_title: Loveseat Deluxe Portable Beach,camping,pool Side Chair, Easy Fold with Carrying Bag.
review_body: I strap this on the back of my motorcycle and my girlfriend and I go to concerts and outdoor activities and this is great for us. Can't find them in stores, very portable and functional.

product_title: X20 Universal Adult Life Jacket Vest - Blue & Black
review_body: This is a good vest. The size is adjustable, I bought one for me and one for my husband. It fits perfectly adults, too big for a kid.

product_title: Croakies Kids' Croakies Eyewear Retainer
review_body: This product really has helped keep my 5-year old daughter from looking over the top of her glasses. As you probably know with kids, it is very difficult to properly adjust their glasses. The outcome is often 1) too tight and hurting, or 2) too loose and continually slipping down their noses.    Please note that if the end of the frames bend down, which is often the case for children, the retainer accommodates this by having a hold at the bottom where the frames can come through. This allows the retainer to come straight back.    Also, in the case of a girl, these are not all that noticeable since they are tight to the head and are mostly covered with hair -- another plus.    Great product.

product_title: TRC Recreation Adult Super-Soft USCG Vest
review_body: Wish they made a larger youth jacket.  We have been buying these jackets for over 20 yrs.  The quality is excellent, we still have the first one we bought and it has been used by our children and now grandchildren.  The delivery was prompt.  Would purchase from this retailer again.

product_title: 3pc Skinny Ice Cube Trays for Narrow-Top Sports Water Bottles
review_body: I ordered these and they are perfect for my water bottle.  It is an aluminum water bottle with the small hole (as shown in the picture) and I use it all the time.  I definitely recommend it.

product_title: Rubbermaid RefillReuse Squeezable 20 oz Water Bottle (Colors may vary)
review_body: I've tried several styles of take along water bottles and this is my favorite. Even keep this size or the 32 ounce next to my TV chair at home. Haven't had a problem with the O-ring, though.    Fits in my car cup holder. Super easy to pick up, flip the top with my thumb and take a swig of water. Set it back in the holder and snap closed the flip-top. Washes in the dishwasher without any problems. I put the top in the top rack and base in the bottom rack.  Also, these are super easy to crochet a cover, which keeps condensation at bay as well as easier to grip/non-slip, to coordinate with your home or just to look great on your office desk.  OK, so I went to Rubbermaid dot com and their customer service response to several to reviews of this product indicates they want you to contact customer service and they will replace the entire lid with o-ring if the o-ring is defective. Or I would guess, sell you a new lid with ring if you were at fault in losing the o-ring. Call and ask.  On my gallon Rubbermaid water jug, the o-ring has a tendency to twist, but it's easily corrected and back to leak free travel and pouring. I take my own water to work...my well water is not chemically altered.

product_title: Coleman DayTripper Beach Shade
review_headline: Great for baby at the beach, but needs one big improvement
review_body: I bought this for a last minute trip to the beach with my 3 month old. I set it up myself in about 15 minutes with my infant on me in the Baby Bjorn. I would suggest doing a test run before taking it out for the first time. If you can put together a tent, you can put this together with or without an infant strapped to you. The mesh netting that guides the poles is HORRIBLE. It often gets caught when putting the poles through. With patience and gentle guidance it gets all the way through. All-in-all it was a great solution for a beach day with my baby.

product_title: Park Tool Carbon Cutting Saw Blade CSB-1
review_body: Works great on carbon.  Takes a while to cut through, but cut is smooth with no jagged edges.  Make sure to tape carbon before cutting to reduce splintering.  Then as you get towards the end, make sure to hold the cut piece so it does not fall off due to its weight.  Doing so will cause some small splintering.  Instead, hold the piece being cut and cut through to the very end.

product_title: Razor Electric Mini Chopper Bike (Blue)
review_body: We got this Razor Mini Chopper at Christmas time and the price was better than anywhere else we could find.  My 2 sons had a great time using this chopper, however it did go a little fast for their age group (6-8).  Make sure you purchase a helmet to go with it.

product_title: Stearns Extreme Paddlesports Vest
review_body: Bought this as a used item,  came shipped with all tags and all instructions on use of PFd use.  Paid 2/3 rds of what a new one was.  Must of been a floor model. Just awsome

product_title: Loadedboards Slide Gloves Replacement Pucks
review_body: I made my own slide gloves with these pucks.  I used some velcro and work gloves.  These pucks slide really smooth!  They come with two palm pucks (really huge), two thumb pucks (small, but perfect for your thumb), and two finger pucks (about 1\\" x 4\\", bug enough for all four fingers).  Would recommend to any friend!

product_title: Columbia Cougar Flats II Family Cabin Dome Tent
review_body: My title is intended both ways!  This tent is so big that we were unable to find sites in local campgrounds with a tent pad big enough for it. Also, it weighs 54 pounds! That's just to much for a weekend getaway.  I can't say the tent is bad but consider where and how you camp before buying.

product_title: TOPEAK Alien II Multi-Tool
review_headline: Used it to assemble entire bike
review_body: I used this to assemble an entire GMC Denali road bike.  It is a solid tool that I expect to use in perpetuity.

product_title: Slime Bicycle Tube Protector
review_body: Have used tire liners for for over 20 years  Originally used Tuffy, which were and are good.  Have also used Slime liners for years, which were good and now have no positive value.  Others have mentioned their sharp edges cutting tubes ... This is true - Slime liners have sharp edges on both the end and sides - these cut tubes.  Also instead of being molded ( rounded to the two curves of a tire ) Slime liners are flat.  The result is the Slime liner snakes around on the inside of the tire, sometimes going all the way down the sidewall.  With a little finishing by the manufacturer ( smoothing the edges, molding the shape ) they would be useful.  As currently sold, they cause flats.

product_title: Lole Women's Silhouette 2 Tank Top
review_body: I bought this top for my mom who uses it for her spinning classes, but it looks just as good as a running or yoga top. The cinch at the back adds a really nice touch so that it isn't just a boring white tank top and the color of your sports bra can peek through. Overall good breathability.

product_title: Maglite Mini AA Flashlight Accessory Pack
review_body: The maglite replacement lamp was just what I needed. WE use the maglite at church when we go around after evening services the make sure the doors are secure. It's much saffer when you have a light in this day and time. Thanks so much for your product.We found that replacement lamps bought at other stores didn't last very long maybe twice turning the light on the lamp bought else where went out. Thanks again................

product_title: Coleman Oversized Quad Chair with Cooler
review_headline: Not the same as the Quad Chair
review_body:
Over the last few years, we have bought 4 Coleman Quad Chairs with Cooler and loved the chairs, they were 5 star chairs. So when one broke, we went looking for a replacement and found this. While this is a decent chair, it's nowhere near the comfort level or the construction of the previous model. I am 5'6\\" and I feel like the chair is too high for me, it cuts into the back of my legs when I sit on it. My husband is 6'1\\" and doesn't have that problem with it, so he's using it and I'm using the older model. When we are sitting side by side in the chairs, his chair is up higher than mine. Both of us felt the chair wasn't as good as prior models, it looks like they have tried to cut costs and put out a cheaper product. The parts are different and it doesn't look or feel as high-quality as the Quad Chairs that they put out before this one.
I contacted customer service at Coleman inquring about the changes with the chair and they sent a short, two sentence reply that wasn't helpful at all.
I'm keeping the chair, but I would not buy it again. For the price I paid for it and with the Coleman name, you'd expect better quality.

product_title: Nalgene Tritan 20oz MultiDrink BPA-Free Water Bottle
review_body: I really like this water bottle. Fits nicely into my backpacks side pouch, and there two ways to drink your liquids. Being BPA free as well is a big plus. I don't have anything negative to point out and believe if you are looking for a nice compact water bottle, you surely will not be disappointed!

product_title: Pearl iZUMi Attack Low Sock
review_body: I like this sock, its quality made. I would buy again. If you are looking for a good sock for cycling this is it.

product_title: Coleman Back Home Instant Screenhouse
review_body: This is the best screen tent that I have ever boought. It is very easy to install and taken down.

product_title: Delta MegaRack Ultra Frame Mounted Bicycle Rack
review_headline: Little Work for a Great Rack
review_body: I had to do a little work (drilling and tapping) to get this rack mounted. It didnt come with all the hardware I needed to mount it but when I got it mounted it is a great rack. Seems much stronger then the rack on my other bike at half the price. I highly recommend this rack and Ill buy it again for one of my other bikes.

product_title: humangear capCAP Water Bottle Lid
review_body:
i am on my second capCap. the first is now strapless after soaking it in boiling water to clean it. the high temperature seems to make the plastic less pliable and caused it to tighten around both parts of the cap. this created too much friction when turning the top cap to take a sip, so the strap eventually split.

it's still quite usable and, as i've said, i've bought a second.

product_title: Intex Raised Downy Airbed with Built-in Electric Pump, Queen, Bed Height 22"
review_headline: the best airbed I have used
review_body: I have bad experience with airbeds.  I tried a couple of different airbeds and they just didn't work well. One was very wobbly. I was sleeping on the floor by the middle of the night. When I was just about to give up, I decided to give this one a try. I am happy I did. It's surprisingly comfortable. I was able to put of fitted sheets. I love my sheets they are so comfortable. Now I won't have a headache when I have company because I have a comfortable bed for them to sleep in without being scared something bad will happen.

product_title: New Wave Enviro Stainless Steel Food Container
review_headline: You won't tear off a nail trying to open this one!
review_body: I was a little leery of buying another metal lunch box, because the only other one I've had was so hard to pry open that I never really used it. This one is designed much better--when it's closed, the lid is on very tight, but the design of the latches are such that they slide open without much difficulty, and the lid pops right off. The lid seems to be held on partially from the pressure of the bottom of the container, since it is slightly bigger than the lid. But this is a good thing!

product_title: Reliance Fold45;A45;Carrier II 5 Gallon Water Container
review_body: Like the other reviews, it lasted 1 day. Water began leaking wherever the bag was folded along the crease. Am going to try a swimming pool patch kit (cost $2.00). If it doesn't work, I'll try some other bag..

product_title: Pearl iZUMi Men's Quest Cycling Short
review_body: These shorts fit pretty well...I would pick up another pair!  I ride 30-60 miles at a clip on a regular basis...these shorts get the job done.

product_title: Avenir Combo Cable Lock (10mm x 6ft)
review_body: Fits easily on the bike (and you have multiple choices of where you want it). Strong, well made and fine for me. Of course, no lock can hold up to a determined and well tooled thief; but, for a decent deterrent, it's fine.

product_title: MSR DragonFly Stove
review_headline: Best hiking stove for true cooks
review_body:
I have used propane burners, MSR Whisperlite and Dragonlfly. And although the Dragonfly is slightly pricier, bulkier, heavier (85g) and a lot noisier than the MSR whisperlite, there is one big, big advantage: you can regulate power (ie simmer). Unless you're only cooking noodles every day, you will in fact often use this. Not having the simmer feature also burns up your fuel a lot faster if indeed you do want to cook several minutes (eg make pasta). It's actually really hard to cook on a Whisperlite (which is on full or off).

So, if you intend to do some actual cooking, buy the Dragonlfy. If you just need to boil water; get a Whisperlite (needless to say there's a huge advantage of fuel stoves over propane tank stoves: you can refuel at any gas station in the world).

product_title: Panaracer Pana RiBMo Bicycle Tire with Protex Shield (Aramid Bead Folding, 700x25, Black)
review_body: i've had these tires for months now using them 60 miles a weeks and haven't had a flat. awesome deal on helping avoid the stress of flats. extremely satisfied with this purchase. thanks!

product_title: Thermacell R-4 Mosquito Repeller Refill, 48 Hour Pack (12 Repellent Mats and 4 Butane Cartridges)
review_headline: Not sure if this acutally works
review_body: I bought this product based on the great reviews, but my experience was less than stellar. I had 3 thermacell units surrounding me while gardening and continued to get attacked! even after 1 hour there was no noticeable decline in bites.....HOWEVER we live near a lake and have an EXTREME mosquito problem in early summer- perhaps this would work o.k. for less problem areas- but was pretty much useless for me.

product_title: GSI Outdoors Glacier Stainless Martini Glass
review_body: Stainless steel does NOT keep your drinks colder longer...it's far too efficient a conductor of heat for that.  These glasses hold a lot of fluid, are very sturdy and look really cool.

product_title: Coleman RoadTrip Grill Cover
review_body: I was curious to see how cheezy this cover would be after looking at the ones in the store and to my big surprise, this thing is super-thick, durable, and heavy!  This will protect your WHOLE grill all the way to the floor!  I live in Florida and get massive storms with massive winds and let me tell you this cover doesn't move!  It is super thick to protect it pretty much from limbs or small items dropping on it, it's heavy too so the wind doesn't kick it up and blow it all over, in fact it doesn't even really move.  I also love how the materials they use are super durable.  I am really happy with this product and would gladly recommend this for anyone with the RoadTrip Grill and to top it off the price is worth the product!

product_title: Sunlite Cloud-9 Bicycle Suspension Cruiser Saddle, Cruiser Gel, Tri-color Black
review_body: Cloud 9 seats are the best you can get. Kinda wish I got the smooth saddle for my bike but this one did the trick.!!

product_title: Foam Maverick Pogo Stick
review_body: This pogo is amazing! My 8 year old daughter, 10 year old son, and all their friends love it and have been using it for the past month. It still looks brand new! It's very solid, durable, and well made! Looks like it will last for a long time!

product_title: Lezyne Pressure Drive Medium Hand Pump
review_headline: I bought a second one. That says something.
review_body:
I have 2 of these, on my XC and touring bikes.

On my XC bike, I like to \\"ride to the ride\\", so I sometimes put in 25 road miles to and from the trailhead. This pump is perfect for airing-up for the return road portion of the ride. The barrel gets a little warm by the end of the second tire, but not enough to worry about the seals.

I like the flexible hose as it takes the stress off the valve stem and makes it easier to pump harder/faster.

It comes with a mouting bracket that goes on/under a bottle cage mount.

product_title: SKS Commuter Bicycle Fender Set
review_headline: Mediocre Fastener Options but a good deal regardless
review_body: I just got this and installed it on my bike. I have a 27\\" road frame and this set did install but it was not easy.  It also rattles around a lot and the black caps on the side-stays fall off unless you tape them on, all in all I am not sure what to compare it to because this is my first fender set but I think the set is reflective of the great price.

product_title: Fenix TK12-R2 240 Lumen Tactical LED Flashlight
review_body: I picked up this item a few months ago after comparing it to a lot of other super-bright flashlights.  I have not been disappointed.  It has a solid and rugged feel to it, and the light output is off the charts.  I enjoy comparing it to the other flashlights that my relatives bring along up in the hills, and it absolutely blows them away.  I can see a hundred yards down the draw, and a much greater field-of-view is illuminated, compared to conventional flashlights.  It is the perfect size for wearing on a belt and is light-weight, compared to the Lumens output that it is rated for.  My only gripe is the way you have to twist the head to switch modes.  I would prefer some sort of button or slider, or just a simple rotation of the head.   Even so, it is a great item to own!

product_title: Pair of PaceMaker "Journey" Trekking Poles with Extended Life Rubber Feet and Attachments
review_body: These are passable.  I got them to help me fend off dogs in my neighborhood.  They will work for that but the construction is not very sound and I actually found them to be rather cheesy!  Sorry, but the cost is commensurate with the quality.

product_title: Giro Adler Kids Snow Goggle
review_body: I am very happy with my order. Was unhappy at first but company made things right AND the product is really great and the price is unbeatable.

product_title: Smith & Wesson Taylor - S&w Magnesium Rescue Ez-open - SWHRTMGCP
review_body: I was looking for a good knife to replace my previous model that I lost and found this great knife. The design caught my eye to begin with, but the performance definitely matches it's looks. This knife is a great deal; I have seen many knives priced at $70 to $80 that were of inferior quality to the Smith and Wesson Rescue knife, and you can buy this one for about $26 with shipping and handling. If you are looking for a strong, dependable knife that also has a great design, then look no further.

product_title: Smokehouse Products All Natural Flavored Wood Smoking Chips
review_headline: Oustanding buy on Apple Wood Chips!
review_body: Half-price on these now hard to find bags of wood chips for Luhr Jensen / Smokehouse electric smokers but you'd better like doing a lot of smoking with Apple/Alder wood because this is a case of 12 bags weighing 22# total. We think it's is a very good all-purpose smoke flavor and use for anything we like to smoke from ribs to fish to poultry...

product_title: Giro Spree Toddler Bike Helmet
review_body: We bought this helmet for my daughter when she was about 10 months old and she is now almost 3. It is pretty easy to adjust.  The built in sun visor shape is great for keeping some sun off her face. We tried several helmets from other brands recently in hopes that she could move up to one of the larger hand-me-downs we have and leave this smaller one for her baby sister this summer. But the other 2 (a Nutcase and a Bell) never fit right no matter how many adjustments we made. Ultimately we decided to but a 2nd Giro helmet for the younger rather than mess with the others. The 3-year old loves the \\"lavender bunnies\\" print, although in person it is more pink color than lavender.

product_title: Outback Magnetic Indoor Bicycle Trainer
review_headline: Good and not as bad as some reveiwers say
review_body: I got this for those days that I did not know I could go riding outdoors do to weather. I read the reviews about loudness and tension. I also saw people discounting those posts here is what I found for myself. First off I do have a bike with the quick disconnect axle but mine did not work I had to use the one provided. Second, I did find it was a bit louder that I thought but as others have posted if you have nobbies on your tires it's going to be loud. Thirdly, when I first put my bike on i had the Magnetic resistance portion lightly touching the wheel thinking that would be the best way to make it work. I found that did not help, even on the most resistive setting and me on the highest gear it still was too easy. I did find tightening the magnetic mechanism tighter to the wheel helped out a lot. Once I did those tweaking the device has worked great for me. I ride 3 times a week about 16 miles each time. In that distance I cover hills both up and down so it's not just a strait shot. That being said I found this product an ok substitute to the real thing.

product_title: Traser CODE BLUE Watch TRITIUM Light Source P6508
review_body: This watch is not nearly as bright as I was led to believe.  On average it's only about as bright as my current watch's luminous paint.  Not worth the $225 that I paid.  In all fairness, it keeps time well.

product_title: Overland Equipment Donner Bag
review_headline: More info needed on trim source
review_body: For the following reason I give this bag 2 stars.    This has always been great little bag, I've purchased a couple before and they're still with me I just wanted a different color.     The problem is I object to wearing/using leather. No where in the product details did it mention that the front plate is leather. When they were made in Chico the trim was then synthetic fabric. Since it is being manufactured in China (something I read in these reviews)it's leather. This is important to quite a few people for various reasons.  People should be made aware so they can make informed choices.    Rather than go through the hassle of returning it, I'm giving it to someone who doesn't share my personal ethic.

product_title: Coleman 2000018295 8-Person Instant Tent, Black (14x10 Feet)
review_headline: what a great tent, perfect for family camping.....
review_body: I bought this tent for my family to go camping together,since there is only 7 of us. We also go camping with the boy scouts.This tent is easy to set up and take down.My family and i love it. Thank you amazon for a great price.

product_title: Pedco UltraPod Lightweight Camera Tripod
review_body: Perfect tripod! Very light and small enough to fit your pocket or the camera bag with no problem.  Love it!

product_title: Victorinox Swiss Army Classic SD Pocket Knife
review_body: I tried to use a different type of pocket knife for a while but I kept on missing the features of this Swiss Army knife.  I always need to have a knife like this in my pocket.

product_title: Bear Grylls Men's 1/2 Zip Sweat Top
review_headline: Great layer sweater, warm, attractive looking
review_body: Although the brand isn't known, this sweater is great for wearing layers when you're camping in the mornings. I'll buy this again in the near future!

product_title: ALOKSAK Water / Sand Proof Dry Bags
review_body: These bags were not what I was hoping for and they have two features you should be aware of:    1) They are smaller than you think.  I bought the 4x5 thinking I could store my 4.5 inch iPhone in one - it will not fit without bursting the seams.    2) They are not \\"thick\\" plastic.  They are one step up from a freezer Ziplock bag.     I'm sure they are waterproof but they will not last much more than a Ziplock, maybe one backpacking trip as long as you put soft and rounded and small objects inside them.

product_title: Bear Grylls Parang Machete
review_body: Pros: great Parang. Cons: crappy sheath (I've had it for less than 5 hrs, and its already broken)    I took the parang out to try chopping up some some brush around the house, and it works very nicely.  Sharp, sturdy, steel blade.  It feels very comfortable in my hand.  When cutting and chopping the hand shock is moderate, but not unreasonable for this type of tool.  The only thing I don't care for on it is the hand lanyard - too small for my cave dwelling knuckle dragger hands.  Easily remedied with a new piece of nylon.    As for the sheath.......if I were Bear Grylls, I would be embarrassed to have my name on it.  At first glance, it looks really nice, and is made of heavy duty cordura.  When I tried to slide it into the sheath, two of the rivets pulled apart.  Almost like they were held together with Super Glue.  Sheath flaw #2 - there are two snaps for closing the sheath around the parang, but the sheath is too small and the parang gets in the way of being able to snap them shut.  I'll first ask Gerber to send another (they're pretty good about that kind of stuff), and then I think I'll take the one it came with and re-rivet the crappy ones, and put in smaller snaps.  If not for those things, I think it would be pretty good.    In summary - I like it a lot and if I can fix or replace the sheath, I'll be a happy camper.  I guess I shouldn't expect too much......it was only $31, and very useable.    Good choppin' to ya!

product_title: Tovatec Mini Torch Flashlight
review_body: This is an absolutely great light. It is EXTREMELY bright, with a great wide beam. It is so small too, with an easy to use button on the bottom. It has a great lanyard already attached to it. These intova lights are the best lights on the market for diving. Extremely well made, durable, and feel good in your hand. People's only knock on them is the cr123 batteries, but they give you such a long burn time. You can do about 5 or more night dives on two batteries, and really the price evens out. Definitely recommend this light.

product_title: CamelBak 0.4-Liter Kids Bottle
review_body: This is keeping in the spirit of CamelBak products.  It is simple to use and clean.  It is right-sized for our 5.5 year old and it allows him to be just like mom, dad, big brother and big sister...we all have the 24 oz. versions.  The dinos are fun for him too.

product_title: Suncloud Polarized Optics Honcho Sunglasses
review_body: I needed to replace a pair of Bolles that I really liked, but that model was discontinued. I took careful measurements of the Bolles and I put a lot of time into finding a pair with the similar dimensions. Buying sunglasses on line that fit, is not easy.
