product_title: OnGuard Boxer 5047 Motorscooter and Motorcycle Disc Brake Lock
review_headline: good but doesn't fit a scooter
review_body: i have a yamaha zuma 125 and it didn't fit. its a heavy duty lock just didn't fit my scooter

product_title: DC Women's 8K Martock 11 Pant
review_body: I recently just got my snow pants and I like them a lot. But the straps are Extra long! I don't use them because of that reason. And the color oak, I think you should just say brown because I didn't know what color they were exactly, I thought they were more gray. But besides that I do love them.

product_title: ER Emergency Ready 6N Solar/Hand-Crank Powered Emergency LED Flashlight and AM/FM Radio
review_body: I have one in my car for emergency and other in house in case of emergency, works great and needs no batteries.  I would recommend everyone have one of these, it even will charge a cell phone if your power is out.

product_title: Powersports Motorcycle Ski and Snow Goggles (Clear)
review_body: I bought my husband these goggles because he rides his bike 14 miles total to and from work each day. These are great for the cold weather.    We got the clear ones, because he bikes home in the evening when it's dark out, and we didn't want to get tinted ones that would affect his visibility. The clear goggles do look a bit dorky, but he was willing to sacrifice vanity for the sake of safety.    My complaint was that my husband did not originally find them comfortable, particularly with the strap attached to them. He took the strap off and he found the discomfort more tolerable.    The other problem we had was that the goggles would fog up from his breath, particularly when wearing a balaclava. He learned he had to buy an offensively named substance called \\"Cat Crap\\" to rub onto the goggles in order to keep them from fogging up.

product_title: NALGENE Tritan Wide Mouth 32oz BPA-Free Water Bottle
review_body: Pros:  Very durable design...dropping it from 6 feet and dish washing cause no damage.  Great Cap...seals good, does not leak, can be taken on and off with only one free hand.    Cons:  Expensive  Too much advertising on the outside of the bottle.

product_title: Naruto Men's Gaara Sign Anime Wristband
review_body: If your an Anime fan you will love this! I ordered it & didn't even have time to track it! It was here less than 2 days later! My daughter loves Gaara and this was a perfect gift for her! Very pleased, great quality!

product_title: Skincom Solartent Easy for Two
review_headline: Buckles break due to bad design, miserable service, terrible in the wind
review_body: A metal buckle broke the first time I used the product. The design of these buckles is primitive, and is incredible hard to attach the chords to them. The customer service promised to send replacements, but they never arrived. Truly a miserable solar screen and  definitely the worst product (without any close competition) I ever bought online. There were no reviews of the product at that time, so it was an uninformed buy. Buyers beware!

product_title: ENO Eagles Nest Outfitters - SlapStrap Hammock Suspension System
review_body: I bought these to go with a [[ASIN:B000ZKEIK8 Expedition Asym Hammock]]. I can't hang the strap per the ENO instructions (pull through the loop and use the necessary loop) due to it doesn't lend itself to the proper figure 8 knot. I just wrap it and use the best two loops. Works fine and holds the hammock up perfectly. 4 stars do to the smallish loops, inch and a half webbing would have been better. Also, picture shows blue bag, mine came in a beige bag. doesn't bother me at all, but something to note.

product_title: HIAEFIRE Q5 CREE 240 Lumen LED Bike Bicycle flashlight Torch +1 x Bicycle Holder +3 AAA batteries + dual charger
review_headline: Smaller than I thought they would be
review_body: I've got pretty big hands...so when I say this, keep that in mind....but the lights are only slightly larger than my thumb and have only 1 LED per light.  That said, they seem to light up the area pretty well...the package says visibility up to one mile....I think that is to say that people can see you for up to one mile.  I haven't gotten the bike I ordered for these so I will update when I get them on the bike and give it a try..

product_title: Therm-a-Rest Lumbar Pillow (Blue)
review_headline: Good pillow, but not for all uses
review_body: I tried this in my car, but could only use it when it was totally deflated (there is a thin pad inside so it provides some support even with no air).  It was a good thickness, but even though I had the valve closed tight, every time I got into the car I would have to sit back on it and open the valve to get the air out again which had leaked back in.  It is designed to want to go to the inflated state.  It does operate exactly as intended though, and may be just the thing for some people.

product_title: Snow Peak Titanium Fork and Spoon Set
review_body: Can't fault the price as its lower than most titanium utensils. The stamping job is not super great so they look and feel cheap. Still, this product will do what it is supposed to do.

product_title: Krown Complete Longboard Skateboard
review_body: Great deal my daughter will be getting it for Christmas!! Had a couple of knicks in the board but I'm sure she will put many more on it. Ganna be great for her first longboard!!

product_title: Schwinn Lakeshore Women's Cruiser  Bike (26-Inch Wheels)
review_body: Assembly took me 5 hours. I have never assembled a bike before. But it is really hard to assemble a bike and ride one that is broken. Front brakes were frayed. Derailer bent. Decorative Chain guard bent. I finally had to take it to the bike shop. Shifting takes some getting used too. Bike is working ok now. Seems like I'm working harder to pedal than I should but I could just be out of shape. Cute bike overall though. not so sure about how it will function.

product_title: JanSport Bulldozer Core Series Daypack
review_body: The back pack is good except for the side pockets.  The velcro does not securely keep the pockets closed.  I am looking to add snaps to insure the pockets stay closed

product_title: Croozer Designs Cargo Trunk Bicycle Trailer
review_body: I purchased this cart to enable my Welsch Cogi dog to accompany me on my bide rides.  This cart is great.  Easy to assemble, easy to pull and my dog loves riding in it. I like that all parts can be removed easily & their attachment pins are permenently attached to the cart bed using short cords so that nothing is missing when you go to assemble it.  Unassembled I use the cart bed as a travel bed in my truck. Thank you for a great product

product_title: UST SaberCut Chainsaw
review_body: The loops instead of handles give your hands a break.  The saw came very sharp and packs up very small.  Takes up almost no room in a pack.

product_title: Victorinox Explorer
review_body: The Boy Scout version of the Explorer is in reality, the Explorer Plus with its extra tools, at a significantly lower price. [edit: This was true when I bought it. The Boy Scouts have now downgraded this model to the plain Explorer]  For me, it's critical the phillips screwdriver be on the end, where it can access screws in tighter places.  The corkscrew and scissors are also frequent must-haves, the can and bottle openers only a bit less frequently used.  I use the short knife blade most of all and would be willing to trade the large blade for a serrated one or a saw.    [edit 9/11/2014: Although I still carry this every day, I bought the Victorinox Farmer as the swiss army knife I carry hiking and backpacking. It has fewer tools I don't need for lighter weight, as well as an excellent saw I do need.]]

product_title: Profile Design Ti Rails Tri Stryke Saddle
review_body: Very pleased when I opened the box. Re-inforced hard plastic under the nose of the saddle. Will prevent damage when racking bike under seat for Triathlons and support sitting forward on the saddle. Did one quick 20km ride to test it out. Felt very comfortable and happy with the breathable forward half of the saddle. Feels a little like a cushion padding on the front half.  Added this to a forward profile seat post to turn my normal road bike into a triathlon geometry bike for using tribars.  Will see in time if the saddle lasts with wet (after swim) conditions, but at the moment, very comfortable and happy.

product_title: Ski & Pole Carrier and Ski Boot Carrier
review_body: Make carrying skis and poles a snap. I like the over the sholder configuratioin and the boot carrier was a nice freebie.

product_title: Sierra Designs Men's Pull-On Down Bootie
review_body: absolutely what they say they are.  tough soles make it easy to go in and out of the house.

product_title: Serfas TCPG Bicycle Floor Pump
review_body: I was skeptical about purchasing a pump online that I had not seen in person since they are so often built poorly. I was not disappointed with this pump. Solid metal tube with plastic components. My only gripe is that the plastic components seem like they were not really designed to last 10+ years, which is something I was looking for. Not bad for the price though. If you are a semi-serious cyclist, this is a good place to start without investing too much. I recommend.

product_title: Salomon Women's Vibrant Jacket
review_body: Fits great, looks great and i'm reminded of why i'm such a great fan of Salomon products.    The only caveat being, i have not actually used it for skiing yet and hence have no experience of how this jacket will perform on the ski slopes.     Otherwise, it's a great looking jacket for running around town and gym etc.

product_title: Blackburn Mars 1.0 Flasher Rear Bicycle Light
review_headline: Nice unit (if you don't lose it!)
review_body: I made my own rear light, spinning it off of the front light I made out of a cheapie Radio Shack 4 C cell once upon a time (I use NiCads and an external charger). Problem is the rear light doesn't always work. Tom Cuthbertson said those rear lights never seem to work. Of course, he was talking about wired lights, and mine is indeed that.    Well, riding home last evening after dark I notice something glowing in the gutter. I double back and there's a Blackburm Mars 1.0, full-on. If it had a phone number on it, I'd return it to the rightful owner, but absent that it's mine. I couldn't figure out how to open it to replace the batteries but a review here cleared that up (penny in the slot and turn).    Well, mine doesn't have a bracket, just the J clip, so I don't know how I'm going to attach this thing so I don't lose it too. Maybe I'll work out something with velcro. My DIY tail light has a switch I can use to turn it on/off according to how I feel about the situation. The Blackburn doesn't have that but I like the up-to-250 hour operation on one set of batteries. Seems nice and bright and as long as I don't lose it I'll feel far more confident that I have an operating tail light for those dangerous city streets.

product_title: ALPS Mountaineering Lightweight Series Self-Inflating Air Pad
review_headline: Great sleeping pad, a little bulky
review_body: This pad is great for the money.  It is a little bulkier than other pads, but makes up for this shortfall with its comfort (for a camping pad).  It is easy to inflate/deflate.

product_title: In Clover, Canine Connectin All-In-One Daily Joint Supplement for Dogs
review_body: My 12 year old Border Collie mix was starting to show her age: she had trouble getting up and would sometimes yelp out in pain. I found this supplement about two months ago and started giving it to her right away, 2 half-scoops twice daily (she weighs about 40 lbs.)  We are now down to 1/2 scoop once daily. My sweet Carly is still going strong, with no signs of aches and pains! I am amazed!

product_title: #6000 LaserPro Pelican Flashlight
review_headline: Bright Light for indoor work or emergencies
review_body: We use this for  the times our electricity goes off during storms, etc. or for those times you want a bright light to illuminate a work site inside the house or garage.

product_title: HotHands Toe Warmers (40 Pair)
review_body: If my feet are cold, I am miserable.  With Toasti Toes my feet stay warm for up to 10 hours and I stay warmer all over.  Would recommend to anyone that has problem keeping their feet warm.

product_title: Fenix 132 Lumen LED Flashlight
review_body: There's not much to say which adds to the technical details. It is one of the most efficient, consistent and brightest AA flashlights in the world. Has some gimmicks like SOS flashing, various power outputs and a strobe, but you're probably going to just use it on high all the time. I disagree with some reviews that the high output is too bright for nearly any sort of work. It is perfectly suitable for computer case work at the highest power.

product_title: Shimano ST-2300 2300 Shifter/Brake Lever STI Set (2x8 Speed)
review_body: This product came exactly as specified in the description (new product in-box). They work great and were shipped before the expected ship date.

product_title: Aloe Gator All Natural SPF 30 Lotion (1-Ounce)
review_body: After researching several sunscreens I decided to buy 3 of them that used either zinc oxide or titanium dioxide as the protective agent.  This product was so thick it was nearly impossible to spread onto my skin.  Since one of the main ingredients is Aloe, we decided to dilute it with a little more aloe gel to see if we could get it to spread a little better, but to no avail.  It definitely leaves a white coat that doesn't seem to blend in.  This isn't a big deal to me, but I know it is for some people.  It was the least favorite of the three products I bought and won't buy it again.

product_title: Coleman 8-Person Red Canyon Tent
review_body: I'm a decently experienced camper, and took my son on our first tent-camping experience with this tent. As luck has it, there was a horrible rainstorm--but this tent withstood the rain exceptionally well. I detected no leaks, and I had not sprayed it with sealant before hand. Excellent seams, easy to put it up, too. All the way around, a VERY good deal.

product_title: Polar Bottle Insulated Water Bottle (20-Ounce, Graphic Blue)
review_headline: Not great at keeping water cold.
review_body: It doesn't work all that well, unfortunately, when it comes to keeping your beverage cold. I started a 20 mile bike ride (in southeastern Louisiana, mind you) with this bottle filled to the brim with ice and water topping it off. At our 10 mile break, the ice was completely melted and the water was only slightly cool. Pretty disappointing, but the bottle is easy to grip, provides great fluid flow, and is very easy to clean.

product_title: TSL Women's Take The High Road Aluminum Snowshoes (25-Inch)
review_body: I bought these snowshoes a couple of years ago but wasn't able to really use them until this year due to lack of snow last year. They are comfortable enough to walk in for a while although I have had trouble with the toe straps coming loose so my foot ends up pigeon toed in the shoe. I'm not impressed with the heal strap adjustment. The way the strap fastens is a pain to deal with. I highly recommend adjusting indoors when the traps are warm and SLIGHTLY more flexible. Once they were adjusted though there was no risk of them loosening up! Also recommend using the same boots with them so you're not constantly needing to adjust the heals. The ratcheting system across the top of the foot is easy once you learn which parts need to be used to loosen it.   The other reviewer was right on with the sketchy directions. There were only drawn pictures no words, which in some cases works better but having both would be better. I still sink in the light snow of course so that was disappointing with just how little they helped. If you're looking for a snowshoe for that kind of walking you should look at the large old fashioned kind in wood frames. The downfall there is they don't have crampons which definitely help if you're planning on using them on hills.   Hope all this helps your decision making!

product_title: Meyerco MANKU Neck Knife
review_headline: Invest on a better Neck Knife
review_body: I bought this knife by impulse and I basically spent some dollars that I could have save for a better neck knife  Sometimes is better to wait, be patient and save your money for better products

product_title: Camelbak Quick Grip 21 Oz Hydration Pack
review_headline: Just what I was looking for!
review_body: This is a great water bottle for running -- especially on a really hot and humid evening.  Because the bottle is insulated the water stays nice and cold.  Take care, though, to take it out of the freezer ahead of your run.  Otherwise, when you finish your run, and you're ready for a nice cold gulp, you'll still have a chunk of ice that has not melted.  The little pouch in front holds a paper towel and my car key.

product_title: Aquamira Frontier Straw Filter
review_body: Purchased 2 for our survival kit for camping and hiking trips.  Great price for it, hoping to not use it unless it's an emergency.

product_title: XLC Boxed Tube, 700 x 20 - 25C (27 x 1), PRESTA (48mm)
review_headline: XLC Boxed Tube, 700 x 20 - 25C (27 x 1), PRESTA (48mm)
review_body: These tubes are the smooth unthreaded, Presta valves without the valve lock nut. I wasn't certain when I ordered them, but for $ 2.79 each thought it was worth giving them a shot. The tubes aren't self-sealing or thorn resistant, but again, those extra features are available in pricier tubes. The OEM Innova's the XLC's replaced were threaded and my original quest & intent was to get threaded tubes to replace threaded tubes. That was the only moment of any perception of disappointment. I proceeded to install them and now realize these are much better in that the unthreaded valve stems don't wear out the Presta valve rubber gasket seal of your hand pump sooner. Reading on-line I had read forum discussions & feedback that there is a possibility that the unthreaded don't lock onto the air pump as well, but as previously stated, that threading comes with a wear and tear penalty on your air pump. I had no problems locking onto the XLC smooth unthreaded Presta valve and inflating the tubes to 100+ psi, they hold air and if you can get past not having a threaded valve with a lock nut, these are excellent value tubes.     My OEM Innova tubes had 4 defective bumps in the front tire tube, I haven't checked the rear, maybe I pay a price for being lazy that way. Anyway, one of those defects developed a hole and thus the flat. The XLC tubes were non-deformed rubber all the way around. All tubes inflate with a bulge here and there and that's to be expected with these as well.    As for Niagara Cycle Works as a vendor, they priced for value, the XLC product performs as new, and my test ride(s) around the neighborhood, I encountered no issues. Customer service was excellent, prompt shipping, Amazon provided tracking number for USPS.    Good reading on threaded vs unthreaded:    […]

product_title: Mirrycle Road STI Bicycle Mirror - Only Compatible w/ 2010 or older
review_body: Very good mirrors. I have one on each shifter tower on my drop handlebars.  One adjusts the left to right angle of the mirrors by raising and lowering them. There is no direct adjustment. It sounds clumsy but in practice works very well.  I feel safer with the mirrors because I can easily keep track of vehicles behind me even when I am on the \\"wrong\\" side sidewalk.  The primary drawback is that the mirrors are potentially easy to break off of the shift towers.  I recommend them to my children.

product_title: Planet Bike Blinky "3" 3-Led Rear Bicycle Light
review_body: My wife and I do a lot of nighttime walking, usually in areas without sidewalks.  We each use a Blinky 3, and are reasonably confident that vehicles approaching from any direction see us in plenty of time to avoid an accident.  It has a build-in clip you can use to attach the device to clothing.  Although the clip doesn't attach to clothing as securely as we would like, it works.  As an alternative you can always run a cord though the ring, and wear the device around your neck like a pendant (which is what we now do).

product_title: Intex Raised Downy Airbed with Built-in Electric Pump, Queen, Bed Height 22"
review_body: I bought this bed after a job offer brought me to a new city and I needed to buy new furniture.  I'd been considering getting a memory foam bed, but hadn't really researched them, and I didn't want to spend over a thousand dollars until I was sure of what I wanted.  But I also didn't want to spend several hundred dollars on a traditional mattress to use until I'd made up my mind about memory foam mattresses.  I also have qualms about buying used mattresses from strangers...  So what to do?  I came on Amazon looking for an airbed, and this was the first one that came up.  With the hundreds of great reviews, I thought it was worth risking $60.    And am I ever glad I did!  That was the best $60 I've spent in a long time.  This bed is so comfortable that it's going to be quite some time before I spend any money on a memory foam mattress.  I sleep like a baby on this thing.  It doesn't leak, either, as far as I can tell.  Its height makes it easy to get out of bed in the morning, and its comfort makes it possible to get a great night's sleep.  I  used a fitted sheet for a few weeks, but it tended to come off a lot.  So now I just put a comforter on top of the bed and sleep just fine.      I never dreamed that two months after buying this I'd still be sleeping on it every night, but here I am, and I imagine I'm going to be sleeping on it for many more months to come.

product_title: Cateye HL-350 and LD170 Bicycle Headlight and Tail Light Combination
review_body: It was easy to put on my bike and works great. The light on the front is not as strong but it works well.

product_title: Cadillac Ladies Fleetwood Cruiser Bike, Light Blue
review_body: I purchased this item as a gift and I am very pleased with the overall quality of workmanship.  Assembly was relatively simple and only a make a few minor adjustments were necessary (rear wheel rubbed the frame when the tire was inflated) to get it going.  The one complaint that I did have concerned the cable run to the NuVinci hub.  The cables bow just far enough out for the pedal to strike them as it turns.  I took care of the problem by securing the cables to the frame with a tie-wrap.    It's first ride was greeted with a compliment.    The quality and value that I recognized in this Cadillac bike inspired me to order one of the mountain bikes for myself...

product_title: Patagonia Beanie Hat
review_body: This hat runs true to size and fits on you head like a glove.  Well, like a mitten because it doesn't have little ear pockets; everyone knows they ears or the fingers of the head.

product_title: Polarmax Women's Double Base Layer Pant
review_body: This pair of long underwear is one of the warmest that I have own. They are great for any outdoor use. The elastic waistband is adjustable so you can tuck in any top base-layer clothing comfortably. The sizing was correct, however, the ankles are a big snug and there is a lot of extra room in the crotch area. I am 5'2 and 135 lbs and I ordered a Medium if that helps anyone out! I was expecting them to be a bit stretchier (if that is even a word..!)

product_title: UCO Stormproof Matches, Waterproof and Windproof with 15 Second Burn Time - 50 Matches
review_body: Good as advertised.  Have only tried them out, not used them in a necessary situation.  Have a pack in my car, home, and backpack.  Great Bug Out item!

product_title: Chinook Cascade Widemouth Stainless Steel Bottles
review_body: I love this bottle, I highly recommend it. I've had it for a year, well worth the price. At the time it was hard to find one that held 32oz - it suits my needs.

product_title: Blantex XB-6 Extra Wide Heavy Duty Steel Folding Cot
review_body: My daughter is 176 lbs. She easily fits on this bed and says it is very comfortable. Folding it and storing it is easy. I highly recommend this product.

product_title: Huffy Men's Moire Bike, CharcBlack, 26-Inch
review_body: Overall,I am very pleased with this bike.It looks great.Rides great.The price was right.I only have a few problems.And they might not be problems for other people.First off,I had a heck of a time getting the front disc brake to function correctly.Also,the bike feels a little bit too small for me and im only five nine.The front forks might be a little soft also.All and all though,id buy this bike again.You really get alot of bike for the buck.

product_title: K2 Radical 100 men's In-Line Skates
review_body: Great Skates. The only thing I would want to jack up is the wheel size... can't go any bit higher than 10 cm. But that's what they are... :-)

product_title: Avenir Round Spoke Wrench
review_headline: Worked great for what I needed.
review_body: I wasn't sure which size I needed. Very strong and worked perfectly for what it was needed. A single sized wrench is likely to have better ergonomics, but at a cost in terms of versatility.

product_title: Pearl Izumi Men's Impact Jersey
review_headline: Good Jersey with a Loose Fit
review_body: Good jersey, This is what I expected for the price, it is comfortable and it gets the job done. The jersey runs a little longer than I expected and I realized after I received the item that this is from the Pearl Izumi MTB series but it works fine for the road also. For the price this is a great jersey if you are a cyclist who likes a more loose fit in your jersey.

product_title: Victorinox Swisscard Lite Pocket Tool
review_headline: Great little gadget for purse or wallet
review_body: I've given lots of these as gifts and they are always a hit for men, women or teens.  So many handy gadgets in a \\"card\\" small enough to put in a small purse or man's wallet. The tiny scissors and tweezers are high quality, and there are several screwdriver sizes. The knife can even pass through ariport security!

product_title: Sunlite Pro Cruz Pedals - 1 Pair, 9/16", Polished Silver/Gray.
review_body: Good product, very nice looking, good grips, seems to be nice quality. Still new so I cannot attest to the longevity as of yet. But worth the $$$ so far.

product_title: Pocket Size Fishing Survival Kit
review_body: It's true that many fishermen could make a kit like this from their tackle box, and probably not even notice the missing pieces.  At the same time this kit serves a great purpose.  It's lightweight, self contained in a sealed package, and it can be slipped into a getaway kit and you'll never know it's there.  And if you need to catch a fish in an emergency someday, it's enough to get the job done.    As to the seller, I'd recommend them most highly.  I placed my order at about 11:00 PM my time before I went to bed.  When I woke up in the morning I'd already received an email that the item had shipped.  I immediately went to the USPS tracking site, and they already had the item in possession.  I received it in the mail the following day, from NY to AZ in 40 hours.  That's service that rivals Amazon itself.    In summary, this is a fine kit for those of us with no tackle box in our garage.  Buy 2 and put 1 in your glove box.

product_title: ALPS Mountaineering Lightweight Series Self-Inflating Air Pad
review_headline: Good, but one was sent wrong size
review_body: This pad was comfortable and kept us warm for our grassy camping ground. I had to blow additional air into it to make it really full, but not much work at all.  The only problem was that one was sent with the incorrect labeling and size on the pad itself.  I had to send one back for replacement of the correct size.

product_title: Sea to Summit Big River Dry Bag
review_headline: They may cost a little more, but they are SO worth it!
review_body: I bought one of these bags a few years ago and decided to see if I could find watertight bags for cheaper elsewhere.  Big mistake!  I now have 4 or 5 cheap, useless heavy no-brand plastic bags that just don't work as well stuck in the far corner of my boat storage closet.  I am also the proud owner of about 10 of these Sea to Summit bags in several sizes and colors.  The Sea to Summit bags are NOT just vinyl.  They are a soft, flexible waterproof cloth material kind of like the stuff they make marine foul-weather grear out of.  The bags are lightweight and fold up very small when empty.  Don't screw around trying to find cheaper bags.  Just buy a few of these.  They will not disappoint.

product_title: Eureka! Copper Canyon 10 - Tent (sleeps 5)
review_body: Have used it once so far. Set up was in the dark and was still pretty easy, except for the rain fly. It was very hard to put it on the tent, It kept sliding off! You definitely need 2 (or 3) people for the fly attachment.   It rained and we were perfectly dry inside. There were not any wind problems either, as stated in other reviews. I did get a ground pad for under the tent.  I think the open ceiling makes for a cold tent though, bring something to cover the mesh if it's gonna be in the low 40's!  I read elsewhere that you can loosen and drop the fly to do this, but I don't see how unless you remove the support rods in the fly. I was not going to get up and try this in the rain.  Great tent nice and tall, I'm 6'4\\" and was surprised at the size. The included gear loft storage was a handy feature. Tent was easy to fit back in it's storage bag.    I set up the tent in the garage to dry it out and that set up was much quicker, fly was still a pain for one though.

product_title: Nemo Equipment Losi 3-Person Tent
review_body: I purchased my Nemo Losi 3P for for $325 from HumbleOutdoors, it came with a free footprint.    By adding only one extra pound of weight, NEMO increased the interior from 32 to 50 sq ft. I love the Losi 3P pole configuration which provides super strength and almost vertical walls for max usable interior space. Two people can move around in this tent, definitely worth the extra pound.

product_title: Rawik Women's Cirque Bib
review_headline: Great... Great.. & oh I forgot... GREAT!!
review_body: I am 6 months pregnant and I ordered a large!! It stretches & it fits perfectly.. I wear it every single great and I am EXTREMELY satisfied with my purchase!!! I am 5\\"8 and it fits perfect!!

product_title: prAna Women's Harlow Dress
review_body: This product was enormously disappointing compared to another Prana dress I have which I love! The material was thin and appeared cheap; I bet it wouldn't last three washes without looking faded and worn out. The neckline was not flattering at all as the thin material made the gathering around the neck look uneven. I will be returning this dress.

product_title: SLA Battery Charger - 24 Volt 1.5A/ 1.8A/ 2.0A Charger with XLR Connector for Electric Scooter
review_body: This was sent to me instead of the one I ordered.  It does not work.  I left it on over night and my battery was still not charging.  I can not return it because there was no invoice or return address to tell me where to send it.  Amazon beware.

product_title: Allen Sports Deluxe 2-Bike Trunk Mount Rack
review_body: Very nice bike rack. Fits well on ford escape. very sturdy and easy to work with.  Will need adapter to accomadate girls bike. I purchased that as well from amazon and works great. Very happy.

product_title: Eureka! Tetragon 7 - Tent (sleeps 3)
review_body: I have only used this product 1 time so far.  It did not rain during my trip at all, but I loved the tent.  It was easy to put together and take down, as well as travel with.  I like the full rain cover which would have kept rain out of the sides.  I did spray the tent in case it rains, so maybe in the future I will be able to test it out for leaks.

product_title: CamelBak Hellion 100-Ounce Hydration Pack
review_body: Love this backpack. I haven't used it for skiing yet, but have used it for hiking/climbing about two dozen times so far. Great backpack. Fits great, plenty adjustable, tons of straps for carrying extra jackets/gear/etc. Also two small lined pockets for delicate items like camera/cell phone/sun glasses.

product_title: Razor Rip-Rider 360 Drifting Ride-On
review_body: Gave this to my 8 yr. old for Christmas.  He rides it around the circle in our house since it's snowy outside.  He absolutely loves it.  I can't wait until summer and he can ride it outside and save my walls from spin-out dingers.  I wish the seat would adjust so I could ride it, it looks so fun, but I can't pedal without my knees hitting the handlebars :(

product_title: JanSport Ella Tote Core Series Tote
review_body: This bag is great, holds a ton of stuff. Though it has a section for a laptop it doesn't take up a bunch of bag space like some other laptop compartments (which most new bags have now.) I also love that it has a zippered top so that your stuff doesn't fall out while you are driving or if it tips over.

product_title: Heat Factory 6 Hour Adhesive Foot Warmer Insole, 30 Pairs
review_body: My daughter, who suffers from Raynauds Syndrome, would be unable to function normally without these foot warmers.  Not only have they enabled her to continue to compete on the track team, but she is now able to comfortably endure outside winter temperatures while waiting for the bus.  Without these foot warmers, she certainly would not have been able to enjoy a winter trip to Europe, where her sightseeing group walked several miles a day in cold temperatures. These foot warmers have been such a lifesaver for her!    As it turns out, these foot warmers have also been a godsend for my daughter's grandmother, who has poor circulation and chronically cold feet.  During a recent visit, we let her use one of my daughter's foot warmers so that she could accompany us on a walk in 30-degree temperatures.  She was so thrilled with their effectiveness that before the day was out, she was on the computer ordering TWO full boxes of them!  We can't say enough for this product.

product_title: HotHands Body & Hand Super Warmer
review_body: I purchased these for a friend of mine in the Army that is stationed in Afghanistan, where it can get quite cold, and figured that they were perfect size to fit in any pocket or even in a sleeping bag ect. They are still in transit (can update later) but i kept a few for myself to try out. They work great, i used them when i was out hanging up christmas lights in the cold. Placed one in each front pocket of my jeans and they provided some much needed warmth. they do take a little while to warm up,it is not instantly hot, so keep that in mind. hopefully they will be a help to my friend as well. overall i am happy with these.

product_title: Stansport Mountain Hauler Pack Frame
review_body: This pack frame fell apart on me after only two hikes.  The plastic buckles don't even snap together correctly and then pull apart when they do.  Not worth your time.

product_title: Stansport Tatami Straw Ground Mat, Color May Vary
review_body: Portability is nice, however, the straw mat itself is not very sturdy, and did not withstand after only 3rd and 4th use.

product_title: JanSport Classic Merit Backpack
review_body: In use as a school backpack for the past 2 months.  Standard Jansport quality. Holding up well.

product_title: Michelin Dynamic Tire (Black, 700x32c)
review_body: Purchased 6 of these, 4 for two road bikes with 2 for spares. After less than 500 miles on relatively smooth surfaced roads the 700x32 rear tire on my Trek hybrid developed a bulge in the tread area about 1/4\\" high and 3\\" long with a very noticeable distortion in the tread. Obviously it thumped quite badly which is how I discovered it. After changing it I could not find any separation of the casing inside the tire, just a weak area that you could push out easily with your finger. These tires are serviced correctly prior to each ride with the maximum rated psi (87). Could just be an isolated incident but now I am questioning the safety of these as I ride 100% by myself out in rural areas.

product_title: Photo Digital Camera Sling Shoulder Backpack Bag 3 Lenses Adjustable Divider C1000
review_body: This bag was a little smaller than I expected but has worked out quite well.  I had to reconfigure the inside compartments a little to make things fit better.  It holds my Pentax K-x with 55mm lens and extra 200mm lens along with a flash in the main compartment. In the top compartment I have extra batteries, usb cable, handheld GPS and in the front zipper pocket I have extra SDHC cards and lens cleaning accessories. Everything fits well and is secure. It is padded enought that it seems like it will give plenty of protection and is comfortable to wear on your back.

product_title: Schwinn 20-Function Bike Computer
review_body: What a great product, i ordered it for my spinning bike, easy to mount, only problem i had was attaching the magnet to the wheel, so i crazy glued the sucker on.  shows calories burned and speed so i can really rev up the intensity i need for my workout. Works great> i am very pleased with this product.  I would recommend it to anyone

product_title: Seirus Innovation City Noise Softshell Bandana
review_body: I got 2 of these and was not clear on what the material was going to be like.  Let me explain it this way:  it's similar to the fabric of a wetsuit only much more thin.  It has breather holes and is cut / stitched well to fin the contour of your nose and chin.  My only issue is that they need to have more Velcro to secure it in back.  It will come off if you are really active...say snowboarding perhaps.

product_title: Polaris Ranger Boy's 24-Inch Mountain Bike
review_headline: Liittle hard to set up but nice
review_body: Just purchased for my 12yo.  He absolutely loves it.  Setting up the Shimano drive was a little hard, after two hours I still wasn't able to get the first gear to work properly (first time setting one up).  Besides that, the shifting is smooth on the other gears.  It has excellent brakes and nice meaty tires.  The bike seems very sturdy in constuction and will most likely hold up to the abuse that most 12 year olds dish out.  I rode it myself, felt a little on the small side and the front shocks seemed to give quit a bit and I'm only 5' 11\\" at 180lbs (maybe better for kids and not for most adult men).  I think it's a very nice bike overall, especially at $[...] bucks.

product_title: Planet Bike Anatomic Relief Pad Bicycle Seat Cover (ATB)
review_body: This seat is comfortable, easy to take on and off, and good for long bike rides. This saved me from having to buy an expensive pair of biking shorts.

product_title: Coleman AC 120V QuickPump
review_body: Although it is loud, which doesn't bother me---it does the job! Fills up my mattress in less than 5 minutes, has all of the correct attachment pieces. Delivery was fast, transaction was efficient.

product_title: Coleman Pack-Away Portable Fireplace Grill
review_body: I was very impressed with this grill,it is made very well. The carrying case was a lot better quality than i expected. The only reason i gave it 4 stars instead of 5 is because it does need a suspended grill in the bottom to put the wood on. I bought a small round grill that fit on the very bottom and cut 2 pieces of metal conduit to sit it on and this works fine. At 62 years old i have bought various grills and stoves over my lifetime and i will have to say that this grill is one of the best products i have ever bought!!!!!!

product_title: Pearl iZUMi Women's Select Cushion No-Show Sock
review_headline: Great if you don't walk. Socks don't stay. Horrible.
review_body: These socks are soft. Really soft. Too bad they slip off your feet instantly, walking their way into an annoying bunch in your arch and completely off your heel. What's worse than the socks? The seller who wants you to keep their defective product. Don't shop from these people, they're not honest.

product_title: Polar Bottle Insulated Water Bottle - 24oz (discontinued colors)
review_body: The bottle works fine, but is very cheap-looking.  It doesn't really resemble the picture.  There is a clear plastic outer layer with a colored middle layer (I ordered pink) that looks like crinkled-up aluminum foil. So it isn't really the pink bottle I envisioned. (The inner layer is opaque white, which is fine.)  But it keeps water reasonably cold, doesn't leak, is BPA-free and is dishwasher safe, all for a very reasonable price.

product_title: DryGuy GripOns Ice and Snow Traction
review_headline: These gripons are made for walking
review_body: Don't attempt to run in these because they can fail to provide traction at high speed, but otherwise they are an easy way to walk on ice.  They don't snag carpet and they are fairly easy to drive in.  I've worn them for a few weeks and they aren't showing any signs of wear yet.  Muddy snow can be messy if it gets stuck between the gripon and the shoe though.

product_title: Gore Bike Wear Women's Solid Lady WindstopperJacket
review_body: Got this jacket for my sweetheart. I have a similar gore bike jacket in men's that really breaks the wind. We both are happy with our jackets.   She uses it for breezy early morning walks too.

product_title: Exofficio Men's Give-N-Go Boxer Brief
review_headline: cleans up good (and feels nice too)
review_body: As advertised! Easy to clean in the sink and dries super-fast. Plus it feels nice and squishy.

product_title: InStep Take 2 Double Bicycle Trailer
review_body: I LOVE this trailer!!! It sets up easily and the instructions are simple.  Only problem was getting the bolt off my back bike wheel to connect the trailer connector adapter piece (wouldn't be a problem if I had one of the nicer quality bikes that have the pop off back wheels). But the trailer is great especially for the price!  Nice attractive blue color with gray frame, good storage, sturdy design, folds up easily and compactly, light weight, sets up quickly, etc...  LOVE IT!!!

product_title: Igloo Earth Series 1/2 Gallon Jug
review_body:
it's really hard to find a drink container that's bigger than one liter. i don't like to drink a lot of soda or coffee, so i brew fresh tea daily to take to work - which means brewing enough tea to last the whole day. thusly, a ~2L container is a must for me, and i've been through about a half dozen over the years.

pros:
-this one holds a good amount of liquid
-\\"earth series\\" means it's partially recycled materials
-spout is easy to flip open, and stays shut when closed
-durable enough to survive frequent drops onto the pavement or kitchen floor

cons:
-the handle is attached by a pair of flimsy bullet-points molded into the plastic, which easily snap out of their insertion holes. i dropped this thing all the time when picking it up and having one or both sides of the handle give up.
-no seal/gasket/o-ring in the lid, so if it's laid down on it's side, this jug will start dripping.
-adhesive used to put the label on the jug is industrial strength. after 6 months of hand & dishwashing, strips of the plastic label and a black gummy spot of old adhesive were still there. and yes, i tried removing it with acetone and alcohol, no dice.

temperature control is merely ok. stuff will stay hot or cold in here for a couple of hours, but it's definitely room temperature by the end of the day.

i suppose the final telling review was that i wasn't sad (merely annoyed) when the dogs pulled this down off the counter and destroyed it, since that meant i could move up to a better beverage container.

product_title: U.S. Divers 281156 Island Dry Snorkel
review_body: Works better than most other snorkels I've tried. Takes a bit of getting used to but it's worth the trouble.

product_title: Schwinn 700c Men's Connection Hybrid Bike
review_body: Pretty light.  Put together easily, but needed tune up.  So far so good.

product_title: New Wave Enviro 10 Stage Water Filter System
review_body: This is a great filter that does what it promises:  removes most contaminants from water, including the creepier contaminants like lead.  I've had it for three years. So far, it's survived and tackled the water problems of urban New Jersey (benzine and who knows what else) and Tiny Town, Washington (trihalomethanes from small town water system).  Customer-service-wise, this company is tops:  after moving from NJ and reinstalling my filter, I noticed that one of the gaskets had gotten lost in the move.  I called, spoke to a very helpful sales rep, and she sent a replacement - free - within 4 days.  The only thing that ultimately succumbed to heavy daily use was the auto-shut-off valve, which just means that I have to turn off the valve manually after use (no big deal).

product_title: X20 Universal Adult Life Jacket Vest - Blue & Black
review_body: It arrived a day early, it fits (I'm a round guy) ccomfortably.  Gotta love it for the price.

product_title: Finish Line Fiber Grip Carbon Fiber Bicycle Assembly Gel
review_headline: Worked well on carbon fork steerer tube
review_body: This is a clear gel that has a fine abrasive blended in.  I was having issues with carbon parts staying tight at recommended torque settings.  After coating with this gel you could feel the components tighten with a much more pronounced \\"grab\\" and I have had no issues since.

product_title: ExOfficio Alpental Hoody - Women's
review_body: Great sweatshirt: well-made, nice styling, textured material, soft, fairly deep side pockets, on the larger side (but a previous review let me know this, so I knew to order a size down). The only problem as that I ordered the sage color, but got the blue. I'm keeping it anyway because the blue is very nice. The \\"navy\\" blue is really not quite as dark as navy, which makes it nicer in my opinion.

product_title: Women's Classic Padded Bike Shorts Cycling Bicycle BikingMade in USA
review_body: Much more reasonably priced than your typical 'cycling' brands and a great short. Wore them for the first time yesterday and my ride was much more comfortable. The shorts were a little higher waisted than I would have liked, but I loved the length and the comfort.

product_title: Rollerblade Women's Activa 90MX Skate
review_body: This is a second pair of Roller Blades I have ever owned.  They are good and snug and I don't consider myself a novice at rollerblading.  The color is really nice and neutral and would go with anything you wear.  I also liked that it has some mesh like material that allows it to \\"breath\\" in the boot. (Though, you can't feel any air.) If you are a pro at stopping with your brakes I commend you.  I have worked on stopping with the brakes and found that it's pretty much worthless when you get up to even a moderate speed.  In my opinion these don't take much to get up to speed with a few strokes and stopping is better if you can do a good T-Stop at any moderate speed. (still a work in progress  So I am seriously thinking of taking the brake off since it doesn't seem to add any value unless your very slowly rolling.  So it's either I learn to stop by a face plant or a T-Stop! Overall I love the skate and couldn't be happier.

product_title: Schwinn Urban Lighted Adult Helmet (Grey)
review_body: In the title of this product, it says \\"Schwinn Urban Lighted Adult Helmet (Grey)\\"... This helmet is NOT lighted... however, still a great helmet, but the false advertisement really disappoints me.

product_title: Intex Fabric Extra Wide Camping Mattress
review_headline: Inexpensive but Doesn't Hold Air Long
review_body: When we first received the mattresses, they worked very well with steady use, but both developed slow leaks after 3 months.  I tried to find the leaks using water in a bathtub to try and patch, but couldn't see any bubbles.  I believe there might be a problem in the seams.  Now they need to be filled each use and loses half the air by morning.

product_title: Victorinox Swisscard Lite, Onyx
review_body: Esperaba que la tarjeta fuera de la calidad de Victorinox, la portaba en la billetera, en la primera semana, se quebró, esto no representa la caliadad que se espera de esta marca

product_title: Thule Sidearm Universal Bike Mount
review_body: I own one sidearm attachment and two criterium attachments, all by Thule. I use the sidearm to hold my dual suspension 29er because due to the shape of the frame, the criterium does not hold as securely as I would like.    Overall I am more satisfied with the criterium, it weighs less, goes on and off the vehicle more easily, and looks better on the car. It is also easier to load the bike into the criterium. I would only suggest the sidearm to someone with a dual suspension bike or an unconventional frame shape, but if that's what you have, I would strongly recommend this product.    If you have a road bike or a hardtail mountain bike, buy the criterium. I have read some reviews of the bike falling off on people, but if you take your time to ensure the bike is loaded properly, you won't have any issues.

product_title: Disney Princess Micro Bicycle Helmet and Protective Pad Value Pack (Toddler)
review_body: my little 4 year old girl just started to ride her bike without training wheels and we just love that she will be safe doing so!!!  she loves this  sunshinemacaroni

product_title: Pearl Izumi Men's Elite Thermal Cycling Tight
review_body: These tights are exactly as advertised. They have an incredible fit, wick moisture nicely,and of course keep you very warm during those chilly morning rides. The chamois is comfortable and form fitting. It doesn't make you squirm around on your seat like many others. The tights fit like a glove, but move with you and are not restrictive in any way. I would rate them as excellent and recommend these to anyone who is looking for top performance cycling tights.

product_title: Razor Ground Force Electric Go-Kart
review_headline: fun but a few design issues
review_body: My son loves this cart which he's had since yesterday. I guess that is what's important. So far it looks sturdy, which it should be for the $$$ price. The brakes are good, the ride seems stable, and the top speed is probably around 10 mph carrying a 10 year old. However, a few design issues are immediately apparent:  1) The wheels are tiny, perhaps 4.5 inches in diameter. So the ride is quite rough on our paver driveway. Would be much better on pavement.  2) The car is extremely low and would be impossible for a car to see from certain angles or at dusk. The safety flag is short and dark colored and really doesn't improve things. We changed the flag to a much longer orange one and put forward and backwards lights on my son's helmet to help visibility.  3) The turn radius is gigantic. He can barely make a U turn in our wide driveway. My minivan has a better turn radius. This would not work in a backyard patio area.  Other than that, so far so good. The red color is pretty!

product_title: Jansport City Tote (Black)
review_body: This bag is perfect for me. I used it as a carry on for a plane trip.  I could not believe how much it could hold, while not being overly huge.  Perfect bag for my needs!!  Definitely recommend!!

product_title: Kryptonite Kryptolok Series 2 Mini Bicycle U-Lock (3.25)
review_body: tried to insert the lock into the bracket it didnt go through.  Never buy such product from amazon!!!  Go to store where you can easily buy and return if you received product has flaw.

product_title: Aosom Elite II 2in1 Double Baby Bicycle Bike Trailer and Stroller - Yellow
review_body: This product has been a little disappointing. First, the directions to put the thing together were a joke. There might as well not have been any directions. Trying to get it switched over to hook on to a bike is a total pain. The ad for the stroller has to be revised to say that it is for kids 2 and up. It didn't say that in the ad, so we figured it would be adjustable for any age. Our 1 1/2 year old gets practically smothered by the straps. We had to do some adjustments of our own to be able to fit our two kids in it. Once we got through all that mess, it worked fine as a jogger and a trailer.

product_title: Timbuk2 Freestyle Bag (Gunmetal/Cement/Gunmetal, X-Small)
review_body: Okay, after being an Amazon customer for more than 15 years, this is the first product I'm providing a review for.  I purchased the black version for my iPad and have loved every minute of it.  I don't even have a cover for my iPad since this bag protects it very well.  The Timbuk 2 Freestyle has a ton of compartments for my iPod, work BlackBerry, wires, etc.  Once I purchased the iPad 2 for the Mrs., she wanted a Timbuk 2 like mine, so I purchased the grey/gunmetal one for her.  We're always getting compliments on the bags & people always want to know where to purchase them.  Please be ADVISED that if you're 5'10\\" or taller this bag may fit and look a little small on you.  The strap is not that long, which is unfortunate for taller folks.  But, it's just a great bag to carry around your iPad.  I highly recommend.

product_title: O'Neill Wetsuits Men's 24/7 Tech Long-Sleeve Shirt
review_body: I don't surf but I do swim in the KY River every day that I can stand the temp of the water. This swimshirt keeps me burnfree and dries out quick. Thumbs up! How long it will last I'll report after a year or two.

product_title: MSR Lightning Ascent Snow Shoes
review_body: I bought these for my husband after having used a similar pair for the last two seasons and absolutely loving them. The only thing that is different is the binding buckles now have a small knob at the end that needs to be pushed through the hole on the cross-strap.  That improvement just makes it more difficult to put on the snowshoes. I'm hoping that with a few wearings, the holes will enlarge a little and pushing that small knob through will become easier. Otherwise these snowshoes are GREAT...lightweight, maneuverable, don't slide sideways because of the grip-edges, the bottom gives them good float and they don't kick snow up your back like the Atlas snowshoes do.

product_title: Theeve Deck Bolts
review_body: These things are pretty light. I thought it was a scam but they are very light. There 7/8 so you cant have risers with them. So yeah

product_title: Gibbon Jibline Slackline
review_body: I have just recently emerged into the slack line world about a year ago. My friends and i were not very good, finding it extremely difficult to even stand up on the line. We had been using truck straps from the home depot for this whole time, and realized that we needed to actually find ourselves a real genuine slack line. After some research we felt that a Gibbon slack line would be the most reputable choice, and decided to purchase the Jib line! We received it the next day (we were so excited we choose 1 day shipping) and were so excited to test it out. We were excited to find that it literally only took us about 2 minutes to set it up as apposed to about 10 minutes using a truck strap. The set-up was soooo easy! The tightness of the line was perfect, and the material used for the jib line is way better than what we were use to. We absolutely love this product. It came in the box with tons of info how to use/ set up a line and even a carrying case for it as well! I even bought i speaker for our ipod because we are out on the line about 4 hours a day. Excellent product i would recommend this product to all my friends. Even if you are new to slack lining or want to go further in the sport this is the perfect line for anyone!

product_title: Giro Section Bike/Multi-Sport Helmet
review_body: Like the other reviewers posted there is not much ventilation in this helmet, so I 'll be using it for Fall and Winter riding only.   Also, there is not much padding and the chin strap is a little skimpy.   The buckle sticks out after it is secured.   Giro needs to redesign the padding and strapping system on this helmet.   My wife has a really low cost helmet that has a much better strapping system and is more comfortable.

product_title: Tri Black Alloy Bicycle Handlebar, 25.4mm, w/ Rubber Grips
review_body: VERY comfortable.   I highly recommend.   I used to get uncomfortable at 12 miles into ride.  I find these are a great rest and change of position.   They did come loose at the clamps, so I would recommend keeping your wrench on your bike just in case...

product_title: Sunlite Single Speed Crankset
review_body: The 44T gear makes it ideal for riding in any condition, flat or uphill. Good ratio, no issues with the product. I'd recommend it.

product_title: Zefal Locking Bicycle Hub Skewer (2-Piece Front/Rear)
review_body: Bought a set of these last year and they worked fine.  Needed to remove my rear wheel yesterday, inverted the bike, the lever wouldn't open.  Tried tapping on it with a wrench, no joy.  Positioned the bike at several angles in my work stand, again to no avail.  Also tried using a magnet as another reviewer suggested, no luck.    The wheel had to come off!  Grabbed the lever with a pair of pliers, swung it to the open position. The lever didn't bend, but the locking mechanism no longer worked.    Threw the Zefal skewers in the trash and put my originals ones back on.

product_title: Coleman Overnighter SpaceSaver Air Bed (30" x 80")
review_headline: Coleman Overnighter Spacesaver Air Bed XL Twin
review_body: Since August 2009, this product has been in use in our home for our young grand-daughter whenever she has spends the night...usually more than 1 or 2...with us.  The value of this air bed & supporting cot by Coleman is outstanding...far cheaper than buying a roll-a-way bed...and more comfortable to boot.  And, contrary to what another another reviewer said, this bed...after some practice-not a lot...is easy to set up by one person--as well as break down.  We also ordered from Amaxon.Com twin XL sheets and a mattress pad.  One reviewer suggested using the shipping box for storage when the bed is not in use...an excellent suggestion!  Although the air mattress has held up without fail during weekly use over a period of 16 months or so, I would like to purchase a backup air mattress...just in case the original one should fail.  I hope Coleman brings this product/concept back on the market.  I can't say enough nice things about this product.  Thank you, Coleman!

product_title: Intex Raised Downy Airbed with Built-in Electric Pump, Queen, Bed Height 22"
review_body: way better deal for the money than another, much higher priced (Aerobed) inflatable mattress that i had before.  this one will leak out some air over a couple of nights.  i like it inflated to the max for support, so maybe it's just a bit too much for it.  it inflates very easily and quickly.  very comfortable sleeping on it.  i'll certainly be keeping it and using it frequently in the spare bedroom.  the old, expensive Aerobed had to be replaced once and the second one leaked just as bad as the first and neither would hold air overnight!

product_title: CamelBak 0.75- Liter Stainless Steel Better Bottle
review_body: I carry the bottle when I jog and it keeps the water cool and allows me to hydrate during exercise.

product_title: Eurosled Snow Fox Sled
review_body: My 5 year old son loves this sled.  The steering wheel really works.  He likes to go over the bumps so when his sled veers off course away from the bumps , he uses his steering wheel to get on course.  This sled is fast but safer than those inflatable things. You Can't comfortably go down on your stomach on this which I see kids doing on the inflatable ones which I think is very dangerous.  Highly recommend - all the kids will be eyeing this sled.

product_title: Shimano CS-6500 Ultegra Bicycle Cassette (9-Speed)
review_body:
Going from a 12T to 11T rear, you notice the difference.

Cassette was a breeze to install. Shifting is accurate, fast, and silent if you let up the pressure slightly as you go.

This went on a training bike with training wheels (Mavic CXP33), so no report on the liveliness of the wheel with less mass (not sure I'd even notice it, really); it was an inexpensive way to increase my wattage/interval intensity without pedaling hyperfast. Certainly cheaper than replacing the bike :)

I notice my saddle more with this gearing, the extra intensity of a session on rollers (I train indoors, daily) brings saddle pain to a higher level (for me, at least). Thus, a $70 purchase is turning into a $200 one :)

Pleased with the cassette, did the right things for the right reasons for the right cost, and you can replace it yourself (buy the Park cassette tool for $9, and use a pair of big channel-locks with cloth such as a washcloth in the jaws to hold the old cassette on the 17T ring, gently, you don't need a chainwhip).

product_title: Osprey FlapJack Pack
review_body: Bought this bag for a new 14\\" laptop to use during graduate school.  I considered buying a messenger style bag to ride my bike with, but after looking at the reviews I went with this one.    It has worked perfectly as a commuter bag.  I ride 14 miles with it from home to school a few times a week, and it is very comfortable and stable.      The only reason I gave it 4 stars instead of five was that the bag's middle pocket that is held by a small Velcro strip could be better.  It has two mesh dividers which are nice, but the holes for the pencils/pens are right below the velcro (can't use 1 of  the holes for holding pencils) which doesn't make sense, and stuff could potentially fall out.  I don't keep any thing valuable in that pocket just in case.  Maybe a smaller flap over that pocket would have been a better idea.      Overall a very durable and well made bag though.  I would recommend it for anyone who rides a bike around and wants to carry a laptop, books, and some other stuff.

product_title: CygoLite Milion 200 LED Rechargable 1-Piece HeadLight W/ Helmet Mount.
review_body: I recently committed to commute to work on my bike a minimum of 3 days per week.  When daylight savings time disappeared I was faced with commuting with my $30 flasher that I used when I got caught in the dark. This new light really throws out the light. It is almost as good as a car light and I am sure that it can be seen from a long way away.  I am using the Helmet Mount which seems secure. There is also the ability to rotate the direction of beam once it is on the helmet which I did not know about before the purchase. I especially like that it can be recharged with the USB port on the office computer if I need more battery.  Based on my usage so far the battery life seems pretty accurate. We'll see if I continue to get 3 hours with every charge. This piece of equipment seems well worth the money given the safety advantages of being able to ride in the dark with confidence. Keep riding!

product_title: Swagman XTC Cross-Country 2-Bike Hitch Mount Rack (1.25 and 2-Inch Receiver)
review_body: This thing is great.  Well built, good quality, I've had it for about a year now and there is no rust, all the parts are as good as the first day I got it.  Very easy to use, just put the bike on, lower the bar and go!

product_title: Emotion Comet 110 Kayak
review_body: Amazon shipped this using UPS package two day service. It was wrapped in a big plastic bubble wrap. It arrived with few dings & scratches but for the price, it was cheaper than the local store (REI). This was the second order for this yak as the first one was returned to Amazon for some reason (my shipping address was not correct, yeah right) This yak is long & it does not track well in windy or choppy waters. The seat is comfortable, the foot braces are a bonus & the thigh padding is useful. I have taken this out on Lake Washington yesterday, the wind was about 12MPH & it was a challenge to paddle in choppy water but was a lot of fun. My next stop is going to be Alki, on the sea, but waiting for that perfect summer like weather. I highly recommend this yak for anybody who's on a budget.

product_title: Push up instant Beach Tent Beach
review_body: I bought this tent for our first trip to the beach with our 1 yr old! So easy to put up and take down and folds up smaller than a bag chair! Perfect for what I was looking for!

product_title: Coleman Coleman 62 qt. Xtreme Cooler
review_headline: Arrived intact, unlike the one shipped by Sears, Worked great on long road trip
review_body: I thought since Sears was cheaper, even with Amazon's free shipping, that I would be okay ordering from Sears.  Well, they slapped the shipping stuff on the cooler lid and shipped it without any packing or protective plastic.  Not surprisingly, it arrived without wheels (not even in the cooler, just completely missing) and filthy with transport dirt.  Amazon boxed the cooler and it arrived in perfect condition.  The wheels seem have a metal rod connecting them that looks like it pops into a channel; there's nothing additional holding them in. Update on Sears - took me a month and a half to go through the process of returning and getting my money refunded. I would never recommend using Sears - I couldn't return the cooler to my local store because they couldn't bring the order up on the register, so I had to ship it back and get that money refunded.     On using the cooler: I took the cooler on a long road trip, 5 days east, 5 days back. Leaving home, I filled the cooler with some frozen food, chilled food, cold drinks, ice blocks made using plastic storage containers (8-cup) and some frozen water bottles and a zipper bag of ice cubes. It worked quite well, even though I was in it frequently during the day for drinks and food and never removed it from the car, which meant it was in a hot car with no windows cracked in the mornings. Every night I would chill drinks in the motel fridge and add them to the cooler. When I arrived, it was still working so I didn't unload the cooler for a couple days and still dumped ice. I wrapped the cooler in heavy freezer foil wrap to help keep heat off it, which probably helped a little, even if it did look a bit odd, plus I keep a window sun shield over the cooler.     Coming home, I didn't have the big storage containers to make ice, but I used smaller ones to make ice blocks and packed them together in gallon freezer zipper bags. I also filled another gallon freezer zipper bag of ice cubes. I threw in a gallon zipper bag of ice from motels most mornings so I'd have fresh ice for drinks. After 8 days of use I emptied the cooler, and there was still a lot of ice left, even some of the ice blocks. The last 3 days it was in the car in the garage and not opened, but otherwise it was opened frequently as I traveled.     I do have tricks that I use: I always put ice in freezer zipper bags (ice would cut holes in thinner bags, and still pricks these), which helps keep the ice colder longer, and also reduces water in the bottom of the cooler. I always use ice blocks if I can, and making them is easy with plastic storage containers - just don't fill the container full to allow room for expansion and you can put the lid on it when it's freezing. I freeze food I won't need for a few days in single-serve containers and move them to the top of the cooler to thaw as needed, allowing two days for thawing. And frozen water bottles become drinks after a while, and are easy to fit around things - open the bottle before freezing, squeeze out excess air and just a little water, and get a tight seal so there is room for expansion.    I only moved the cooler a few times in and out of the car, and it is heavy when full. I didn't have any trouble with leakage, and I didn't drain the cooler until I emptied it. There's still water in the cooler since the zipper bags leak some. Moving it is fine, although I could tell it was heavy, and the big handle worked fine. The only complaints I have are that the drainage hole is on the same side as the big handle, which makes it harder to hold the cooler up to drain the last bit of water, and the big handle cannot be laid flat next to the cooler since it is just a little too long and props the cooler up, which I'm sure eventually would break the handle hardware.

product_title: Zippo Color Lighters
review_body: I have a Matte Black Zippo as well and wanted a second as a backup and also for \\"tricks.\\"    Because certain tricks require you to bend the wick a bit (in a way that actually hinders the effectiveness of it being a lighter), I wanted a second, separate lighter. It also doesn't hurt since it's a backup.    The Zippo works great so long as you make sure it has fuel in it (even if you fill it and never use it, it can evaporate over time so if you are in a situation where it's your only source of fire, you should always top it off before you leave, and consider bringing some spare fluid). Second, you also have to make sure the flint has not worn out, or keep a backup in the base of the lighter. Cause without flint, you have no fire!    So yes, since this is not a disposable lighter it does require some maintenance, but that's not unlike any other thing.    All Zippo's are internally the same so just choose the color and finish you like.    As for this specific color, I really like it. It's a nice blue but it has an iridescent effect so it responds a bit to light.    The only bad part is that it's really prone to smudges from oils on your finger.

product_title: Electra Bicycle Bell (Daisy Blue)
review_body: My daughter got a new bike for Christmas and needed a bell.  This bell is loud and very cute she loved it.

product_title: LEDwholesalers 51-LED 395nm Ultra Violet Blacklight UV Flashlight 3xAA, 7202UV395

review_body: Since it's winter, I haven't used cooler much yet but it does have have the classic look. Don't have any major concerns.     The white plastic lid handle would have been nice if it was a metal piece. Other than that, I always wanted a steel belted Coleman. Had a plastic Coleman cooler for years but wanted something nicer. I think the listed price is a bit high but do realize nothing is cheap today; pay for what you get.
