product_title: Topeak JoeBlow Pro Floor Bike Pump
review_body: I bought this pump a little over a year ago thinking it would be the last pump I would have to buy for years (as some reviews claim). I ride a lot and pump-up my tires every time, so this is an important tool for me. I did a lot of research and saw so many good reviews and I liked many of the features, so I went ahead and splurged for this pricey pump. Within the 1st few uses, I learned that the locking lever on the head will quickly snap back when releasing it from your tire. Since the lever neatly retreats into a sharp-edged groove, it will bite anything in its way. I've gotten blood blisters on fingers and the palm of my hand from flipping the lever down while trying to pull it off the stem. (minus 2 stars for the pain) The head also stays so firmly attached to the stem that you have to pull hard to get it off after flipping the lever down to release it. When it finally lets go, your hand gets smashed into the spokes - not very pleasant with blade spokes. (minus 1 point) Then it started to make a terrible groaning/squeeking sound on the downstroke while pumping. A little embarassing, but still worked well pumping my tires to 120psi. (minus 1 star for the noise) Recently, the pin holding the lever in the head popped-out. I was able to get it back in, but since then the pump will not hold air. (minus 1 more star) That should leave this with zero stars, but it did work for awhile.

product_title: Benex LED Bike Light
review_body: This little unit puts out more than enough light for street commuting , the batteries last a very long time and it is the easiest handlebar release of any light I have used , which anyone who lives in a city will appreciate since we have to load and unload our bikes every time we go anywhere.

product_title: Serfas Drifter Tire with FPS
review_body: I purchased this tire at the local bike shop and paid a premium price for a pair. I liked the look of the tire and had some fun riding pavement and paved paths. The tires had a lightweight feeling and accelerated well, rolled smoothly, cornered well and stopped confidently. I then decided to use these tires in some dirt and very easy off road trails. I crashed after sliding out on a fast curve. The surface was a fine gravel. These tires do not track well on hard packed surfaces, they \\"Drift\\" pun intended. I tried them on our local crushed gravel bike path. I didn't crash but found them less than adequate for this purpose. I decided to take them off after a couple of hundred miles to change to a more dual purpose tire. The good news was that the tires showed virtually no wear. The bad news is when taking these tires off the wire bead seperated from the rubber ruining the tire. Never had that happen before! So use this tire for paved surfaces and not on loose gravel or dirt. Hopefully the bead won't seperate for you while you are riding.

product_title: Coleman Grill And Stove Carry Case
review_body: The cover fits realy tight, however after you get it on, it protects the stove finish very well. Would recommend this product.

product_title: Bike Peddler Take A Look Cycling Eyeglass Mirror
review_headline: Bike Peddler Cycling Eyeglass Mirror - Just Okay
review_body: This mirror is okay. Fits over you sun or eyglasses ok, but is a bit small and doesn't extend out enough to safely check behind you while watching ahead of you at the same time. It is also a bit fragile while attempting to adjust and could be dangerous if you need to adjust while in motion due to wind knocking it ot of adjustment while riding.

product_title: TUBBS 3 PC POLES
review_body: I ordered the Tubbs poles hoping they would arrive before my scheduled snowshoe/ski trip. They did!  The poles were exactly what I was looking for. I used them for snowshoeing and my friend borrowed them for x-country skiing. They were wonderful. I fully recommend the 3-piece poles.

product_title: Pure Comfort Full Size Flock Raised Air Mattress
review_body: I was in desperate need of a new mattress, but didn't want a conventional one because of all the flame retardant chemicals they contain.  The organic mattresses are very expensive and ordering via the internet is risky, not knowing if the comfort will be just right and then not being able to get a refund.  On a whim, in a moment of exhaustion, I purchased this air mattress, not really expecting it to be that great.  It took a little tweeking -- you can adjust the firmness with the amount of air.  It does not leak at all and I've have it almost a month now.  I'm not thrilled about sleeping on vinyl, but I add layers of blankets & mattress pads to the top of the bed, under the sheets.  This makes it feel more like a 'real' bed.  I'm used to this now and find it quite comfortable, and no back ache in the morning.  Still may get an organic mattress, but the urgency is off now.

product_title: Genuine Issue Magnesium Survival Firestarter
review_headline: Too weak, slow, and unreliable to count on in a pinch
review_body: Yes, it works; if you have a lot of time to scrape a quarter-sized (2.5 cm) pyramid of magnesium off the rectangular mass, protect it from every little gust of wind, and then try again and again and again to get the weak sparks from the fire steel to light it. However, if you are using a device like this to start a fire, it probably means that you are in a survival situation, and do not have a lot of time to get a fire going. Consequently, I have dropped this from my outdoor carry gear, and replaced it with a good flint and steel device (one that produces a usable flare of sparks instead of the laughable little flickers this one produces) and some good, reliable, waterproof fire starting tablets. They work quickly, reliably, and well (I know because I've used them). This magnesium thing works slowly, after much time and effort, and only in ideal situations (I know, because I have tried it and given up in frustration). The fact that the military issues this dog does not impress me at all. When I am outdoors and off the pavement, I need gear that works easily and quickly. This thing does not, so I'm not carrying it.

product_title: Thule 970XT Helium 2 Bike Hitch Carrier
review_body: This a great rack.  Light weight, easy to put on and take off.  The arms for the bikes could have been about 2\\" longer; would have made this 5 stars.

product_title: Park Tool Deluxe Home Mechanic Repair Stand
review_body: Since I already have the Park shop stand which has been great, I needed a portable stand to take on trips. I bought the Park PCS-4-2 to use on our downhill bikes and it has been junk so-to-speak compared to our base stand. My Demo 9 is about 42 pounds and this stand can not handle the weight. When the bike is clamped in by the seat post the stand flexes down and the pedal hits the stand making it impossible to turn the cranks without holding the bike up. Also, the rotating head does not have enough friction to hold the front of your bike up. It works fine for very light bikes but for downhill or free-ride bikes it is not heavy duty enough.

product_title: One Touch Push Up Easy Setup Beach Shelter 8 Feet Tent Better than Pop Up Easier when Fold Up
review_headline: Great idea - poor ventilation - stakes are a joke
review_body: This looks great, and is REALLY easy to set up.  One man can easily set it up and bring it down/wrap.  Provides enough shade for a small family.  HOWEVER, it heats up in the sun and due to poor ventilation (the window barely helps) makes it almost impossible to sit in.  The stakes this comes with are a joke. They barely hold in the sand. Get longer and wider ones immediately.

product_title: CamelBak BPA-Free Better Bottle with Bite Valve
review_body: I like the bite valve technology. Easy to drink without spilling :). Bottle is well made.

product_title: Fenix L2D 6 Level High Performance Cree LED Flashlight (Black)
review_body: Fenix makes quality products. But like with all technologies, you need to keep up with the latest and greatest (in this case, LED technology). I've had this particular light for years and at the time it came out, it was magnificent. But nowadays you could probably get one dropped shipped from China that's twice as bright and half as expensive.

product_title: Sevylor Inflatable Sit-On-Top Kayak, 2-Person
review_body: Like other reviews, this is VERY comfortable.  It feels like sitting on a couch on the water.  For a small 5'4\\" female, this is a bit too wide for me.  It'll be perfect for a large man.  Very comfortable. Doesn't go fast. Great for a leisurely stroll down water lane. .. not built for speed.

product_title: Techni Ice HDR 4 Ply Reusable Ice & Heat Packs 20 Sheet Special
review_body: I use Techni Ice in my insulated lunch cooler always, and it will keep anything cold that goes into that bag. At the end of the day (12 hours) they go back into the freezer for the next time I need them. Drinks are just like straight out of the fridge with this product. In a soft insulated bag I've had these last 8 hrs. and still cold, and cool after two days. Techni Ice is perfect if you have an absorbtion cooler (12v cooler that plugs into 12v outlet and cools or heats) that you cant put ice in. Put them in frozen and it helps the cooler keep colder temps and maintain those temps longer. This product saves on the cost of ice because when your done using them you can store them and use again at a later date. Also you can use this to keep anything you can imagine warm as they are also a heat pack. I have not used thes to warm but the instructions to do this are on the pack. You can cut to fit any size you need, just cut in between on the seams. I bought a 20 pack of these for alot cheaper than always having to buy ice again and again. Well worth the money. One other thing, for continous use as I do in the lunch bag you can expect 2 or 3 these to last about 8 months. I've bought these at an outdoor retailer more than once at $4.95 a sheet. They can also be hard to find on store shelves.

product_title: Cloudveil Men's Run Don't Walk Top
review_body: Not my first Cloudveil product & quality is great as usual. Smooth finish on outside makes it very easy to get jackets on. Definite downer on most fleece. 5'10\\" 160# & Med is great. Longer zipper is a plus. TC

product_title: Razor A2 Kick Scooter
review_body: What can I say about the Razor scooter? It is a well made product that is very inexpensive. My 5 year old loves it as well as does her big sister, who got her second one last year. The only issue I have with it, which is not that big, is when I pick it up when not folded together it swings around and usually hits my legs, not a deal breaker just annoying. My little one was riding like a pro on her second on it. It is just pure fun for the kids. Nuff said.

product_title: Coleman Boys Lights Out Sleeping Bag
review_body: Bought this for my camping-obsessed four-year-old.  He loves it.  Right now he's using it for nap-time at daycare, but we plan on using it for the camper this summer.  He loves the glow-in-the-dark strip and zipper.  It's pretty thick and comfy, too.  I was worried it wouldn't be big enough for him, but it works fine and he's tall for his age.

product_title: Sigg Lifestyle Loop Top Water Bottle (1.0-Liters)
review_body:
When I found out about the BPA deception from SIGG, I tried to give them the benefit of the doubt. I went ahead and shipped back my old bottles to SIGG, at my cost, for an exchange. I have friends who just threw their bottles away because of their distrust of SIGG. Over a month later, I received an e-mail with a gift code to order replacements. The replacement order and customer service was a fiasco. It took several e-mails, phone calls, and over 3 weeks to resolve.

If you aren't aware of the scandal, all SIGG bottles before August of 2008 have BPA liners. When SIGG was asked during that time, if their bottles or liners contained BPA, SIGG reps carefully worded their response to assure the public that their bottles did not. It wasn't until SIGG quietly released their new liners and an investigative report revealed their lie, did SIGG finally come clean. Patagonia, the outdoor company, was lied to in their face by SIGG. Patagonia was so upset by SIGG's deceit, that they returned ALL SIGG bottles, including ones with the new liners, back to SIGG to be recycled.

Not only are SIGG bottles not as safe as everyone thought (including Oprah), but the company itself has burned the trust of consumers and retail partners with their deception. Fortunately for us, real BPA-free alternatives do exist. I personally own 2 Camelbak plastic bottles that use the Tritan material, which is BPA-free. If you want metal bottles, Camelbak makes them with medical grade stainless steel. Klean Kanteen also uses medical grade stainless steel but does contain nickel and is also made in China, which apparently a lot of people have a problem with. Personally, I'll be trying the Klean Kanteen bottles soon.

Knowing what we know now, I cannot imagine anyone trusting this brand or company again. I certainly am through being a supporter and customer. If you want more information, feel free to Google \\"SIGG BPA\\" and you'll be inundated with negative press. The number of articles speaks volumes of the outrage SIGG has caused. Be safe everyone!speaks volumes of the outrage SIGG has caused. Be safe everyone!

product_title: Pramex Pre-treated Insect Repelling net - Ideal for 2 People
review_body: I am very happy with my purchase at the moment. I will know more after living under it for three months in Africa.

product_title: Pearl iZUMi Men's Slice Ultrasensor Bib TechKnicker
review_body: These are my first knickers and they fit perfect and I believe they are true to size.  They look & feel fantastic on.  I do wish the 3D Elite chamois was a touch more comfortable.  I ride 20 & 30 miles and they only pose a slight discomfort in the perineum area. I ride a Specialized Avatar gel saddle (looking to upgrade soon) and I realize my saddle could easily be the problem.  The 3D Elite has 13mm of thick nice protection and claims to be varying densities but I can't seem to tell by squeezing it. I personally think a fairly dense layer should have been used in the sandwiching of the chamois but maybe this was forgone for breath ability purposes.  So, all in all these knickers are great and I recommend them as with anything Pi makes.

product_title: Coghlan's Travellers Mosquito Net
review_body: This product seem to be of good quality...for me it was kind of big so I had to find a smaller one.

product_title: Swiss Gear 10- by 10-Foot Smart Shade Canopy
review_body: I really wanted a screened in patio but the budget said Swiss Gear Canopy with screen.  We have only had this for a few weeks but I love it.  We have it on our patio and with the screens we are able to sit and enjoy the outside without the bugs.      We also ordered  the Lasko 4900 Pro Performance High-Velocity Utility Fan   and now  we are really loving being outside in this heatwave we have here in the south.  The screen was pretty easy to put together.  My husband and son had it up in minutes. You will not regret getting this Canopy[

product_title: Topeak Explorer Bicycle Rack with Disc Brake Mounts
review_body:
This bike rack is very well made and painted. It is extremely light weight. I have a Trek Valencia with disc brakes and installation was a breeze although looking at where my brake hardware is, I probably didn't need the disc brake version of this rack.

I use this rack with the Topeak MTX which fits perfectly and stores all my tools, lock/cable, with enough room for a lunch/snack. I also bought a bungy net cage for it also.

Bottom line: I don't think you can lose with this rack. My only beef with it is i feel it should already have a rear tail light reflector or a universal light mounding bracket on it. It does come with a bracket, but no screws for it and it won't fit other mfg lights.

product_title: Intex Pillow Rest Raised Airbed with Built-in Pillow and Electric Pump
review_body: I purchased this air bed because it was advertised 82 inches long. It barely measures 76 inches a good half foot short  of my expectations.The width is also short by 4 inches.  However Iam pleased to report that it is a full 18 and 1 half inches high. Needless to say Iam returning this air bed for the above reasons.

product_title: MICRONET Microfiber Towel
review_body: This is a great addition to a backpakers gear.  It is very light weight and dries very fast.  It is my go to towel for backpacking when I want to lighten my load.    I also use this towel when going on dive trips.  It doesn't take up any real space in my dive bag and helps get me dry quickly.  I agree with the other reviewers in that it doesn't do much to block the wind and keep you warm however.  I would recommend getting cold quickly if that is an issue.    The only gripe is that it packs so small I can't use it as a pillow at night.  A good problem to have.

product_title: Pearl iZUMi Women's Quest Cycling Short
review_body: These shorts are long enough (come to about an inch or 2 above the knee) and the padding is terrific. Be sure the check the measurements for sizing before ordering because you'll likely need a size larger than you would for street clothes. I wore out the last pair of Pearl Izumi's and I like these even better.

product_title: Avenir Coil Combo Cable Locks
review_headline: Great Lock!  Easy to change combination.
review_body: I was a little nervous about getting this lock initially because some of the reviews I read indicated that it was hard to figure out how to create your own combination since it did not come with instructions.  Not only did the lock come with instructions, they were extremely easy to follow and I had the combo set in about 1 minute.  It is a very sturdy lock and will be great when I ride to the store for some quick grocery items or to the library for a book.  I am very glad I got this strong, affordable, easy to use, lock!

product_title: Serfas Mutant Guppy Bicycle Light
review_body: This light is surprisingly bright, especially given the small size. It's a great backup light as it weighs nothing. It would be easy to turn it on accidentally, so don't just throw it in a bag with nothing covering the switch: you could find the batteries dead when you need it most. I like the 2 red LEDs pointing out the sides of the guppy. I've only used it for about an hour and it worked fine.

product_title: Overland Equipment Donner Bag
review_headline: Great bag for travel or toddlers
review_body: This latest version (2010) of the Overland Donner has a much-improved new front pocket design. Instead of velcro holding the bottom mesh-panel flap in place, it is more of an accordian style front pocket (still with velcro closure). It is much easier to access contents in front pocket now, which I really appreciate. The side bottle pockets still accomodate my thermos and child's sippy - they collapse into the bag when not in use, too. The bottle pockets are tall enough so they conceal the bottles I'm carrying. The back panel pocket fits a paperback or compact changing pad, and the interior slip pocket fits a few diapers (or your wallet). There are still a few things that annoy me about this bag, though. I miss the older matte canvas - the new shinier cordura looks a bit cheapy. I miss the old interior printed fabric too, the newer bags have boring solid color nylon interiors. I guess when they moved production from Chico, California to China, they decided to use cheaper-looking, plain fabrics. The key clip in the front compartment is plastic (wish it was metal, the small plastic clip cannot hold but 1 or 2 keys), and the sunglass compartment only has fleece on one side (wish it had fleece on BOTH sides). But overall, I would still recommend the bag for travel or for use as a sportier-looking toddler bag. Not too many bags on the market have tall side bottle pockets and good organization; the Donner has both and is lightweight.

product_title: Pirate Bag 9x12
review_body: I have an 8x12 mat so I have a little extra room. Also holds the stakes and a hammer. I gave the 4 stars because the first one a bought had a factory hole in it, not properly sewn. But the seller sent me a new one right away.

product_title: Coleman King-Sized Quickbed with 4D Pump and Wrap 'N' Roll Storage
review_body: The little inflator feels a bit cheesy, but it works. Mattress itself is robust and comfy with a little fine tuning of the air pressure.

product_title: Fenix HP10 7 Level 225 Lumen LED Headlamp
review_headline: Amazingly powerful headlamp for a decent price!!!
review_body: I own a few headlamps and a few flashlights and I gotta say this thing blows all of em away! The hp10 headlamp has 4 settings, low,med,high, and a turbo function which boosts its power to a whopping 225 lumens! It only lasts 3 minutes before it overheats and goes back to the high setting but on only medium, this overpowers all the lights that i own and puts them to shame.    This little headlamp is powered by 4 AA batteries which are easily replaceable and you can find rechargeable ones such as the eneloops which are one of the best at keeping its charge. On the lowest setting, it is low enough to not blind anybody and you can still see a great deal of what you're working with. Also, on the lowest setting, they claim that it lasts more than 200 hours but i'm not gonna run any tests to confirm it so i cant dispute it. Still, this is the brightest light related product i've ever own, and best of all its handsfree!    There are 2 buttons on the top of the headlamp itself. The main middle button is the on/off switch and mode toggle. When u turn on the light, double click the main button to toggle to the flashing modes. The side button is the illumination toggle which toggles from low,med,high,and turbo. It has a memory setting so say if u last use the light on med, when u turn it on again it will be on med. However, if u last used it on turbo mode, when u turn it on again, it will revert back to high which i assume is for battery purposes.     There are 3 types of flashing modes. There are the SOS,warning flash, and a really fast strobe mode that can possibly be used as a self defense tool to disorient a would be assailant. I know it messes up my eyes so it does do a very good job at doing so.     When i first received the product, i was baffled as to how to put on the headstraps but then after paying closer attention, u just slip it thru the cracks and it goes thru. It's not very noob friendly so it may take u a while or a few tries to setup the headlamp.   It says itis also waterproof up to 2 meters(6 ft), however im not gonna to test it out as i dont see it neccessary for what i use it for. It would come in handy though if u use it during a rainstorm.     Anyways, its the most powerful headlamp i could find without breaking the bank, compared to a certain brand which sells a 350 lumen headlamp for 430 bucks. So for only 64 bucks, its a killer deal!!    One last thing is that this does NOT come with any batteries or the diffuser accessory.

product_title: Primo Comet Tire - Belted, 20 x 1.50
review_body: I bought this as a backup as bike shops don't keep recumbent equipment in their inventory.

product_title: Schwinn 20-Function Bike Computer
review_body:
As a casual weekend and summer rider who also owns a more expensive bicycle computer, let me say that for the money you can't beat this.

I'm not a particularly gifted bicycle mechanic by ANY means, but installation and programming were a snap. Now both my wife and I have a trip computer on our bikes.

We are VERY satisfied with this.

product_title: Mountainsmith Tour Recycled-Fabric Lumbar Pack
review_headline: Very well-made, lots of room, but room for improvement
review_body: I use this bag in my travels as well as a good, everyday, pack.  I think the quality is top-notch, and it's a plus that recycled materials are used in the construction.    My only \\"gripe\\" is that the shoulder pad on the shoulder strap has no way of fastening itself to one place on the strap - it migrates around and often ends up at the end of the strap.  If there was some Velcro on the interior of the pad and on the middle of the strap, one could stop the movement.

product_title: NALGENE Tritan OTG BPA-Free Water Bottle 24 Oz
review_headline: Bottle works, but it arrived dented
review_body: I ordered this bottle for my boyfriend as part of a care package. When he opened it last week it was dented. I'm not sure if it was from the packaging or was damaged beforehand, but I was very unsatisfied.

product_title: H2Odyssey Maui Men's 3/2 Fullsuit Wetsuit
review_body: Fits great. Will make pool opening in the spring & closing in the fall much more comfortable.

product_title: Mongoose Raid Freestyle Bike (20-Inch Wheels)
review_body: This bike was very easy to assemble. I had an issue with the back rim; but, with the excellent costomer support I had a new rim in just two days.

product_title: Cateye HL-EL530 LED Bicycle Headlight
review_body:
Sometimes I ride to work into central Tokyo (32km one way)
I was looking for a light that can show me the way home.

I was attracted by the HL-EL530 as I first thought it offers good value.

The visual design is very appealing and seemed easy to use.
I liked that it looks and feels like older (non LED) bicycle lights.

The handle bar mounting bracket is very easy to fit (no screw driver required), so thats is going to be useful for the initial setup.

The usage of the light is also straight forward.
So full points until here.

What can be improved:
The light beam itself is only light enough in the center. The surrounding area is actually hardly usable.
As such the light does really only work in areas with NO lights around at all.
If you have at least some street lights around you (villages) you will wonder if you did turn on your light.
Having said that the light color is beautiful (close to white).

That kind of vague guessing was reason enough for me to continue searching.
I am not going to guess if I have an elephant in front of me or not. I bought the light to see obstacles coming towards my way in advance.

The HL-EL530 did not help me much. So after some time and thinking I opted for the Cygolite Tridenx as I dont feel like buying lights at random that I am unable to make any use of.

I understand now that LED lights that are indicating their spec in candela serve the purpose of being seen.

Generally speaking lights giving the spec in lumen have the necessary force to bring light into darkness and let you see where dangers linger.

That was a valueable lesson to learn, I wish Cateye would do a better job of indicating what quality customer can expect from the light output.

product_title: Intex Deluxe Pillow Rest Raised Airbed with Soft Flocked Top for Comfort
review_body: WE LOVED THIS BED. MY HUSBAND WHO WEIGH 220 SLEPT ON IT FOR 5 DAYS STRAIGHT AND SAID \\"ITS COMFORTABLE AND IT HOLDS UP THE AIR. BOUGHT 2 AND WERE USING IT FOR GUEST IN SPARE BEDROOM. LOVED THE HEIGHT OF THE BED. CANT WAIT TO FIND MATCHING TWINS BEDDINGS. THANKS

product_title: Deluxe all season Motorcycle cover (L). Fits up to 84" length sport bike, dirt bike, small cruiser.
review_headline: Works Great, Even after torrential downpours
review_body: My first one was stolen, but I was so impressed with the quality that I bought it again. We experienced super heavy rainfall for a couple of days, and it kept the scooter dry as a bone.

product_title: Light My Fire Original Swedish FireSteel Scout 3,000 Strike Fire Starter - Red
review_headline: Not as big as 4th of July, but lots of sparks nonetheless
review_body: This + dryer lint = Instant flame.    I ditched the cruddy lanyeard and replaced it with a longer piece of paracord.      I would have given 5 stars had they just not included the cheap lanyard in the first place.  The clip came undone when I was playing around with it after opening the package and after that, it had to go.

product_title: Coleman Boys Scattered Sleeping Bag
review_body: We purchased this bag for our son to use for sleepovers and movie nights.  Its a great size and quality, rolls up easily and washes well.  My son finds it comfortable to sleep in and he doesn't get overheated - he sleeps in it every chance he gets!

product_title: Sunlite Standard Mesh Bottom Lift-Off Basket w/ Bracket
review_body: This fit perfectly on my hybrid bike.  It's a little heavier than I expected.  And it can pop loose when going over a bump and its empty.  Believe it or not, and more than once, when riding across a sharp bump, both handles pop up and the basket falls forward so that it is only supported by the bottom hooks.  I had to bungie the handles down to prevent this from happening.    Which brings up a point but not a negative.  Instead of sitting on a sort of \\"shelf\\" as depicted in the photo, the model I got had two holes in the rear and two \\"points\\" that fit into the holes to hold it in place.  The only downside of this design versus the shelf method, is the bottom isn't completely flat, so you might poke a hole into any bag or box you carry in the basket.  Also, there was not mount on the front for a reflector.    But, I liked the fact it comes with foam pads in place to protect the handle bars (and make it more secure) as well as a Velcro strap with some padding to hold it against the steering column.    Overall, it's a good deal and I'm satisfied.

product_title: Shimano RD-TX31 Tourney Rear Derailleur without Hanger
review_body: Derailleur was received by me in a bent condition. I straightened it the best I could and it appears to be working fine. I hope it lasts. Item should have been checked prior to being shipped. Need better quality control. Service was fast and always has been.

product_title: Proforce Equipment Primitive Skills And Crafts Book, Multicolor
review_body: This book is good if you want to just sit at home and read.  It's more of a history lesson than a guide.  I got about halfway through it and got bored and haven't picked it up since.  The instructions are a little hard to follow if you don't already have a conception of what to do already.

product_title: TOPEAK Alien II Multi-Tool
review_headline: Quality Multi-Functional Tool at a Good Price
review_body: While I'm far from an experienced bike mechanic, this tool has just about everything you would need should you have a breakdown on the road.  You can also use it at home, although given the dimensions of some of the individual tools (a necessary evil, given that this is a compact tool set), you'd probably want use your own tools first, and use this to fill in where you might be lacking.  But it is very tempting to use this tool as much as possible because just about everything you need is in the palm of your hand, rather than scattered across your workshop.  I was impressed at the overall quality and sturdiness of the tool as well as its (relative) light weight.  It's definitely found a home in my saddle bag!

product_title: Sunlite Cruiser 927 Tires, 26 x 2.125"
review_body: This was a really good tire at a great price. Purchased it for my motorized bike and have had no trouble since.

product_title: Native Eyewear Hardtop XP Sunglasses
review_body: Very Comfortable and effective sunglasses but the temples broke after two months with only normal wear.  Look for a different brand.

product_title: Hobson Easyseat Ergonomical Dual Pad Bicycle Saddle
review_body: I needed a bicycle seat that would not put any pressure on my private parts due to a recent surgery. I found the Hobson Easyseat on line and decided to give it a try. I just went on a 12 mile ride and found the seat perfect. I think any man would be happy to stop having pressure placed on his scrotum while riding.[[ASIN:B000GBK4Z4 Hobson Easyseat Ergonomical Dual Pad Bicycle Saddle]]

product_title: Giro Rivet Full-Fingered MTB Cycling Glove
review_body: Have riden with the gloves now about 12 times.  They are great.  Not to thick to make your hands sweat, not too thin that they dont provide any protection when you take a spill.  I highly recommend these gloves.  Fantastic option.

product_title: All Terrain Natural Hand Sanitizer Gel
review_headline: Perfect hand sanitizer for the fragrance-sensitive
review_body: I have major problems with fragrance sensitivity, so I was thrilled to find this fragrance-free version at my local health food store. Sadly, they didn't continue to stock the fragrance-free version, so I'm glad to have found it here at Amazon. It works great. I've gone through the entire cold and flu season this year without getting sick, which is a first. (This may have to do with some supplements I've started taking, too, but I'm willing to give Hand Sanz a large part of the credit.)

product_title: Lorpen Micromodal Uniform/Duty Socks
review_body:
I decided it was time to upgrade from the multi-pack tube socks, and it was well worth it.

These socks are extremely comfortable with just the right amount of cushioning. The different areas and constructions make for a great fit. I think these socks will be my sock of choice for some time to come.

product_title: Cateye CC-MC100W Micro Wireless 10-Function Bicycle Computer (Black)
review_body: I say yes. I bought a Trek incite 8i and it lasted 4 months. My wife has a Cateye and never had a problem with it. The buttons work better than the Trek. Since my Trek broke I have bought a Cateye and am very happy.

product_title: VDO MC1.0+ Wireless Altimeter/Cycle Computer
review_body: Lost the main computer head on a ride tonight because of a few minor bumps.  I like the functions other than an altimeter requiring constant recalibration.  But the mountings are just really low quality.  Lost the main computer tonight and now what do I do now with this after paying $120 plus?    Update:    I contacted Amazon about this problem and they immediately sent me a new replacement unit.  Their customer service is OUTSTANDING.  I will continue to use Amazon for many purchase in the future.  Thanks Amazon.com!!!!    However, I still think the mounting method for the transmitter and computer head piece should be enhanced because these thin wire ties that hold them seem very vulnerable to breakage.  At least use a thicker wire tire VDO.  These thin wire ties are risky for securing the relative costly components.

product_title: Nylon Web Deluxe Duty Belt, Medium
review_headline: not what I expected in a law enforcement belt
review_body: OK so I rant a bit. But I may have to depend on a rope hanging from this belt and the description when it arrived stated \\"light to moderate duty.\\" OK thats for who. If I am hanging from a rope, I can't depend on the buckle which is not well described. I would have expected more from Uncle Mike's.

product_title: Intex Raised Downy Airbed with Built-in Electric Pump, Queen, Bed Height 22"
review_body: Very comfortable.  We are using the bed as a guest bed when needed and as a camping bed for our tent.  Our Generator fills the bed with air and we have a Intex 12 volt pump as a back up.

product_title: Planet Bike 3044 Blaze 1-Watt LED Headlight
review_body: I have only been using this light for about a month, but so far it is great. I live in a rural area(no streetlights)so it is pretty dark but the headlight puts out a good beam on the road ahead. The only problem with the light is the way it fastens to the handlebar. I could not get a tight fit and had to use the clip to my old headlamp Planet Bike Super Spot 1(lucky they are interchangeable) and was able to keep the headlight from moving when I am riding. Other than that, seems to be a good product. My other light lasted 2 years so I will see what I get from this light.

product_title: Nirve Starliner Women's Hybrid Cruiser Bike
review_body: I have not been on a bike for over thirty years and was looking for something comfortable, easy to ride and I could lift (for storage, bike rack, etc).  This is one of Nirve's lighter bikes, but is by no means flimsy.  Extemely comfortable and easy to ride, I had it out and rode for a half hour with out feeling like I was going to kill myself.  This bike will last the rest of my life, but I am so impressed with it I will probably get another.  The quality and workmanship (they are handmade) is very good, and pricing is extremely reasonable considering it is handmade. My brother, who has a Cannondale Mountain, was so impressed with it, is planning on buying one (and he is a distance rider).  Even looking at in in a color I didn't care for, the bike still appealed to me,and I have looked at and sat on many bikes in my search before deciding on this one.

product_title: Roller Derby Men's Viper Speed Quad Skate
review_body: I bought these so I could re-learn roller skating as opposed to roller blading, for roller derby. I knew that these wouldn't be top-of-the-line for derby, but I just needed a pair that I could practice on.  And they're great for that! They're comfortable and fit perfectly. They roll smoothly on INDOOR speed wheels. And they're not heavy.

product_title: Kwik Tek AIRHEAD AHTR-60, 2 Rider Tube Tow Rope
review_body: Have used it many times and it works great! Was an awesome deal compared to the bulk sporting good stores.

product_title: Third Eye Bar End Bicycle Mirror
review_body: The mirror is nice. I bought it based on the reviews. But for me it was almost impossible to install. There are essentially no instructions. There  is a nut but no instructions on where the nut goes in relation to the  rubber pieces.

product_title: 2000C - Sabrelite 3C Bat
review_headline: twist-on doesn't always work, expensive lamp module
review_body: Twisting the flashlight on sometimes doesn't work. I've done my best to ensure that this is not operator error: the internal tray, lamp module, and spring are undamaged and all parts are clean; the batteries are good, the spring seats well.  It looks like a design (or quality control) flaw, in that the tabs from the battery tray do not go up far enough to contact the lamp module until the lid is tightly seated, causing inconsistent operation and leaving no additional leeway for metal component wear.  Sometimes a small whack at that point will get it on, and reassembling it may help - hit or miss.  Coming on every time is pretty much job one for a flashlight.  My other complaint is that a replacement xenon lamp module is half the cost of the flashlight at ~$11, hydrogen-absorbing catalyst pellets or not.  Two stars for a sturdy case.

product_title: Wenzel Ponderosa 10- by 8-Foot Four-Person Two-Room Dome Tent
review_body: It was a very good, and cheap tent. Its did the work for me and husband. It was easy to put together. What I like the most is the price :)

product_title: MICRONET Microfiber Towel
review_body: Great product and well worth the expense.  This is a generously sized towel that is both lightweight and compact.  The folded size is slightly larger than a high quality washcloth folded square.  If you're looking for a great towel that won't take up much packing space, look no further.  The XL size towel is roughly the same size as a beach towel.  I've purchased four of the Micronet Towels in both Large and Extra Large sizes and have been incredibly impressed at their durability and shape/size retention... even after a year of daily use and regular laundering.

product_title: McNett ReviveX Spray-On Water Repellent
review_body: Ordered two bottles of ReviveX both were Christmas gifts however when the package came one was damaged and the contents leaked into the box. I did file a claim with Amazon in December however I have not heard from them since which is why this is here. I did get a call from them in Late January. Two replacements were sent, both times this product leaked from a broken neck ... I gave up and got it someplace else.  This stuff works real good my complaint is with Amazon................. only time I ever had a problem with them after all these years.

product_title: Bell Citi Helmet 2010
review_body: I bought this helmet primarily because it offered a visor and an attachment for a light.  It works well, better than the helmet it replaced, but the visor still allows much light to get in my face (eyes) and the light bracket allows the light to be bumped out of the bracket during handling.  I have a small head and the straps barely adjust enough to keep the helmet on snuggly.

product_title: SteriPEN Adventurer Opti UV Water Purifier
review_headline: Nice update to the classic SteriPen Adventurer
review_body: I had held off on getting one of these for awhile.  Basically the concept seemed like magic to me.  Wave the magic light in your water and kill all the germs.   Well guess what? They work.      You will still need to filter to get any chunks out, SteriPen makes the FitsAll Filter just for this purpose.  The FitsAll filter also acts like and adapter to fit the SteriPEN into a Kleen Kanteen. That makes for 1 liter of water purified in less than a minute.      This model comes with a nice neoprene case that will clip to your belt and a removable hard plastic cover that helps protect the end.  It also has a flash light function, so you can filter at night.      They have also put in some circuitry to keep it from turning on unless you have it submerged in the water.  So no more accidentally turning it on and running down the batter.  I haven't had this model for too long, but I'm loving it so far.

product_title: Kent Sierra Madre Men's Comfort Bike
review_body: I'm 6' tall and weigh 210.  This bike holds me just fine.  I have a bad back so I was looking for a bike more comfortable than my previous one.  The Kent Sierra Madre, I find, very comfortable and the shifter works well. The only problem I had was during assembly.  It wasn't difficult, I was missing a brake pad and nut for my front brakes.  I inquired about it, but have not had a reply.  anyway... who needs brakes.  Overall I am happy with this bike.

product_title: Swiss Gear Oasis Technical 2-Liter Hydration Pack (Grey/Black/Red/White)
review_headline: Spacious, well-made hydration pack... a great value
review_body: I've had this hydration backpack for a couple months now and use it at least 2 or 3 times a week. There's a lot to like about it. The 2-liter bladder is a great size and it slides easily in and out of its lined pocket in the bag. The liner does a decent job of keeping beverages cool, especially if you add ice cubes. The straw is well-placed and is easy to access while riding a bike, and it has a convenient locking mechanism that keeps your beverage from dripping out. It's pretty comfortable, which is helped by waist and chest straps.     One of the best things is that this pack can hold a TON of stuff, even with a full bladder. I've had it loaded with 2 liters of water, a change of clothes and shoes, snacks, and a couple other accessories and had no problem with everything staying in place. It weighs more than some more minimalist hydration packs, of course, but you'll be surprised at how much you can cram in there.    Also, compared with other brands of hydration packs, for the features you get, the price is unbeatable. I was afraid it might be cheaply constructed, but it's really well-made and has held up perfectly.    There are a couple things I don't like about it. The lid to the bladder can be difficult to screw on, and sometimes it will look like it's closed but the bladder will leak when you squeeze it. It usually takes me a couple tries. Additionally, because of this, I've noticed some odor in the lined bladder compartment from water leaking out. I've been able to take care of that by cleaning it out with a germ-killing wash. One other thing is that there are two little tabs in the bladder compartment that are supposed to hold the bladder up, but a full bladder is simply too heavy for them. It's not too big of a deal, though; the bladder just obeys gravity and slides to the bottom of the compartment.    Overall, I'd highly recommend this product.

review_body: My son is 2.5 and loves this. He's had it for a couple weeks and is already lifting his feet when 'striding' around. we use it in the house alot! Small, light weight - perfect, perfect for him!  Update: 4/4/10: We've had this for about two months. My son LOVES this bike. We use it all around the neighborhood. We have a skate park near our house and my son brings the Strider and has a blast riding up, over and around the park. He has amazing balance!  Still Highly recommend this!!

product_title: Klean Kanteen Stainless Steel Water Bottle
review_body: I love my Klean Kanteen - this is my second one (I lost the first one after taking it everywhere I went for months).  Both bottles have been the 40 oz size, but the first one had the loop cap while the second has the sport cap.  I like that the Klean Kanteens in general are made out of stainless steel rather than aluminum and they feel sturdy.  I have gotten compliments on the appearance of the bottle.  I never dented either of them, and the first one got thrown around the back of an ambulance quite a bit.  The enamel does scratch some, although I try to take care of it, but I don't find that it is too bad.  It certainly doesn't look bad enough for me to stop using it.  The colored bottles are not supposed to be dishwasher safe, although I did put mine in there a couple times and it did fine.  I bought these primarily to use at work, and I work in an emergency room which I consider to be a very germy place.  I did not like that the part where I put my mouth is exposed with the loop cap bottle, so if someone picked up my bottle by the neck their germy hands touch where I would put my mouth.  I also thought it was a little bit of a pain to screw and unscrew the lid, but it never spilled so I guess that is the trade-off.  This time I was excited to get the sport cap because I thought it would be a better fit to use at work.  I have been using it about a week and I love it.  It is quick and easy to open and there is a cap to cover the part where you put your mouth.  Having this large bottle close at hand helps me remember to stay hydrated.  The lid does make a noise a little bit like a dolphin as others have mentioned, but it is not very loud and doesn't bother me.  Someone standing near you would notice it but it wouldn't attract attention from across a room.  It seems to seal well, although I have not tried transporting it in a bag or sideways.  Overall I am very satisfied with my purchase and if I should happen to lose this one, I will probably buy another one!

Spend a little more money for a nicer, better made product.  This one is junk.    G
