product_title: Elite VIP Universal Cage Mount 22-50mm
review_body: Decent idea, and fastens somewhat securely .... until you put a full bottle in the cage and it begins to move around a little.  The interface between the strap and the mounting point seems like it would wrap more securely on larger diameter tubes, i.e. aluminum or carbon frames with oversized tubes, not the older 1\\" steel tubes that are most likely to need additional cages.

product_title: Coleman 12 Cup Stainless Steel Percolator
review_body: [[ASIN:B0009PUQSM Coleman 12-Cup Stainless Steel Coffee Percolator]]    What a joy to finally find the Coleman 12-cup stainles steel coffee percolator for my daily coffee treats.  It reminds me so much of my childhood to hear the perking sounds and the great aroma.  I am able to get at least two mugs of coffee each time that is used.    Prior to purchasing this percolator, I searched department stores, specialty stores and camping gear stores and could not find the item.  Finally, I went to the internet and searched for percolators and found this one at the Amazon.com.  Keep up the good work with these hard to find items.

product_title: OnGuard PitBull MINI DT 5008 Bicycle U-Lock and Extra Security Cable
review_body: I've been using this lock for about a month now and I think it is fantastic.  It has good weight and feels very sturdy and well made - I feel confident in leaving my bike in any bike rack around town.  Also, having quick releases on both my wheels, the additional cable is very convenient.    I've read that people have broken keys inside their locks, but to be honest - I dont know how people are doing this.  If you insert the key in all the way, the key will turn very easily in both directions.  The only time the lock gives tension is if the U-rod is not fully inserted into the locking mechanism (letting you know that you're not closing the lock properly).  Admittedly, I was hesitant to buy this lock because of all the broken key issues I've read, but once I got my hands on the lock - my doubt went away.    Overall, love the lock.  Its small and fits right in my backpack with the cable.  The only downside is the cheap strap the lock comes with.  I didn't even bother with it since I figured I would break it in a few rides.  But security is the key when buying a lock, and I'm certain I'm getting plenty of it with this lock. I'd recommend it to fellow riders.

product_title: DRY PAK DP-44 Yellow/Blue 4" x 4" Alligator Waterproof Wallet
review_headline: okay but there are better options
review_body:
I've tried this while swimming and it doesn't hold much except for few cards and bills. The opening is narrow and easy for water to dribble in and out just from opening such and you have to be careful not to open it too wide to tear at the edges. It wasn't always as waterproof as I'd like but for the things I was carrying, but it didn't matter so much.
The hard shell type waterproof cases do better (my favorite is the one that Eddie Bauer used to sell that also contained 'emergency' stuff inside, which I took out and used instead to put my cell phone in with credit card and money and just used the waterproof case) - unfortunately that case is hard to find now. and for bigger items, the Lewis and clark medium pouches have worked much better.

product_title: Victorinox AA LED Flashlight
review_headline: Better than my mag for less money
review_body:
I have had the Red Rubber Grip version of this light for about a year now and use it daily as a tool. I have to say that the LED is extremely bright and works great for what I need it for. There are those that want the focusable beam but even on my mag LED the focus is pretty pathetic. This flashlight is dropped and stood on and banged up on a regular basis and while my Maglight LED didn't make it, this one continues to provide flawless service. I love it when I have a friend that is showing me something with their Maglight LED and I turn mine on and their light beam is devoured by mine. It always prompts the question of \\"what kind of flashlight is that\\"? It is water proof, although I don't know to what depth. My little ones like to take a bath with it and turn out all the lights. I use rechargeable batteries with it and they seem to last for a very long time. I am buying another one for a friend. I would definitely buy this product again and again if it performs like mine has for the last year.

03.06.12 I have now had this flashlight for over three years now and it is still working strong. I use it multiple times throughout the day...every day. Since my first post, the red rubber grip has been removed due to it being stretched out from using my old maglight holster which is a little on the narrow side. Also, the decorative red rubber band around the top is also finally gone from wear and tear. The light is still working well. Went through another mag light since then. The housing on the maglight is fine but the way the bulb is situated is the problem. The victorinox brand is well secured and protected even when the head is removed. The Maglight has the LED exposed when the head is removed so if it is dropped or mishandled (such as by my kids) you run the risk of ruining your flashlight. As stated in the first post, I find the broad beam to be most suitable for the work I am doing where I need to see the broad picture. The spot beam works best for long distance viewing while the diffused beam of the Victorinox is best suited for everyday use and for using it to light the ground in front of you on a dark evening. One of the other posts has done some good homework and makes some good objective points about the qualities of each light. It appears from his research that Victorinox doesn't convert the available energy very well but also points out that it provides light with lower voltage than the Maglight. This post also indicated that his Mag provides a brighter light than the Victorinox. I can't speak to that and I don't know the condition of the mag light my friend had. I do know that this light has always provided bright usable light and has been indestructible. It has lasted longer than any maglight I have owned. If you want some reassurance about the quality, this light is made for Victorinox my Emissive Energy Corp which is the INOVA brand. They make military flashlights and flashlights used by the TSA and other government agencies. Very high quality stuff. If you want a compact, durable flashlight with good broad light that will always work, buy the Victorinox. If you want something different then buy something different.

Conclusion: Still the most durable small flashlight out there for the price.

product_title: CamelBak BPA-Free Better Bottle with Bite Valve
review_body: This is a great water bottle.  I had used an extra that a friend had when I was out of town for a week, and loved it so much that I had to get one of my own.  I am expecting a new baby in January and this is one of the sure-fire ways that I get my daily allotment of water.  I got the 750ml size and it works great in my cup holders in the car.

product_title: Planet Bike Protege 9.0 Wireless Bike Computer, Black
review_body: Love our new Planet Bike Protege 9.0 Wireless Bike Computer!       The 4-line display is great because you don't have to constantly change the display. Of course, not every function will fit on one display, but there is minimal changing involved. When you want to change displays, all you do is push the unit forward in the cradle and the display will change. No buttons to press. Easy to use.      Set-up was just as easy, since it is wireless that instantly makes it 50% easier to install than a wired unit. Just a couple of plastic ties secure it to the fork of the bike and a quick tightening with a screw driver secures the unit to the handlebars. The sensor on the fork can easily be adjusted to make closer or farther away from the magnet on the spoke.     Everything else is pretty accurate as my wife and I both have the exact same model and the tempterature is almost always the same if not, it is off by one degree. I like that there is a manual adjustment for tire size when you are settung up the unit. Initially we put the default code for our wheels. Technically we both have the same size wheel but different manufacturers of bikes. We discovered that my wife \\"went further\\" than me on our first ride. So, there is a way to measure the distance of one revolution of your wheel and then you put that code in for a more accurate distance reading.      Initially, we bought it for the multi-line display, the temperature display and the price. But we were happy to learn that Planet Bike donates $5 of every purchase towards bike organizations and trails. We are very happy with our product and will look at more Planet Bike products in the future to help further bike organizations and trails!

product_title: Yakima Spare Joe 2-Bike Spare Tire Mount Rack
review_body: This product did not fit my spare tire as advertised.  It should have expressly stated \\" will only fit 15 inch tires\\". This was just a waste of my time. By the way I drive a Rav 4.

product_title: Primus Toaster
review_body: This toaster is by far the best I have tried. It only toasts one piece of bread at a time but it is quick. The secret is to adjust the burner to low and be ready to turn the bread over in short order. It takes constant attention but you can make nearly-perfect golden brown toast as fast as the four sided toasters can ruin bread.

product_title: Kenda K838 Slick Wire Bead Bicycle Tire, Blackwall, 26-Inch x 1.95-Inch
review_body: These are great tires for the money i have about 40 miles on them now, they were easy to install this was my first set of tires i have ever mounted no water or soap just deflated the tubes(not all the way about 10psi)and slip them on about 5-6 mins for each tire. They are a great tire to convert your mountain bike fast shipping in a big box but the tires dont get bent that way so dont complain my friend just ordered two tires and they came all folded up in a bag so whoever ships theses cares about the product.

product_title: Light My Fire Original Swedish FireSteel Army 12,000 Strike Fire Starter
review_headline: One RANGERS veiw on the S. Firesteel
review_body: Well,.. First of all let me tell you that I have recently returned to civilian life after being in the USARMY for 5 yrs. I was pinned with the well known \\" RANGER TAB \\" and have went out on several missions where my team and I could have use of some really nice gadgets like the Firesteel. Only untill you have to go without nothing does it make you prepare more so for the next time so you dont have to \\" GO without\\". Having nothing really makes you appriciate the little things that you've left behind. And in the woods,desert,Jungle, or any where else you might find yourself without the lux. of the modern world there is definately nothing that will lift your moral more than a nice fire. I remember countless times when I would sit staring at a small fire and feel the stress of the day just kinda go away. I would feel some of my lost hope come back to my sences and motivate me to keep pushing on to the objective.       Enough of history,( I could go on and on! haha) The Swedish Firesteel. I have always wondered if these little gagets would work,.. I have started fire in Training with an accual flint stone. However those can be almost impossible to find. And I am capable of making fire in every possible way. Although I do have to say I think there is nothing better than a good  ol' Bic lighter (2). But lets face it,.. the bic lighter CAN be busted and you are stuck trying to make a fire with your boot lace and some twigs sweatin ur ass off for 30-45 mins! NO THANKS! Well as I search for products to make what I plan on selling, a ruck sack made for survial. I ran accross this product,.. well the curiosity got the better of me and I ordered 2, one for me and one for my brother who is also a survival freak. I recieved the FireSteel and had to try it out imediatly. I went outside and gathered up a handfull of dry material, and sat down. After 4 strikes the material was glowing red and yellow. I couldnt believe how easy it was!       Needless to say, this FireSteel will permantly be a addition to my attire every   single day. I have to say I cant beleive that it worked so damn well. But anyways I've written enough. E-mail me with any questions. I am considered a survival expert and would love to hear from like minded people. [....]

product_title: Sweat GUTR Sweatband
review_body: When I described the GUTR to my friends and told them how it worked, they laughed at me.  After they saw it in action, they stopped laughing.  I have to admit, I am surprised at how well the GUTR works! I NEVER have to wipe away the sweat - never!  I use it for racquetball and running.  When playing racquetball, the sweat would end up on my safety glasses which meant I had to stop playing every so often just to wipe them clean.  When running, the only thing I have to worry about is if I can make it another mile, not the sweat in my eyes.  Before the GUTR, I used traditional sweatbands.  They would become saturated and eventually, leak sweat.  I am SO happy I bought the Gutr.  I highly recommend this product!

product_title: Allen Sports 102S Premium 2-Bike Trunk Mount Rack
review_body: I've only used this rack once so far and it was to transport my bike on a 40 minute drive to and from a ride. It was fairly easy to put on and I didn't notice any damage to my car when I took it off.     It is definetly an improvement over folding down my backseat, taking off the front wheel of my bike and awkwardly loading the bike into my trunk!    I have only used it with one bike and it is a women's bike. I didn't buy the adapter thingy, but the crossbar on my bike is fairly straight unlike some women's bikes.    I would recommend this to the casual user, good value for the money. I just hope it is durable enough to last a couple years.

product_title: Swiss Gear Smart Shade 10- by 10-Foot Screenhouse
review_headline: Drips a bit but still glad we have it.
review_body: The very first time we had this it rained steady for over 12 hours. So we were extremely happy that we had it. After setting it up in the rain we sat like drenched rats on the drenched picnic table and made some coffee with huge smiles on our faces in our new rain free zone. after a few hours it did get a small drip in the center of the tent by a seam. I would have normally treated the seams with \\"camp Dry\\" by Kiwi before the first use but was unable to in the rain so not a major minus. The shape of the screen house is why we wanted this one. We have seen the domed ones but were not liking them. My head would rub the ceiling in the corners of the domed style where we store every thing. The instructions say not to use camp stoves in them because they are not fireproof. There is so much space in these tents that we did not have any problems. We use a 3 burner coleman stove and it was fine. Keep your flames low and use common sense and you should be good. We were able to place a standard sized picnic table in the tent and still had room for coolers.

product_title: Deluxe Water Resistant Nylon Day Pack *
review_body: Pack has nice proportions for a day pack but the waterproofing has left it with an unpleasant odor which days of airing in the sun has not mitigated much. Otherwise, no complaints and as I needed a waterproof pack, this should serve its intended purpose.

product_title: Intex Challenger K1 Kayak, 1 Person Inflatable Kayak Set with Aluminum Oars and High Output Air Pump
review_body: I had kayak out first time and nut on paddle broke in half. Called support to get it replaced Non in stock and not free repacement. Person was vary bad. I will never buy a thing from INTEX again.

product_title: Schwinn Roadster 12-Inch Trike
review_body: What a stylish bike. My 3 year old diva loves it. It doesn't it tip over on the turns. It has real rubber wheels which make it easier and more comfortable to ride. My little girl has long legs, reaching the petals could be an issue for a shorter child but the seat is adjustable. She also had to work her legs as this was her first bike, but she got the hang of it quickly. Easy to put together, qualty product. Shipping was not an issue. Although it may cost a little more, I highly recommend this over the little plastic barbie type bikes for safety and quality. We bought this in spring 2009 and expect to have it for a long time.

product_title: Ephor 6 Person Family Camping Dome Tent
review_headline: Quirky tent - Huge with lots of potential
review_body: I looked high & low for a family tent & found this one by the Camping Equipment Company. We've used it once and it took a full experience to figure out exactly how it works, and ways in which to best utilize it. The pros are definitely the size, storage, and fun. Cons are numerous, but in our case, they're worth it because it suits are needs, anyway, they are: heavy (almost 60 pounds), tons of guys wires, very difficult to install rain fly properly, and the biggest one - there is no floor in the main area, allowing crawling critters as well as runoff water into the main area. Now, a note on the cons, for the rain fly, follow the directions on this, as the tent goes up in tiers, and the fly goes on after tier two, not after it's all done. Also, there are nylon straps on the fly and the main tent that need to somehow be fastened together (caribbeaner or zip tie works) to keep the fly in place. Once that's done correctly, this tent will hold the water out, with the exception of the no-floor runoff. With regards to that, once the main tent is up, there are essentially three inner tents that suspend from the main tent, each of these inner tents are bug enough to fit a queen sized air mattress, and they have  have a tub floor, full doors, etc. So even if rain runoff gets in the main area, it won't get in the sleeping areas. By the way, it does come with a tarp for the main area, but it doesn't fasten to the edges of the tent, so it's more like an outdoor area rug. Given that no large family tents are perfect, I'm satisfied with the purchase, not sure if it's worth $300, but it's nice having all that space!

product_title: Bell PRO-GEL Cycling Gloves
review_body: I've been wearing these gloves for 40+ mi road bike rides for a few weeks now 3-4x per week.  So far so good, no signs of wear or deterioration, where the fingers meet the palm, which is where the deterioration happens fastest on this kind of glove.  They are very comfortable and do a decent job of reducing hand fatigue on long rides.  The sizing of the gloves is perfect.  I have big hands, and the L/XL size fits very well.  Overall, pretty good product.

product_title: Bell Lumen Bicycle Road Helmet
review_body: I got this a week ago. Most comfortable helmet I've ever owned. The padding inside, the fit, it's perfect. Now I've only owned 2 before this, in a similar price range. Anyhow, I suggest this.    Seems like it just came out November 1st. I must have just got it early. Recommended. Of course, it's best if you go to the store and try it on.

product_title: Shimano Single-Speed Freewheels
review_body: I have had this on my bike for almost a month and I really like it, so far!  I'm trying to keep my bike as an inexpensive project, so this was the way to go.

product_title: Razor Ground Force Electric Go-Kart
review_body: This GoKart is great! Works well and very sturdy. My 10 year old loves it! It is a issue where to use it. Not a good idea in neighborhoods with cars because it is so low and hard to see. Basically have to load and take to a park. Use caution in users under 8. My 7 year old nephew crashed it into a fence going about 10mph. Could have been a bad crash if I hadn't enforced the helmet and seatbelt rule. The kart was fine after the crash. Super sturdy. Woulld make a fabulous Christmas gift.

product_title: Thule Parkway Hitch Mount Rack
review_body: This really is an easy to use and good quality hitch.  Don't waste your money on the much more expensive models.

product_title: #2330 M6 LED Pelican Flashlight
review_headline: Bright, sturdy reliable and long lasting
review_body: I use this light on film sets. Its reliable and sturdy. I've dropped it and submerged it dozens of times. It just works.    It lasts longer than the manufacturer claims too. It does have diminished light output, but it runs a really long time if you need it to. I usually swap batteries pretty quickly, because I need the light to be very bright when I am working. Off set though, I've run the light far more than 48 hours of use between battery changes. In fact I ran it once for just about 48 hours continuously as an emergency light on a stand. I can honestly say I have never had to replace batteries because the light was dead.

product_title: Paddleboy Peanut Kayak Cart
review_body: OK for light/short travel/portages. Would purchase a more balanced cart for any distance or weight.

product_title: Pathfinder I Single Inflatable Kayak (EA)
review_body: This is a fine kayak for a beginner.  It's stable, easy to paddle, tracks well (unless the skegs are broken off like I did going down a river), and suitable for class 1 rapids.  But, the price this one is selling for is outrageous.  I guess I got a good deal when I bought two of these last year for $100 each from WalMart.  Definitely NOT worth it at this price.

product_title: Schwinn Thrasher Helmet
review_body: I haven't 'tested' it in an accident, but as far as comfort and ease of adjusting, this is about the best I've tried. Perhaps the only thing I would give it, would be an extended visor to keep rain out of your face, still in most normal conditions it works well, and keeps your head cool.

product_title: Avenir Pedal Blocks Black
review_body: Cheap cheap cheap.  They don't stay on they break easily and just plain cheap.  Did I say cheap?  These a cheap.  They also smell really toxic.  Don't waste your money.  You'd do better just duct taping wooden blocks yourself.  Same concept.

product_title: DC SCARABE blk size xlrg
review_headline: A shame it is out of stock
review_body: This is the best ever.  It says it is water resistant, and it truly is.  It says it is warm, and it truly is.  The zipper is the best around, and anyone who has bought something similar recently knows how unusual that is.  The fleece liner is warm without being super hot.  The hood is a great wind and rain protector.  If you get a chance to order the tall version, make sure your arms are proportionally long.  Mine aren't, so the pockets are a bit low for my comfort.  But that's not the hoodie's fault.      Anyone who wants a great three season all around hoodie at a great price should pound the table as hard as possible to get this one back in stock.  I mean it.

product_title: Origin8 Urban-Pro Riser Handlebar, 25.4mm, Black
review_body: Once I got these on my bike I realized they weren't quite what I wanted, but that is no fault of the handlebars. My one complaint about the construction of them is that the groves in the center to prevent it from sliding around in the handlebar stem are a little low profile, so the slide a bit easier. Once I tightened it enough it didn't pose a problem when riding, but its something to be aware of. They are nice and light handlebars and the construction seems sturdy enough for someone's weight to be one it for awhile.

product_title: Kettler Bicycle Accessory: Detachable Rear Mounted Metal Wire Bike Basket with Carrying Handle
review_body: I bought this basket for my recumbent trike, mainly to carry bags of trash to the neighborhood dumpster, and maybe take my dog for a ride, now and then.  It was too small for my dog, but big enough for a full kitchen-size trash bag.  I never actually used it, so don't worry that you'll get the one I returned and have it smell like a junkyard dog.  The basket mesh is easily deformed; it's sort of a heavyweight window screen.  That didn't bother me, as it is strong enough, and not too heavy.  I sent it back because I wasn't happy with the mounting system.  It could have been ideal, as it attaches and detaches from a rack easily and quickly.  What I didn't like was the plastic pieces that grab the rack rails.  They are designed to fit either thick rails or thin rails well, but I thought that the grip on my medium rails was somewhat insecure.  I'm sorry I didn't measure the clamps, so I could report the optimum rail sizes.  Mine are about 3/8 inch thick.  I would recommend this basket if it happens to fit your bike correctly.

product_title: Airhead Telescoping Paddle
review_body: I store 2 of these in my jetski for emergencies only. They seem perfect for emergency use. I fit two paddles in one bag, no problem.

product_title: Ripstik Caster Board
review_body: Awesome!  This is what my 12 year old daughter says. She has really enjoyed this toy,and I have really enjoyed that it keeps her fit, while she has fun.  Even my husband and I have tried it. Takes a little practice but once you get it, youv'e got it. Go out and have some fun on a RipStik.

product_title: Comfort Zone The Heat Solution Instant Portable Heat Pack
review_body: These hand-warmer packets worked nearly as advertized.  They get pretty warm (we measured a 120° peak after 3 minutes, which lasted for about 10 or 12 additional minutes, then tapering to about 100° after about 28 minutes total--this was all done on the kitchen table), and last about a half-hour (± 5 minutes) in actual out-door use.  They're about 3 1/2\\" x 5\\", so they stick out of the hand-warmer pockets in my gloves by about an inch (3\\" x 4\\" would fit perfectly), which may affect their heating time or efficacy.  The pouches themselves are a thick, flexible plastic that seems like it will be very durable.  It's fun to watch the reaction!  Recharging them is a snap...10 minutes in boiling water, maybe 15 minutes to a half-hour to cool, and they're good to go again.  These would be good for short-duration, or if you carried a bunch with you for longer periods in the cold.  Over-all a good product with some time limitations.

product_title: SunLite Wire Lift-Off Front Basket
review_body: I put this on the front of my three wheel bicycle at work.  I am an IT professional and in the basket I put my tool bag whick is pretty heavy. The basket has held up fine for months.  I highely reccomend.

product_title: Superman Bike (16-Inch Wheels)
review_body: Received the product well packaged, spent about an hour to assemble and voila, my 3-yr old son started riding it right away. It's been about a month and he's having fun.

product_title: Sea Doo Round Ski Tube Inflateable Towable (70 Inch)
review_body: This is a fantastic durable tube that makes going fast pleasurable and painless.  You can fly out of the wake or chill with two people comfortably on this totally sweet tube.   Its awsome and by awsome i mean totally sweet

product_title: Giro Monza Bike Helmet
review_body:
This is a good helmet for the money. It fits my head like a glove (well, like a hat, really). I found it helpful to know that Giro helmets generally fit people with a more round head around the hat band, whereas Bell helmets are better for folks with a more oval shaped head.

One issue that will keep me from buying another one is the pads. They are oriented longitudinally so that sweat runs down from the top of the head and is channeled to drip right into my eyes. The Limar helmet I had before this one avoided this by putting a front pad across the forehead laterally with its low points depositing the sweat outside of the eye area.

product_title: Razor E300 Electric 24 Volt Motorized Ride On Kids Scooter
review_headline: Want your kids outside? Get one of these.
review_body: I cant keep my kid or the neighborhood's off it. Only drawback is the short battery time. 45 mins really goes by fast when your having fun. Starts slowly and breaks well. Easy to plug up for a recharge.

product_title: Coleman 2-Burner Electronic Ignition Propane Grill Stove
review_body: This product works great. Perfect combination of burner and grill. Ignition works great even in windy conditions. Great investment and upgrade from previous stove.     Cons: I would like a better lock on the cover to keep it closed. Looking into a case but havent purchased one due to bad reviews of stove not fitting properly...

product_title: Pulse by Kettler Men's Firenze Comfort Bike
review_headline: Good deal on a good bike.
review_body:
The bike came on time and in good shape. My husband put it together in a couple of hours, it is already mostly assembled except for gears and so on. The problem with purchasing a bike on line is trying to 'fit' the bike to yourself. We went to a bike shop and talked to salesmen there about 'size' and also did some research online (there is some great, easy to understand information out there). My husband is 5'10 and this bike fit him perfectly.

He was very pleased with it.

product_title: Hydroslide Assault Kneeboard
review_body: The Assault is an overall great ride on the water. The deep foam pockets for your knees is much more comfortable than that of an older model I also own. The wider leg strap with elastic shock absorber also add to the comfortable ride, and I also found the strap to be easy to secure. The retractable fins enable some really great cuts in the water, but it's nice to be able to retract them for other manuevers like a 360. My only complaint is that the decals are already starting to peel, but this is only a cosmetic issue. I would recommend this kneeboard to anyone interested in a versitile board at a low price.

product_title: X-Treme Scooters X-360 Electric Variable Speed 350W Scooter
review_headline: Scooter stinks do not buy u will be out 250 dollars
review_body: I am extremly sad to be writing this review. after my birthday i was so excited, i was able to buy an electric scooter. so i started looking for one. then i found this one.i read the specs and was amazed at what it said: and extra batery, faster than the average scooter, little trunk thingy on the back, horn light you know everything that anyone could ever want in a scooter. so i wait 2 weeks and then they never send it to me so my mom calls and they say that it will be here anyday. so two weeks later right IT NEVER COMES! finally after about a month it arrives. i get so excited, me and my dad open in, the directions are one of the worst that i have ever seen, its like trying to preform brain surgery on ur first day of medical school. i had no idea how to do it so after about 2 hours we are almost done, when we find that the clamp on the steering wheel doesnt work so i end up having to wait for them to send another clamp ( this takes about another two - three weeks)when it finally gets here i put it on and every thing seems to be perfect. so i go for a joy ride around the neighborhood and before i no it the seat falls of and i go with it. thank god i was wearing a helmet.then i go home and fix it and then the next day while i am riding home from my friends house the obnoxisis horn on it goes off and wouldnt stop. it is around 9:30 and iam really embaresed because every1 outside was looking at me. so i had to turn it off and then walk it home from the other side of my neigborhood.then i pulled out the wire to the horn so that it would stop. so about a week goes by and i have no problems and i think that it is fixed so i am riding to my friends house at top speed and all of a suden i loose steering i used the breaks but those are cheap plastic as well as the rest of the scooter so it took a while to stop. then i go home and i call extreme scooters and i t ell them that it hasnt been 60 days and that i want my money back. they tell me no returns and that i agreed to that. so then my dad goes to the store and buys a new clamp and it seems to be working fine again so i am driving and all of a sudden a piece of the body cracks off. now i am stuck with scooter that is falling apart and i am  afraid to drive. do not buy it. you will either get hurt or wind up with no scooter

product_title: Victorinox Swiss Army SwissChamp Pocket Knife
review_body: I Think Everyone Should Get The Swisschamp xlt. As Being To Big To Cary In The Pocket I Had No Problem carying A Swisschamp Xxlt.

product_title: Petzl E44850 Tikka/Zipka 3-Lens Kit
review_body:
First, a small disclaimer; I'm not an outdoors type person. I have a headlamp purely for fun.

I bought this with the savings on the headlamp. The lens filters are constructed with the same high quality standards as all Petzl products.

However, the red filter is a very mild red. To me, it almost looks more like a darker orange than a full red. In fact, when the headlamp is on, it casts an orange light with the middle of the beam (almost) a pink (from the mixing of the bluish light from the headlamp and the filter). I'm guessing Petzl used a lighter red to keep the brightness of the headlamp up, but I would have much preferred to have less light and a darker red.

I didn't spend as much time with the green filter, but I will note that it has a slight teal tint to it.

As far as the purpose of having a red filter to help preserve your night-vision, I can't say that I noticed any benefit to installing the red (or the green) filter.

review_body:

Marie/ Orlando Florida

review_body: I bought this because Bell made the helmet that evel kenevel wore jumping caeser's palace (figured it would work well for a 5 year-old). It's snowing, so it's not yet been tried. the fit is a little snug, but it matches the huffy \\"so sweet\\" bike perfectly.

product_title: Lamborghini Viaggio Tandem Bike
review_body:
We've ridden this tandem a few times, and all parts have worked. I put it together myself, but I am relatively handy with a bike. The wheels were pretty true, brakes needed adjustment, shifting was mostly on, but no major defects. If we do much riding, or any mountain riding, the brakes need upgrading. The cockpit is very large for me (I am 5'8\\"), it is an uncomfortable stretch to reach the handlebar, and I put a new stem on to fit me better. Both saddles have been replaced, Neither of us were very thrilled with the saddles that came with. Overall, I am pleased.

We bought this bike too see if we would like riding a tandem before forking out a few grand. This bike fits this bill perfectly, and we have had much fun figuring out how to peddle together.

product_title: GMC Yukon XL Road Bike
review_headline: Ok as a first road bike
review_body: I purchased this bike on Amazon after seeing it for [...].  As a $275 bike, I got what I expected.  Had I paid $400 I would have returned it.  The bike needs upgrades right out of the box.  For instance, neither tire would hold air.  I pumped them up the first night and by morning they were FLAT.  The frame is all aluminum and seems to be put together ok.  The brakes are fine.  The shifter/derailer system is sub-par and will be upgraded in the future.  But, they do work ok. You get a speed hub on the front, but not on the back.  So, if you get a flat while riding, you better have some tools with you.  As an experienced MS150 cyclist with my TREK, I found this bike to be a decent start for my 15 year old.  Luckily, I have a friend who just upgraded his TREK wheels, so I inherited his old ones and am in the process of switching them over.  Go ahead and buy this bike for $275, but expect to do a little upgrading.  With $200 more, you will have a decent road bike for beginners.  Still beats paying $800 for entry level 'big boy' bikes.

product_title: Razor PowerWing Caster Scooter
review_body: The Razor Powerwing is a great value.  Not only the hours of entertainment but the physical exercise needed to have fun with the Razor.

product_title: Delta Cycle Delta Airzound Bike Horn , colors may vary
review_headline: Every bike needs this light weight lifesaver.
review_body: Face it. For every hour you ride you'll encounter at least one driver who just doesn't see you. Bicyclists need a loud horn. And the air horn is loud - really loud! (The volume is adjustable - but I keep mine at the loudest.) The air horn is also really light. So it doesn't add weight to your ride. Finally, I really like that to \\"recharge\\" it all you need is a bicycle pump. Mine arrived quickly, (two days?) and in good shape. I recommend this vendor and I very strongly recommend this product. It will save your life!  By the way, writing reviews is a pain in the butt. I don't normally do it.

product_title: HotHands Body & Hand Super Warmer
review_body: I used these hand warmers when I was outside all day at the Presidential Inauguration.  It was around 30 degrees outside and the warmers stayed warm from 7:30am until after 8:00pm that day.

review_body: The 'Polar' Insulated Water Bottles keep liquids cold for several hours.  Just fill with your desired drink and place in the frig overnight.  Easy to wash by hand or in the dishwasher.  If your obsessive about the color -they are lighter than advertised.

product_title: SIGMA BC906 9-Function Topline Wired Bicycle Speedometer
review_body: Sorry, I cannot agree w/ the reviews. I am returning this bike computer.  Reason: This computer has cancelled out the trip distance every single time. Not once have I seen the milage biked. The distance biked jumped to 35 miles after a brief stop when I had biked only abt 11 miles. The O-rings attaching the bike computer to the handle bars are pathetic to put it mildly. If they break, the computer probably will hit the pavement.  Not recommended.

product_title: Columbia Hawk Ridge 10-Foot by 7-Foot Three-Person Dome Tent
review_body: This tent is the best tent I have every used!  First off, it is easy to set up.  I practiced in the back yard, like you should always do with a new tent, and using the instructions, had it up in less than 7 minutes.  After that, it was a breeze.  The poles are either color coded or different lengths to know where they go.  It is so much simpler (and sturdier) than the two-pole dome tents.  I am a Scout leader, so the first time I used it was for a 3-night campout shortly after buying it.  The second night we got rained on and I got to test the rain fly.  We were in a downpour for over 45 minutes and the inside of the tent stayed bone dry.  The vestible and flaps over the windows roll back, so when it is not raining the tent can be open for more air circulation.  When I first saw the material of the tent, I was afraid it would rip easily, but although it feels (and sounds) almost like paper, it is pretty strong material.  The storage bag is very roomy, too.  My other tents I have had needed to be rolled as tightly as possible and still I had to squeeze them in their bags.  This one comes with an expandable duffle bag and is very easy to fit everything into.  All in all, I believe this tent is worth the $160 dollars they have as the retail price, and definitely a great bargain at less than 1/2 the price that it is selling for.

product_title: Ritchey Pro Bar Ends, Cold Forged, Short, 100mm, Black
review_body: I like these bar ends because they fit by bigger hands (I'm 6'2\\" and 200lbs).  There was only one issue, it seemed like one end had more of a slant to it.  It's barely noticeable and may just be because of my handle bars, but that's the only thing I noticed.  I like the size and feel of these bar ends.  Not bad for the price.

product_title: Texsport Willowbend 2 Person Backpacking Camping Trail Tent
review_body: We picked up 2 of these for a couple of 10-year old boys that were a bit annoying to tent with (\\"Why is there sand everywhere?\\", \\"Which of you hooligans left the door open?\\", \\"Why am I sleeping in kool-aid?\\", \\"Whose underwear are on my pillow?\\").  They now each have their own tent!  They love it, and we are all much happier.  The boys sometimes set the tents up in the yard, just for fun...and camping in their own tent has really taught them a lot of responsibility.    The zippers, material, and overall quality are not great, but for twenty biguns I won't be upset when they finally get destroyed.  We have about 10 nights using them so far, and no serious problems (one zipper never worked quite right). The poles are actually really light aluminum, and quite study.  The tents have little ventilation though, so they heat up fast inside (and get moist if you close the door).    I highly recommend this tent for a childs first tent.  I turned the strings into loops, so the boys can more easily hook the ropes where they need to, and set it up for them once.  Since then, they have been doing fine on their own.  The tent even fits easily into the bag, and they can both do it (sometimes they need an adult to help squish the air out or pull up a stuck stake).      2 people will be cramped, 1 will be fine.  You will want to leave the door and tiny window open so you don't build up moisture (which will make you more cold than leaving it open).  Also, you might not want to use the side tie-downs.  They cause the tent to sag in the middle.  We loosely attach them to something, so they only come into play during a gust of wind.    Overall, a great first tent, simple to set up, sturdy, and an excellent value.

review_body:
I had problems getting the presta valve head to depress the inner stem so it would take air on my road bike. I messed around with it for a while trying to insert it right and finally gave up and returned it. I ended up buying a Specialized pump with a dual valve head and it works better.

The actual build quality of the pump is better than some because the floor plate is metal and the pump doesn't flex when you pump high pressure, but beware of the presta head.

product_title: Pacific Fazer Boy's Bike (16-Inch Wheels)
review_body: For the price this is a good bike, my 3 years old nephew is really happy with his bike and it has been working perfectly

product_title: Slumberjack Latitude 20-Degree Mummy Sleeping Bag
review_body:
We just got this bag today for our son. We got the short version of this bag, but I don't see that version on Amazon anymore. The outside is a very nice rip-stop nylon material and soft and cuddly, and the zipper is very smooth. The inside is a little scratchy, but I am sure it will be better after a washing. The drawstring around the hood pulls nice and tight to keep out the air. The only thing I was disappointed about was the color. The picture on Amazon, and on the box it came in, is turquiose. The bag is definitely NOT turquiose! It is a darker blue - closer to navy - color. And the yellow is more of a mustard color, not a bright yellow, and the inside is dark gray. But my son likes it anyhow, and of course it doesn't affect the quality of the bag. I like the fact that the hood turns inside out, too.

UPDATE: We have since used this bag to go camping, and my son says he stays perfectly warm in it, although he does wear sweats while sleeping, too. it got down to freezing one night and he was completely warm.

product_title: Garrity 1 Watt LED Flashlight with Batteries
review_body:
I bought a 3-pack of these from Costco about 18 months back, for $20. I had no expectations as they lookd like a nice compact, fairly solid aluminum barreled flash-light and I bought them for that purpose. The Costco packaging did not allow you to test them, but I would have been happy with any performance as I wanted one for my car, and one to take camping, and for this purpose I would have been happy with anything that was mechanically solid and had average performance.

After installing the batteries, I was litterally blown away by their performance. The 1W Luxeon LED is BRIGHT, and the fixed focus lens is perfect for utility and camping work. The LED is pure white, so you don't have that yellow cast you get from regular incandescent lamps.

Mine came with 3 sets of batteries, and even though I use them frequently, I have yet to replace the battery.

Even at this price, I would buy this again, for myself and as gifts.

review_body: I purchased this bike for my Daughter who was turning 5. Her favorite color is Orange so when I saw this it was perfect. The box did arive damaged but the bike was fine...very simple to put together and the coloring is very pretty....It is the perfect size for a 5 year old. She jumped on this and started to ride....She is in awe of this Bike....She wipes it down after a ride....she talks about it all the time....and everyone in the town loves the color.   The bike is well made and sturdy. The handle bars and seat height are adjustable so this bike should last a while. I would have given it 5 stars but the tires do not seem to be as well made as the bike...And being white tires (although they look great when new) are starting to show all the dirt...which my daughter keeps trying to clean.  So to finalize....This is an excellent well made bike...the price can not be beat and any little girl would be proud to own it..and any parent should be proud to give it.

product_title: Hot Wheels 4 Inch Folding Aluminum Scooter
review_body: I bought this as a gift for my 4 year old nephew and he loves it.  He even rides it in the house. It's like a razor without the razor price tag. Even better is that it takes 2 seconds to put together. Just a bend and a snap.

product_title: Deluxe Rio Aluminum Backpack Chair with Large Storage Pouch
review_body: I bought two chairs for the beach, it has a pocket in back that has ample space for every thing we need.   the chair is pretty comfortable as a back pack and makes carrying everything a breeze.  the chair is also very well made. Its not a flimsy chair. Its well worth the money :)

product_title: ECOnscious Men's 100% Organic Cotton Long Sleeve Tee
review_body: Bought a black-coloured t-shirt. Its a good quality product. The neck will stay in shape and the product is of decent thickness. It fits slightly tight. So if you are used to wear a Medium sized t-shirt, would recommend you to order a large one.    Overall a good product!

product_title: Blackburn TPS-2 Bicycle Floor Pump
review_body: Well, it does what a good pump should do, inflate tires! and it does it, no problems.....

product_title: Cateye CC-MC100W Micro Wireless 10-Function Bicycle Computer (Black)
review_body:
Very Nice product that preforms as advertised. I used it on a mountain bike over rocky trails, mud and tree roots without problem. I would recommend this item. Very easy to read and work the buttons while riding.

The only complaint is the sensor is not strong enough and must be very close to the spoke to pick up a signal 1.5cm. If it varies or bounces around, then you loose the signal.

product_title: Timbuk2 Women's Cargo Tote
review_body: Its a little heavy to be used for the purpose it was bought for (to be my 2nd bag/carryon when traveling with backpack) but it is a great, sturdy bag! It fits my laptop in neophrene sleeve, and pretty large Crumpler camera bag, so its a nicer alternative to a daypack for business travel. The organizing pockets are great. There is no key chain as promised - not sure if my bag is defective or description is outdated. The only thing that would make this bag more perfect - but would probably mar the ease of use - is some sort of rain protection flap for under/over the zipper. I could see how water could seep in....

product_title: Cateye CC-MC100W Micro Wireless 10-Function Bicycle Computer
review_body: The manual start/stop is the most important feature to me. It's the only way to save all my data at the end of a ride while I'm still on the bike cooling down. Most computers are exclusively auto start/stop, other than the bottom end generic ones that only have manual start/stop or the very expensive ones that have both auto and manual. The only con I have is it could be a little brighter display.

product_title: Chicago Boy's Adjustable Quad Skate
review_body: These skates were a huge hit for our 5 year old son.  The fact that they are so adjustable is a big plus.  Good ankle support.  We had a little problem with one of the buckles, but were able to fix it.  I would recommend these to anyone.

product_title: Giro Flak Multi-Sport Helmet
review_body: I ordered one for myself and a medium for my daughter. The finishes are first rate and the fit is snug. It takes a little adjustment to get the chin strap right. I am very pleased with the look and fit and would recommend it to anyone.

product_title: Swiss Gear Altenberg Daypack
review_headline: Good daypack with one little problem
review_body: The size is perfect for a daypack for traveling.  I just spent 2 weeks in Turkey and the pack was perfect for touring/hiking during the day.  It also worked well on the days when I needed to pack for the beach.  I liked that it has two main compartments instead of one huge compartment where everything is all jumbled up.  The elastic band in the front was handy for tying up my shoes when I went wading in water, to the beach, a sweater when it got too hot, etc.  The one but crucial negative is that the zippers are not of sturdy quality.  A few days into my trip, my new backpack already had problems zipping up.  The zipper in question still works but it catches easily and generally, I have to treat it gingerly.  It looks like the backpack will last a very long time but will be useless because I do not think the zippers are going to make it.

product_title: Planet Bike A.R.S. Standard bike seat - Men's
review_headline: Awesome feet.. no more number feet
review_body: I like it alot, no more numbness so I'm happy.. plus I think it looks pretty good!

product_title: Advanced Elements Spray Skirt
review_headline: Kept me kayaking in the winter
review_body: I bought the spray skirt for my Advanced Elements inflatable kayak: the Dragonfly. I use it in the winter months when getting wet is just too cold for comfort. It kept me kayaking no matter what the weather. It fit around the inflated tubing edges and stayed put. It is heavy and durable. I'm looking forward to using it next winter. True, I live in NW Florida and I'm not talking about temperatures below freezing.

product_title: Victorinox Swiss Army Classic SD Pocket Knife
review_headline: I always carry one of these.
review_body:
This is the most functional knife I have ever owned. I buy a new one every six months, I don't sharpen it, I just get another one. This of course is another selling point, affordability. The blade is sharp and will cut through the most annoying plastic that everything now comes entombed in. It is not a lock blade so you must be careful. This is the only thing I don't like about the knife, but I have not once in 10 years cut myself with one. The scissors are sharp and do a good job. The flat tip/file is great and hard to live without.

I have used this knife to remove small screws from aircraft to working on my computer. Cut zip ties and remove clothing tags. It is small and fits perfectly into my coin pocket on my jeans. And if I forget to remove it, it comes out clean from the wash, still in the pocket. Not recommended for your washers sake, but it does happen.

I am ordering another one as I just lost mine in Iraq. Can't live without it.

product_title: Flexible Flyer Snowball Maker, colors may vary
review_body: This snowball maker works great in any type of snow (dry or wet).  My 5 and 7 year old boys have no problem making perfectly round snowballs with this handy tool.  It took a while for it to ship but it was worth the money.

product_title: Short Queen (60X75) RV & Camper Sheet Set 300 thread count, 100% cotton CAMEL color
review_body: Sheets arrived in 7 days.  They were the correct size for our RV short queen mattress. The bottom sheet fits well with plenty of room for a mattress pad.  They are 100% cotton and very soft.  The top sheet has one end that is  fitted simular to the bottom sheet that keeps everything snug. product_title: Turfer Waterproof Tailgate/Picnic Blanket With Handles
review_body: The picnic blankets more than met our expectations. They are soft and are equipped with convenient handles.

product_title: Transformer Bumble Bee 16-Inch Kids' Bike
review_body: I bought this bike for my six years old. Really a nice bike. Only problem shipment had a faulty nut. I have contacted manufacturer and they promised a replacement part.

product_title: Bell FreeFfit 15 Function Wireless Speedometer
review_body: The package was well made. I took the wireless sensor, magnet, and computer from its well made package and placed it on my bike and found I had a piece of junk. Ok a bit harsh to start but after changing the batteries, realigning the sensor multiple times on many trips this beasty still registered 0 mph on any speed greater than 12 mph and randomly sticks at 7 mph while the time stops. I like Bell for many of their other products but their cycle computers are a zero in my humble opinion. Do not waste your money.

product_title: Pedco UltraPod II Lightweight Camera Tripod
review_body: Not the most stable tripod in the world, but it works for what it does and for the price.

product_title: Cadillac Adventure Series AVP2.1 Women's Dual Suspension Disc Brake Comfort Bike
review_body:
The great things about this bike are: it's a great price, good looking, and has well made components. The bad things are: it is not easy to assemble (had to take it to local bike shop as many other reviewers did), it's very heavy (you're pedaling your body weight plus an extra 42lbs of bike), there is no kick stand (you can buy your own and add it on as other reviewers have said), the gears are noisy, and most importantly for a "comfort" bike, it's not very comfortable.

The seat is very hard and I can't exactly pinpoint what it is but it just feels akward and uncomfortable (another reviewer pointed this out also). The handlebars are in a "U" shape instead of straight across which puts your arms in an akward position, especially for a long ride . Most of the "cruiser" bikes have "U" shaped handlebars for tuling around the beach. I wasn't expecting it on this kind of bike.

Even though the bike shop custom fit it to me and I got the 19" frame (I'm 5'10), it just feels akward and after about ten minutes, I want off. I will keep using this bike but I wish I would have gone to the bike shop and tried several. You don't know what you're getting when you buy off the internet. My advice would be to try this first before you buy it.

product_title: Klean Kanteen Stainless Steel Water Bottle
review_body: A metal water bottle is great. We all know you can use it forever, which means good for Mother Earth, but it's just not he same as a squeeze bottle. When I am working out at the gym or trying to jog, nothing says 'easy' thirst-quenching like a squeeze bottle PLUS they are usually easier to carry. That being said, taking a drink out of my 18oz Klean Kanteen makes the water taste so much better. Seriously. No matter what type of plastic bottle you use, taste can and is an issue. You may not think so, but that's because you haven't had a swig of water from a Klean Kanteen. I have the 18oz and it is perfect for me. I am getting used to using it at the gym and on my so-called jogs (maybe I'll get the sports cap). A quality-made product here.

review_body: ON A SCALE OF TEN, IT WOULD HAVE TO BE A 9.9 ! I ONLY SAY THAT BECAUSE THE CHROME ON THE FINS , WAS THIN AND IT WAS GOING ON A SCHWINN \\" SPOILER \\" SHOW BIKE MADE INTO A MOPED ! WITH MATCHING HOODED HEADLIGHT ! WOW !
