product_title: Coleman RoadTrip Wheeled Carry Case
review_headline: Coleman Road Trip Grill Wheeled  carry case
review_body: We purchased a Coleman Road Trip grill for camping and I wanted a carrying case to protect it. I did price checks on this item and Amazon was best price and free shipping too. I love it. It keeps the grill in place and doesn't let it get scratched or slide all over the RV. So it's been a great investment and worth the money. I highly recommend this item for your Coleman Road Trip grills.

product_title: Petzl Tikka 3-LED Headlamp, Green #E43P2
review_headline: Great product  but for changing batteries
review_body: I fell in love with the PETZL Zipka Tikka model LED light in Alaska where I first saw and bought one. In the winter as obvious, it is very  dark and you really, really need a reliable light source at times.  It is not an exaggeration to say that your life might depend upon it.  I like the trail distance I got, the ease I could use it on my wrist or forehead. I especially recommend the small size so it can be put in a parka pocket or purse. I also use Petzl in Arizona which often is short of street lights in urban areas. Only hassle is the #$%@ accessing to replace batteries. It is impossible to open the unit with your fingers/nails.  You will need a sharp object and plenty of light and a little muscle to open the unit and replace the batteries. I finally found manicure scissors do the job. If the light gives out on the trail, in a cave or dark street, you are in trouble because of the difficulty in replacing the batteries.  This is the only hassle I (and plenty of others) have found with this great product. (I often carry two so I don't have to hassle battery replacement).

product_title: Schwinn Prelude Men's Road Bike (700c Wheels)
review_body:
Background:

I came from a background of BMX trail-riding in the late 90s when I was a teenager. I sold off the bikes I had at the turn of the millennium and have been bike-less since.

Pre-purchase:

Now that I'm in my 20s, I've recently decided to buy a bike to help maintain a healthy lifestyle, and I did hefty research before purchasing. I originally wanted to spend as little as possible, under $150 for a bicycle. I went to Wal-mart to take a gander at what they offered, and nothing really wow'ed me, so I went on Amazon. I didn't want to fool with Mongoose or any of the generic brand names. I rode Haro in my glory days, but I always wanted a Schwinn. I saw the prices and decided to spend a little more since I'd be using it a lot. It was a toss-up between this one and the Ridge-AL Mountain Bike, which is $35 cheaper than this one. I ordered this bike finally, at a $235 price tag with free Amazon shipping.

Shipment and Setup:

I got this bike in a cool three days, and it came in a big box. The setup was pretty easy. I set it up by myself but it would have been a big help if I had asked for help. One thing to note is that it does have the quick-release front wheel, so I'm telling you now so you don't act like an idiot (like me) sifting through the box for bolts. The front brakes take a little fidgeting to set just right, but the back gearing and brakes are already set up for you. Overall, everything is solid and exactly what you'd expect from Schwinn.

The ride:

This is my first road bike, so I had to adjust alot of things before it became comfortable. I'm about 5'8\\" and it's okay; I think the ideal height for this bike however is in the 5'10\\" range. Everything is smooth and shifts smooth,

Cons:

Handlebars - You can't adjust the handlebar height because of the threading system. It's not really a big deal, but if you want it changed you have to take it to a licensed pro, orrisk it by doing it yourself.

The seat - The best for last. The seat is like riding on your household iron, metal side up. This thing is so uncomfortable, I can't even ride for extended lengths of time. If you ride in a crowded neighborhood, you'll be thinking to yourself on how to look cool while being really uncomfortable, but most people can see through this technique. This is one thing you absolutely must replace if you purchase the bike (in my opinion).

product_title: Huffy Synapse Women's Mountain Bike
review_body: I was looking for a good mountain bike for employment in an urban environment where smooth roads may not always be available. When I received the bike it was in large package, I was afraid I wouldn't be able to assemble the bike, but with a few key tools it was put together in 45 minutes. I find the bike to be sturdy and fun. I only paid $79 for the whole bike. I choose the free shipping, although that seemed to take a while for the bike to make it to my house. If you looking for a less expensive good mountain bike this is a good choice.

product_title: Coleman GolfCat Perfectemp Catalytic Propane Heater
review_body: I got this gift for a friend because I hate the cold winter golf cart rides I used to suffer each year.  We couldn't find a Coleman propane tank, so we used another brand.  It didn't fit in the holder properly and fell over.  But we tied up the holder with a bungee cord, and this little heater really works!  It was 37 degrees outside, and a toasty 60 degrees inside with the cart enclosure zipped up.  It's really a great idea for anyone who uses the golf cart as transportation in their community. Now I'm looking forward to those wonderful rides around the waterfront in heated comfort.

product_title: OGIO Metroid Street Backpack
review_headline: Large Backpack: What I was looking for
review_body: This is a large back pack lots of room.  As a field computer engineer, I carry way too much equipment. This backpack holds it all.  There are a total of ten pockets that help organize my equipment.  Of particular use is the file folder pocket that will hold full 8 1/2 x 11 paper.    I have an IBM T43 that fits nicely in the laptop compartment.  I have not tried the larger notebooks.    Well built laptop with solid zippers.

product_title: Coleman Cooking Station Table
review_body: When my wife and I got married, I got to register for some camping goodies.  This is by far the best- folds up small, but really gives you two tables worth of surface space, plus a shelf underneath for things you don't want on the ground.  Lightweight, folds small.  Keep it clean though- a few too many beach campouts, I may have to replace this one soon, but 3 good years of regular use/abuse and it's still kickin'...  a highly recommended camp accessory.

product_title: Blackburn Airstik Carbon Fiber Bicycle Road Pump
review_headline: This lightweight pump stays out of the way, but does the job when needed.
review_body:
Riding on poorly inflated tires make cycling more difficult and flats happen on rides. For these reasons I keep a pump with me. When preparing for a ride, I prefer to have the least amount of stuff I can get by with. This lightweight pump stays out of the way, but does the job when needed.

This pump made with a high-pressure carbon-fiber barrel is 11 inches / 28 cm long and weighs 5.5 ounces / 157 grams. The handle folds out from the pump forming an ergonomic T handle. Combined with the double-action internals, this pump will easily fill your tires to 160 psi. 160 psi is overkill for mountain bikes and is needed more for road bikes. A bracket with Velcro strap keeps the pump attached to your bike in between uses.

Blackburn stands behind their quality products. If you have trouble with their pumps, it is covered by their lifetime warranty. This may be the last pump you'll ever need.

PROS:

No cartridges to carry around

Lightweight carbon-fiber construction

Does the job with ease

Lifetime warranty

product_title: Independent Stage 10 169 Truck Standard, Silver Silver (Pack of 2)
review_body: Have a set from 1987 that are better,but these are lighter and very durable(have spent hours on real coping,trying to grind into the axle,and it is taking longer than usual). Indy quality,American made....'nuff said. Buy 'em,grind 'em!

product_title: Dora the Explorer Plush Backpack Bag
review_body:
This is really a backpack, from the straps to the side pockets. That's the best part of it.

My 2 year old won't let it go. She has put everything Dora in it and even tows it to church. It has been washed and dried and still looks greats.

My only problem is the magnetic clasp, but I added some velcro and it stayed shut. Anyone who has a Dora fan needs to purchase this for them.

product_title: Coleman Rechargeable Portable 48 oz. Blender Plus Bonus 4 Margarita Glasses
review_headline: pretty good blender but take into consideration...
review_body: Don't expect a home corded blender performance but it works pretty well given it's battery operated.  The blender and included glasses are nice but it isn't practical to box it up everytime you use it and most tail gaters or campers appreciate a good carry case.  Unfortunately, it doesnt come with one leaving the owner to figure out how to tote it all about.  Coleman supposedly makes a carry case but it is proving hard to find.  I ordered one from amazon who cancelled the order 2 weeks later because they could not fulfill the order.  The carry case should definately be included being a portable only use device.    update 11-16-10    After 2 years and only 2 uses, this unit will no longer accept a charge.  Completely useless!  It was neat while it lasted, both times... lol.

product_title: Wenzel Sycamore 18- by 10-Foot Seven-Person Three-Room Family Dome Tent
review_body: I spent the last 15 years backpacking and looking down my nose at car campers. THEN I had two kids 18 months and 4 1/2. I now appreciate the TRUE value of having seperate rooms (still waiting for tent-sound proofing technology) and the ability to stand up and change. If you are car-camping with kids THIS is the tent!!!!    Dave

product_title: Wenzel Timber Ridge Sport 9-by-7-Foot Four-Person Dome Tent
review_body: This tent is a great buy for the money. It sets up fast and it is spacious enough for two people including space for backpacks, shoes, etc. Keeps water out well, but be sure to use the rain fly and all of it's straps & stakes to keep the water from dripping inside. Careful not to set up on top of sharp rocks or pinecones, as the floor of the tent may wear thin over time. Packs up pretty small and easily and is light. All together it is a great deal for the price.

product_title: Thule Sidekick Cargo Box
review_body: Great Grab! used it to help load belongings on a trip from Montana to Massachusetts. made it all the way with not a problem in sight and held a huge amount of equipment.  cant beat the price and the quality that Thule products offer...direct fit straight to my jeep as well couldnt have taken more than 10 min. to install.  i'd buy another if i needed one.

product_title: Spitfire Brand Personal Defense Pepper Spray - 4.5 grams (black dispenser)
review_body:
I like this product, but, I'm looking for a replacement.
To order 2 units, the cheapest shipping is $15.00.

product_title: Topeak Aero Wedge Pack with Strap Mount
review_body: Good size bag for a road bike.  I can fit 2 spare road bike tires, couple small tools, wallet, and have a little space left over.  Good quality construction.  I went for this over the one with the seat clip on top because of reviews on Amazon about the clip being prone to breaking.  I've had no problems with the strap/buckle connection.

product_title: Brunton  Key Ring Compass black
review_body: I just received this from Amazon today. It came in a box that was roughly 15\\" long and 8\\" deep. All this for a little tiny compass. There was one crumpled piece of brown paper in there and of course the compass wasn't inside the paper, it was at the bottom of the box. So, first observation, it was poorly packed.    Second, one side of the compass pointer is red and the other white. It seems that if you are facing north or south, you need to look at the red side of the dial for an accurate reading. If you are facing east or west, you'd better read the white side of the dial to know what direction you are really facing. This thing is either defective or crazily designed. Considering how ridiculously it was packed, it's probably damaged. If someone wants me to pay to return it, for a $10 compass, it's not worth it.

product_title: Topeak DeFender M2 Mountain Bike Fender (Rear)
review_body: THIS FENDER IS GREAT AND WORKS AS WELL AS THE FRONT M1 FENDER. SAME STYLING AND COOL LOOK. YOU CAN ADJUST IT COUNTLESS WAYS. IT STOPS DEBRIS FROM KICKING UP ON YOUR BACK SIDE AND GREAT ON A RAINY DAY. IF YOU USE A REAR FENDER YOU NEED TO HAVE SOMETHING HOLDING THE BIKE UP WHEN YOUR NOT RIDING LIKE A DISPLAY STAND OR KICK STAND. MOST PEOPLE WHO USE THIS PRODUCT WILL HAVE A HIGH END MOUNTAIN BIKE WHICH USUALLY DOESN'T HAVE A KICK STAND AND THATS WHERE THE FENDER BECOMES A PROBLEM. IF YOU LEAN IT ON SOMETHING THE FENDER WILL USUALLY BE THE FIRST THING LEANING ON THE OBJECT BECAUSE IT STICKS OUT WHICH MAY CAUSE IT TO WARP A LITTLE OR STRESS IT DO TO THE BIKES WEIGHT. YOU COULD LEAN THE BIKE BY THE HANDLE BARS THEN YOUR FINE UNLESS YOU GET HOOKED ON THE BARS AND THE BIKE FALLS (ARGGG). IT'S DEF A GOOD FENDER, YOU JUST NEED TO PLAN THE BIKES STORAGE. I ORDERED THE DISPLAY STANDS AND THE BIKE STANDS FREE AND NO MORE LEANING ON ANY THING. I DIDN'T USE THE REAR FENDER UNTIL I GOT THE STANDS TO SAVE HEADACHES. YOU CAN USE THE FRONT FENDERS WITH OUT ISSUE. THEY ALWAYS STAY OUT OF THE WAY. IF YOU WANT TO USE THE REAR FENDER RIGHT AWAY IT COMES OFF EASILY AND YOU COULD TAKE IT OFF AFTER YOUR RIDE IS DONE SO AS NOT TO SNAG IT ON SOMETHING. I THINK THE STAND IS A BETTER OPTION PLUS YOU CAN WORK ON YOUR BIKE IF NEEDED. VERY DURABLE MATERIALS - GREAT PRICE - GREAT BUY. BIKE SHOPS TRY TO SELL THE CHEAPER VERSION FOR 2WICE AS MUCH.

product_title: Bell Impulse Bike Helmet
review_body: went with this over the faction.  lighter and in solid colors this one is not too outlandish like some of the other helmets.

product_title: Coleman Guide Series Powerhouse Dual Fuel Stove
review_body: First of all, this product is high quality product from Coleman.  I researched for weeks trying to find a new Dual Fuel Camping Stove at a reasonable price.  I haven't found a cheaper priced one until I came across this one at [...].      My family camps at least once a month.  The camp set up has to be like the Hilton for my wife and this product adds to the quality camping experience.  I was using propane stove prior to this stove and I hated lugging around all those propane bottles.  I've actually moved to all Dual Fuel camping equipment ie. stove and lanterns.  All I bring is a small 2.5 gallon unleaded fuel to run all my camping equipment and it is very convenient.    I would highly recommend this product if you and or your family are hard core campers who camp more than 4 times a year.   Happy Camping!

product_title: Razor MX350 Dirt Rocket Electric Motocross Bike
review_headline: Small, underpowered, ok for 6-7 yr old
review_body: We got this for our 10yr old after doing research on it on the Razor web site.  It is recommended for a 12+ year old and we based our decision on that.  Bottom line is it has 'ok' power if it is your childs very first electric vehicle.  Any child with electric vehicle experience will love the looks and always be looking for power.  For a child over 8-9 and 50-60lbs this will disappoint.  It is VERY small, 12inch tires, and no suspension.  Our son is average height/weight and he overwhelms the bike.      Looks great but NOT worth the $.

product_title: Schwinn Mark I Bike Trailer and Stroller Combination
review_body: great deal. doubles as a bike trailer and a jogger.  We used it all summer to transport our 2 year old and all that goes with him to and from our community pool.  Extremely durable.  Large wheels for a smooth ride.  I definitely get a great work out too!

product_title: Thule 857 Caravan Rooftop Cargo Bag
review_body: The bag is nice and the size is great (and the no PVC is where Thule needs to head).... BUT... it ripped the first day I used it (had a stroller in it, and the seam ripped straight through) and it is definitely not 'weather-proof', it rained for only a few minutes on our trip and the inside items were wet.   Probably a great bag for soft items in the desert... but not for all the time use...  Come on Thule!  Make a better PVC free bag!  We know you can do it.

product_title: Coleman 2-Room Durango Tent (15-Feet x 10-Feet)
review_body: The tent was very easy to setup and put away.  We experienced a full day of rain and had a minor leak, but that was due to user error - we hadn't wrapped all of the velcro around the poles, causing the rain cover to come into contact with the tent.    We have a family of 5 - two average sized adults - man 180, woman 130, - three children, age 7,3, and 2.    With two queen mattresses, we pretty much used all of the space.  I was a little disappointed in the fact that the rear of the tent rose sharply from the floor to the roof, causing us to have to move the mattresses closer to the entrance way, otherwise the people on the two ends would have come into contact with the tent (raincover not over that area too, so could forsee problems).    Ventilation was fine.  Without the user error, the tent stayed dry.    Really only a 4 person tent.

product_title: Razor E100 Electric Scooter
review_body: My daughter of 9 years old loves this scooter. The only complaint is the low clearance to the ground and the battery pack guard. It sometimes scrapes the ground when going over the driveway curbs.  (Update 9/18/2011), over 2 years later this scooter is still holding up and running strong.

product_title: Rio Adventure Military Style Cot
review_body: I think this is good cot and easy to set up and fold it down quick and space saver, too.  I think this is good size for 5'10 tall and under if you are a curl sleeper then it's probably a little uncomfortable.  Strong structure cot.

product_title: Topeak MTX Rear Bicycle Basket
review_body:
I had one of these on my bike for about six months. During that time:
- the handle fell off and got caught in my spokes (ouch!)
- the basket got several large holes in it from regular usage

Before the holes and the missing handle, it was a nice basket

I would not recommend this to anyone.

product_title: prAna Men's Sonora Pant
review_body: A really great pant for action sports , picnic, or just a visit to the movies...

product_title: Thule 687B Atlantis 1800 Rooftop Cargo Box (Black)
review_body: I have had this product since last March and have been on a few trips with it.  After removing if from the box two of the plastic \\"Thule quick grips\\" immediately popped off the box and had to be rescrewed on. They continue to pop off almost everytime it is placed on the roof. It is very frustrating and a poor system for attaching the box to the roof.

product_title: Rio Adventure Camp Caddy
review_body: Table space is usually a premium when camping and this camp caddy does a great job. I've used it once on a sandy campsite and the only downside is that it doesn't have a table clamp. The sandy soil didn't support it's weight very well when it was fully loaded. I remedied that with 1 piece of duct tape and it withstood 30 mph winds (didn't fall over once). I would highly recommend this product.

product_title: Sunrace Top Mount Friction Shift Lever Set, 5-9 Speed, Friction
review_body: These were good shifters, but i would recommend going for something a little more expensive, like Shimano SIS or something.  I had a problem, that now i realize was my derailleur, but the left shifter pretty much broke off. The main support parts on these is made up of plastic.

product_title: Iron Horse Triumph 5.0 Adult Road Bike
review_body: Had local bike shop assemble and tune. They sell bikes w/ same components for $900.  Tech said I got a great deal.  Came next day (w/ 5-9day shipping).

product_title: Wenger Adler 17- by 15-Foot 3-Room 11-Person Family Cabin Dome Tent
review_body: I bought this tent for our family camping events. I received it within 5 days of ordering it. The following weekend, my ten year old son and I set it up in the yard. It turns out that this tent goes up easier than my 6 man Coleman tent. It is hugely spacious, 193 sq ft. It will work well for my family of five. I am very pleased with this tent.

product_title: Topeak JoeBlow Sport Floor Bike Pump
review_body: I've had this pump also for about a month.    Pumps up tires/tubes with Shrader valves OK.    The Presta valve side of the twin head does not work properly with short stemmed Presta valves. It seems that the pump nozzle has difficulty in forming a good seal with short stemmed Presta valves. The pump will only pump up to around 75 PSI into the tire/tube. Pressures beyond 75 PSI appear to \\"seal\\" the valve, which prevents further tire/tube inflation. The extra pressure just pressurizes the pump hose only!    Pumping to higher pressures is a bit difficult. Especially when compared to easier working pumps such as Specialized and Blackburn brands which I have also.    An average pump.    Not recommended for use with short stemmed Presta valves.

product_title: Topeak Road Morph G Mini Pump
review_body: I bought this pump for those occassions if I get a flat and have to pump up the tire after repairing the tube.  I've used the others that are smaller and require that you use both hands and have you pumping a million times, pouring sweat just to get a little air.  I hated those.  This is the greatest portable pump that I have ever used.  You can stand on the little foot lever for stability and you push down on the handle until the gauge reads the amount of air you need in the tire.  It has a hose on the end of the inflating piece so that you don't need to hold it to prevent it from shredding the inner tube valve.  I was able to inflat the tire to 100 psi in just a few minutes and didn't even break a sweat.

product_title: MSR Alpine Gourmet Cookset
review_body: You really can't go wrong with MSR Stainless mess kits.  Simple, sturdy, effective.  Stainless is a pain to clean, but bring some steel wool and  you'll be good.  Cooks much more evenly than anything else out there.  You don't have to worry about scraping off the teflon and you won't burn your stuff or break the bank like with titanium.

product_title: MEN's Pro Bike Shorts Cycling Bicycle Biking
review_body: Best fitting and most comfortable shorts I have ever bought.  Will definitely purchase again.

product_title: Coleman Retro Rechargeable Battery Powered Lantern (Family Size)
review_body: This is a very cool lantern. It charges via AC or DC. Since I have solar panels on my trailer, this is a perfect match.

product_title: Sunlite Thorn Resistant Presta Valve Tubes, Black
review_body: I was originally looking for a set of Maxxis downhill tubes and ran into these Pyramid tubes for a fraction of the cost. After reading other reviews decide to give them a shot. Very impressed so far...been riding on them aprox 3 months. About as good as it gets for this price or any price for that matter.

product_title: Sigg Vintage Water Bottle (0.4-Liters)
review_body: Very cute, quite the conversation piece.  Attractive and completely spill proof.  I feel a bit uncomfortable drinking water from it in a place like a school or while I'm driving and a cop is near me as it really does look like a flask, but it's lots of fun, not heavy at all, and well made.

product_title: Browning Chaparral 0-degree Oversized Mummy Sleeping Bag
review_body: This bag is great for warmth and room, so if your camping with a car its fantastic...for hiking though its massive, about the same size as youd hope your rucksack might be.....so too big and cumbersome for hiking but a great product other than that

product_title: Razor E200 Electric Scooter
review_body: My son received this scooter for his 11th birthday, and loves it.  He hasn't gotten to ride it for very long stretches at a time since it's winter, but he can't wait to ride it for as long as possible right now.   So far, there hasn't been any problems with the scooter.  I went back and forth about which scooter to get him because he's on the small side, but he does well with it, and it should last him a long time because of the bigger weight limit.

product_title: Knog Frog 1-LED Bicycle Light
review_body: Obviously this little guy isn't intended to illuminate the road.  The point of this light is to be seen by cars when you are driving on city streets and other well-lit areas.  Snaps on and off easy, works great, easily fits in your pocket.  Looks cool too.

product_title: CamelBak BPA-Free Better Bottle with Bite Valve
review_body: The bottles arrived on time and were the right color.   I have now purchased 15 of them over a period of about 4 months, friends in Europe have seen the one that I use and asked me to buy them when I was in the US.    They are easy to use, don't drip, and easily come apart so that you can put them in the dishwasher for cleaning.

product_title: ShelterLogic Max AP™ 10 x10 ft. Compact Canopy
review_headline: Not so easy to install canopy.
review_body: I bought this canopy thinking I could use it for art festivals, but once I started to assembly it, I discovered that not only was it a two man job (at least), but it would be difficult to transport to each event, as it was bulky, and there was no carrying bag. I ended up using it in my yard as a carport for my motorcycle, and so far it has held up well. My husband bolted it to the side of the shed so the wind wouldn't carry it away, because it didn't come with any stakes.  The directions should have easy to follow, but it took both of us to interpret parts of it. The poles were all marked well, but the joiner pieces could have been marked with arrows to indicate up or down.  Overall, not a bad canopy, just not portable.

product_title: U.S. Divers Cozumel Seabreeze Dry Proflex II Mask, Fins and Snorkel Set
review_body:
Tried out the set today at the pool, works well.

The fins fit good even though I wear size 15 shoe. Snug but not painful.

The snorkel could be longer, but works suffieciently... I've never snorkeled before and I think I have it down in a hour... to clear it of water you have to put one hand over the end near your mouth while you blow. Works well enough you can go down, come up, clear water, and keep you head down.

The mask is the part of the set that needs help, while trying to adjust the strap, it broke. So I took off the plastic adjustment piece and fed the strap though the hole where the strap was mounted and it stays better. I think it works better after I broke it and improvised. I think I'll do that to the other side too. Fogged up a bit too, but I bet there's a secret about that too...

overall
Fins A+ not too big, snug fit for larger feet
Snorkel B- easy to use once you get the hang of it
Mask C+ strap adjustment lock sucks, better once you break it & Improvise

Price/Value A- Best deal I found for <$30

product_title: WearEver LR-4 Mesh Backpack Lounger
review_body:
I purchased this for a friend to use on her balcony and she loves it. She does report that the cup holders are more suited to cans than bottles but she finds it very comfortable. However, she and her husband have been unable to figure out how to fold the footrest to take the chair to the beach. I had warned them that others had broken the footrest, so they have avoided putting much force on it. Is there a special trick to this?

Except for that, she would give it 5 stars.

product_title: Fisher-Price Child Carrier with Toddler Helmet
review_body: We bought this for our 2 year old daughter.  It was a nightmare to put together, then it did not fit.  Becareful when installing in larger mountain bikes.  We bought a 20inch frame, men's mountain mike and it was 3 inches too short of fitting.  Not worth it!!!

product_title: Texsport Enamel 20 Cup Percolator
review_body: This product is just what we were looking for to heat water for hot chocolate when camping.  The shipper could do a better job with packing to prevent the enamal being chipped during shipping. I have seen othere with the coil around the handle to prevent the handle getting hot.  That would have been a plus. Other that that, perfect.  Good price and quick delivery time.

product_title: Planet Bike 1200 1.5-Watt & Blinky 3 Bicycle Light Set
review_headline: Other Planet Bike Lights are a lot better
review_body:
This was the first planet bike light that I ever bought and i was not too happy with it so it was almost my last one. This one just doesn't really cut it. It's not very bright and the run time on the batteries is not that long. The blinky works well but the headlight just doesn't cut it. A better option would be [[ASIN:B000AQU8BA Planet Bike Beamer 1 and Blinky 3 LED Bicycle Light Set]] Yes it costs a few dollars more but it's a whole lot more brighter, lasts longer and it's easier to put fresh batteries in and take old batteries out.

I also use [[ASIN:B000FVMLR4 Down Low Glow Lighting Kit - Two Tubes-Envy(green)]] for side visibility at night.

product_title: Razor E100 Electric Scooter
review_body: I got this scooter for christmas and it is awsome! It is durable and goes fast (...)! It is perfect for me! For (...) Its worth every cent!

product_title: Sportsstuff 30-3524 Air Flyer Snow Sled
review_body: Do NOt Buy!!!!!!!  We used this 1 time and it tore in 2 places. It is garbage.

product_title: Pearl iZUMi Phase Tight
review_body: I purchased these after a minor hamstring pull playing ultimate frisbee...over the last month they have made a real difference to my play in cold weather sports (running, ultimate frisbee and cycling). I used to think that they were just about looks but am now a convert to these tights.    There have even been some cool studies about these kind of running wear...    Aerobic energy cost and sensation responses during submaximal running exercise--positive effects of wearing compression tights.  Bringard A, Perrey S, Belluye N.    EA 2991 Efficience et Déficience Motrices, Montpellier, France.    \\"This study aimed to examine the effects of wearing compression compared to classic elastic tights and conventional shorts (control trial) on oxygen cost and sensation responses during submaximal running exercise. ....    Wearing compression tights during running exercise may enhance overall circulation and decrease muscle oscillation to promote a lower energy expenditure at a given prolonged submaximal speed\\"

product_title: Kid Trax Dodge Viper Electric Ride On
review_body: This toy car has all the feeling of a real vehicle,  so say my grandson.

product_title: Body Glove Professional Junior Marvel Silicone Youth Diving Mask with QAS Strap
review_body: These goggles are a favorite for my daughters.  This is the third ones that I've bought.  (Not because of them breaking, one was lost while we were in the ocean.  I like to have an extra for friends also.)  The quick release strap is a must for kids.  The girls won't wear any other kind now that they've had these.  Nice, large lenses and I can even pop them on if I need to.  Overall, great goggles.

product_title: Zeagle Ranger Technical Scuba Diving BC
review_headline: Now I know why the military uses this BC.
review_body: This is a great BC. It has plenty of lift and can endure alot of rough use. The weight release system is superb. I recommend this product highly!

product_title: Total Fit Speedometer/Pedometer
review_body: Although I like the features of this Pedometer/Speedometer, I've discovered that it is not shock resistant. If if falls off you belt, you lose your stats. When on my bike, it periodically reverts to startup mode and stats are lost. The concept is great, but to be really reliable, more work needs to done on the design. Made in China like many low cost products now days. Guess you get what you pay for!

product_title: Rio Adventure Cooking Table
review_body: I JUST OPENED BOX AND WAS SURPRISED TO SEE THAT IT IS 24IN, WIDE...NOT 30 AS ADD STATES...SEEMS FLIMSY ...wOULD RETURN IF NOT SUCH A HASSEL....

product_title: Victorinox Swiss Army Rescue Tool Pocket Knife with Pouch
review_body: what  else  can  you say  knife  of  the  yr ! i  bought  two  one  for  me  the  other  for  my  son ! as  far  as  folding knifes  go i  don't  think  you  can  go  much  better  and  at  a  great  price ! hopefully i  want  have  to  use  most  of  the  tools  it  has but  it  does  provide some  peace  of  mind  just  in  case . i  think  every  guy  should  carry  this  knife .

product_title: Klean Kanteen Stainless Steel Water Bottles
review_headline: Good overall, but problems with lids
review_body: I bought two 18 oz Kanteens, one with a loop lid and the other with a flat lid. Though the Kanteen is a good size and easy to hold and clean, the lids have been a problem. The flat lid doesn't always feel like an air-tight seal, probably because of the metal-on-metal connection. It is, however, easier to open than the loop lid, which is very difficult to open unless you have very strong hands or a screwdriver handy.

product_title: Wenger Pathfinder II Technical Day Backpack
review_headline: Great day backpack for almost any purpose
review_body:
This is a good all-around pack. It's cheaper than some of the other better-known brand backpacks but is built and design with quality. I've had mine for about a year, use it almost every day, and it's held up great. It has everything you need; two outside pockets for water bottles, strong rip-stop fabric, a waist belt, even a compartment for adding a camelpak and hole for the tubing. The front pouch has lots of little pockets for storing pens, first aid, pocket knives, and more.

The rain pouch is a little strange; it's stored in it's own compartment on the bottom the pack. While it adds soft padding to protect the bottom of the pack, it takes up volume and a few ounces of weight and is non-removable. If you're looking for ultra-light camping or hiking, this is not the pack you want.

But if you're looking for a great durable backpack that you can take to class, take to the gym, and then take to the woods on the weekends, this is a great purchase.

product_title: iBert Safe-T Front Mounted Child Bicycle Seat
review_body: This is a fantastic product!  My daughter LOVES going for bike rides, pointing out every mailbox, fire hydrant, tree, etc. that she sees and looking up at mommy for acknowledgement!  I can actually converse with her and keep an eye on her.  It's such a great bonding experience as well.  And the bike is so easy to handle with the seat attached.  We're looking forward to warmer weather so we can make full use of it!!

product_title: Kelsyus Recline Backpack Beach Chair with UV Canopy
review_body: This item was made for Kelsyus in TWO(2) colors, blue and stone.  Color was not mentioned in the description at all !! The item was ordered hoping it was STONE.  The item arrived, blue. The chair was returned for credit and I took the hit for a reduced credit because you people thought it was my error that it was returned.  Moral of the story: NEVER assume that Amazon can describe products accurately !!  Future purchases at Amazon will be made only after alternative sources have failed.  It makes one wonder what ever happened to integrity Amazon once had !

product_title: Helly Hansen Women's Silverqueen Knit
review_body: very nice and warm jumper. I have to recomend. Im very happy with this product. Also it is large enough I have usually size S and order XS and it seams fine to me.  Eliska

product_title: Transformer Bumble Bee 16-Inch Kids' Bike
review_body: What an adorable little bike. It arrived on time as promised.  The packaging was perfect, no damaged parts, no missing pieces.  My grandson was very happy with the bike that \\"Santa\\" brought him. I am so happy that Amazon had the bike in stock...I wasn't able to find it anywhere and it was free shipping on top of a great price.  It was a very pleasant on-line shopping experience.

product_title: Sigg Screw Top for Sigg Water Bottles
review_body: All, Ignore the viewer who gave one star due to having to unscrew the top.  Its fast to take the top of, plus it's good exercise for your fingers.  I threw away all the other tops, they leaked or like another viewer said they don't give a good stream to drink.  The bottles are so light, you don't have to worry about breaking them either. They never leak, shake them up and down, nothing comes out. I have about ten of these bottles to last me through a week.  I have different designs and different sizes and love them all.  You'll love them!

product_title: Sunlite Polo Saddle
review_body: The seat looks ok for the price. I haven't installed it yet though. Seat arrived with a small tear by the rivet. Hope this isn't indicative of quality level.

product_title: Black Diamond Spot Headlamp
review_body:
I got this for my wife because we go motorcycle camping regularly and my old Princeton Tec light is bulky and looks fairly silly on her head (and mine for that matter).
This light is extremely bright and a very nice size. The spot is the brightest LCD I have found for a 3 AAA battery lamp. The three LED wide beam is very bright also and what I use most when I steal her lamp.
It takes a couple of minutes to get the hang of using the options for lower light level and stobe which is the same button as the off and on.
The only negative I can say about this light is that loading batteries is a PIA the first time. The battery door is hard to open until you get the hang of using the tilt adjustment on the lamp to open it. Once I figured that out it was a breeze. The batteries last a very long time even at the higher light settings.

product_title: Topeak Survival Tool Wedge Pack with Fixer
review_body:
This Topeak tool kit/storage bag is perfect for any road cycling enthusiast. Performance Downhill shipped the product the same day it was ordered. Order this if you want the ultimate package. Performance Downhill will deliver!

William R. Cundiff
Winter Haven, Florida

product_title: Planet Bike Blinky Safety 1-Led Bicycle Light Set
review_body: Very bright and eye catching.  They use quality super Leds so this things are visible from a good distance, especially the headlight.  The small size is great to carry them around in any saddle pouch or riding bag.

product_title: YayLabs Play and Freeze Ice Cream Ball Ice Cream Maker
review_body: This works great when you have lots of kids to help you. Let them toss and roll it around. Takes a bit of time and kids may get fidgety  we are currently on our second Ice cream ball we got the larger size after our daughter broke the last one on the tile floor. other reviewer said that they kicked it wow !! good luck with that !!!    Everyone in the campground looks forward to when we have Ice cream night ; )

product_title: Stanley Classic 17oz Vacuum Food Jar
review_body: I returned this product when I saw it was made in China. Give me a break.

product_title: Intex Pillow Rest Raised Airbed with Built-in Pillow and Electric Pump
review_body: Just returned from camping. Bought this for the height, for my wife. It would not hold air. It inflates nicely but only lasted about 2-3 hrs before swallowing you up. I slept on a mat on the ground. I bought it some time ago and never used it, out of warranty, no receipt. It is now in the dumpster.

product_title: Plan B Premium Skate Backpack Black
review_headline: Plan B Premium Skate Backpack Black
review_body: Wonderful item.  My son loves it.  It is a little heavy, but of very good quality and durability.  It was a great price and speedy delivery. Overall, good product and service.

product_title: NFL Official Team BMX Bike (16-Inch Wheels)
review_body: My husband and I researched bikes pretty thoroughly for our 4 1/2 year old son.  He is a HUGE Steelers fan and this bike was just perfect for what we were looking for.  The packging kept the bike from being scratched and it was easy to assemble on Christmas Eve.  The frame, seat, handle bars and training wheels are of great quality.  Of course he is not some professional biker, but he loves to ride.  The little wheel inserts are a little annoying (but our son LOVES them!!) so I just taped them in and they are much better now.  Overall, this is a great bike and a great price.

product_title: JanSport Solstice Daypack
review_body: I am 5'4\\" average sized woman and love this backpack. It is my daypack and I use it on all trails except overnight when I need more space.  For a while this backpack hiked with me 3 times a week at 7 miles average.  I find it very comfortable and it has many adjustment points.  I have carried it weighing 13 pounds and it was great.    Here's how much I like this bag - I bought my mother who is a hiker this backpack,too.

product_title: HIAEFIRE Q5 CREE 240 Lumen LED Bike Bicycle flashlight Torch +1 x Bicycle Holder +3 AAA batteries + dual charger
review_body:
excellent light and a great value. The mount at first seemed difficult to place, but if you are patient and read the instructions, you will learn how to install it with out any problems.
the brightness factor is important. In the $20 price range, you can't beat it! it is enough to light up street signs and reflective parts of the road. the path is a bit more dim, but brighter closer to the bike. but most importantly, it will for sure alert car drivers, as it can be seen clearly for a good 200 yards. the light has a blue-ish tone to it.
Also, this light is light weight, especially for its size. It is much better than the sigma trilet, which I returned.

product_title: Highgear Fitware PR Pulse Reader Pedometer with Watch, Alarm, and Chronograph
review_body: I bought this pedometer because it has all the features that I want.  Love the pulse rate monitor, but you get a different reading depending on which finger you use. Not really an issue since it's supposed to be just a guide. The biggest problem I have is that once attached to my pants, all I have to do is turn sideways, wiggle my body, move my leg up and down or any other minor movement and the pedometer increases.  One day while at my desk I put on 4000 steps!!  The direction book doesn't have any info on how to change this so, I don't really have an accurate account of my steps.  If your goal is to get in 10,000 steps a day, this isn't really the tool to use because of its sensitivity.   If you're only using it during your workout, it's a good tool.

product_title: Bolle Sport Recoil Sunglasses
review_body: I had gotten tired of buying the cheap versions from locally super store.  These are good built, come with a case and cleaning rag which is very nice to have.  Polarized lens are nice.  These wrap around my eyes which I like.  This seems to keep the wind from drying out my contacts when outside.

product_title: Intex 2-in-1 Airbed with Zipper Queen
review_headline: Do NOT buy this air mattress!
review_body: I purchased this air mattress to bring over to a friends house and was very disappointed to find that it didn't come with an air pump to inflate. So I had to spend another $20 for the pump, although the total was still cheaper than other brands.     I am now updating my review although I can't seem to change the rating from a 4 to a 1!!  After the second use I noticed the top mattress deflated during the night, so I took them apart and only used the bottom mattress. After 2 more uses the bottom one completely deflated as well! I have tested both out to verify that they both leak.   This product was a complete waste of money and I have now gone out and purchased the Aerobed that has a 3 year warrenty.

product_title: Burley Design Jogger Stroller
review_body: I love my burley jogger.  This jogger comes at a great price without sacraficing anything.  The jogger folds up very nicely and is light weight around 27 lbs. operational.  (17 lbs. without the wheels)    It literally took me 4 minutes from start to finish to put it together. I had it ready and used in 10 minutes.      All the gadgets work well.  The window to see your baby, its folding mechanism,  the front brakes and the rear breaks.  I would highly recommend this jogger for anyone that doesnt want to pay 300-500 for a jogger.  Works just as well as the expensive joggers.

product_title: Swagman XC Cross-Country 2-Bike Hitch Mount Rack (1/1/4 and 2-Inch Receiver)
review_body:
Bought the Swagman XC Cross-Country 2 after searching bike hitch in the web and some stores. Besides the price was very good, I was particular on how to mount the bike on the rack. I want the flexibility that my wife can also mount the bike easily. I saw this bike hitch mount and immediately figure out that the bike will be very stable since it is holding the bike with the tires and the center frame. It eliminates the concern of mounting a bike with a different frame since the double or single bar post makes a bike frame for ladies difficult to mount. Showed it to my friends and they were quite impress the way the hitch was designed.

Update July 4, 2011 - I am just coming back for this review that i made. I have added a photo in the share image. It is still one of the best bike hitch out there. I have this set up with my CRV. Love it!

product_title: Allen Sports Hitch Mount Rack Base Replacement (2-Inch Receiver) model #500EXT
review_body: I purchased this piece to replace a damaged part.  The original part was damaged in an accident when I was rear-ended and the replacement fit perfect.  Shipping was fast, and FREE!  Great deal all around.  Saved lots of $$$ on purchasing a whole new rack.  Allen customer service was great in pointing me to this replacement part instead of selling me a whole new rack.  What a company!

product_title: Thule Escape II Bag
review_headline: All I expected and then some!
review_body: After just one trip from Chicago to the Ozarks, I can honestly say the positive reviews for the Thule 866 Escape 2 cartop carrier were right on the money. It attached to my 2004 Freestar roof rack with ease; I stuffed it with 4 good sized duffle bags, one backpack; A medium suitcase; a tri-pod; and I STILL had room for more odds and ends. That left more room in the minivan for the 6 passengers.     I followed the advice and used some duct tape on the straps to prevent them from flapping and it worked great. We drove thru some pretty hard downpours on the way down and nothing got wet. It folds up with ease and stores in its own carry bag. I can't vouch for the longevity of this carrier since we've only used it once, but it seems pretty sturdy. The only negative I can think of is having to wipe off the bugs before putting it away, but even that wasn't too bad with just some wet paper towels. Overall, I'm VERY glad I got this carrier instead of the more expensive hard-top carriers.

product_title: Cateye HL-EL410 LED Bicycle Headlight (Black)
review_body:
I have used many bicycle lights over my lifetime, including generator lights. The Cateye is the first LED B.L that I have purchased.
I feel it is far superior to any other light that I've owned.
It would recommend it 2 anyone.
Great \\"light\\"

product_title: Eureka! Solar Shade - Shelter (medium)

The ability to zip it up makes insect control work as well as a screen house. You do of course, give up size,but you can go to the larger unit. This too, is easy to put up and take down. In exchange you get much easier set up and take down. It is also very well made. You can also use it as a beach tent, its original purpose.

review_body: junk,   studs very poor quality,   soft steel,   plenty of rubber left but tire of no use because of worn studs.

product_title: Coleman Tent Fan
review_body: My family and I bought this fan before a camping trip to South Carolina in July. I was really looking forward to a cool breeze in our tent. Much to my dismay, this puny fan did not provide ANY breeze. Holding it in your hand, 6 inches away from your face, it is a mediocre personal fan. It might work for one-person tents, but for families or hot climates, this isn't worth its weight.

product_title: Klean Kanteen Stainless Steel Water Bottle
review_body: Overall a good choice for a water bottle.  No leaks. The spout cap (with tether) works pretty well although I question how long before  the cap no longer fits tightly.  The mfg. says it is dishwasher safe but I have not tried that as I am concerned about the plastic top melting. I hand wash it now.  It was rather pricey but at the time our local stores didn't have many choices. Now that spring has arrived the stores have similar types but not brand, for less money.

product_title: 14 1/2x8 1/2x7, Front, Lift-Off Basket White
review_body: Bought for girls bike in white, looks good, nice coating.  Medium size wiring used, but sturdy, Pyramid brand.  Have another with thicker wire but this one still compares well.

product_title: Planet Bike Protegé 9.0 bike computer
review_body: This bike computer works as described.  It was very easy to install and use at the same time. 3-modes to choose from, to switch modes, simply click the computer by sliding it forward on the station. MPH, Temp., clock, ODOM., etc. all seems to be working just fine.  I gave it a four star because my bike has smaller handle bars than the docking station, so I had to install on the column (mid-section that holds the handle bars to the bike frame) of the handle bar instead AND i will need to make some adjustments to get it to fit on the handle bar. *****MAKE SURE YOU INSTALL THE MAGNET ABOUT HALF WAY IN BETWEEN THE MODULE READER, ALSO THE TWO DEVICES NEED TO BE VERY CLOSE TOGETHER*** IF YOU DO IT RIGHT THE COMPUTER SHOULD FLASH RIGHT AWAY!@

product_title: Bell Motivator Mag Indoor Bicycle Trainer
review_body: Given the inexpensive price, this is a terrific buy.  This trainer is fairly loud, so no early morning training sessions if you have folks downstairs...It comes with an extra skewer so that's nice, although you don't have to use it.  There are certainly better trainers out there, but this is the best you will probably find for under $100.

product_title: Kettler Sprint Balance Bike (Multiple Styles)
review_headline: You'll be amazed at what your kids can do!
review_body: We bought this balance bike for our 3 and a half year old son at Christmas time.  We were a little disappointed that he didn't just whizz right off like some kids do on bikes with training wheels. I had to remember that balance is a much more difficult skill to learn than pedaling. Now that he is closer to 4 (and it is spring time) he really has been practicing and loving every minute. He has a strong sense of accomplishment, because he really is figuring out how to do this by himself. Falling down hasn't been a big issue because his feet are right there to catch him. We've had no major bumps, bruises or scraps yet! Flat surfaces are best for getting started, but taking them to an area that has a slight hill really gives them the hang of picking up their feet for coasting.   Also, the seat height makes a big difference.  If it is too low then they can't pick up their feet easily. Most parents that I run it to say if they had known about balance bikes that they would have opted for this route.

product_title: The Original Big Wheel 16 Inch
review_body: With my daughter eagerly awaiting its assembly, I started to put the big wheel together.  Much to our dismay, one of the pieces was missing.  After calling the phone number and being told to go to the website, I found out that we had to wait 5-7 days before we would be contacted.  Rather than waiting, we returned it to the store.

product_title: InStep Ultra Runner 2 Double Jogging Stroller
review_headline: Great stroller at a great price
review_body: This is a great double jogger for a reasonable price.  I did get the discontinued model, which, oddly enough, had better features than the new one.  I wasn't sure initially how my 2 year old would take to a new stroller, but he loves it!  It's comfortable for them and easy for me to push (only 23 pounds).  I also love the large, adjustable sunshade.  I live in the southwest, and sun protection is a priority.  If you can find this model, I would definitely recommend it!

product_title: Planet Bike Women's Anatomic Comfort Gel Bicycle Saddle, Black
review_body: The saddle I received is much wider, more of a full-seat comfort-bike triangle than the racing style with a narrow front section as shown.  For a comfort-bike seat, I prefer the Cloud-9 brand, which I can ride on all day.  This one got uncomfortable after ten miles, but I had it on road bike, and it's really not the correct shape for that.

product_title: SKS Toolbox Travel 18-Function Bicycle Tool
review_headline: You get what you pay for !
review_body: The best !  I am a professional steel stair designer and fabricator, so I am very tuned in on mechanical tools of many kinds. This is why you can believe me when I tell you I do not know how, anyone could make a better tool-kit than this one !!! Quality Quality Quality !!!  Germans Do It Best !

product_title: U.S. Divers Cozumel Seabreeze Dry Proflex II Mask, Fins and Snorkel Set
review_body: Of course Amazon's order process and selection where superb. I received the item within 3 days of shipping and took it to the local pool to test it out. I am very happy with this product.

product_title: Prospector Moonshadow 8- by 8-Foot Dome Tent
review_body: I bought this tent to go to RenFest.  We camped out 2 nights and it was freezing cold both nights.  Once when I woke up, my fiance's feet were wet and freezing because they had been up against the tent wall.  There was dew all over the outside of the tent and every time we moved, some shook down on our faces!!  I'm not talking damp, but the walls were saturated.  Also, it made me nervous changing in there because i could see people through the mesh.  It was just big enough to fit a queen size air mattress, but not much else.  I have no idea how 3 or 4 people could fit in this. The zippers worked really well though, and the height wasn't bad, even with a double sized air mattress.

product_title: DVS Skate More Skateboarding DVD
review_headline: One of the Best Skate Videos in my collection
review_body: This is not your typical skate video. What sets it apart is that you get to listen to great music while watching the skaters demonstate their skills. The CD contains multiple songs that will become your favorites very quickly. My son and I have watched this video many times. The picture and sound quality is great. If you like this video you will also like the popular Skate Movie called \\"Grind\\" - I also give Grind 5 stars - Awesome !!

product_title: Victorinox Swiss Army One-Hand Trekker Lockblade Pocket Knife (Black),One Size
review_body:
This item was beyond my expectations. It is bigger than I thought it would be and it came with the blades super sharp. The locking mechanism on all the parts seemed quite sturdy and it is a great little tool. My husband is very pleased :)

It is a big big for a pocket knife, but it is well worth it to have around.

product_title: Transformer Optimus Prime 16-Inch Kids' Bike
review_headline: A bike your kid will like but limited quality for the price
review_body: My 5 year old son likes his new bike because it is a Transformer bike.  However, he does get frustrated by it's weight sometimes, especially trying to go up an incline. And I get frustrated because his seat is constantly crooked, and I can't seem to tighten it enough to make that stop happening.  All in all, I would say buy this bike if your kid is really into Transformers, but otherwise you are probably better off with something a bit better built.

product_title: AIRHEAD AHTK-P2 Deluxe Kayak Paddle 2 sect Alum 84" Curved Blade
review_body: This paddle has curved blades, durable foam grips, and is a two piece paddle.  These features and quality would cost 3 times as much in a sporting goods store.

product_title: iBert Safe-T Front Mounted Child Bicycle Seat
review_body: I have to admit I wasn't sure this was going to work good, I figured it would be difficult for my wife or myself to see over my son with him on the front. However, even for my wife who is only 5'3\\" its not a problem at all. My little one loves going for rides with us in his seat. It also seems to be safe. My wife once stumbled while getting off the bike and my son was held in securely and didn't get so much as a scratch.

product_title: Garrity Power Lite 3 LED Crank Light
review_body: I purchased the light and the switch worked only a few times, we hadn't even removed it from the packaging when it quit working.  I think I would have liked it but I really didn't get to find out because the switch quit working so quickly.

product_title: Wenzel Castle Rock 12- by 12-Foot Six-Person Family Cabin Dome Tent
review_body:
I am very happy with the tent. We've had it up 3xs now and each time I've liked it more. The height of the tent is wonderful as my partner can stand up at 6' and walk around without hunching over.

SIZE: There's just the two of us but we carry a lot of stuff. Last time we put up our two large cots, and we were still able to sit in our folding chairs in the middle and cook dinner on a small grill. If we'd of had a small table could have put put up.

SETUP: The tent is easy to set up, two people can take care of it in about 15mins. I like that the poles are easy to tell where they go and are strong. Whats great about the take down... you don't have to be a rolling/folding protogy to get it back in the bag, they actaully included a bag large enough for it to go back into. You can stake it if you like it'll help the sides stand out but they are not needed for structure. I would get some different spikes as the plastic ones arn't going to last long.

EXTRAS:I like the mat in front of the door as I steped out on it several times to grab a soda and didn't get my socks wet from the ground. This tent has a lot of breeze when the top is off as it's almost all mesh when you zip out the windows. The little net in the top was nice to put glasses and other breakables up, it also held a light well. Also the door is large enough to get in and out without having to fold yourself up, I really liked that.

I can't see a thing wrong with this tent, we call it the circus tent as its tall and square, plus our friends had to make fun of us as we have a huge tent and only two of us.

product_title: PlayWheels Kids First Skateboards
review_body: I didnt like that there was NOTHING on the actual skateboard. The spongebob is in the bottom. It is exactly as it is in the picture. We've had it for a few months and its still in good shape. If you are thinking about it, go for it, it'll make a great gift.

product_title: Kettler Spezi Bicycle Lifter
review_headline: Best Bike Hoist on the Market
review_body: I have tried almost all bike hoists on the market. The Racor is the cheapest at $21 and it works fine, but feels and looks budget.  The other brands have similar design to the Racor but cost more and really don't work any better (some say they can lift more weight, but they have the same mechanical advantage as the Racor at 4:1 -- so anything more than about 80lb is really too hard to lift anyway). The Kettler Spezi has a unique design. It is around $50 but it feels good, works smoothly, and has the best locking mechanism. If you must have quality, buy the Kettler.

product_title: Eureka! Copper Canyon 1512 - Tent (sleeps 12)
review_body: I was impressed with the large space inside the tent once assembled.  The tent was very easy to put up.  I did it alone in about 20 minutes on the first attempt.  It seems to allow for good air flow and held up well to relatively high winds the first night out.  This is not a great tent for early spring or late fall outings particularly in cooler parts of the country as it does not hold heat well.

product_title: Razor E300 Electric 24 Volt Motorized Ride On Kids Scooter
review_body: I bought this for my 10 year old son and he LOVES IT! Hasn't stopped riding it for three days! Much more fun that I expected it to be since even adults can ride this model. It's very responsive, good brakes, more sturdy then I thought it would be. An all around really fun scooter!

product_title: Cars 12-Inch Boys BMX Bike by Huffy
review_body: It is a nice bike. Pretty and firmly. But it is a little bit hard to drive.

product_title: Columbia Trailhead Disc Men's Mountain Bike
review_headline: Looks nice, have not ridden yet
review_body:
I purchased this bike in August and promptly started to assemble the bike. When I tried to attach the front brake rotor the 6 screw holes on the hub did not line up to the mounting spacer provided. I called the number on the waranty card (World Wide Cycle) and the person on the phone told me that I actully had voided the waranty by assembling the bike myself. It had to be assembled by a certified bike shop and that was printed on the outside of the shipping box. There is no such statment on the outside of the box.

I did email Columbia directly and explaned the problem. They promptly sent out another spacer and 6 bolts, That is why I gave them 3 stars and not 2. It turns out the hole pattern on the wheel hub is not spaced correctly when measured with a gauge. I am able to get 5 of the 6 bolts in the spacer.

Has anyone else had this problem?

This is my second bike. My first bike I purchased in 1994. I purchased it from a bike shop and road it very heavily. I am really impressed with the quality of this bike aside from the brake issue. I hope I can get it resolved as well.

product_title: Slumberjack Stowaway Camp Table (Black)
review_body: Table assembles quickly and is fairly sturdy for the price. I wanted a small table that packed into a size easily carried over the arm. It is the correct height for folding chairs or \\"captain's\\" chairs.

product_title: HIAEFIRE Q5 CREE 240 Lumen LED Bike Bicycle flashlight Torch +1 x Bicycle Holder +3 AAA batteries + dual charger
review_body:
This is a really great, bright, light-weight light.

My only qualm with it is the bracket is a bit finicky and sometimes needs to be messed with to be secure.

A

product_title: Suunto Vyper Wrist Computer
review_headline: Excellent computer for what it does
review_body:
I have had the Vyper for a few years now, and my only complaint is that it does not allow the use of multiple gases during a dive.

The display is laid out well and easy to view underwater, and I like it a lot better than the Oceanic Data Plus I used to have. On the surface you can easily review your dives or check O2/no deco limits for another dive. Of course, with the computer you do not use repetitive dive tables.

The Suunto dive manager software is a decent logbook and, if you provide a cylinder size and pressures before and after the dive, it will calculate your SAC rate. With the optional download cable you can view your dive profile on a computer afterwards.

The computer has a personal adjustment to make the algorithm more conservative if you are in a situation that increases DCS risk.

I would recommend this for all divers except serious technical divers. You can check out the manual and try a simulator at the Suunto website.

product_title: SPOT Personal Tracker
review_headline: It saved my life the day I got it!
review_body: It saved my life the day I got it!    I Cannot Believe The Spot Device Saved My Life The Day I Received It!     I am alive today! I work and ride ATV's with a great group of friends who all carry a Spot Device. It was an easy choice when I decided to buy the Spot Device, with all the positive words of so many on[...]  and my friends. For my birthday a group of us decided on an ATV trip a friend ranch in central Texas. I had ordered the Spot Device at the last minute, hoping the device would get to my house before we left. I was disappointed when I was told the Spot Device was not delivered to the house on Friday, knowing I was leaving early on Saturday morning. To my delight when I left the house at 5:00 am I noticed the package behind the pillar of the front porch. My Spot Device was delivered and now I had little time left to activate it. I logged in to the website and in no time at all my Spot Device was up and running. When the sun came up on my 28th birthday the dirt was flying at the ranch. We rode for 4 to 5 hours before lunch. After lunch we headed down to a creek where the 12 of us were ridding and within 10 minutes of getting wet and muddy at the creek I collided with another rider in mid air. After everybody stopped and realized what happened I had already pressed the 911 button on my device. Some people in the group tried to call 911 and others pressed their 911 buttons. Due to our location no one had cell coverage. A group of riders rode back to the house to call from the house line. To their surprise the 911 operator had spoken to the Spot Operators and Fire and Ambulance services were in route to our location. After the Fire Department arrived I was air lifted to a trauma center. Even though there was more than one device activated mine was the first received by the Spot Operators. The timely notification and fast response of the Fire Department and Life Flight saved my life. Emergency Services give the credit to the Spot Operators for their fast andaccurate notification and location of the incident. My Family was also notified and was in communication with the Spot Operators thru the entire ordeal. I cannot thank them enough.    I Still Cannot Believe The Spot Device Saved My Life The Day I Received It!

product_title: Schwinn Free Wheeler Jogging Stroller
review_headline: Everything you need at half the price
review_body:
For those of you who want a great go anywhere stroller, but can't wrap your mind around paying $300-500 for a BOB Revolution - this is your stroller. It's easy to put together, has plenty of storage, easy to push, and most importantly to us, easy to steer. We had a fixed front wheel stroller before this one, and got fed up with constantly having to raise the front wheel to make a turn. Now with the swivel wheel, we feel comfortable taking it into the grocery store, which is very convenient!

Pros:

*Swivel wheel - unless you do a lot of distance running with your stroller a swivel front wheel is a must.

*Canopy - Provides good coverage, and can be detached at the top so it can pivot down in front of your child - important when walking towards the sunrise/sunset

*Storage - Huge bin below, zippered pocket behind child, parent tray, kid tray.

*Adjustable handle - I'm 6'2, wife is 5'2, works great for both of us.

*Kid tray - It's easily removed if your little one won't use it yet, but makes such a huge difference for our 2yo - sometimes we'll go for a walk, just so she'll eat something!

*Easy to assemble - You'll have it ready to use within 7 minutes of taking it out of the box. Also means it's easy to break down to pack for a trip or store.

*Weight - Lighter than most similar strollers at the same price range. Perhaps a touch heavier than the expensive strollers - but not much.

Cons

*Quality - If you can't afford a BOB Revolution or other high-end stroller, don't go try one - you will notice a difference. The Freewheeler lacks the polish of the BOB, and some of the features aren't as easy to use. That said, the Freewheeler will do everything the BOB does at half the price.

*Folding Mechanism - While it folds relatively easily in a single motion, you will probably struggle with it a little bit. With practice you will do fine - but if you plan toput the stroller in the back of your car more than once a day, you may want to think twice. It's just kinda klunky and awkward when compared to the $300 strollers.

*Seat angle - My kid is 2, and has no troubles - but if you have an infant you will have to improvise some padding to make your child comfortable.

I have no doubt that this is by far THE BEST jogger-stroller for the money. Now you just have to ask yourself: How much are you willing to pay for something better? Unless the answer is nearly double, I'd pick the Schwinn Freewheeler.

product_title: Giro Skyla Sport Bike Womens Helmet
review_headline: Great entry helmet, but its small so check sizing carefully
review_body: Having owned many Giro helmets, and currently having a high end model, this is an excellent Giro for the price.  The expensive models really give you huge vent openings, but this one is pretty good.  The styling is excellent and the dial fit adjustment is comparable to the RocLoc system of the higher models.  If you need a nice bike helmet at a good price, this is certainly a great choice.      However, make sure you measure your head!  This is listed as a universal fit Womens model, which is a total joke.  I bought this for my 3 year old daughter, who has a head that measures more than mid-way in the fit range, and it fits her great.  On the other hand, my wife who wears a medium Giro Monza, a not-uncommon size for many women, could never fit into this helmet and it almost looks like she's trying to fit a kids helmet on her head.  Obviously this will fit many women, but don't read \\"universal sizing\\" and order without measuring your head. The Skyla fit range is 50 to 57 cm.  In comparison, a medium Giro helmet is 55-59cm (Roc-loc limits) because it also has a larger shell.  By the way, the Giro Flume children's specific model has the same fit range of the Skyla of 50-57cm, and the Giro Rodeo toddler helmet is 50-55 cm.    When a Womens helmet has almost the same range as a toddler helmet, you know Giro is trying to limit the number of women who will fit into this helmet, forcing many to move up to the more expensive models that come in sizes; and there are some good reasons to buy the expensive models like fit, Roc-Loc system quick adjustability, and increased air flow.         But if your head fits, its a great helmet at a good budget-friendly price.

product_title: Schwinn Hope Jogging Stroller
review_headline: Great jogging stroller for the price
review_body: Bought this jogging stroller after borrowing an old Babyjogger from a friend.  I did a good deal of shopping around and even talked to a service rep. from another company about some of their options.  This stroller was priced right and had most of the featutres I wanted (no clock, but few jogging strollers have them).      PROS:  As a bonus, it has a rain shield is permanently zipped into the sunshade so it is fast to deploy and you don't have to spend extra to buy one.  It was easy to assemble even for my non-direction-reading husband. The wheels are smooth running and the adjustable height handle is great.  I had a brief problem with it pulling right but adjusting it was super easy (even on the road without my manual).  The big wheels and shocks make sidewalk bumps a breeze -- SO much better than a conventional stroller. It is a bit difficult to steer at low speeds (walking) but all you really have to do is push down on the handle to lift the front wheel and it turns easily.  It's not made for the mall, so don't expect it to be suited for that application! I didnt' want a swivel wheel, because they can sometimes jam on bumps.  The 2 break options are great as is the leash.  I can let go of the stroller when jogging and have no problem reeling it back in.  The rear wheel break system is very easy to use and quite firm.  Much better than the front only break on my friend's jogger and better than the break on my full sized Graco as well.  When it's on it's on and you can't push the stroller at all. Finally, I think that when it's all folded up it may be almost exactly the same size as my full sized stroller making it just as easy (or not easy) to take on trips. My 14 month old likes the padded seat -- she rests her head on the side comfortably while we walk or jog.  I like the zip pocket in the back for wallet and cell phone.  The parent tray is a nice bonus as well that is not available on all strollers.   I like the mesh back.  I think it will allow more air through in the hot and humid days of summer.      CONS:  I do agree with others that the basket underneath is hangs too low and am trying to think of a way to rig it so it might carry heavier stuff.  The design problem is that it is hung on a wire loop that is only secured at the front of the stroller and has no support by the back wheels.  I have not had any problems with it, but am concerned that if I put a few water bottles in it it pr something heavy it would bottom out on bumps.  The hip belt seems snug even on my 14 month old -- I'll look into adjusting that better but I'm not sure it does.  The sun shade tends to not look as crisp on mine as it does in the picture.  Maybe it will settle in over time.  I have run with this a few times and it is quite comfortable.      Summary:  This is a great jogging stroller for the money.  It has almost replaced our full-sized Graco stroller for walks around the neighborhood, the park, and camping. Well worth the money if you are trying to get back in shape or want a smoother ride for baby.

product_title: Bell Night Trail Bicycle Light Set
review_body:
For the price, this light is hard to beat. Over the years, I have used approximately twenty different bicycle lights by brands such as Cateye, Cygolite and Planet Bike. While some of these were significantly better than the Bell, they were also three to ten times as expensive. If you don't mind the large mass of four AA batteries on your handlebars and have under twenty dollars to spend, the Bell Night Trail bicycle light is the way to go.

The real downside to having the batteries in the enclosure is the hazard created when the housing becomes dislodged during an impact. While this has not happened with the Bell light, it did occur with a Planet Bike light while riding through traffic in NYC. The distraction was extremely dangerous. Losing half of the batteries was not fun either.

Fortunately, the Bell light has a sturdy enclosure where the top half slides backwards to open. This makes it almost impervious to front and vertical impacts. However, the internal latches never quite give you a clear indication that it is closed. Rather, you must squeeze the top downward and push forward simultaneously until you can't move it further.

Much like the headlight, the taillight compares well to more expensive lights. Similar to competing products, it has various blinking modes as a well as an always-on setting. Due to the design of the lens, light escapes from the sides and top of the light. Such side lighting is crucial for riding in urban areas.

The build quality is good but not on par with the $100+ lighting systems. But again, the selling point of this light is overall value. Some of the nicer features include a bright Xenon bulb paired with miserly LED lights that can blink for hours. Unlike some of the MR11-based bulbs (parabolic track lighting bulbs), the lens assembly has two ports on the right and left sides. This spreads light perpendicularly to the path of travel, which is a nice feature when in traffic. These features combined with a very modest price make this light an excellent choice for the budget conscious.

Pros

Value

Brightness

Combination of LED and Xenon modes

Decent build quality

Side lighting on headlight

Cons

Questionable design of battery compartment (top half of headlight)

Bulky
