Love the easily adjustable seat. I added a wicker basket in front and a rack on the back.  The handle grips are comfortable, too. It's perfect. If you're thinking about buying this bike, go for it.

product_title: Katadyn Microfilter Bottle
review_body: We used this bottle on a trip to  Asia.  It was easy to use.  We  can not vouch for the effectiveness,  but we had no ill effects from the  water that was filtered by the  bottle.

product_title: Bell Gel Relief Bicycle Seat Cover
review_body: I purchased this product about 2 weeks ago. The first problem that I experienced was that it did not fit my mountain bike's seat. I had to change the seat so that it fits. It did not fit as I thought it would be. When I ride my bike, the front of of the gel cover moves from right to left and vice versa. Also, the gel cover moves forward and backward. What I suggest is, before you purchase this product, make sure that it will fit your seat. Otherwise, you will have wasted your money.

product_title: Dora Adjustable Quad Skate Size 1-4
review_headline: GREAT SKATES FOR FIVE YEAR OLD
review_body: Our daughter loved these skates- they roll good, but not too fast and of course they are Dora!

product_title: All-Weather Blue/Gray Rain Jacket With Pouch Elastic Wristbands Drawstring Waist GFRAINML
review_body: I guess you get what you pay for.  Ended up not using it at all for the rain in Kauai.  I was looking for something lightweight and it is.  So, maybe I shouldn't complain.  It simply was very plastic-like is the only way I can explain it.

product_title: Eureka! Sunrise 9 -Tent (sleeps 4-5)
review_body: We bought this tent to use on RAGBRAI - the Bicycle tour that crosses Iowa with 15,000 - 20,000 riders during the last full week of July each year.  It worked well.  We needed a tent that could be erected quickly, and taken down almost as quickly, and this worked well.  We had researched for a tent for this specific use, and decided on the 9x9 Sunrise, as being large enough for two people and all their gear for a week of erecting and then packing -- traveling across Iowa with a new campsite each evening, and the gear to be loaded each morning on a Ryder truck and unloaded each afternoon, by a crew who toss the gear from the truck to color coded piles.    The tent erected in 5 minutes, if both my husband and I were working, and this included staking the loops out.  Inside we had a double bed air matress, 3 large duffle bags, two portable folding captains chairs and an open bag that held our linens (pillows, towels, light weight sleeping bags, and sheets).  There was still room to get around the matress inside, and the gear loft came in handy to lay out our wet biking clothes to dry, by bedtime.  The tent allows you to stand up, which makes it easier to get around inside.  There are large screen windows, protected by the rain cover, which worked out well for ventilation.   Taking the tent down took a little longer, but it was not a noisy project, which was important, because we liked to be on our bikes by 5:30 am, and so wanted the packing process to go smoothly and quietly so we wouldn't bother our camping neighbors, and it did.    It rained on us several nights, but the tent dried out quickly when set up the next afternoon.  We stayed dry inside, as did all our stuff - hi humidity not withstanding.  We also had one night with gale force winds when we were awakened at 2:15 and all herded into the county fair buildings for safety.  The tent came through it fine.  The winds in Harlan were gusting to 50 mph.  As we biked to Jefferson we saw plenty of trees and limbs down, and a few empty grain bins blown over from that storm (the winds in this area were worse).  I would buy the same tent again, for what we used it for - and we saw several others very similar to it in the campgrounds, so we weren't the only ones who had decided that this was a practical tent to have for RAGBRAI.  A fellow team member came over (Pottawamie Pedalers, 86 members rode the whole week) and asked us about it, and decided it was what he wanted to have next year, when he does RAGBRAI again.

product_title: Schwinn Midmoor Men's Hybrid Bike (700c Wheels)
review_body: Overall this bike is a great value. Relatively light weight for its price and easy to assemble.  There is very minimal assembly needed, which means much of the bike is pre-assembled.    If you're not comfortable doing it yourself, I would suggest having a shop take a look and tweak the brakes & gear shift as I found that it isn't overly ideal.    Not to mention with a new bike it is a good idea after the first month to bring it in to get the brakes adjusted (brake cables stretch).    Everything is great except for the seat. They definitely could've put a more comfortable seat on this thing, however you get what you pay for and that would have increased the pricetag on this otherwise good city bike.

product_title: TETON Sports Celsius XXL -18C/0F Sleeping Bag
review_body: Great sleeping bag, buy both the left and right and zip them togther, they work great and keep you very warm.  Great product!

product_title: Coleman Tent Light
review_body: This little light is great for the tent...lights up everything.  It says that it runs off 4 AA batteries, but I can take two of the batteries and it still lights up...just as bright.  I think that this light is a great buy for camping trips.

product_title: Humvee 15 Million Candlepower Searchlight 110volt Camping Flashlights

product_title: Delta Cezanne 4-Bike/Multi-Use Storage Rack
review_body: The product was extremely easy to setup and assemble. It took me about 30 minutes to assemble the storage rack and hangup the bike.     Pros: Easy to assemble, light     Cons: Seems abit flimsy and shaky, and a little to high for a standard garage

product_title: Darn Tough Hiker Micro Crew Cushion Socks - Men's
review_headline: Darn good socks made in the USA.
review_body: I wanted to buy some boot socks made in the USA if possible and this is one of several I tried. These are made out of merino wool. They are crew length which is an inch shorter than their regular boot sock. These are the \\"cushion\\" version which have extra thickness in heel. They also make a \\"full-cushion\\" sock. I wear these with boots like the Danner Explorer which is also made in the USA and highly recommended. Please read my review of the Darn Tough Nordic ultra-light for more information. Bottom line, wool is good and so are these socks.

product_title: Allen Sports Deluxe 4-Bike Hitch Mount Rack
review_headline: Great rack, but caution for Toyota Sienna...
review_body: The bike rack is great.  It's easy to put together, and just as easy to work.  Only issue has been that it comes within centimeters of the back of our Toyota Sienna (with an after-market hitch from Uhaul).  We've put some rubber cushioning between the rack and the Sienna that should solve it, but if you've got a Sienna - be warned.

product_title: Eureka External Frame Screen House
review_body: This is a nice screen room but there is no provision for guy lines.  Ours blew down in a brisk breeze and broke three of the poles.  We are currently waiting to see if Eureka will replace them.

product_title: Thule T2 2-Bike Hitch Mount Rack
review_body: Debated on what style rack and decided that this was the best option for me. Being a mt. biker this was my choice for the ease of transporting. Mt bikes have all sorts of frame designs and shock placements. Buddy has a roof rack and seemed more of a pain than I wanted. Researched and decided on this. Putting it together wasn't bad. Not difficult to remove from the car. A little heavy but easier than my Thule Speedway. Another reason is the 2 bike add on which I also purchased. Works great. Also bought the locks to protect my investment. Real happy with everything.

product_title: Therm-a-Rest Compressible Pillow (Advantage Max 4HD,Medium)
review_body: This is really a great product for camping and it was on sale. The more you fluf and knead it with you're fingers, the better it gets.

product_title: Razor Pocket Mod Miniature Euro Electric Scooter
review_body: My daughter absolutely loves her scooter.  The body is all plastic, and the box arrived damaged.  Some of the plastic was cracked.  I called the company and they sent some of the replacement parts.  I will be calling them again to get the parts they missed. (I was very specific in the parts I needed, yet they sent some of the wrong ones.)  Razor was very receptive to fixing the problem, though.    Overall, it was exactly what my daughter wanted for Christmas, and she is thrilled with it.

product_title: Razor MX500 Dirt Rocket Electric Motocross Bike
review_body: WE purchased this bike as a gift for my 10 year old son as his main Christmas present. He got on to ride his new bike on Christmas morning and the Razor did not work properly. We evaluated all of the troubleshooting scenarious on the website. From everything we can tell the rear wheel is not engaging. The motor drives the chain does not engage the wheel to produce momentum. We are very dissatisfied at this moment.

product_title: Razor A Kick Scooter
review_body:
This is my secret: I bought this scooter for my son when he was 5. He didn't know how to ride a bike, but he quickly learned how to balance on the scooter. I figured that if he could balance on a scooter, we could transfer that knowledge to his bike so we took the training wheels off his bike. What a great transition! He learned how to ride his bike by learning to balance on his scooter!

We now have another son who's 3. He's now able to balance on his scooter and we'll be taking off his training wheels soon!

All three of my kids love their scooters. It's nice that the scooters come in different colors for them. It's nice for me b/c I know who gets in trouble for leaving theirs outside. ;)

product_title: U.S. Divers Hydrosplit II Fins
review_headline: Perfect for a vacation once a year
review_body: We got these fins for my wife before our three week trip to the Caribean.  During our vacation we snorkeled or scuba dived every day.  These fins held up fine for both activities.  They are very flexible and short in length, good for manuvering around in small areas, i.e. near a boat with lots of people.  Obviously, larger fins are much better for long distances, i.e. large coves. Easiest way to think about these fins is compared to a bike gears.  These fins are good if your kick style is fast, like Lance Armstrong going up a hill.  Large fins are better for long, flat streches and strong leg muscles.    The selling point for these fins is that they are cheap.  If they get stolen off the beach or lost during a flight, we really didn't care.  In fact, we thought about just leaving them at the hotel rather than lugging them back home. Ideal for kids under 16.

product_title: Flybar Foam Master Pogo Stick
review_headline: Works great and logged 1000's of flawless jumps in the first month
review_body:
We got this for our son, and what a hit!

He loves it and bounces till his heart content.

Highly recommend it.

product_title: Tech 4 O Accelerator Women's Hiker Watch
review_headline: Exercise Enthusiast With So Little Time
review_body: I would have rated the product 5 stars as far as quality, but the reviews that I read berfore ordering were correct - the instructions were complex for setting up the device. As one comfortable with computers and am not intimadated by things such as this I took a chance.  I could have figured the instructions out if I had enough time, but it just was not worth it to me - I would rather be out walking or hiking than trying to figure it out so I returned it.

product_title: Giro Indicator Sport Bike Helmet
review_body: I really like the look of this helmet because my old Bell helmet made me look like a dork. This helmet is light, highly affordable, streamlined, fits very well and is easily adjusted. I highly recommend this helmet to anyone who is looking to not have to take a second mortgage out just to buy a great helmet.

product_title: Victorinox Swiss Army Swisstool Spirit Multi-tool Plus Free Pocket Knife
review_body:
I just received mine after ordering from Amazon (after waiting almost a month!). It's a very solid tool, and it's lighter than the comparable Leatherman, which I was also considering. My only two complaints are that the scissors are very small - moreso than my previous Swiss Army Knife that was significantly smaller - and the knife is the combo-blade without a sharp point. Rating this tool down one star for this might be too much, though.

Locking tools are very nice, the case looks nice, and the bonus mini-knife is a good addition too.

product_title: Blackburn Mountain Air Mountain Bike Pump
review_body:
This pump is great I filled my 26'' tires in about 4 to 6 minutes it was very easy, unexpectedly. The pump is super light and it mounts to your bike frame under the water bottle cage the Velcro strap however should be checked every few day of regular use it does have a tendency to loosen a little as your calf occasionally bumps it.

This makes Cartridges useless it's reusable and probably weighs the same as 3 or 4 cartridges.

product_title: Dora the Explorer Plush Backpack Bag
review_body: I am very pleased with the product, the speedy delivery,and buying through Amazon and their vendors. Will always check with Amazon before buying elsewhere.

product_title: Topeak Explorer Bicycle Rack with Disc Brake Mounts
review_body: This product works well with my bike that has disc brakes. It was hard to find a rack for this type of brakes. I did have to alter the installation by removing extra screw on brakes and then using supplied screw to replace from opposite side.

product_title: Mountain Boy Sledworks Bambino Grande Pull Sled
review_headline: This is such a wonderful sled!!!!
review_body: Looking for some good exercise with a toddler, I decided that a walk, snowshoe, or cross-country ski would be great with a sled like this!    Boy was I right!  This sled is so smooth over the snow, both packed and powder.  Getting back from our 1 mile journey, my 20 month old said, \\"again!\\".    I really can't believe what a great sled this is.  We are definately going to buy more Mountain Boy sleds in the future!

product_title: Sigg Bottle Grip for Baby and Kids Water Bottles (0.3/0.4-Liters)
review_headline: Works like it is supposed to.
review_body: Handles work as expected for the Sigg bottle. No complaints and they make my daughters Sigg easier to carry around and drink out of.

product_title: Coleman Crestline Dome Tent (9-Feet,10-Inch x 7-Feet)
review_body: I purchased this tent from a local sporting goods store about 5 years ago.  It has been used on several weekend camping trips, first with my son, and now with my daughter.  We are in the YMCA Adventure Guide/Princess program.  The tent has been great, it still looks almost as good as new.  Granted, we have not encountered any really severe weather, but it stood tall through several pretty windy (30-35mph) nights.  I would recommend this tent for no more than two adults, or 1 adult and two younger kids.  It is not a 4 person tent.  Me, one of my kids and all our gear is perfect.  If your crew is the right size, this is the right tent.

product_title: Eureka! Solar Shade Large - Beach Shelter
review_body: We just received this tent for an upcoming trip. I was at first a bit frustrated putting it together and then realized the key is to always push the tent poles into the sleeves, and out of the sleeves. Once you work out a technique for that the tent is great. Easy putting up and getting down. The windows could use a better method to fasten them shut. The tent does have nice features like a small clothes line and mesh pouches to keep items out of the sand. My kids love it and all in all it was a good buy.

product_title: Crazy Creek Crazy Legs Beach Chair
review_body: Fantastic, nothing better for a Saturday afternoon in Central Park. It's super light, comfortable to sit on despite the fact that it is so small. I am 5.8\\" and it works for me. Great product, great price.

product_title: Deluxe Rio Aluminum Backpack Chair with Large Storage Pouch
review_body: This chair is fabulous for packing stuff in and out of the beach or wherever I happen to be going.  It holds a decent amount of stuff, is light weight and is comfortable enough that my kids do well with it on their backs too.  The quality is great and the height is very comfortable.  My only complaint is the head rest.  I find it hard and awkward and usually throw it over the back of the chair to get it out of the way.  I think it would be nicer if it were smaller and softer.

product_title: Alps Mountaineering Camp Chair
review_headline: Go on and Sit on it! :)
review_body:
This is a sturdy, well made-chair, and I believe it is adequate for brief sitting sessions. However, for larger people, sturdy is not the only consideration. This chair would have been a stellar product if the seat was wider--about four inches wider and the arm rests at least angled differently for comfort. It's better than most products; however, it missed its mark by one star. (June 2007)

______
***UPDATED: June 21, 2008. Above was my original assessment (old review) of the chair just on limited first use. After having this product for a while now--over a year, I have changed my mind! It has lasted very well, and it has held up to a lot of use--big folks and squirming little ones alike. The chair still looks nice, and it has maintained its \\"seatability\\" and comfort. My father, who is 70 and a biggish fellow, loves the chair, and he usually makes a bee-line for it when outside--hahaha. First come, first seated! His chair of choice among all our outdoor furniture. He's been known to sit in it for hours on our porch, just watching the birds and squirrels playing in the yard.

product_title: Klean Kanteen Stainless Steel Water Bottle
review_body:
The Klean Kanteen water bottles are competitive in features and quality with the higher-priced, more familiar product. If you fill one with water, chill it down and drink from it you would not know which brand of water bottle you were using. The appearance and heft is the same as well.

I bought three along with the sport top and gave them as holiday gifts. They were well received!

product_title: Topeak QR Beam Rack MTX Bicycle Rack
review_body: Great rack.  Simple, yet effective.  I like the quick release function; easy on and off but stable when in place.

product_title: Coleman Retro Rechargeable Battery Powered Lantern (Family Size)
review_body: Bright red makes this electric lantern just as cheerful as a gas-powered lamp, despite its cold fluorescent bulb.  I feel this is much safer for my family than anything with a flame.  Has three positions: high, low, and night light, which includes a yellow bug light.

product_title: Coleman Two-Burner Power Pack Stove
review_body: Big camping stove, easily accomodate any multi person camping needs, especially great is the griddle, and instant start. Love it!

product_title: Tovatec Aluminum Torch Flashlight
review_body: excellent backup flashlight for night diving - well made, bright, small. O-rings and the body looks very water-proof. The switch is a bit difficult to operate in gloves. Takes two lithium photo batteries - they are quite cheap on the Internet.

product_title: Thule 883 Glide & Set Rooftop Kayak Carrier
review_body:
This is a great product. I have 2 17 foot kayaks. One is narrower than the other, these adjust to the size of each one.
Easy to instal on the base rack. If you are using a bunch of different thule racks, one might want to have a separate set for just kayaks. I have mine set in place and I can get the entire rack off the car with the bars and the crossroad towers without having to reajust the settings of the kayak rack. I can put the rack and the boats on the car and have them tied down in 10 minutes.

product_title: Victorinox SwissMemory 256 MB (Silver Alox)
review_body: Used it as a gift to a groomsman, and he loved it. Good product, good sale.

product_title: iBert Safe-T Front Mounted Child Bicycle Seat
review_body: Our 15 month old daughter LOVES this bike seat.  She stands at the back door and says \\"bike?\\" (one of her first words) and can't wait to ride.  We love having her in the front.  It's almost too comfortable for her...she actually fell asleep on the way home from one long bike ride. It's comfortable for us too.  Neither my husband (6'4\\") nor I (5'4\\") bump our knees on the seat. We got 2 stinger assemblies to quickly switch the seat between bikes. I highly recommend this seat.

product_title: VISKEY Unisex Smart Touch Screen Warm Winter Gloves
review_body: These are great fingerless mittens and were exactly what I was looking for--Stretchy, comfortable, warm, and serve my purpose.  The only problem is that the edges of the fingers aren't reinforced very well and began to unravel the day I got them. But for the super price, I will sit with my hot chocolate in front of the TV and reinforced them myself.

product_title: Bell Bike Trunk Rack
review_body: The rack didn't fit my bicycle, which suprised me because i have a pretty standard trail riding bike.  The arms were too far apart to fit inside the frame, and there was no way to adjust it.  I didn't even try to see if it would fit on my car once i saw that it wouldn't hold my bike.

product_title: LEKI Mountain Trek Super Makalu Ergometric Long Poles (Pair)
review_body: And hopefully the last.  These are fantastic.  They're light, comfortable, easy to adjust.  I have bad knees and without poles, any hike with a pack will kill me.  I'll take these on any back country trip I take from now on.  Well worth the cash.

product_title: Lance Armstrong Performance Program Book
review_headline: This book fired me up... and should fire you up too
review_body: In fact, I referenced it in my book.  As a serious adventure racer, I wanted to learn what Lance did.  As a business coach I wanted to learn what Chris did.  I urge you to read this book!  Doug Gray, PCC, author of Passionate Action, 5 Steps to Creating Extraordinary Success in Life and Work (2007)[[ASIN:0975884158 Passionate Action: 5 Steps to Extraordinary Success in Life and Work]]

product_title: Disney Princess Micro Bicycle Helmet and Protective Pad Value Pack (Toddler)
review_body: The product features and image indicate \\"one helmet, one pair of knee pads and one pair of elbow pads.\\" I was a little disappointed to only receive one pair of pads that could be used for either knee or elbow. I guess the picture does say more to what you are actually getting. Other than that, it has been a great product.

product_title: Schwinn Adult Comfort Gel Bicycle Saddle
review_body: It looked wider than it is. It is not any wider than the seat that came with my bike.

product_title: Klean Kanteen Stainless Steel Water Bottle
review_body: This is a great choice if you want to get away from plastic toxins. The taste of the water is a huge improvement over plastic too. Everything reaches room temperature faster than in plastic so the \\"cozies\\" might be in order if that matters.

product_title: Kettler Flipper Bicycle Seat
review_headline: Flipper seat by Kettler is the best out there
review_body: I bought the Kettler Flipper seat after doing tons of research into bike seats for my then 14-month old daughter.  I decided on this one and am so glad I did.  She loves riding in this...the suspension system is somewhat unique and so she gets a nice comfortable ride--she even falls asleep in it!  It feels solid and is made very well.  The best features are: 1) reclining seat great for catnaps; 2) it has an adjustable seat height, which is good if your child is taller like mine; 3) has a higher weight limit of compared to alot of other ones I'd seen; 4) adjustable-length footrests with Velcro straps to prevent child from kicking you, 5) easily and quickly switches from one bike to another without needing to use any tools, provided you've also purchased and installed the additional mounting hardware, 6)there's a lap bar that the child can hold for extra stability and you can mount a stationary toy to (don't attach anything with a long tether that could catch in the wheels).  Negatives:  I don't really care for the cutesy blue print on the seating pad, and it's on the pricey side.  But I guess that's the price you pay for safety and quality.  Some reviews I'd read said that there was a problem with attaching this to certain types of women's mountain bikes, but I had no problem at all, and I have a 14.5\\" women's mtn. bike.  FYI, Kettler also makes a line of amazing tricycles for tots, which we also purchased.  All in all, one of my better investments into baby/child equipment.

product_title: Kent Ultra Light Magnesium Compact Folding Bike
review_headline: A decent bike for the price, but...
review_body: I got this bicycle to be able to ride approx. 1 mile from where I park my car to my work to save some time. The bike came pretty much preassembled, but like others mentioned it needed some adjusting/tightening (shifter, brakes, some screws). There was nothing wrong with it and it did not get damaged during shipping. It also rode fairly well for something this size, although as others mentioned - it was quite slow (uphill people pass me walking :/).    I did end up returning this bike. You might not be ready for it when you order, but what I couldn't take (and didn't quite think about it) was the laugh factor. If you have no objection walking around without your pants wearing a pink beret on your head then this bike is for you. If however you do mind people laughing out loud at you like they saw a circus clown on a child bike (and that is how you are going to look like) then perhaps you should reconsider. One guy almost crashed his car passing me because his eyes got full of tears from laughing - at me. I decided I'd rather wear pastel pink beret than ride it again... But that was me.    So like I say, the bike technically is nice, the ride is decent, it's light, and the price is more than fair. But if you can't see yourself as a circus mascot then I suggest you move on.

product_title: Coleman Translucent Twin Quickbed with 4D Pump
review_body: i bought this for a guest visit. the air mattress has to be pumped every night, or it goes soft. i don't think it is that great if the user would have to refill it nightly. also the battery powered air pump is not very convenient, since buying and re-buying batteries is an additional cost to the user.     i think i will have to return it. am kind of disappointed, since it's not as amazing as the reviews portrayed.

product_title: Bell Ride 'N Haul Rear Bike Rack
review_body:
I was afraid this item would not hold or be very sturdy...but it is. The part that attaches to your bike frame and runs under the rack part is metal and the rack part is made of plastic. I have put my backpack full of books on it and it held it just fine.

You just may need an additional cargo net to hold larger items as the one that comes with it will only hold a few things. Plus it serves as a mud gard!!

product_title: Giro Indicator Sport Bike Helmet
review_body: This helmet is easy to adjust to get a good fit. It is also light and you hardly notice that you're wearing a helmet once you start riding.

product_title: Victorinox Swiss Army Classic SD Pocket Knife, Cobalt Blue
review_body: I am very impressed with your service and your products. Thank-you for helping me to complete my Christmas Shopping. RJP

product_title: Klean Kanteen with Sports Cap, (27 oz)
review_headline: KLEAN KANTEEN 27 OZ WITH SPORTS CAP
review_body: I LIKE THIS ITEM, BUT SWEATS WITH COLD WATER, ALSO DOESNT KEEP WATER VERY COLD..BUT IF YOU JUST WANT WATER IN STAINLESS STEEL INSTEAD OF PLASTIC ITS A GREAT OPTION.

product_title: ALPS Mountaineering Camp Cot (Large)
review_body: It's nice and sturdy and very taught.  Sometimes tough to get the crossbar into it.  And its BIG.  Didn't fit in the tent I planned to use it in.  Barely fits in the Boy Scout canvas tents at summer camp.  Wish it was a bit shorter for my uses.  If you've got the space, I recommend this cot.

product_title: Super Pogo 1505 Pogo Stick
review_body: Tis a great pogo if you're a little older or a little bigger....try to be over 150 lbs. if you want to get some serious air. This pogo is very strong...probably the strongest on the market. But, I have seen a couple of these break. It just depends what you are going to do with them. Mine broke because of the tricks I was trying to do. But If you just want to have fun bouncing and you're too big for those bite size pogos....get this one!

product_title: Intex Pillow Rest Raised Airbed with Built-in Pillow and Electric Pump
review_body: My grandson loved sleeping on this blow up bed, he said it was so comfortable. It's a great idea if you need xtra guest beds, because it deflates and stores so easily. It takes about 3 or 4 minutes to inflate.  I would recommend this product highly.

product_title: High Sierra Carry-On Laptop Tote
review_body: purchased this bag for a new laptop and accessories. Bag and it's functionality turned out to be better then I expected. well laid out. Lots of space. quick access back zipper to access just laptop works great. you can really load this bag up with lots of other books and files along with laptop and it holds up great. pretty comfortable to carry for this type of bag. I buy again in a second.

product_title: Wenzel Insta-Flex Queen Size Airbed with Pump
review_body: It leaks,junk

product_title: InStep Take 2 Double Bicycle Trailer
review_body:
I bought it for my son so we could all go on rides together. He is 9 months old and he fits in it fine. i wouldn't suggest putting anybody younger in it though because it has your kid sit pretty upright and younger kids tend to slump. it rides good and it connected to our schwinn bike pretty easy. i couldn't even tell it was back there until i went uphill.
the reason its 3 stars is because the top part buttons up instead of zips which makes it harder to get to your kid quickly, the seatbelt buckles are a pain to get off, and the seatbelts really rub your kids neck raw. also when he gets older i can tell that if he sticks his feet in a certain spot the bottom will rub on the ground.

product_title: Slumberjack Cabin Wrap - Elk
review_body: Some of the snaps were put on backwards and would not close so I returned it.[[ASIN:B000NO5OWW Slumberjack Fleece Cabin Wrap - Elk Blanket]]

product_title: Wenger Heritage Collection Strudel Youth Daypack
review_body: Bought this 3 years ago as a compact diaper bag/purse.  Have used it as a purse ever since.  Wonderful compartments. Sturdy construction. Non-seasonal color. Perfect size for all my everyday needs.

product_title: Razor Pro Model Scooter
review_headline: A fun way to spend time with kids!
review_body: I remember when the Razor scooters first came out and I have this idea they were fairly pricey at the time.  Well, they are very inexpensive now and if you weigh more than 143 lb you will need the Pro model.  Everyone in our family has one and we happily scoot all over the neighborhood on weekends!

product_title: Yakima 8002401 Kingpin 4
review_body: I have been using this bike rack for about one month now and have no regrets with my purchase.  I researched bike racks for about six months before buying and I felt this Yakima rack offered the best quality of any on the market.    When the rack is folded down it stores away very neatly in the garage.  It is fairly lightweight, so carrying it out to mount on my SUV is very easy.  The mounting straps are the most rugged I've found and most bikes are very easy to get up onto the bar.  Small to Medium-sized kids' bikes seem to present the biggest challenge - they are too small for the bars to fit between the bike tubes.

product_title: Columbia Bugaboo Four to Five-Person Family Dome Tent
review_body: Tent met all expectations for the $, plus. Easy to assemble, easy to dismantle...great air flow, easy access. Well designed tent fly. More then comfortable for (3) using cots or (5) on floor using sleeping bags. GREAT buy for the $ which included shipping.     Had an easy loading storage bag and a few extra goodies not noted in the advertisement.

product_title: Razor E100 Electric Scooter
review_body: Xmas gift for 6 yr old daughter.  She was able to use it the next day  and loved it.  Perfect for her size and weight.  An older or heavier   child would want something above the E100.

product_title: Allen Sports Deluxe 4-Bike Hitch Mount Rack (2-Inch Receiver)
review_body: Easy assembly and mounting plus is very secure in carrying bikes though would suggest a lock for the mounting pin to keep it from disappearing.

product_title: Wenger Mt. Generoso Technical 4200 Cubic Inch Internal Frame Backpack (Dark Green/Taupe/Black)
review_body: Got this as I have been doing more traveling during the weekends and wanted a bigger backpack then my daypack but not as large as my normal hiking pack. This fit the job perfectly.

product_title: JanSport 8-Track Messenger Bag
review_body: My wife really likes it. It's not that big so you can't carry your notepads in it. It's more like a general purpose street bag. My wife carried it on our trip to Canada. She loves it.

product_title: OUTBACK 10" OVEN
review_body:
There's so little information I thought you might like to know what comes in the box

The 10'' Outback Oven features:

10'' non-stick pan with lid
10'' Pot Parka
Scorch Buster & Riser Bar
Reflector collar
Screw in thermometer
Mesh carrying sack
Backcountry baking book
Weight: 26 oz.

The manufacturer gives little more info than that. [...]

I noticed that Backpacker's Pantry also had their \\"Outback Oven Ultra-Light\\" for sale at Amazon.com. It includes no frypan, and has an 8\\" pot parka. So I thought it'd be good to update this review with that information.

Backpacker's Pantry sells each of those parts (listed in \\"what's in the box\\") separately. Amazon.com doesn't carry them all, but it does sell a 10\\" Outback Oven with a 10\\" pan. This Ultra-Light Oven doesn't include a pan, and has an 8\\" pot parka.

Backpackers Pantry sells pot parkas in 8\\", 10\\", and 12\\" sizes.

My own preference is to go camping with the same pots & pans I use at home. So I'd select a size for both. GSI Outdoors (also sold at Amazon) has Hard Anodized aluminum cookware that is very light. Their Extreme Andz. 6 PC Mess Kit (Hard Anodized Extreme Cooksets)would go nicely with the 8\\" Outback Oven Ultra-Light, whereas their 10\\" & 12\\" pot parkas would be better with GSI's 10\\" or 12\\" Hard Anodized Dutch Ovens.

You have to shop very carefully at Amazon.com, because I've seen many items that appear to be identical, but have grossly different prices. For example, they use the same picture for the Outback Oven, the Outback Oven Ultra-Light, and the Outback Oven Thermometer. The thermometer is only the little knob on top of the lid!

Do note thought, this 10\\" Outback Oven does come with a 10\\" pan & lid that has a hole for the thermometer to stick through. So that would be better than hoping you could use the thermometer with the lid from a 10\\" dutch oven, or other frypan lid.

product_title: Therm-a-Rest Trail Lite (Regular)
review_headline: Good for overnight, not for anything else.
review_body: Bought this for a 5-week field excavation, terrible idea. I can say it is probably possible to survive on this thing for a week if you've got a plush sleeping bag on top of it, but your back will be aching. a 15 dollar air mattress is nearly as compact deflated and infinitely more comfortable (though you can't lay it out on the dirt obviously). If you've got a tent, get an air mattress, if you're sleeping out while hiking, this could serve your purpose since it is rather toughly built. That's about all I can say positively about it is that it is very unlikely to tear or rip or anything like that, very durable.

product_title: Schwinn Speedster Men's Flat Bar Road Bike
review_headline: A Great Bike for the Money
review_body: This is a very good bike for the money.  I cant believe it was so cheap.  The gears shift perfectly and I haven't even had them adjusted.  The brakes are pretty good too, though I did have to adjust the front brake when i put the bike together.  The bike is fast and rolls very smoothly.  The pedals do look cheap but they get the job done until I can get some better ones.  I am 6 feet tall and the bike is very comfortable for me.  I love the flat handle bars also.  The gears and brakes are right where you rest your hands so you don't have to move them around.  I had a gmc denali road bike and it was horrible, this is 10x better and worth the extra money.        BTW this bike was $130 with free shipping when i bought it, now it is up to $330.

product_title: CUSCUS 6200ci Internal Frame Backpack Hiking Camp Travel Bag Navy
review_body: This pack is great. I bought this a few months ago and has been very useful during hurricance Ike and after. I highly recommend this pack.

product_title: Coleman 54-Quart Steel-Belted Cooler
review_headline: High quality work horse; good for car camping, parks.
review_body: This is a great cooler.  It holds a ton, is strong and takes banging around.  It is good for dragging stuff for a family outing to the park, or for car camping.  Not a back-packable cooler, mind you, but this is the heirloom cooler you will want for decades.  We use ours as a mini-fridge in a lake cabin, and it keeps stuff cold with occasional changes of ice or cooler blocks.

product_title: Red Maltese Taillight Bicycle Light Flashing
review_body: A cool taillight with multiple LEDs. Designed to mount on rear fender of cruiser-style bike; no frame or seat-tube mount included. Lacks weather seal between lens and case.

product_title: Razor V-17 Youth Multi-Sport Helmet
review_body: I got this for my 10 year old boy and it is way too small............He did love the way it looked!

product_title: Razor A2 Kick Scooter
review_body: I got my razor scooter 6-7 YEARS AGO and it is still the funnest, most economic toy I've probably ever bought. Good job razor.

product_title: Outdoor Products Mountain Duffel
review_body: I bought this bag for my boyfriend because he travels a lot on weekends.  The good thing about the bag is that it's a very rugged and gigantic.  The bad thing about the bag is that its GIGANTIC.  It was so surprisingly big, that it wasn't even very useful for the weekend traveling that my boyfriend does.  However, if you're making longer trips and need a big big bag, then this bag is a great bag for the money.

product_title: Cateye CC-MC100W Micro Wireless 10-Function Bicycle Computer (Black)
review_headline: Worked for several months but now randomly moves to zero MPH
review_body: I used to really like this device, but lately it intermittently will go to zero MPH and thus my miles do not get recorded. For example, on a route I know is 22 miles it will only say 17 miles -- that is a lot of missing miles. When I watch the display it will be correct, but then suddenly go to zero MPH. I'll then be biking and fiddling with the device to wake it up and then it will start displaying real numbers again. I don't trust it and now must go spend the money and time finding / buying / setting up a new device. So, just be warned that although it initally is a good computer within a year it turned out to be worthless...

product_title: 1 Liter Better Bottle
review_body:
Update Sept. 2010: I still use this strictly for water, despite it's huge downfalls, mostly due to the fact that you don't have to tip to drink it, I find that very convenient and because I'm too lazy to find something similar that I like. But please know this: it grows nasty looking mold in the bite valve and straw. My best friend has the same camelbak and said she stopped using hers for this reason. It's nearly impossible to reach some of the areas with the mold. I've really put in the extra effort to clean it just because I like the carrying loop and that you don't tip to drink. On a leaking note - I recently threw this in my purse without thinking and it did leak. It got my ipod soaked, though thankfully it dried out and recovered. This is clearly not made for the person who tosses things in a bag!!

Original review: I wanted something leak proof, and BPA-free. This really isn't it. If you hold the bottle at an angle when drinking at all(both slight and severe angles), it can spill out. I've had both water and other drinks spill down the front of my shirt...sometimes at very inconvenient times(during work). Having a red streak down a white shirt is bad. It also leaks when the straw is down(which is when it's definitely suppose to be leak proof). I left it on the bed recently on my way out the door and found it in a big puddle wet spot when I got back an hour later.

I like so many things about this bottle, but that really ruined it for me. I do still use it at home because I like the drinking nozzle and that I can tote it around the house/outside. If you're going to use it, use it only for water. Otherwise you could ruin some perfectly good clothing with this.

And lastly,to be honest, I'd prefer something I could put in the freezer that would thaw slowly on hot days, and for most of these type containers, they tell you that you cannot put them in the freezer. I may be looking for something nonexistent and will probably return to using old soda bottles for now.or now.

product_title: Montego 26" Men's Cruiser Bicycle
review_headline: great look and quality for little money
review_body: I was really impressed by the free shipping that took less than a week to arrive.  The bike was easy to put together. I didn't even need to read the instructions.  the bike is comfortable to ride with it's nice wide seat.  really good deal for my daily commute...

product_title: Bell Free Fit Platinum Series 15 Function Wireless Computer
review_body: I wish I had bothered to read these reviews before buying this bike computer!  The first 200 miles that I used this computer, it would occasionally fail to pick up the rotation of the bike tire and read zero or some low number.  After 200 miles, it barely worked at all.  I read the manual and tried adjusting it numerous times.  It is JUNK!  I once thought that Bell was a quality brand, but I am quickly changing my opinion.      Do not buy this bike computer.  Buy anything but this one.

product_title: Blackburn Quadrant and Mars 3.0 Combo Bicycle Light Set
review_body: The Quadrant is easy to mount, bright and easy to direct. The quick dismount tab is hard to use and sticks even when the latch is depressed. It's feels easier just to unscrew the mount (it takes about 20 seconds). I think the plastic they use binds when used in the sliding area; they might think of using a different plastic or metal there. I tried different lubricants there and it still binds badly. The Mars rear light mounts on the seat post only. While it is quite easy to dismount, I would prefer a method to mount it on my rear rack since the light gets covered up if I put things on top of the rack. All in all though a good deal.

product_title: Serengeti Ronan Sedona Polarized Sunglasses (Sport Classic)
review_body: I had another pair of Serengeti sunglasses and loved them so when they broke I was upset and didn't know how I was going to replace them - because I live in Germany now.  I was so happy to find them on Amazon.  The price was excellent and, of course, the shipping was fast!  Thanks, Amazon!

product_title: Columbia Journey DX Women's Comfort Bike (16-Inch Frame)
review_body:
Right out of the box you can tell this in a great bike. 21 speed sram shifter that shifts like a dream, omni fork on the front that has plenty of give and take, and an activa seat that is comfortable. It is one smooth ride.

True there was no instructions on how to put it together, but it was a snap. The only thing you had to do was attach the handle bars, the front tire, the front fender, the seat, and screw on the peddles.

Everyone who has seen this bike asks about it - one person even turned around on the trail to ask me.

product_title: New Wave Litter Free Lunch Box
review_body: I wish it came with containers that were BPA free!  Otherwise...the print is cute and the idea is great.

product_title: Klean Kanteen Stainless Steel Water Bottles
review_body:
There's a lot of debate about which is better: Klean Kanteen or Sigg water bottles. For most people, I really doubt there's much of a difference. Both brands of bottles are reliable and safe to use.

I took a while to read over the pros and cons of each bottle and I ended up choosing Klean Kanteen because they're made of regular old stainless steel, and they have wider mouths.

I bought two of the 27oz bottles, which fit perfectly into the water bottle pouches on my daypack. The 27oz bottle is only slightly wider than a regular 16.9oz plastic Arrowhead water bottle so they should fit into most pouches or cradles. The only thing to note is that the 27oz bottle is fairly tall. Take a look at the photos that I submitted in the gallery above.

Pros:
- Made of stainless steel. This means that it's easy to clean and extremely durable.
- You can cook using it because it's just stainless steel. The KK website points out that you can use the bottle to cook on an open flame, which is something you definitely can't do with the aluminum and epoxy resin coated Sigg bottles. Just make sure to remove the plastic cap.
- The 27oz bottle is only slightly wider than a 16.9oz Arrowhead water bottle, so it actually fits into the water bottle pouches on my daypack.
- The wider mouth of the Klean Kanteen lets you put regular ice cubes in it. Since you shouldn't put metal water bottles in the freezer, this is a good alternative for having ice water.
- Pretty light weight. Not much heavier than a Sigg.

Cons:
- Plastic cap. I actually don't think this is a huge con though. It's made of a strong plastic that supposedly doesn't leech and someone pointed out that a plastic cap means less metal on metal wear at the mouth of the bottle.
- Slight metallic smell that went away after a couple washes and reuses. Siggs supposedly do not get a metallic taste or smell.
- Made in China. To me, this was the biggest con for Klean Kanteens. Siggs are made in fancy, eco-friendly factories in Switzerland.ly factories in Switzerland.

product_title: Under Armour UA Renegate Unisex Laptop Sports Backpack Book Bag-Geometric Pathern, 18" Small X 14" X 4"
review_body: this backpack was well worth the price. it's a bit thin, but it's really light and comfortable even when you're carrying around tons of books. the front pocket has lots of storage room and although this backpack looks small, it has lots of space. i'd get this again if i needed. great backpack! u won't go wrong buying this

product_title: Planet Bike Blinky "3" 3-Led Rear Bicycle Light
review_body:
Not much to say, this is a great light for the price. 3 functions work well and it is easy to install.

Plus, it's from Madison, WI (great biking city) so you know it's good!

product_title: Mongoose Maneuver Men's Dual-Suspension Mountain Bike (26-Inch Wheels)
review_headline: Solid construction w/dual suspension features provide great ride!
review_body:
Great deal on a solid full suspension bicycle from Mongoose that handles very well. The rear suspension mechanism feels very solid and is very comfortable for general or strenuous pedaling. The front and rear brakes are pretty solid and required very slight tweaking to balance them. GREAT handlebars with GREAT bar ends. Wish that the derailers were adjusted a little bit better out of the box, but functioned as expected. Seat post is tall enough for 6'0\\" and under, so bicycle should fit most people easily. Wish the rear axle was quick release but the front is, so locking up the bicycle is easy.

The only significant complaint that I had was the cheap pedals used. The metal \\"teeth\\" are sparse resulting in somewhat slippery petal performance, so you are forced to keep your feet close to the cranks to keep from slipping on hard pedalling. Otherwise no complaints!

Great deal folks!!!

product_title: Beach Depot Women's Carolina Blue Long Sleeve Rash Guard SPF 50+ Swim Shirt
review_body: I bought this as I sunburn easily while vacationing in PR...well I just returned from a 2 week stay...not a bit of sundburn thanks to the shirt. PERFECT!

product_title: Polar Bottle Insulated Water Bottle - 20oz
review_body: This bottle works well and keeps its contents cold much longer than standard bottle. The wide mouth allows the addition of ice to keep things colder longer still. It fits in standard waist carrier (for running) or a bike water bottle holder. It is not intended for hot liquids. The bottle is type 4 plastic which is BPA-free.

product_title: Razor Kiddie Kick Scooter
review_body: My 2 1/2 year old got this from Santa. He is always trying to ride his older brother and sisters scooters. He loves this scooter and was able to control it immediately. His favorite Christmas present!

product_title: T Gauge 2, Tee Depth Gauge, Pen, Flashlight
review_body: This is a tool that is simple and takes the guess out of how high the ball should sit on the tee.  The divot repair tool is not a functional part of the device.  It does not work at all.  The ball marker works and the pen is marginally good.

product_title: Micro Maxi Kick Scooter with Joystick
review_body:
I bought this for my slightly-smaller-than-average 5 year old daughter. I thought it might be too big for her, as the manufacturer claims that the Maxi Scooter is for 6-10 year olds. After waiting patiently while much larger children rode the display model in the toy store, my daughter began cruising around the store on the Maxi while calling it \\"her\\" scooter.

When we brought it home, I was pleased with the ease of assembly. It took my daughter two riding sessions to get used to the feel of leaning rather than turning, and holding the pilot stick rather than handlebars. Now, she leaves her older friends on Razors in the dust, uphill, downhill, and while turning. Even though she goes a lot faster than she did on her old scooter, I feel that she is safer because she has a much easier time turning and stopping. Kids as old as 12 line up to take turns riding it, as the pilot stick height adjustment takes about a second, without tools.

Many neighborhood parents have asked about it, so I imagine the streets will soon be filled with Maxi Scooters, unless they choke when they see the price. The Maxi Scooter was worth the price for our family because my daughter and her friends are SCOOTER FANATICS, and this model should last several years.

Here's how I would rate it (out of 5):

Ease of assembly: 5 (Snap the pilot stick into the kickboard. Done).

Construction: 5

APPARENT durability (we haven't had it very long): 5

Intuitive use: 5

Braking: 5

Fun: 5

Worth the price: 5

\\"Cool\\" factor: 5

I hope this helps!

product_title: Klean Kanteen Cap
review_body: Not much to say about this cap except that it works! I bought several Kleen Kanteens with sport caps as gifts, then added these loop caps as alternatives for the recipients. Two things which are different from the caps on the older bottles: they are not as big or clunky, and the bottoms are hollow (instead of being sealed over).

product_title: Pacific Shorewood Women's Cruiser Bike (26-Inch Wheels)
review_headline: Take it to a bike shop.
review_body: This bike came faster than it was supposed to, and was assembled within an hour.  I took it to a bike shop to get the kinks out, it was missing one screw, and the fender was a bit bent.  After they fixed any kinks and pumped the tires, I was good to go. I've been on quite a few 6-10 mile bike rides, and everything works safe, the gears are great for my hilly area, and I'm very satisfied.

product_title: Razor E300 Electric 24 Volt Motorized Ride On Kids Scooter
review_body: We bought this for our 8 year old son.  It was a big hit and has held up to the last months beating.  The battery starts off strong and holds its charge for a reasonable amount of time.  The instructions claim 40 minutes on a full charge.  It seems pretty accurate.  I definitely think that getting the 300 gives you the best battery/power combination.  The box says ages 12 and up but I think it is perfect for our 8 year old.  Not too powerful but enough power that it is not laboring to get going while he rides it.  I weigh 190 pounds and this scooter does a good job of pulling me around.  I would recommend this product to anyone that is looking for a motorized scooter.  Good quality...

product_title: Bolle Hot Helmet,Black,Medium
review_body: i love the bolle hot helmet it's my first helmet and i got it on time thanks.

product_title: Yaktrax Pro
review_headline: Fantastic! No more fear of ice in Seattle!
review_body: We bought these just after the Seattle ice storm in December and are using them. They are fantastic. We had to buy a pair for my wife's parents who live in Idaho on a mountain. They love them. Highly recommended. Buy the \\"Pro' version.

product_title: 2.2 Liter (64oz) Water Bottle Tote Only Bottle Not Included
review_body: This water bottle is great until the seams fall apart, which happens quickly. Too bad - since totes like this are hard to find.

product_title: Garrity Power Lite 3 LED Crank Light
review_body: bought these for emergency situations.  staff members laughed them off.  used it 3 days after they arrived due to blizzard snowstorm, trying to get generators started.  they are not maglites, but held charge well and worked well enough to see in the dark, flipping breakers and starting generators.  staff members still laugh them off, but also said they worked good.  one said perfect for taking to the timber.

product_title: My Little Pony Toddler Bicycle Helmet, Horn, Streamers, and Water Bottle Fun Pack
review_body: We only use the helmet currently. The water bottle has so strong plastic smell that I will never give my daughter to use. Streamers don't fit my daughter tricycle so I have to wait till she is big enough to get a bike.

product_title: Razor Pro Model Scooter
review_body:
I work at a facility up on a hill. Part of our company benefit includes super cheap public transportation. I take the train to work and the scooter down hill and back home. This little thing weighs almost nothing and it cruises pretty well down hill. I can take it on the train with me without having to worry about a big bulky bicycle or anything. At work I can put it into a locker so I don't have to worry about it getting stolen. On the way home I actually have to use the break to keep from going too fast down hill. Lastly with the shiny aluminum frame I feel safer riding at night time because the whole thing is like a big reflector.

I'm probably the clumsiest person on earth, but this thing is easy to ride. I haven't wrecked yet.

I like the design of this scooter, the metal is very sturdy, the grip tape holds up good, the wheels seem really tough, the break is easy to use, the steering is just what you'd expect... I could go on, let me just say it's a good scooter with a good value.

Lastly, I have the red model. I like it. I haven't seen the silver model, but the red is like a translucent plastic or rubber (don't know which). It's really cool.

product_title: Sevylor Inflatable Sno Pro Tube
review_headline: Well made, needs steep hills to work
review_body: A plain old vinyl tube works better, but is more subject to punctures.  This one keeps its air and is tough.  The textured bottom means that the hill you are sledding on needs to have a good grade or this one will just sit in one place.  The more packed the snow on the hill, the better.

product_title: iBert Safe-T Front Mounted Child Bicycle Seat
review_headline: iBert Child Seat , two thumbs up!
review_body: Easy to install and my son loves it! This is the coolest seat ever. Everywhere we go, you can hear people make comments about how neat the seat is while we are riding by.  It really gives you a chance to interact with your child while riding the bicycle and you don't have to keep looking behind you to see if they are ok. I highly recommend the iBert.

product_title: Princeton Tec Fuel Headlamp (45 Lumens)
review_body: Short and sweet, I use it for running at night, works great, first time i tried to change the batteries, the battery door broke off, cheap, weak hinge on battery door.

product_title: Topeak PrepStand Elite Bicycle Repair Stand
review_headline: A bit wobbly but not bad.
review_body: My only point of comparison is a $600+ Park professional stand that I used during a bike repair workshop that I attended this past fall, so the bar may be set pretty high when I compared that to a collapsible home repair stand.  Overall everything is fully functional and easy to use.  My only complaint is that it seems a tad wobbly with a heavy steel bike in the jaws.  I would recommend to a friend looking for a repair stand in the sub-$200 range.

product_title: MSR Whisperlite International Stove
review_body: 19 years now and only problem was when the o rings failed (after 15 years) and the jet clogged once. I had it repaired on a trip within 10 miuntes. Learn to field strip before you use. Be sure primer cup can be removed w/o a tool (hand tighten. I carry spare rings now and soon fuel line just in case because I go solo and or in 20 miles.  12000 ft no problem, 22-26 degrees no problem.  Never tried other fuels but have read vodka can be used.  If 100 proof ?? Always use the heat deflector not shown for safety. A metal base option (3oz) is great for uneven surfaces.  Daily use - I figure on 2-3 oz's fuel per day with breakfast 10 minutes and dinner 25.  Adjustable flame can simmer real low.  Primes nicely.  Avoid cheap fuel. I use Coleman for best results.

product_title: Stanley Classic Vacuum Bottle
review_body: It's the best thing since sliced bread. I really like the way that it keeps my coffee hot all day. The last cup was just as hot as the first.

product_title: Jeep Cherokee SE 26-Inch Mountain Bike
review_body: This bike is great!  I took it out through mud, ice, snow and heavy gravel...no problems.  It's not that heavy and feels very sturdy which is surprising for a bike of its price...overall, it's a great ride for your buck!

product_title: Comfort Zone The Heat Solution Instant Portable Heat Pack
review_body: I bought these for my daughter who has circulation problems in her hands.  She said they heat up within about 30 seconds, and hold their heat for about 30 minutes.  They get really hot.  She has also used the disposable hand warmers, and found those to heat inconsistently, and require shaking to rewarm.  These reusable ones though get very hot very quickly, and stay that way until they cool off.  The only reason I didn't score them as a 5 is that they are still sitting on the counter (after a week) waiting to be boiled to reactivate them.

product_title: FreshPark Professional BMX and Skateboarding Grind Rail
review_body: Aside from the fact that my son opened this at Christmas and it was missing the connectors, end caps, and the bolts and screws, it was nice. I guess next time I'll buy him a piece of pipe since that's what I felt arrived.

product_title: Coleman RoadTrip Cast Aluminum Accessory Grill
review_body: We have used these grates all year and love them. Easy clean-up -- can go right in the dishwasher (when we get back from camping!)  The other reviewer needs to remember that the grates are non-stick, so SOS pads can be a little rough on them.  Coleman does now make a cast iron grill grate for the Roadtrip grill.  Maybe they need to get those instead.

product_title: Spring Swings Vinyl Sling Seat
review_body: Wonderful!!!! Have had this product several years now and no signs of wear and tear. We leave it out in the weather year round too. I highly recommend this product.

product_title: Victorinox Swiss Army Classic SD Pocket Knife
review_body:
I love My Little Red Swiss Army Pocket Knife. It performs tasks like:

1. Cleaning finger nails.

2. Installing screws.

3. Tooth Pick.

4. Tweezers.

5. Sizzors.

And much more. I wouldn't be with out it.

product_title: Highgear Alterra Computer Watch with Altimeter, Barometer, Compass, and Thermometer (Graphite)
review_body: Bought in Feb of 2008 from an online retailer in the US.  Used three times and the last digit on the display disappeared.  Watch band separated.  High Gear will not warranty the watch for the digit as it was not purchased from a dealer they say is authorized.   The dealer I bought if from say it has a full warranty.  My loss.    Pros:    Cost is good for features -initially.  If it lasted would have been a good product.  Lots of features and not very large.    Cons:      Short life    Warranty is worthless if not purchased from the proper vendor.  They must be authorized.  See the warranty wording on their website- [...]      There is a list at: [...]     Watch band which is part of the watch is poorly constructed-delaminates.        It was hard for me to reset the various altimeters functions.  I don't feel the instructions are very clear.  Does a nice job of accumulating, but how do you reset them.  Push enough buttons and it happens sometimes.   This is my own issue but it could be easier.    I believe the watch band and the watch head itself is very suspect as to its useful life.  I would avoid unless you get a warranty and can take the time to send in for repairs.    So I should not have bought from a certain dealer.  Now I know you need to go to one of the authorized dealers.  After all, my experience shows you are going to need the warranty for this item.  The question is really does this company stand behind the product of the dealer?  Basically they are saying, our watch failed but because you did not buy from a certain party we are not interested in our product failure.    Watch band which is part of the watch is poorly constructed-delaminates.        It was hard for me to reset the various altimeters functions.  I don't feel the instructions are very clear.  Does a nice job of accumulating, but how do you reset them.  Push enough buttons and it happens sometimes.   This is my own issue but it could be easier.    MORAL OF THE STORY:    Trouble prone item with little manufacturer support.   The company seems to be trying to find a way to avoid standing behind their product.  I purchased a watch in a factory box sealed.  It fails after 20 miles of hiking.  The issue has nothing to do with the middleman but the product.  Basic quality of the product is in question.  I don't see Amazon listed as an authorized dealer.  OW!

product_title: Ripstik Caster Board
review_body:
The Ripstick made by Razor is one of the hottest new toys that I have ever seen. Once you get the hang of it you can have hours of fun. Not only is it fun it's also a great way to get exercise as well.

TJR
Houston TX

product_title: Powell Classic Skull and Sword Skateboard Wheel Set (58mm/90A, White)
review_body: These are the Cadillac ride of skateboard wheels. They're for a soft, smooth, and quiet ride. Yes, quiet (don't have anything to do with anything, but for some reason these wheels are very quiet).   Also, they easily roll over those annoying little rocks that normally cause you to \\"eat-it\\".

product_title: Victorinox SwissTool
review_body: so, i was a bit skeptical. my wife and i have been guides for years and have used leatherman and gerber exclusively.  i bought her this one as an experiment. she loves it and i love it. going to get myself one also. like the curved handle(a bit odd at first, but now enjoy it), the blades/tools, and all the accessories. most of all, i like the durability. had it for two months and have put it to good, heavy use. seems to do very well and blades keep a good edge and sharpen easily. if you 're thinking about getting one. do so.

product_title: Planet Bike 5019 Men's ARS Spring Anatomic Relief Saddle with Gel and Elastomer Springs
review_body: This saddle gets an unqualified thumbs up.  I recently rode over 187 miles in a 14.5 hour period and I had no saddle related soreness whatsoever.   Buying this saddle just eliminated a key limiter from long distance bike touring.  I have used it on both my mountain and road bikes with no problems on either.  Although it wins no beauty contests among bike snobs, I will be ordering another one.  In my case, the \\"ugly duckling\\" gives me everything I need and nothing that I do not.

product_title: OnGuard Akita 5043 Bicycle Security Cable (Lock Not Included)
review_body: 11/28/08 - Buyer Beware:  I had two bicycles stolen (over $1400 value) from my garage when a thief cut through a related product [[ASIN:B000FL4YGU OnGuard Akita 5080 Bicycle Security Cable (Lock Not Included)]] in one slice. Looks like they used a chain cutter. Unless you're using this as a theft deterrent or for low value items, don't fool yourself that you're buying security.

product_title: Advanced Elements FireFly Inflatable Kayak
review_body: I bought it here last Nov. I am quite pleased with the purchase. It perform better than what I expect.     Good things:    Quite stable, it takes only 5 minutes to pump the air and set it up( the fastest one I ever had), conquer class II white water without much problem. Speed and tracking are fine. Perform well both on flat water or class I or II water. Durability is quite good. Still strong after 30 uses.     Bad things:  Not for people who is tall or over 180 Ib, and don't pump too full for the bottom chamber. Otherwise, you could damage it. Both air chambers are made from so-so or cheap material. That's why it is cheapest model of great AE. Sitting is not very comfortable, but not too bad either. Can't carry much stuff.    One word: The best solution for a quick trip or short trip if you are not tall or quite slim, no matter flatwater or whitewater.

product_title: New Wave Enviro Stainless Steel Water Bottle (1-Liter)
review_body: I purchased this product because I wanted a water bottle that was not made of plastic that I could drink from while biking.  I have not seen another one which is steel and this large.  This is the perfect size for my long bike rides and other than the cap which is plastic, I have less exposure to plastics leeching into my drinking water.

product_title: Planet Bike Superflash Stealth bike tail light
review_body: This planet bike blinky superflash is really  like reported by others. It is so bright if you  ride to close to it it annoys you.  You can see it from at least 1/4 mile back.  Its an amazing little light, and very easy to install.

product_title: Bravo Weekender 10 x 10 Quik Shade Instant Canopy
review_body: Great canopy!  I use mine for tailgating at UGA football games.  Easy to set up and take down.  I would highly recommend this product.

product_title: HotHands Toe Warmers (40 Pair)
review_body: This is a fantastic product for anyone who has cold toes/feet and can't find any other way to warm them.  I have tried battery heated socks and they just don't compare to the warmth of these toastie toes.  Also, the adhesive pad sticks to your socks and there is no slippage in your shoes.  I would definitely recommend these. The only downside is that they are not reusable.

product_title: Ripstik Caster Board
review_body: First, you must start with your dominant foot forward.  Next, take a leap of faith and give yourself a good push.  It is like a motorcycle, once you get going, the two wheel thing doesn't matter.  Third, it helps to have someone walk along side of you until you can go down a small hill by yourself.  As you do this you begin to do little turns naturally with your feet.  To turn, you need to tilt your feet in opposite directions.  This takes practice.  Our 8 year old picked it up in a day with help!!!  Our six year old can go down a little hill with very little help in one day.  My wife is 38 and is not athletic.  She picked it up in one day.  Last, get the right one.  They make small ones for kids.

product_title: Mountainsmith Tour Lumbar Pack
review_headline: Best Lumbar Pack I've ever used
review_body:
This is the best lumbar pack I've ever Had

I use it primarily for knocking around town with my camera gear or day hikes with food/water/stove and a few extras and it works great for both.

The capacity is just right. Not to big like some I've seen where you might as well add backpack straps. Not to small, it can hold what I need it to.

Features
I have a couple of camelbacks but I was looking for something a little faster and cooler that is easier to access. With the Camelback if I want to carry something other than water I have to unsling it to get at it. I have small kids so I frequently have their milk or sippy cups and having to unsling it whenever they want a drink is a pain. But with this the side mesh pockets can hold 2x 20oz bottles and make access a breeze.

The fact that it goes on the waist instead of the back is also a big plus. I live in Texas and the summers are hot and humid. So not having something strapped on my back makes life a little cooler.

Access to what you need is easy, its not a long tube like the camelback. Of course you can't hold as much. But if your not taking that much you don't have to fish around as much with the same kit to find something.

The all important Strap
The strap is one of the best parts, its amazingly useful. When you have it loaded up putting it on your waist can be tricky since it sags a bit. Trying to get it on the right spot and clicked up can be challenging. But the strap makes it easy, slip the strap over one shoulder to take up the weight and slack, snap the belt, synch it up and slide the strap off and your ready to go.

Also when you access stuff the strap is great, if your under load the main body of the unit is under compression (keeps it tight and stable) but this can make it hard to pull things out. Slip up the strap, take off the load and unsnap the belt and its easy to go fishing.

When you need to run fast the unit and flop up and down making it uncomfortable, just bring the strap up and take some weight off and you can run without a problem.

Or you can just use the strap and stow the waist belt (it slides in underneath the lumbar support) and use it as a bag. The strap pad is quite good.

If straps are not your thing you can detach it and just go with the pack. I was worried at first the strap might get in the way but I've never had problems and its always there when I need it.

Pockets Everywhere
This pack has a lot of pockets. There is of course the main pocket which is shaped and kind of rectangular, this is where most of your business goes. Attached to the inside front is an envelop sized zipper pocket, useful for loose change, batteries and other small knickknacks.

In the front is another pocket, though if you've got the main section loaded up and strapped down this pocket isn't very useful. Its not bellowed or anything so the main support pulls on it. There is a plastic key clip inside. I use it for a mini LED flashlight.

In the back you have your lumbar pad, nice mesh coated foam. It has a pass thorough behind it from left to right on the sides. This is where you would stow the waist belt if you were not using it.

Then behind that is another pocket, open at the top that runs the height of the pack. Useful for large flat things that stick out like maps or pamphlets. Not really big enough for a book. You could fit a DVD case in but that would be pushing it.

The side mesh pockets just make the unit, there not as deep as I'd like but I've gone up to 20oz gatoraide bottles and never lost one.

A normal around the town load for me will be 2x 20oz bottles, a heavy pro F2.8 lens, Flash an extra small SLR body or point and shoot camera, table tripod, extra batteries, 50mm lens, remote triggers, a few snacks and knickknacks. It handles it all very well.

Out in the woods I mighthave the 2x 20 oz bottles, water, mini stove (snowpeak), titanium pot, spoon and some freeze dried food and munchies for the day and maybe my SLR or a flash. Getting things out can sometimes be tricky but it works.

If I need a jacket or a shirt I'll have it strapped to the outside as long as its light. The further out you hang something the more you notice it.

Belts and Handles and Mounting Points
The waist belt is broad and comfortable, the inside is mesh coated. It has a good balance of stiffness and flexibility. It wraps around your hips pretty well and distributes the load well. It has 2 stablizing straps on each side to get your load nice and balanced. There is a small plastic clip on a nylon strap in the middle. The clip is to small for much except running 3/4 inch webbing through it, but throw a carabeener on the stap and you've got more utility.

The buckle is the large 50mm snap type, easy to operate, works well. You can tighten the belt from either side.

On the bottom are two more stabilizing straps, so you can shrink or tighten the bottom if need be. I've found if you full extend them you can use them to hold thinks like a therma rest, a tarp or an umbrella. Pretty handy. Also two more strap loops

On the front is a shock cord webbing. Does a good job of holding a jacket and still giving easy access to the main compartment.

On the top are two carry handles, very nice touch, use them a lot.

Construction
All the external zippers have nice yellow nylon pull ties with rubber coated ends on them. Easy to see, easy to use.

The external bag is high quality condura like nylon, the inner lining is light weight ripstop. Its double sewn in all the critical places.
A note on color
I originally bought this bag in black, returned it and got the red bag. My wife though it more attractive but more importantly was finding things. You had black straps and black zippers on a black bag. It just all blended together and I found myself having to hunt for openings and straps more than I wanted to.

The only \\"problems\\" I have with the bag really isn't a flaw of the design, but rather a limitations. If you have it all tightened up it can be hard to pull things out, most of the time you have to un-strap the belt to get some slack. Also when you adjust the load you often have to adjust some of the straps to snug it back up again or loosen it up again to fit right. Be mindful of that and you won't have a problem.

Also if you load it up too much it can sag and be not as comfortable. You'll have to figure your exact point (it depends on how well the belt rides on you). For me (I'm thin) I can carry a decent load and still be fine.

So to summarize
Pros-
Great design, wonderful strap and pockets, great flexibility with adjustments and mounting points.
Cons-
None other than watch your configuration

Conclusion-
A great bag, not as big or as high capacity as my camelbacks but more useful in most conditions.or a flash. Getting things out can sometimes be tricky but it works. If I need a jacket or a shirt I'll have it strapped to the outside as long as its light. The further out you hang something the more you notice it.
