product_title: Razor Punk Park Ramp And Rail Combo Set
review_body: Purchased these items for my son's 10th birthday.  He loved the ramp and uses it not only for his rip stick but also for his scooter.  He did not care much for the grind rail, but I think he will once he gets a bit older.

product_title: Klean Kanteen Stainless Steel Water Bottle
review_body: I needed a better solution for drinks in my daughters lunch boxes.  I gave up juice boxes because of the price and the amount of trash they put into our environment.  I had bought plastic water bottles to fill with our own water, juice, milk etc, only to find out that these bottles were made with chemicals which could end up in the girls drinks.  The 12oz Klean Kanteen water bottles are great!  They are a perfect size for the lunch boxes, they don't leak and I know that my daughters drinks are chemical free.  We have had them for a month and they have no dents or scratches.  I would highly recommend the Klean Kanteen water bottles!

product_title: Advanced Elements 5 Gallon Summer Shower / Solar Shower
review_body: This shower does what it promises... it gets hot in the sun and it cleans you up!  It is stable and durable.  We got five showers out of this, not washing our hair.  I would think you could get two very nice hair-washing showers out it though.

product_title: Plastic Bicycle Cover CyclePro
review_body: I leave my bike at work outside, and when it rains, it's nice to have this over it for 8 hours. The tarp keeps it very dry, for the most part. For the price, it should come with hooks or strings to keep it from blowing away, so the value for you money could be better. At first, I didn't think this would be big enough for a large mountain bike, but it really does the job.

product_title: Sigg Lifestyle Sport Top Water Bottle (0.6-Liters, Mythical Shadows)
review_body: I love this water bottle.  It keeps my water cold.  Water doesn't taste funny.  I have no problem with the sport top, even when I work out.

product_title: Kent Super Scooter
review_body: This is a very nice scooter, my husband which weights 170 lbs. was able to scoot along on this scooter.  Very substantial very well made scooter. Nice size tires and the brakes work very good.

product_title: Texsport Portable Folding Toilet for Outdoor Camping
review_body: Had one of these items while in the military and it did come in handy. Beats trying to hover over a hole in the ground or trying to park one cheek on a log/rock and vigorously grasping the other cheek. Some of the items clips did break off, but that was rectified with duct tape. After a while the legs did tend to bend but that was rectified by having a friend weld some supports alond the legs. Balance for this item is not very good, so don't expect to read a newspaper while using this. Can be used with bags or you can get creative and dig a hole under you and play \\"bombadier\\". After a while the seat itself broke, but, again, that was rectified with duct tape. After a few years of using duct tape and other creative ways of fixing this item, I hit on the idea of cutting a hole into the seat of a folding chair (much more comfortable). This item is good for the quick use/day trip. Sometimes you get what you pay for. Good concept though.

product_title: InStep Take 2 Double Bicycle Trailer
review_body: This bike trailer is a good value for the money.  It is easy to assemble and attach to a bike.  I would have liked to have seen a sturdier seat inside the trailer itself though.  The spring assembly where the trailer attaches to the bike is very flexible, which makes it very nice for hauling.  I was able to fold the bike down on top of the trailer with it still attached to the bike frame and still fit it in my Ranger.

product_title: Kwik Tek JC-8 Jumper Cables With Nylon Bag 8 Feet
review_body: Product looks heavy duty and durable and was almost half the price of similar and lesser items.

product_title: Victorinox Swiss Army Pocket Knife
review_body: nice knife, good quality,very fast delivery,except the logo on the handle is a little bit esay to be abrased, anyway as an economic one, I like it.

product_title: TETON Sports Fox 5200 Internal Frame Backpack; Free Rain Cover Included
review_body: This pack was great for using on our trip across Europe a couple of years ago. I bought 2, one for myself and one for my wife. I now use them as climbing/camping packs and am very happy with the fabric quality and straps/buckles. It is rather heavy though when packed tightly at it's full capacity, as it is a larger -sized pack, but should be expected.

product_title: Klean Kanteen Flat Cap/Polypro
review_body: I bought this to replace the sport top. A club in my golf bag knocked the top off (the sippy part). I think this top is also more sanitary

product_title: HotHands Toe Warmers (40 Pair)
review_body: these nifty pads stick to the bottom of my socks, warm up within minutes, and keep my toes toastie for hours around the barn or in the saddle.  they also stick to the top of the socks & work just as well.

product_title: Huffy Disney Cinderella Girls' Bike (12-Inch Wheels)
review_body: This is an adorable first bike for your little princess. A great alternative to the Disney Princess bike for those little girls who favor Cinderella!! Love it!!

product_title: YayLabs Play and Freeze Ice Cream Ball Ice Cream Maker
review_body: My kids have loved this ice cream ball. They like coming up with different recipes/flavors to create. We have tried ground chocolate chips, peppermints, strawberries, next peanut butter and chocolate. It works very well. The ice cream does really stick to the sides as it freezes and it takes a bit of work to scrap it out. But it's never a bad thing to have to work for your reward!     It makes enough for 4 people to have reasonable portions. If you really want 4 full bowls, or want to make enough to save for later, I would recommend the Large size ball.

product_title: Mirrycle MTB Bar End Mountain Bicycle Mirror
review_body:
This mirror is fantastic. I bought it to replace a helmet mounted mirror when the stem broke on the helmet mount. I can't tell you how much better I like this bar-end mirror. It's much easier to find this mirror out of the corner of my eye, and it provides a very good view of what's behind me, both in the traffic lanes and directly behind me in the bike lane.

I did have to mutilate the grip on my handlebar to remove the plug and cut out and opening for the mirror, so just trying it out requires some commitment, but once it is mounted the installation looks clean.

I didn't have any significant trouble with the installation. The directions are a little bit unclear about what to do with piece that goes inside the bar (the directions say to \\"secure\\" it, but you need to leave it loose, securing only the nut, until it is inside the bar). If you look at the piece and think about how it's going to hold the mirror in place, it's pretty obvious what to do with it.

The mirror itself stays put very well on rides. It shakes a very little bit, but really only little. The stability is surprisingly good for a piece for which it is so easy to adjust the angles.

All the parts can be replaced individually if broken for about $4 each plus shipping.

product_title: JanSport Big Student Classics Series Backpack - Blue
review_headline: Very comfortable; very useful. Perfect for laptops!
review_body:
Something I didn't know when I ordered this online: The pocket behind the Jansport logo has inner pockets for pens, phone, calculator, small book, rocks, old socks... whatever you want. My other Jansport had the bottomless pit of pockets that was a nightmare to dig through to find a pen or change for that horrible Starbuck's coffee I keep buying.

The straps are thick and harder than the previous Jansport straps. ALMOST too stiff, but they should soften up with use. The nice part about them is that 65 pounds (of books) with these S-shaped straps doesn't feel as bad as it did with my other straight Jansport straps.

The \\"Chocolate Cherry\\" color is realy burgundy, or better yet, a nice cabernet. I don't know about the other colors, but Jansport is pretty good about the color in the picture matching the product.

product_title: Swiss Gear Twin Swiss Comfort Air Bed
review_headline: Mattress is first rate...the pump sucks
review_body:
Sorry for the bad pun. I bought this with possible intentions of using it as an every night mattress. I really don't think it's suitable for that due to the fact that you'd need to adjust the air probably at least once a week and the pump that comes with it is very weak. It's powered by D batteries and can't handle high air pressure; the air just leaks back out from the mattress.
But for the price, this is really a great deal. The mattress is very sturdy and comfortable. I decided to keep it as a spare bed and use an aero-bed for every night sleeping.

product_title: JanSport Spring Break Backpack (White)
review_headline: Sturdy bag, but material abrasive on shoulders
review_body: This bag is perfect for the price.  You get a sturdy bag, decent zippers, and ample storage for its size.  Watch bare shoulders, however, because the material will cut into your skin. Overall, a great backpack for a great price.

product_title: Garrity Nichia LED Aluminum Flashlight (Black)
review_body: This is a great flashlight. I use the red filter for the nights I am out with my telescope to help preserve my night vision. It is a little too bright, even with the filter, so I might add another filter to the red filter to darken things a bit. This flashlight is super bright if you take the filters off. I liked it so much I bought one for my Dad.

product_title: Fox River X-Static Liner Crew socks
review_headline: Felt like Vicks Vapor Rub on my feet.
review_body: I am a sweater.  When I got out of the shower and put on these liners, It really did feel like vicks vapor rub on my feet.  They immediatly wicked away the moisture on my feet, making them feel very cool and comfortable.  On a rain-soaked, 40 degree, March hike in Michigan, coupled with a nice pair of Darn Tough Vermont merino wool socks and gore-tex boots, my feet stayed dry (sweat included), comfortable, and cushioned.  I have never had a better experiance on my feet.  When I got home after seven hours hiking in the rain, I took off my socks and gave them a whiff.  They smelled brand new.  I was shocked and amazed.  Great socks!  Treat yourself to a couple pair.

product_title: Santa Cruz Speed Gremlin Complete Longboard (9.9in Wide by 45.75in Long)
review_body:
Realmente estoy contento con este producto, soy novato en la materia, pero supero mis expectativas, es una gran tabla, firme, dura, de muy buena superficie. Los Tracks y ruedas son increíbles también, uno se desplaza con toda comodidad.
Y como Tipo, el diseño... realmente la recomiendo.

product_title: Humvee 7-Function Survival Tool
review_body: This is one good tool for being out in the woods, or on a camping trip.

product_title: Truvativ Howitzer XR Bottom Bracket
review_body: This bottom bracket is built like a humvee, overkill for most riders, but if your like me, you gotta have one. Two huge bearings outside the bottom bracket housing, with oversized bolts holding everything together.    These only work with cranksets built specifically for this bottom bracket.    Just be sure to buy the correct chainline.  Measure from the center of your frame to the center of your front crainring.  For doubles average the two chainrings, for triples measure to the center chainring.  The 50mm bb (the other one, not this one) is the most common.

product_title: Thule 964 Revolver 4-Bike Hitch Mount Rack (2-Inch Receiver)
review_headline: Great  carrier for the money and features
review_body: This is a great rack if you need access to the rear tailgate.  I considered pretty much every rack out there.  All of them have tradeoffs.  I didn't want to remove a wheel then climb on the roof to mount each bike.  I also didn't want to have the bikes in the way when I needed to get something out of the trunk (that happens quite a bit with kids on a roadtrip).  I looked at the models that fold down.  That's a great idea, unless you have the rack loaded.  4 bikes can be 120 - 140 lbs.  That's a little much for some folks to lift up.  Besides, just lowering the rack doesn't give great access to the rear since you still have to step around the rack.    On to the Revolver, which is almost perfect.  My mountain bike has the cables running under the main tube.  That means that I have to put a protective cloth between the cables and the tube or the cables would rub the paint.  Obviously that's not Thule's fault.  That's it though as far as negatives.  It's the best rack I've seen (the Swing Daddy by Yakima seems to be a clone, but it has some issues).  The Thule Revolver does everything!  It includes the anti sway cages that lock the bikes in place really well.  It includes a lock that secures the frame (someone could still steal the wheels so a second lock could be used.  It includes an anti-sway hitch pin w/ lock that snugs the  mount to the hitch.  The swing-away works so easily anyone can use it.    If I didn't need to get into my trunk, if I wanted to remove wheels and mount to the roof, if I wanted my bikes banged up I'd have gone with something else.

product_title: Planet Bike Blinky Safety 1-Led Bicycle Light Set
review_headline: Plantet Bike Blinkey lights - Planet Brilliant!
review_body: this things are fantastic for the money.  I feel really safe finishing my late summer/early fall rides with them on.  Super easy to use, nice switch feel, good mounting brackets.  And ya, these suckers are bright.  I like too that Planet Bike donates some of their profits.  Cheers.

product_title: Silva Wrist Sighting 424 Compass
review_body:
I ordered this compass and I'm more or less happy with it. the construction is moderate, the strap is cheap and functionality is fair. I have noticed the dial getting stuck & not pointing north properly, but that's usually only when held at an angle. a quick tap usually ends the issue. I bought this compass for use in new cities but campers may want to invest in something more reliable.
as for the cost, I do think it's a bit over-priced [$15.00 + shipping] but for my purposes, it was worth it. I wouldn't normally recomend paying more then $10.00 for this.

product_title: Mirrycle MTB Bar End Mountain Bicycle Mirror
review_body: This is a great product, easy to install and very useful in the road. It folds and gives me a great view of what's going on behind me while I am on my bike.

product_title: U.S. Divers Cozumel Seabreeze Dry Proflex II Mask, Fins and Snorkel Set
review_body: Received the product very promptly. The products were exactly what I was looking for. Size was accurate for the fins. Wish it stated in the description that there is no carrying bag. Luckly I had time before our trip to find a storage bag.

product_title: Tech 4 O Accelerator Women's Fitness Watch
review_headline: Great watch, but not water resistant as advertised
review_body: I walk and hike and swim, and the pedometer and other functions work really well, but after two sessions in the pool the watch display no longer functions. I'm hoping to be able to exchange it.

product_title: Sigg Thermo Mug (17-Ounces)
review_body: Claims of keeping beverages hot for 6 hours and cold for 12 hours don't hold up.  Despite preheating the interior with boiling water, my coffee was tepid at the end of my 20-minute morning commute.  The ice in my mug of water had completely melted during my afternoon commute.

product_title: Coleman Exponent Outfitter Cook Kit
review_body: This cookset appears to be of good quality stainless steel, nests well and with the provided sack is a compact set. The so-called plates are only 5.5 inches in diameter, just big enough to hold a nice size hamburger patty. The handles are a little tough to hold , but manageable. Surprisingly the \\"sporks\\" work well. Overall a good quality cookset that will stand the teat of time.

product_title: Coleman XL Broadband Quad Chair
review_body: Having previously owned other Coleman chairs, I tried finding Coleman chairs locally.  All most stores had, including Dick's Sporting goods were look alike chairs that were not comfortable at all.  So, I looked on line and found these, the price had me a little concerned as being so low, but when we received the chairs we were very pleased to find the same Coleman quality and comfort that we had in our other Coleman chairs.

product_title: Giro Transfer Sport Bike Helmet
review_body: Placed an order which was on sale and waited for a month.  Didn't get any response from the seller when I asked for a tracking number.  In the end, only to be told by Amazon that the order is cancelled.

product_title: Delta Alloy Hi Rise Oversized Bicycle Stem (1 1/8-Inch)
review_headline: A good solution to a problem
review_body: I have a fairly new road bike.  It stretches me out quite a bit.  After a while I began to want what many recreational riders want: a higher, shorter stem.  My hands were beginning to numb on every ride.  This stem has made a big difference.  It was easy to install and fits well.  I bought the 80 mm black finish version.  I recommend it.

product_title: Park Tool Spoke Tension Meter - TM-1
review_headline: No More Guessing and Hopefully No More Broken Spokes
review_body: The TM-1 Spoke Tension Meter works very well.  I commute by bike every day to work, and among my three road bikes that I rotate through (set up differently for weather and load), was popping spokes to the tune of about 1 or 2 a month, mostly due to what I perceive to be overtorque on some of the spokes.  Now I have torqued my spokes at the lower end of the recommended range and have yet to pop a spoke, and it is reassuring to know that they all are torqued to the same value.  It does take a little bit of give and take to get the wheel trued, but with just a little bit of effort you can adjust the tension to the correct range, then make minor adjustments of individual spokes to get the wheel to spin true.  You end up with a much more consistent torque range throughout the entire wheel, which eliminates overstress (hot spots) on overtorqued spokes.

product_title: Katadyn Pocket Water Filter
review_headline: When it comes to purified water, reliability is critical
review_body:
The price is daunting, but its to hard overvalue reliable water purification. We backpack the desert southwest, so the penalty for failure is too great when it comes to water. This filter system is stout, robust and will take a beating and work the next day. I prefer the ceramic filter approach and have never had any problems. Avoid the cheap parts and suboptimal workmanship of other systems. I learned my lesson. I had the plastic version by another company, and after about 100 liters of pumping the O-ring blew. Lucky it was purifying the last liter before starting the day-long hump out. Back in civilization I find out they want $20 for a 5 cent part. I think not. Fool me once...
After that I realized that quality, in this case, is the driving force. That's when I bought the Katadyn. Great investment.

product_title: Genuine Issue Magnesium Survival Firestarter
review_headline: When i need fire it's there
review_body:
With just a scraping tool I get a 700 degree F fire from this, burn a tire to put up a smoke signal in the rain!!! This is the hottest fire on earth, sweet, I can start wet tinder, I think with carbon this thing melts metal....

cool tool gang!!!

product_title: The Mountain Gentle Touch Adult T-shirt
review_body: I gave my daughter the 100% cotton Horse Lovers shirt for x-mas she loved it and it looks & feels nice!

product_title: InStep Safari TT Single Jogging Stroller
review_body: I've taken this out a few times since receiving it.  I like how smooth it rides because of the rubber tires. I haven't tried running with it yet.  It was very easy to put together.  There seems to be a problem with the brake.  It drags on the wheel.  I haven't tried fixing it yet because everytime I tell my husband about it the problem isn't there. My son seems to like.

product_title: Explorer Rack Without Spring, Black
review_body: I put this on the bike Worked fine until some kids decided it was made to be sat on. It still working but parts are broken.

product_title: Julbo Infant/Toddler's Ozone Sunglasses
review_body: When I bought these I was a little confused about what size/age child they would fit. I bought them for my two year old, who is closer to the size of a 3 year old, and they fit perfect. It says infant/toddler, so I thought they would be too small, but that was not the case. They are sturdy and nearly indestructible (given you don't stomp on them with your feet) which makes them worth the extra money you pay!

product_title: HotHands Body & Hand Super Warmer
review_body: I bought these for my daughter when she moved into an off-campus apartment in Syracuse.  She keeps them in a basket with her gloves near the door in the winter, and grabs them when she has a class at the far side of campus, or knows she will be coming home late when snow is expected.  She is very happy with them, since she doesn't keep her car at school, and does a lot of walking in bad weather.

product_title: Thule Quest Cargo Bag
review_body: It's a very sturdy bag.  Bag being the key word.  If you're going to be using it often, spend the extra cash and get a hard enclosure.  It's almost impossible to stuff it so that there are aerodynamics involved.  This means you will usually end up killing your gas mileage with the semblance of a large air dam on the top of the vehicle.  Under wet conditions, the bag performs as expected, however, in a hard rain prepare for wet luggage.  I learned my lesson the first time when we got to the hotel and had to use the laundry room to wash 4 suitcases of clothing.  Wrap everything in garbage bags if you can.  Due to the fact it has a zipper, you can expect a soggy reception after you drive through a storm.

product_title: Petzl Tactikka XP Headlamp
review_body: Although it's not clear from the product description, you can only have one of the lenses inserted at a time. The default of the lamp is to produce a narrow spot, with wider-angle illumination provided by using one of the removable lenses as a diffuser. This means that, while you're wearing the lamp, you can't switch between wide-angle white lighting and red light, since red is also provided by a filter.    If, like me, red is the only color you need, you might do better with the Petzl Tactikka Plus, which has a somewhat wider default beam and the red filter built in. I also bought the Petzl e+LITE Emergency Headlamp, which is quite an amazing piece of work, perfect for Burning Man btw.

product_title: Coleman 6-Day 50 Qt. Ultimate Xtreme Wheeled Cooler
review_body: This wheeled cooler has great ice keeping capabilities. On the downside, the wheels rub the sides of the cooler and make an annoying noise when you roll it around.

product_title: Kent "The Bike Club" Ultra Bike Lock
review_body: Great bike lock.  Very durable and I think is just about theft proof.  The specialized key makes this such an easy lock and versatile.

product_title: Coleman Family 3-Room Eight-Person Dome Tent
review_body: It's a little heavy and cinfunsing directions, but Im satisfied with the tent, it has a lot of room (8 person)

product_title: Saris Bones RS 3-Bike Trunk Mount Rack
review_body:
I purchased this rack to haul my bike around. I drive a Cadillac CTS-v. The rack works as Saris markets. I have not hauled three bikes but have done two. No problems what so ever. The rack secures nicely to my trunk lid. The fit is a little awkward as the suction cup brace things don't fit well on the edge of my trunk lid BUT the rack still secures nicely - doesn't move around, doesn't damage the pain, doesn't bend or scratch the trunk lid.

One thing that was not mentioned in the instructions is the fact that the front wheel kind of swings (from the unrestricted turning of the bars and wheel) back and forth in the wind. I used a small bungee cord to tie the front wheel to the rack. This isn't a big deal and the wheel wasn't turning back and forth to much but I simply want everything solidly attached and not moving. Plus if for some reason my skewer decided to vibrate loose and let my $400 front wheel fall from the bike, the bungee will hold on to it. - probably a bit over protective on my part.

Overall this rack is nice. The locking straps work great and the key really does as advertised. They have plenty of torque with the ratchet system so be careful not to over tighten. The bike is very stable once strapped in. The straps themselves are VERY easy to secure and to release. Installing the rack on the car took a little effort the first time. Now it takes all of 30 seconds - 45 seconds if I lock the straps. Taking it off consists of giving the straps some slack and then simply removing the rack from the car. Literally it takes 15-30 seconds to remove it from the car. You can open the trunk with the rack on. You may have to assist it when you hit the \\"pop trunk button\\" but opening the trunk is no problem - obviously don't try to open the trunk with a bike on the rack.

Great rack overall. I would highly recommend this rack!

product_title: Intex Pillow Rest Raised Airbed with Built-in Pillow and Electric Pump
review_body: I love this air mattress so much. It is so easy to inflate and deflate and it is quick too. It is very sturdy and durable as well. Over all it is an excellent gift to anyone who expects to travel and stay over at someone's place or even if you have a lot of guests yourself

product_title: Dog Backpack Saddle Gear Bag Easy Fit for Dogs New (colors vary)
review_body: Once you get it adjusted (and it may take a few times) it does a good job. Great price.

product_title: Victorinox Swiss Army MiniChamp Pocket Knife
review_body:
The \\"Victorinox Swiss Army Midnite Minichamp Pocket Knife\\" is truly a wonder of miniaturization! Coming in at roughly 2\\" long, the knife attaches unobtrusively to my keyring.

The tools on this swiss army knife really do not lose much effectiveness despite their small size. I find the VERY SHARP knife, magnetized philips head screwdriver, practical (really!) scissors, and the bright LED to be very handy. The built in pen has been a useful thing as well, but I try to not use it too much since replacing it might be difficult. The high quality and solid construction should make this litle knife last for years.

Highly recommended! I might have to order more since my wife and my son keep eying up mine!

product_title: JanSport Half Pint Classic Daypack
review_body: My daughter bought this with a gift certificate she received. She absolutely loves it.

product_title: Sportube Series 3 Snowboard or Multi-Ski Travel Case
review_headline: GREAT CASE FOR A GREAT PRICE
review_body: This case is perfect for the price. I use it for traveling with filmmaking equipment and it's sturdy, rolls easily, and is cheaper than any other type of similar hard case. The best thing is it's really light so I can fill it with more equipment and still come in under the 70lb weight limit. My only dislikes were I had to order the front end carry handle separately (you need it for comfortable walking, but it really should just come standard with the case), and the little cotter pin you use to lock the case together was promptly lost by TSA the very first plane trip I went on. Unless Sporttube changes their design by attaching a small cable to the cotter pin, I suggest you add your own before taking it on any flights or you'll be walking with a loose case.

product_title: Petzl Zipka LED Headlamp #E44P
review_headline: Small, compact.  Works fine.  Lightweight, too.
review_body:
I've read a few of the negative reviews. A few things to keep in mind.
1) You are buying a headlamp with a retractable cord...of course it is going to be a little more difficult to get around your head...BUT find me a headlamp that wraps around your wrist, or arm, or heck, your screwdriver!
2) The "button switching off" issue can be a problem if you don't turn the switch on ALL the way. It's got a pretty stiff detent and if you don't actually switch the thing all the way on, then it 'bumps off'. I imagine this is to keep it from accidentally turning itself on while it's in your pocket. NEVER A PROBLEM!
3) This thing is *small*. Great for backpacking (light, small space) and great for carrying around everywhere.
4) It lasts almost forever. The AAA batteries just keep on chugging.
Try one out in a store....know what your buying and you won't be dissapointed.

product_title: Crumpler 3 MILLION DOLLAR HOME Shoulder Photo Bag (Black/Gun Metal/Oatmeal)
review_body: I have the Crumpler 6 Million Dollar Home bag to carry my Nikon D90 and all it's accessories, and it serves me well; but I needed a smaller walk around bag for occasions when I just want to take the camera with 18-200mm lens attached.  This bag is a perfect fit for that and has pockets to carry extra batteries and SD cards.  One thing, this bag is not big enough to fit D90 with battery grip attached.

product_title: Bones Bearings Reds Bearings
review_headline: You CANT go wrong with these!
review_body: I bought my 11 year old son a World Industries board for Christmas, no matter what I did I couldnt get the wheels to spin very free. I bought some \\"Reds\\" and WOW!!These are freaking amazing, put them in and he hauled a*$! He wiped out right off the bat! I am going to buy another set for when we clean the ones that are on now, so he wont have any down time. Like I said, you cant go wrong. I would  recommend buying the Bones Speed Cream also. You cant beat these bearings, they are dirt cheap. I cant wait to take him back to the Mat Hoffman skatepark now!!

product_title: Coleman 3-Person Colossus Inflatable Boat with Oars
review_body: My husband and I took this boat out in some calm waters and were fine. We also took it out in the Gulf by some real boats and got pushed around quite a bit. It's small, I don't think three people could possibly fit unless one is a small child. It's good to take in calm water where motor boats aren't going to be. For the price it's a good buy, hasn't gotten any holes and we've sat it down in some shelly sand and on concrete.

product_title: #2680C Pelican HeadsUp Recoil LED Flashlight
review_body: Another excellent product by Pelican! Meets and exceeds my expectations. Very bright, and lasts forever! A+++++

product_title: Greenfield Stabilizer Rear Mount Alloy ATB Kickstand, Black, Pouch Packaged
review_body:
Instructions would be nice...but this is actually pretty easy to install. I just looked at the pic online and it was obvious how it was supposed to go. The only problem is, it doesn't quite fit my '09 Trek Women's Hybrid 7200. I have it on there now minus one screw...which makes it not quite as secure as it should be. It still will hold up the bike fine (it feels very solid and still quite strong), but I won't depend on it at all to help support my son in his baby seat (I would never have used it alone to hold him up, with all the screws in it or not-I was just hoping it could help me by taking some of the weight as I put him in/out, while I still had a secure grip).
I will probably keep this to keep my bike up anyway (my bike did not have a kickstand at all). I like the rear design and it's very out of the way. Just wished it fit by bike right-the tubes are just too thick.

product_title: HotHands Hand Warmers
review_headline: very good product at very reasonable price
review_body: I bought this product to keep my daughter's hands warm before musical auditions.  It works very well.  It can be used with or without gloves/mittens. One problems with the glove/mitten-only approach is that the hands sometimes get sweaty.  That doesn't help when you need to have precision and speed in playing your instrument.  Hothands solves this problem pretty well.  Once unsealed, it lasts longer than similar products from other brands.  The price is very good and the stuff keeps for a long time as long as it is sealed.

product_title: Polar Bottle Insulated Water Bottle - 24oz (discontinued colors)
review_body: I bought this as a gift for my father, who frequently bikes for long distances in the Texas heat. He loves it! It's very easy to wash as well as durable.

product_title: Flexible Flyer Aurora,Assorted Colors
review_body: nice sled my grandson likes it.

product_title: OnGuard Bulldog DT 5012 Bicycle U-Lock and Extra Security Cable
review_body: First of all, I don't agree with the ones telling that the keys are inappropriate. I have no problem with the keys. You should try some 'special' tricks for breaking the key!    Everything is perfect with this u-lock. It's long enough to provide you enough space for locking your bike's frame and tire to a bike rack at the same time. This provides much more security.    It's short enough to prevent thiefs to comfortably work on.    It's thick enough to prevent thiefs to break or cut.    The locking system is reliable and durable enough to use for many years.    It also has a protection coverage to prevent dust, humid and stain inside the locking system.    Last but not the least: This product offers you an extra security cable with an incredible price of $30!!!    Do not hesitate buying this great u-lock. You will never regret.

product_title: Hollywood Racks Boomer Bar Womens or Dual Suspension Bike Rack Frame Adapter
review_headline: makes carrying a ladies bike easy
review_body: Carrying a womens bike or unisex can be difficult on your cars bike carrier.  These work.  Makes odd shaped frames easy to carry

product_title: Sportube Series 2 Double Ski Hard Case
review_body:
The case is a little gangly to work with at first but it does a nice job of fitting and protecting the skis. Why don't the just include the $5 handle?
With the wheels it makes for easier transport.

product_title: High Sierra 24-Inch Cargo Duffel
review_headline: This is a very high quality bag.
review_body: I was pleased with everything except one item.  The bag was advertised as being a \\"roller\\" duffle, yet is has no wheels.  I bought it with the desire for it having the capability to roll at airports, etc.

product_title: Mongoose Domain Men's Dual-Suspension Mountain Bike (26-Inch Wheels)
review_body: First off, I was happy when I noticed the dual-boxed shipping that was done to help keep the bike from getting scratched.  Then, after pulling the bike out of the box, I noticed some nice scrapes on the fork of the bike from where the handle bars were hanging when it was shipped.  Also, on further inspection, I found some other paint scrapes on the back of the body as well.  Also, after placing the front wheel on and checking if it spun straight, I noticed that it was way off.  Basically, it wobbles. Fixing this either requires a trip to a bike store, or purchasing a spoke wrench to fix it myself if I understand correctly.  This shouldn't have come like that in my opinion.  This may get shipped back to amazon at this rate.  Also spent an hour trying to get the shifter adjusted so it would work in all 21 gears.  I appreciate that most of it was preassembled but come on.  At least do it right.

product_title: Coleman Water Carrier, 5-Gallon
review_body:
I have two of these, I no longer use them though. The first one , the valve screw broke and the second one had a leak in the seam.

I ended up buying a 7 gallon hard plastic jug

product_title: Thule T2 2-Bike Hitch Mount Rack
review_body: I bought this over the Yakima equivalent for the locking accessory. What a mistake i made. The racketing system that locks the arm down over the bike is made of plastic and doesnt work. I called Thule to complain and was told i have a faulty unit and i need to RMA it. I sent it back yesterday and hopefully that is the case. But i would steer clear if i was you.

product_title: Petzl Tikka Plus 4-LED Headlamp #E47P
review_body: Great for working indoors - I use it for fixing AV equipment and my home PC - light goes right where I'm looking.  Strap is pretty comfortable.

product_title: Aloe Gator SPF 8 Lotion (3-Ounce)
review_headline: Excellent sunblock (though I have heard concerns about the container)
review_body: I used Aloe Gator 40 SPF on a 5-day backpacking trip in the West MacDonnell Ranges of the Northern Territory in Australia. We only applied a thick coat once a day, first thing in the morning before hiking, and even though it was sunny all day every day, we never got burned once. In addition, it wasn't greasy and rarely ran into our eyes even though we were sweating. I was super-impressed as it's hard to find good sunblock that doesn't run into your eyes when you sweat or that goes on without being greasy. And I still can't get over the fact that we only had to put it on once a day.    In addition to using it for our trip to the West MacDonnel Ranges, I have used it on and off since and it's always worked great.    That being said, I did read some complaints on REI's website by a bunch of customers who had problems with the container bursting on them (at the seams at the end of the tube) and making a complete mess in their backpack. Those people seemed really upset by this poor design, and I would be too. This especially seemed to be a problem when flying as the low air pressure of the cargo hold caused it to burst. So I am certainly taking precautions in the future (either putting it in a ziploc bag or squeezing it all out into a different tube). Again, I have no experience with this but thought I would pass it on since I saw a lot about this on REI's site but don't see anything about it here ....

product_title: Kent Super Scooter
review_body: Our 5-year-old daughter had a scooter at the top of her Christmas list for months, but the bumpy, brick sidewalks in our neighborhood eat razor scooters for breakfast.  Other parents told us that after lost teeth and constant frustration, they had \\"lost\\" their razor scooters.  This scooter saved Christmas.  My daughter literally does circles around razor riders.  The brakes are a major pain.  Three bike riding adults could not get them to work, but a 5-minute trip to the bike store solved that problem.  This scooter is top notch -- hey, Kent, how about a couple color choices?

product_title: Coleman AC 120V QuickPump
review_body: I had a major issue with this device.  I ran the pump for the suggeted 15 minutes then let it rest.  I turned it on again and it quit after running less than 10 minutes.  I let it rest again.  But it never came back on.  I had to get a replacement.

product_title: Schwinn Hollywood Women's 26-Inch Cruiser Bike
review_headline: Good Bike for Considering the Price
review_body: I bought this bike for my girlfriend's 13 year-old daughter who is not comfortable with shifting gears or using hand brakes yet.  I paid $130 total with free UPS shipping and no California sales tax.  I chose this bike over the $90 Wal-Mart bikes because I was not at all impressed with their quality.    When the bike arrived, I was pleased to see that the Amazon shipper had double boxed it, preventing shipping damage.  Quality is pretty much what I expected from a bike at this price point, which is to say adequate for a casual rider, but not ideal for someone who is going to put in a lot of saddle time (no surprises here).  The only component that I would call below-par is the easily bent chain guard.  Paint quality seems good, but be aware that the bike is metallic dark green and white, not black and white as implied by the poorly lighted Amazon photo.     Assembly was easy, consisting of attaching the front wheel, handle bars, pedals, and seat.  Only a few tools are needed including 14mm and 15mm open-end wrenches, #2 Phillips screwdriver, and two metric Allen keys (don't remember the sizes); none of these tools are included.  If I have one complaint it's that the instructions are generic (not written specifically for the Hollywood model) and are not very helpful.    Despite the few quibbles, I have to say that I am pleased with the purchase.

product_title: Eureka Timberline 4 XT Adventure 9-Foot by 7-Foot Four-Person Tent
review_body: Had previously used a few low cost store brand name tents from some of the big stores like Target and Walmart. Stepping up to this tent was huge. Very sturdy, lots of room for someone who is very tall (I'm 6'4\\").  I wouldn't say it's a four person tent..four adults would be cramped.  But it works well for two and a little bit of gear.    The vestibule is a great feature, and you can add an optional rear vestibule.  This tent will keep you warm on the chilly nights, but has good ventilation for the warmer nights.  Great tent!    Super easy to set up, only takes a few minutes.  Be sure to pick up a ground mat or tarp to put under the tent to help protect the tent floor.

product_title: Bell Solar Bike Helmet
review_body:
Basic Bike Helmet that is light, easy to put on and doesn't really bother you while riding. Fits pretty snug. I haven't had to adjust it yet as it was done for me by a veteran Bike rider but it looks simple. Might suffer from wear/use on the inside but that's expected. Don't know when I'll have to replace it but it seems good enough. Can't speak of the protection it offers unless one is a physics student but I guess it's better than nothing.

product_title: Klean Kanteen Stainless Steel Water Bottles
review_body: I have owned several types of water bottles--Nalgene and Camelback--you name it, I have probably owned it.  However, after reading about the leaching and potential health hazzards, I wanted to switch to stainless steel.  I bought the 40 oz bottle. I also want to be eco-friendly. I fill it halfway with ice cubes (I love that I don't have to force the ice cubes into the opening) and the water stays nice and cold.  It's wonderful that I can fill it with the ice cubes (filled only 1/2 way)and it does not condense and create puddles and water rings on my desk. Like other reviewers have mentioned, it tastes like good ole H20 NOT metal. I do not think a nylon cover is necessary. Of course, I do live in Wisconsin so I am not a wimp if my hands get slightly cold while drinking! ;-)

product_title: JanSport T501 Superbreak Backpack - Blue/Baby Stripe
review_body: I gave this Backpack as a gift to my daughter to use a a diaper bag for her new born son. It's perfect.

product_title: The Sharper Image Digital Photo Keychain
review_headline: A novel idea; hope my exchanged one works
review_body:
I just bought this today. The first one I bought was defective, so exchanged it for another one. It was on sale for $19.99 at Beall's (retail price is overpriced at $49.99!!). It came with a standard sized CDROM disk (other comment refers to a mini disk), so I had no problem downloading the software. However, it does take forever to recharge (a minimum of 7 hours before the first use when using the USB on computer), so I am still recharging. I have no clue where to find the optional AC adapter (charging time with that claims to be only 3 hours), but it probably costs as much as the unit itself. Otherwise, everything else went smoothly...downloading from the disk and getting pictures ready to transfer to the unit. One thing...I have Windows Vista, and searching for my pictures from their pop-up window is not the same as what the video shows from the website. You will have to search on your own to see where your pictures are located on your computer. I was even relayed this information from their customer service during my \\"help me\\" phone call to them. I won't be able to upgrade my rating until my unit is fully charged. If the unit works as described, the $19.99 is a decent price for both personal use and gifts. I bought it so I wouldn't have to tote my digital camera or brag book around. The automatic resizing of pictures is a bit deceiving. It has a specific border that your pictures can fit in. It will not automatically fit your pictures into the frame, any subjects outside of the frame will be cut off. Make sure you resize your pictures with other computer software before attempting to download onto the digital keychain.
UPDATE: This one works, so I would give it 3 stars and no more. The casing feels cheap as it is plastic. However, I do like the key ring on this model much better than the chain and hook type on competitors. Picture quality is okay. Just remember, if you give this as a gift, make sure the recipient has a computer. Otherwise, the unit is useless. Hope this helps.e, the unit is useless. Hope this helps.

product_title: High Sierra Carry-On Wheeled Business Tote
review_body:
I bought one of these to carry my 17\\" Powerbook laptop and accessories around. I take it on the subway daily and it's been very reliable. It's got plenty of room inside for my laptop, charger, tablet, water bottle, extra sweater, journal, snacks (seriously!) but it's also not too big to wheel around. The handle is plenty long making wheeling it a breeze. As I am over 6' this is a priority. The shell seems durable though I haven't had it for more than a month now.

The only downside to it I've found is the wheels are a little loud. When you're walking up behind people sometimes they turn around and look at you because they think you're riding a skateboard and are going to run them over.

product_title: Petzl Zipka LED Headlamp #E44P
review_body:
I have worked at an outdoor store, where we sold this headlamp along with between 10-15 others, depending on the season. And after seeing many of these as well as it's counterpart, the Tikka, pour out of the store, this is what I have to say.
In theory, this is the perfect little light. It's great because you can use the elastic strap to strap it to the back of your hand like a futuristic flashlight, or to keep it on your head. The wire that wraps around your head is surprisingly VERY comfortable to almost all people.
However, I have a couple caveats.
Via months of experience, I have found multiple customers returning their lamps because they would intermittently turn on and off when they were bumped. In fact, mine does that...and nothing can be worse at night than you bumping into something, and finding that you no longer have any light!
Also, the light loses out on some of its functionality because of its compactness.
It has only two settings - on and off. And it only has one position. Approximately 45 degress below the horizon.
And it's not waterproof at all - they don't even include a little rubber seal!
There are other lights on the market, depending on your purpose- specifically, the PRINCETON TEC Aurora & the BLACK DIAMOND AURORA - which I also own and LOVE - which can serve you better.
For slight added weight, the Aurora has a high, low, and emergency blinking function which are useful. It also can tilt to any position. And it is also waterproof.
For the SUPER lightest weight headlamp, nothing beats the Ion. I have it in my pocket right now for a pockect flashlight. It uses hearing aid batteries which last for hours, it has two bulbs, and is SOOOO small, you won't believe it.
The Zipka and Tikka are good...but from my experience, and myself owning 5 different headlamps, there are better ones out there.

product_title: Serengeti Large Aviator Sunglasses
review_body: This is my second purchase of these glasses. As such I would continue to replace them with another pair in the future. I have a pair in each car and a spare on the shelf if I loose one.    I,m hard on my glasses and these stand up to the ware and tare.   I've had Ray Ban and these are as good or better.

product_title: iBert Safe-T Front Mounted Child Bicycle Seat
review_body: I got this for my 18mo. old boy after reading all the reviews for rear mounted seats and then came across the iBert.  It all makes so much sense to have your kid on the front.  We interact easily when he's in front without him looking at my butt the whole time if he were in the back.  I can see where he's looking and pointing and curious about things.  Incredibly easy to attach and then remove the seat with the pull of a single cotter pin. The additional weight and balance for me is barely noticeable once you get going, and I can also easily put him in and take him out on my own.  The only drawbacks for me are that I have a 12 speed Bianchi roadbike and I needed to turn the handlebars upward to make me more upright.  When I first took him out before that, my chest was bumping and pushing his head forward a little bit.  So while this solution works fine the iBert is definitely more suitable for an upright style bike like a mountain bike or a cruiser.  Additionally, my legs do brush along the sides of the seat, but again, i got used to it very quickly-it's not uncomfortable-just different.  Even with those two cons, the pros far surpassed my expectations and there is nothing better then taking a ride with your little man.

product_title: Bell Generator Bicycle Light Set
review_body: The pointed screws that are meant to screw into the brackets to provide a ground are terrible.  They are too small, what you need to do is go to the hardware store and pickup some longer pointed screws to provide the ground for the brackets, then the lights will work just fine.  Other than problem with the wrong size screws, the product was pretty easy to install and worth the whole 15 bucks I spent on it.

product_title: Wenzel Omega II/Great Falls Mummy 0-Degree Sleeping Bag with Hood (Blue, Black Charcoal, Berry)
review_body: My son took it out on his first Boy Scout campout last weekend.  Temps dropped into the mid-upper 20's.  I wasn't on the campout but he said he stayed plenty warm.  The stuff sack works great too, no more trying to roll a bag and put a strap around it...just stuff it in and pull the draw-string.  So far so good.

product_title: Topeak Dual Touch Bike Storage Stand
review_headline: So good we bought a second one!
review_body: This product has worked great in our apartment--so great, in fact, that we bought a second one to fit all of our 4 bikes in our studio apartment. I would definitely recommend this product to anyone who needs to get some space by getting their bikes off the floor and out of the way.

product_title: Crank Brothers Multi Bicycle Tool (17-Function)
review_headline: Don't get on your bike without it
review_body: Probably the most complete, compact, quality, sleek multi-tool out there. Chain tool works great. Comes with a thick blue rubber band to keep tools in place and add grip.

product_title: Topeak Dual Touch Bike Storage Stand
review_headline: Stand fell on my car too...
review_body: I installed this in my garage.  It was mounted under a stud and secure at the time of installation.  After 12 days it fell on my car and left dents and scratches.  It caused $2,100 in damage to my car.  I believe the vibration of the garage door opening and closing allowed the stand to become loose.  I would not recommend this stand to anyone.

product_title: Liquid Solutions Tea-zer Tea Tumbler
review_headline: Skip this one, save your money.
review_body:
I'll be brief: IT LEAKS.

I bought this to show off my new Primula blooming tea, and had high hopes. Unfortunately, the plasticky taste didn't quite go away with washing, and the seam of the cup leaks like crazy when you tip it. The whole point of a tumbler like this is portability. Unless you like walking everywhere with wet patches on your clothing, in your bag or in your purse, this thing is not for you.

Splurge on a better quality unit instead of wasting $15 on this hunk of drippy plastic.

product_title: HotHands Toe Warmers (40 Pair)
review_body: These are fantastic little warmers that work fast and really do last up to 5 hours. It is a simple chemical reaction (charcoal, iron powder, vermiculate) inside the packet that reacts with oxygen (air). It is very useful for immediate warm-ups when out in the cold. They are also very useful for after skiing or skating in the boots, but be warned that warming your feet can cause sweating which will make you even colder. Use them only after you are done in the snow.

product_title: Biria bicycle Basket with Bracket Black - Front Quick Release Basket, Removable, Wire Mesh Bicycle basket "Express Klick", Black
review_body: The basket was just what I needed as a GO Green item at a silent auction.  It was such a good size that it would hold anything, and it attached easily to the bicycle.

product_title: Intex Raised Downy Airbed with Built-in Electric Pump, Queen, Bed Height 22"
review_body: I was pleasantly surprised by this bed. It was very comfortable and easy to inflate. It inflated and deflated very quickly. I used sheets for a deep queen mattress and they fit well. They did not bunch or come loose during the night. I had to inflate just for a few seconds every couple nights but it did not seem to lose air during the night. I would highly recommend this air bed.

product_title: Victorinox Swiss Army Swiss Card, Translucent Sapphire
review_headline: A Great Idea, But Not Built Tough
review_body:
The plastic door for the scissors could easily break off.
By the way, the Swiss Card was advertised as 10 fuctions; but the blade was counted twice - blade & letteropener.
It has a ball point pen which is quite useful.

product_title: Kryptkeeper, 6' Cable, Keyed, Black Lock
review_headline: Be careful how you use this lock
review_body:
I got this very lock when I went to college a few years ago, because even though I knew a U-lock was more secure, I liked the convenience of the cable, and this particular cable lock seemed pretty secure. It lasted 1 month. It looked like someone used some kind of torsion cutting tool--the cable was cut perfectly cleanly, with no pinching or anything. My beloved mountain bike (and we're not talking about a discount store bike) was gone after a month at college. I had known there was some risk, but this incident pointed out just how bad that risk really was.

For a cable lock, this seems like a quality piece, and the lock component itself seems very secure. But no cable lock is very secure. I have two other Kryptonite U-locks, one basic and one older-generation New York U-lock, and they've done the job for me. This lock is decent for what it is, but only use it if your bike is in an area with NO professional bike thieves (i.e., not a college or medium to large town), or in combination with a U-lock.

product_title: Black Solar-powered LED Flashlight Keychain Pack of 2
review_body: This is a great little flashlight. It sits in the palm of your hand making it easy to put in your pocket. It has plenty of light, at least to get around at night. I actually use it for reading in the dark among other things. I also like how it has a switch instead of a button that won't stay on like in other solar key chain lights. The rubber casing actually makes it easy to hold and gives it some measure of protection.     For the price this product is more than worth it and I am betting it will save me more in the cost of this product in electrical savings alone by not having to turn on bathroom, hallway and kitchen lights in the middle of the night. I also like the fact I never have to charge it. Who has time to buy and waste batteries. Even residual light seems to do the trick.    What I do not like about the product are few. I think the color needs to go as well & the panels could be a little more slick looking. Also it seems everything these days are made in China. Besides it being not the most environmental method to ship products half way across the world China has one of the worst human rights records in the world. I bought this product because non other was like it and I figure the overall benefits outweighed the negatives.

product_title: Bell Metropolis Bike Helmet
review_body: I give this 4 stars because 5 would entail perfection and since nothing is perfect, this helmet is about as close as you can get.

product_title: Polar Bottle Insulated Water Bottle - 24oz
review_body: We bought this for my son who drinks a ton of water and is always putting ice in his bottle.  Now he still puts ice in, but this bottle has kept not only the water cold but the ice has remained.

product_title: Deluxe Rio Aluminum Backpack Chair with Large Storage Pouch
review_body:
At first, when I took it out of the packaging I thought, \\"This chair looks to low to the ground. It definitely isn't 10+ inches.\\" Well, even though I am still not sure if it is 10 inches high, I have to say it is one of the most comfortable chairs I've ever sat in.

I went hiking with it and found a beautiful prairie in the middle of some trees. I had used the chair to carry my food, books, MP3 player & headphones, and drink bottle. I opened the chair without much difficulty and was soon engrossed in a book. I actually fell asleep without meaning to, the chair was so comfortable. The height didn't affect my comfort level at all.

The \\"knapsack\\" made a little too much noise while I was hiking (like clanking), but I bet I could have made it quieter by using cloth strategically. It was comfortable on my back, too. The space it created was big enough to carry a great many things. All in all, it is a wonderful hiking companion.

product_title: Brunton 9077 Compass
review_body: construction is ok, illumination is not that useful. damping may be too much (not sure)

product_title: Crazy Creek Stadium Chair
review_body: The chair does what it's suppose to but if you can get the long back chair it's more comfy.

product_title: Bell Adrenaline Bike Helmet
review_body: Bell Adrenaline is a value for its comfort, fashion and meets US Consumer Product Safety Commission guidelines. Backed by a $20 crash replacement (save your receipt), its an unbeatable deal!    Adrenaline does not let my head get unbearably hot and sweaty with its averagely sized vents. If you're riding around in Nevada with hundred degree plus weather, or a weekend warrior who is going absolutely all-out, look elsewhere. Otherwise, commuters, leisure and trail riders will be satisfied.    Just don't expect a helmet that feels like you're 'not wearing' a helmet - the vents are definitely not of the higher end.     The strapping design fits well around my head (Size 7 1/4), and with proper fit, can sit slightly above your head to allow airflow from back to front. Plus! The helmet does not rattle AT ALL when moving your head back and forth. All this is done by the plastic suspension system fits the crown of your head and allows the helmet to sit slightly above your head while completely secure.    The suspension is a design I have seen done effectively in Firefighter Helmets and some military Kevlars. The beauty about adjustment of the Adrenaline suspension system is that it can be done one-handed with a plastic hold-release mechanism while still on your head, instead of having to remove the helmet and move around the Velcro on military or firefighter helmets.    The straps are more of a minor compliment to make sure it doesn't fall off from being lifted or thrown off. The straps are thin, but the buckle is curved for your chin. If the suspension is fitted snugly, you could almost get away without wearing the straps and feel comfortable.     The pads are thin and few in number, but I see this as an advantage as it won't retain as much heat and sweat as larger pads.     Adrenaline's design mimics higher end designs with a quasi-tear drop design. The carbon-fiber pattern and the long lines racing across makes it stand out nicely from the rest of the pack. The generallyround shape is found to be the safest design, and this accommodates it well without looking like a child's helmet.    The visor leaves plenty to be desired - with the visor sitting about an inch higher than being flush with the bottom edge, it does little to block the sun. It appears the visor is more for fashion and design than efficacy.     Having said all that, my experience with helmets is slightly different from most. I'm accustomed to wearing firefighter or military helmets where I often had to operate in extreme heat conditions under helmets without ventilation! I wore 50lbs of gear, a no-vent Kevlar helmet on foot patrols in Iraq when it was 140 degrees outside.    All said, even with my experience in helmets, if you're looking for a good looking helmet with good accommodations for comfort while retaining safety, this is an excellent deal for its price!

product_title: NEBO Sports Behemoth +5°F Sleeping Bag (King Size)
review_body: My husband and I love this sleeping bag! It's huge, takes up a lot of space and is heavy - things that might affect the star rating if we didn't love it so much. We've taken this bag out twice in temperatures that dropped into the upper 20's and though I am a \\"cold sleeper\\", we both stayed toasty warm. My head got a little cold and I hadn't thought to use the mummy drawstring feature, but with a knit cap I stayed warm enough. We had two twin sized mattresses zipped and hooked together and this bag actually drapes over each side. One of the great things about it is this bag is perfect for restless sleepers. Tossing and turning several times in the night didn't disturb my husband's sleep at all. It's the perfect size to lay across both a Queen size mattress and a Twin size mattress. My husband, teenage daughter and myself can all sleep in great comfort in just one sleeping bag. I highly recommend this sleeping bag for those without space/weight considerations.

product_title: ECOnscious Men's 80% Organic Cotton 20% Polyester Fleece Zip Hoody
review_body: I bought this sweatshirt to get screen printed for my \\"green\\" business. It looks fantastic and it's very soft & comfortable!

product_title: THULE 955 No Sway Cage Hitch
review_body: This is a simple addition to a trailer hitch that really works. The package contains two which is enough for two bikes.

product_title: Razor A2 Kick Scooter
review_body: Excellent quality.  Just what we were expecting.  My 6 and 9 year old boys love their scooters.

product_title: High Sierra Crush Backpack
review_body:
I have one of these, that I bought three years ago.

It's has been my faithful partner for all my travel.

Most of the bag is still in perfect stage, except for;
Orange accents are decolorated (the bag has faced the washing machine at least five times).
The zippers do not zip as easy as they used to. The orange, diagonal one, in particular, got stuck two months ago (that's after about 900 zips and unzips)
One of the lower belts (the pair that is under the bag) broke about two years ago, when I was back packing Canada. [it was not meant to support serious weight]

Other than that, this bag was build to last.
I use it to carry my laptop every day.
And every night it carries my sport clothes.
And on weekends it carries water bottles, gatorade, and whatever I need to go hiking.
[hint, it becomes more comfortable to wear for extended period, if the belt travels diagonally tru all the chest from one shoulder, to the opposite hip]

The local store, that use to have them, brought this one (just one) as a sample.
I am so glad I bought it.

Tonight I am looking to buy another one, and retire my old one with honors.

Great bag, IMHO.

product_title: YayLabs Play and Freeze Ice Cream Ball Ice Cream Maker
review_body: We had a family camp out with our church family with many kids this ball was the absolute hit of the entire camping trip.  We have the large one that make enough for about 6 small bowls (two scoops) of ice-cream per each \\"session\\".  We got to the camp site with all the hills, the kids rolled it up and down the hills while we set up camp.  When we were done we had ice-cream!  We added in coffee creamers for the variety of ice-creams...all in all we had 6 different kinds of ice-cream that everyone old andyoung enjoyed....PLUS the kids were passed out early from being tired from making ice cream.. The anticpation as to when the ice cream would be done was AMAZING.. We use the very simple recipe: 1 pint 1/2 and 1/2 with 3/4 sugar, then added power coffee creamer..then they were off.  Only down fall is remind them to come back to scrap the sides .... but honestly it made sure we keep them close to camp.ENJOY!

product_title: Dora the Explorer Jr. Skate Combo in Vinyl Bag (Junior Size 6 - 9)
review_body: The skates are great, the pads are great, the bag is worthless.  My three-year-old is still too young for this, but she'll love it next year.

product_title: Croozer Designs 737 Single Child 3 in 1 Bicycle Trailer, Swivel Wheel, and Fixed Wheel Stroller (Green/Sand/Black
review_body: Bought this trailer for my son for his 3rd birthday... wish I would have known about these on his 1st birthday.  He'll probably only be in it for a year or so, but for as much fun as he has in it, it was still a great purchase.

product_title: Victorinox Swiss Army Cigar Knife
review_headline: The new cigar smoke in my life
review_body: I bought this for the new cigar smoker in my life who also recently lost his swiss army knife. What a perfect gift! He loves that there are three sizes for the unch and admits that the blades are very sharp. He also likes the fact that this also replaces his swiss army knife without really sacrificing annything. He constantly shows it off at the cigar shop, cigar events, and work. He loves it and so I love it.

product_title: InStep Quick N EZ Bicycle Trailer
review_body: Although I didn't find this on sale it is still a good deal for regular price. Set up is an absolute breeze. Even attaching the coupler to my bike, after some muscle from hubby to get the nut off, was simple and quick. I feel very confident of the hitch as I ride and the kids are secure in the harness. It folds easily and the wheels detach simply to fit in the cargo space of our mid-size SUV. I'm a recreational/fitness biker and use this on very nice paved trails not off-road so I can't comment on bumps or dirt.        It gets a 4 rather than a 5 only on some comfort issues. The web straps would be better if padded. I have to watch the crotch strap on my 20 month-old or it can ride up and cut into her leg, particularly if she has a big wet diaper. Same with my 4 year old with the shoulder strap and his neck. I'll figure something out though. Also if it is going to be made to hold up to 100 pounds it really could be just a couple of inches wider to give room to bigger kids. Two kids are sort of smushed. The sling seats also could be made to recline. I had a jogging stoller with that feature. Lastly, since I live in FL, I would prefer a longer hood or some sort of brim for more shade.        Having complained, I WOULD STILL RECOMMEND HIGHLY for quality and value and fun. The kids do enjoy it despite my nit-picking!

product_title: Trails Illustrated Map White Mountains National Forest, West
review_headline: New version improves on already-good product.
review_body:
This map is part of the Trails Illustrated series covering many national parks. These are all sturdy and convenient.

Your map choices are essentially this one, the National Park Service map, and USGS topos. The NPS map is fine if you're staying at Rock Harbor Lodge and doing light day activities from that base.

If you're backpacking, or doing long day hikes, the Trails Illustrated map is absolutely essential because the USGS topographic maps are outdated. For example, the topo shows a no-longer-existent East Feldtmann trail on the southwest part of the island. In addition, you'd need a lot of topos because the island lies diagonally across them.

The topo also shows inaccurately the trail that goes over White Oak Ridge in the same area. The Trails Illustrated map shows the trails correctly.

This map also shows (1) group and individual campsites and (2) distances between trail junctions that accord with the NPS signage. Both features make it useful for planning your trip.

This is an improvement on the preceding map because Trails Illustrated split the island in half to show more detail. The division occurs at the Todd Harbor - - Siskiwit Lake - - Malone Bay line, which is a good dividing place as that line doesn't break any trail up more than once. Also, the designers included lots of overlap, so that Siskiwit Lake, the largest lake on the largest island on the largest lake in the world, is included in its entirety on one side and its near-entirety on the other. As a result, the map stays useful.

Finally, the designers have included depth soundings off shore, along with lots of disingenuous warnings not to use the map for navigation. It's interesting to watch the depth markers when aboard the Voyageur II around the island, and I *suspect* that there's enough information here for sea kayakers but not for larger craft.

In short, the map is essential for any visit, and its production values are excellent.

product_title: Topeak DeFender FX Bicycle Fender
review_body: Glad I bought this one...  have a full suspension mtb to commute to work and it is very effective at shielding mud and water. Made my cycling communte much more pleasant.  It also looks very cool.. my mtb now looks like a motorcrossbike. Amazon is also quick to ship as usual.

product_title: Rand Batman Dark Knight 16-Inch Kids' Bike
review_body: I received this item promptly and it arrived in perfect condition. It was very well packed and padded.  It was exactly as indicted in the ad.

product_title: 25 Compass Rose Geocoin Geotokens Geocoins
review_headline: Forget leaving "McSwag" items and get some of these!
review_body:
If you are into geocaching you know the delight of opening a cache and finding something really cool in it (besides trackables, which are always welcomed). You also know the disappointment of finding only moldy fast food toys, or, ever worst, nothing.

I own over 200 trackables and all are either \\"in-the-wild\\" or heading there. Yet sometimes I like to leave a nice little charm or memento that the finder can keep if they chose to (O-K, some cachers keep my geocoins, but whatta-ya-gonna-do?). That's where these neat little tokens come in.

For about $1 a piece you can leave a really beautiful gift for the next cacher. Imagine how a child would feel when they get to keep this shiny, colorful metal coin. Plus, if we are to live up to the geocacher's code of leaving each cache better off than when we found it, we all should really need good, affordable swag (these are the right size for film-canister sized micros by the way).

These look much nicer in person than they do in the original photo. They have a clear gloss coating and have a nice, weighty feel to them. The colors are also bright and attractive. I bought 20 and will buy more as soon as these are gone. Great item!

product_title: Coleman 2000016402 5PC ALU Mess Kit
review_body: It's exactly as advertised.  Will work for one person. I wish it were a little more sturdy though.

product_title: Victorinox Swiss Army Golf Tool With Callaway Golf Balls
review_body: The recipient for this gift was a golfer who has it all.  He didn't have this tool though and thought it was really great!  Wish I had someone else to buy this for.

product_title: Coleman Two-Burner Power Pack Stove
review_body: We received our stove today and are very happy.  It arrived in record time.  It is larger than we thought it would be and is a new modern design.  We were surprised to see that ours arrived with a full size griddle as a bonus.  We bought ours on the daily deal special for $79...great buy!  Thanks Amazon!

product_title: Fuzion Asphalt Ultimate Carving Machine Scooter
review_body: Ordered the scooter for my grandson.  When he opened it and we were putting it together, we found the fasteners that hold the wheels to the axels were not included in the box.  It proved a big dissapointment since it was a holiday and no hardware stores were open to purchase the proper fasteners.

product_title: Stanley Stainless Steel Vacuum Bottle (0.5 Qt)
review_body: I carry my tea or other drink to school in this regularly. It's also great for making drinks at home, because you can forget about your tea or coffee for a half an hour, even uncapped, and it'll stay quite hot. The size is a little large because of the dual-layer insulation, but that makes it work better so it's an acceptable tradeoff.

product_title: Delta Botticelli Four Bike Storage Rack
review_body: It was less than 15 minutes and I had it completely assembled.  It has been a great help going vertical.  It is good for lighter bikes.  If you have a very heavy mountain bike that weighs close to 30-35 lbs, it may not be the best option for you.  Road bike, commuter bikes, no problem.

product_title: Wald Lift-Off Basket
review_body: The baskets are specifically for usage on the front of a bike, hung over the front of the handlebar. I bought and modified them to be used with a rack on the rear of a bike, but I would not suggest this to others unless you have a little 'McGuiver', time and tools handy. As far as the intended use of this item, I strongly believe that you cannot find a better device to hold what you need to safely carry on your bike: excellent product and price!

product_title: Cruzin Cooler 50-Series 500-Watt Electric Scooter
review_body: This is my 3rd Cruzin' Cooler in addition to the Coolagon (trailer).  I got them for me and my grandkids- we all think they're cool.  Unfortunately, the axle nuts, seat back, and front fork tend to work loose and fall off quite often.  Keep the tool kit handy and check every nut and bolt often.  Also, the cooler I ordered from the mfg's web site came with batteries that were bad after just 3 months.  I got replacements from Batteries Plus for about $10.00 more apiece than the originals and they run about 30% longer than the other good ones I have.  Everybody we see with them are fascinated...it's sort of like carrying a newborn with you- they really are fun.

product_title: Mountain House Beef Stroganoff with Noodles
review_body: I have been eating freeze dried foods for many years as I hiked the Appalachian Trail, the Long Trail and the Colorado Trail.  There are some I like and some that I do not.  I am now at the point where I only buy ones I have tried and like.  This is one of my favorites.  I should add that there are Beef Stroganoff entries and there are Beef Stroganoff entries with Noodles.  I prefer the latter.

product_title: Razor Dune Buggy
review_headline: Love this buggy -- individual readiness is key...
review_body: Perfect gift, right out of the box, for my 'big' 5 year old.  He has been riding bikes and Razor scooters hard for awhile now and seems to acquired some helpful skills including very good coordination, steering, balance and respect for 'hitting the asphalt' -- I was confident he could handle this buggy.  Rules of the pavement (and sometimes grass) at our house:  adult supervision, limited distractions, helmet and seat belt.  We have a long, paved driveway and live on a very lightly traveled culdesac -- it's perfect for us!  Great quality too!

product_title: Prospector Moonshadow 8- by 8-Foot Dome Tent
review_body: I have used the tent on two weekend camping trips. Both times it rained and the tent leaked. Out of the box, it leaked through the rainfly. This was fixed with seam sealer. The bigger issue is the leaking where the sides meet the bottom. The bottom overlaps the sides and forms a small channel which collects water and allows water to enter the tent.

product_title: Insta-Bed Queen Raised Air Mattress with Sure Grip Bottom & Built-In Pump
review_headline: Inflates fast, needs a matress top.
review_body: Good product, I'm happy with it. Will put a mattress top on though, to increase comfort.

product_title: Princeton Tec Corona 8 LED Headlamp
review_body:
I use the Corona as a bike light. I put it on me bike helmet and it brights the path ahead about 70 or 80 feet (relective signs and license plates stand out nicely)

Since it is LED the batteries don't go south near as quick as a conventional light, and having your light on your head is a real advantage on a bike, checking your chain, or seeing something off to the side is as easy as turning your head.

It was worth the price, especially using rechargable batteries.

product_title: OnGuard Mastiff 5020 Bicycle Chain Lock
review_body: i like the fact that this is one piece, not a separate chain and lock, unlike the kryptonite NY lock that i used to own.  this thing weighs a ton and looks aggressive (especially when locked to a bicycle).  price point is very good.  so far no problems with the locking and unlocking.

product_title: Native Eyewear Dash SS Sunglasses
review_body: This will be the second pair of the Native Dash SS I have owned. I purchased these to have a second set for when I returned my first pair to Native for warranty service.    The glasses have been excellent. The only problem I have had is that the lens coating scratches easily. The glasses are light weight, comfortable and easy to wear. They take a little to adjust to your face, but once that is accomplished I forget I am wearing them.

product_title: Slumberjack Big Easy Mesh Quad Lounger
review_body:
I was pleased with this chair when it first arrived at the beginning of summer. It was big and comfy. Here is the problem I had with it: It begins with noting that the footrest can be removed. To do this you unscrew the footrest legs from the main chair. That's easy BUT the connection is all plastic. By the end of summer, the plastic had cracked. The crack also affected the main legs of the chair, one of them broke when the plastic cracked. The chair is now unusable and I tossed the whole mess in the garbage. It lasted one season. I didn't realize it was a disposable chair!

I wish the manufacturer had used metal construction for the connection \\"joints\\"....then I would give it 5 stars!

product_title: eGear Dynamo 5 LED Light with Radio
review_body: This flashlight-cum-radio, etc., has all the bells and whicstles it says it does. Only two caveats: 1. There is no adapter cord included to plug into a regular wall socket to recharge it, and I still haven't been able to find one; 2. Five minutes of vigorous hand cranking will get you about 45 seconds of decent flash light OR radio. A nice project for the kids to keep them busy during the next hurricane maybe, but without batteries or a convenient way to charge it up beforehand it's usefulness is a toss up. Great idea, and I still keep mine handy, but I will really need to be in a desperate situation before it is worth the work to make it operate. It does come with an charge cord for a car cigarette lighter, so maybe it would be more useful there, until the battery gives out.
